--!strict

-- In-memory state with a single write path. Every change runs as a transaction that lands whole
-- or not at all, and each landed change produces a commit record for listeners.
-- Profiles and shared stores wrap a document and add persistence

local Path = require("./Path")
local Transaction = require("./Transaction")
local Tree = require("./Tree")
local Types = require("../Quartz/Types")

type Path = Path.Path
type PathLike = Path.PathLike
type Transaction = Transaction.Transaction

export type DiffEntry = Tree.DiffEntry

export type CommitRecord = {
	revision: number,
	source: Transaction.Source,
	ops: { Transaction.OpCall },
	diff: { [string]: DiffEntry },
	timestamp: number,
	note: string?,
}

export type TxResult =
	{ ok: true, record: CommitRecord?, dryRun: DryRun? }
	| { ok: false, error: Transaction.TxError }

-- What a dry run found: the paths it would change and what stages such as guards reported
export type DryRun = {
	paths: { string },
	findings: { unknown },
}

export type TransactOptions = {
	source: Transaction.SourceLike?,
	note: string?,
	-- run the body and every stage, then throw the draft away. Nothing commits, no listener or
	-- deferred callback runs, and stages report what they found instead of acting on it
	dryRun: boolean?,
}

-- Runs after the transaction body and before commit. It may change the draft or reject the whole
-- transaction by throwing. Guards, bundles and reactions plug in here
export type Stage = (tx: Transaction) -> ()

export type Options = {
	data: unknown?,
	revision: number?,
	ops: { string }?,
	stages: { Stage }?,
	clock: Types.Clock?,
	-- Where listener errors go. Defaults to warn
	reportError: ((message: string) -> ())?,
	-- Hold deferred callbacks until `runHeld` instead of running them after each transaction.
	-- For callers that may throw away a transaction that already committed here, e.g. a write
	-- UpdateAsync retries
	holdDeferred: boolean?,
}

type Held = {
	callbacks: { (outcome: Transaction.Outcome) -> () },
	outcome: Transaction.Outcome,
}

export type Observer = (new: unknown, old: unknown, record: CommitRecord) -> ()

-- Computed from stored state. Reads like data, but is never written or saved
type Derived = {
	name: string,
	deps: { Path },
	read: (root: unknown) -> unknown,
}

type Listener = {
	path: Path?,
	callback: (...any) -> (),
	connected: boolean,
}

type Fields = {
	_root: unknown,
	_revision: number,
	_allowed: { [string]: boolean },
	_stages: { Stage },
	_clock: Types.Clock?,
	_reportError: (message: string) -> (),
	_observers: { Listener },
	_commitListeners: { Listener },
	_busy: boolean,
	_readOnly: string?,
	_derived: { [string]: Derived },
	_holdDeferred: boolean,
	_held: { Held },
}

--[=[
	@class Document

	In-memory state with the full transaction pipeline. Profiles and shared stores are built on it,
	and `Geode.Raw.document` makes a bare one
]=]
local Document = {}
Document.__index = Document

export type Document = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Fields, Document))

--[=[
	Creates a document holding a frozen copy of `options.data`

	@within Document
	@param options DocumentOptions?
	@return Document
]=]
function Document.new(options: Options?): Document
	local allowed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local ops: { string } = if options and options.ops then options.ops else {}
	for _, name in ops do
		allowed[name] = true
	end
	local self: Fields = {
		_root = Tree.adopt(if options and options.data ~= nil then options.data else {}),
		_revision = options and options.revision or 0,
		_allowed = allowed,
		_stages = if options and options.stages then table.clone(options.stages) else {},
		_clock = options and options.clock,
		_reportError = options and options.reportError or function(message: string)
			warn(message)
		end,
		_observers = {},
		_commitListeners = {},
		_busy = false,
		_readOnly = nil,
		_derived = {},
		_holdDeferred = options ~= nil and options.holdDeferred == true,
		_held = {},
	}
	return setmetatable(self, Document)
end

-- Reading

--[=[
	The frozen value at a path, or the whole state with no path
]=]
function Document.get(self: Document, path: PathLike?): unknown
	local parsed = Path.parse(path)
	local derived = self:_derivedAt(parsed)
	if derived then
		return Tree.get(derived.read(self._root), table.move(parsed, 2, #parsed, 1, {}))
	end
	return Tree.get(self._root, parsed)
end

function Document._derivedAt(self: Document, path: Path): Derived?
	local first = path[1]
	return if type(first) == "string" then self._derived[first] else nil
end

--[=[
	Adds a top level field computed from `deps`. Reads like any other field through `get` and
	`observe`, but it can't be written and isn't in the snapshot. The name can't clash with a
	stored field
]=]
function Document.addDerived(
	self: Document,
	name: string,
	deps: { PathLike },
	read: (root: unknown) -> unknown
)
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "a derived field needs a name")
	assert(self._derived[name] == nil, `a derived field named {name} already exists`)
	assert(
		Tree.get(self._root, { name }) == nil,
		`derived field {name} clashes with a stored field of the same name`
	)
	local parsed = {}
	for _, dep in deps do
		table.insert(parsed, Path.parse(dep))
	end
	self._derived[name] = { name = name, deps = parsed, read = read }
end

--[=[
	The whole state, frozen
]=]
function Document.snapshot(self: Document): unknown
	return self._root
end

--[=[
	How many commits so far. A transaction that changed nothing doesn't count
]=]
function Document.revision(self: Document): number
	return self._revision
end

--// writing

--[=[
	Refuses every transaction from now on, with `reason` as the error. For stores that can't
	save anymore, like a profile that lost its session
]=]
function Document.setReadOnly(self: Document, reason: string)
	self._readOnly = reason
end

--[=[
	Accepts transactions again after setReadOnly
]=]
function Document.clearReadOnly(self: Document)
	self._readOnly = nil
end

--[=[
	Whether writes are refused right now

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.isReadOnly(self: Document): boolean
	return self._readOnly ~= nil
end

--[=[
	Adds a stage that runs on every transaction before it commits
]=]
function Document.addStage(self: Document, stage: Stage)
	table.insert(self._stages, stage)
end

local function failure(kind: Transaction.TxErrorKind, message: string): TxResult
	return { ok = false, error = { kind = kind, message = message } }
end

--[=[
	Runs `body` against a draft and commits the result. Anything thrown inside discards the draft
	and comes back as an error. A transaction that changes nothing commits nothing

	@param body (tx: Transaction) -> ()
	@param options TransactOptions?
	@return TxResult

	```lua
	local result = document:transact(function(tx)
		tx:decrement("coins", 100)
		tx:append("inventory", { id = "sword" })
	end, { source = "system", note = "shop purchase" })
	```
]=]
function Document.transact(
	self: Document,
	body: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
	options: TransactOptions?
): TxResult
	if self._readOnly then
		return failure("readOnly", self._readOnly)
	end
	if self._busy then
		return failure("busy", "another transaction is still running on this document")
	end

	local source = Transaction.source(options and options.source)
	local tx = Transaction.new(self._root, source, self._allowed)
	local dryRun = options ~= nil and options.dryRun == true
	tx._dryRun = dryRun
	self._busy = true
	local ok, thrown = pcall(function()
		body(tx)
		for _, stage in self._stages do
			stage(tx)
		end
	end)
	self._busy = false
	tx:_close()
	if not ok then
		local err = Transaction.toError(thrown)
		self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = err })
		return { ok = false, error = err }
	end

	local entries = Tree.diff(self._root, tx._root)
	for _, entry in entries do
		local derived = self:_derivedAt(entry.path)
		if derived then
			local err: Transaction.TxError = {
				kind = "rejected",
				message = `{derived.name} is a derived field and can't be written`,
			}
			self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = err })
			return { ok = false, error = err }
		end
	end
	if dryRun then
		local paths = {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			table.insert(paths, Path.format(entry.path))
		end
		table.sort(paths)
		return { ok = true, record = nil, dryRun = { paths = paths, findings = tx._findings } }
	end
	if #entries == 0 then
		self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = nil })
		return { ok = true, record = nil }
	end

	local diff: { [string]: DiffEntry } = {}
	for _, entry in entries do
		diff[Path.format(entry.path)] = table.freeze({
			path = table.freeze(entry.path),
			old = entry.old,
			new = entry.new,
		})
	end

	local previous = self._root
	self._root = tx._root
	self._revision += 1
	local record: CommitRecord = table.freeze({
		revision = self._revision,
		source = source,
		ops = table.freeze(tx._ops),
		diff = table.freeze(diff),
		timestamp = if self._clock then self._clock:now() else os.time(),
		note = options and options.note,
	})
	self:_notify(previous, entries, record)
	self:_settle(tx, { committed = true, record = record, error = nil })
	return { ok = true, record = record }
end

-- Runs what stages deferred. After listeners, so a deferred write sees committed state
function Document._settle(self: Document, tx: Transaction, outcome: Transaction.Outcome)
	if self._holdDeferred then
		table.insert(self._held, { callbacks = table.clone(tx._deferred), outcome = outcome })
		return
	end
	self:_runDeferred(tx._deferred, outcome)
end

function Document._runDeferred(
	self: Document,
	callbacks: { (outcome: Transaction.Outcome) -> () },
	outcome: Transaction.Outcome
)
	for _, callback in callbacks do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			callback(outcome)
		end)
		if not ok then
			self._reportError(`deferred callback error: {tostring(err)}`)
		end
	end
end

--[=[
	Runs the callbacks a `holdDeferred` document kept, oldest first. `outcome` overrides the one
	they were held with, for a transaction that committed here and was then thrown away
]=]
function Document.runHeld(self: Document, outcome: Transaction.Outcome?)
	local held = self._held
	self._held = {}
	for _, entry in held do
		self:_runDeferred(entry.callbacks, outcome or entry.outcome)
	end
end

--[=[
	Sets `path` to `value` as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.set(self: Document, path: PathLike, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:set(path, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Replaces the value at `path` with what `transform` returns, as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.update(
	self: Document,
	path: PathLike,
	transform: (current: unknown) -> unknown
): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:update(path, transform)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Adds `amount`, 1 by default, to the number at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.increment(self: Document, path: PathLike, amount: number?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:increment(path, amount)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Subtracts `amount`, 1 by default, from the number at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.decrement(self: Document, path: PathLike, amount: number?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:decrement(path, amount)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Adds `value` to the end of the list at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.append(self: Document, path: PathLike, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:append(path, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Inserts `value` into the list at `path` at `index`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.insert(self: Document, path: PathLike, index: number, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:insert(path, index, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Removes the value at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.remove(self: Document, path: PathLike): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:remove(path)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Empties the table at `path`, or everything with no path

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.clear(self: Document, path: PathLike?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:clear(path)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Copies the fields of `partial` into the table at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.merge(self: Document, path: PathLike?, partial: { [string]: unknown }): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:merge(path, partial)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Runs the custom op `name` with the given arguments as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.op(self: Document, name: string, ...: any): TxResult
	local args = table.pack(...)
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:op(name, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end)
end

-- Listening

local function connect(list: { Listener }, listener: Listener): Types.Connection
	table.insert(list, listener)
	return {
		disconnect = function()
			listener.connected = false
			local index = table.find(list, listener)
			if index then
				table.remove(list, index)
			end
		end,
	}
end

--[=[
	Calls `callback` after every commit that changed the value at `path`, with the new and old
	values. Changes inside the value and replacements of a parent both count

	@return Connection
]=]
function Document.observe(self: Document, path: PathLike, callback: Observer): Types.Connection
	return connect(self._observers, {
		path = Path.parse(path),
		callback = callback,
		connected = true,
	})
end

--[=[
	Calls `callback` with the record of every commit
]=]
function Document.onCommit(self: Document, callback: (record: CommitRecord) -> ()): Types.Connection
	return connect(self._commitListeners, {
		path = nil,
		callback = callback,
		connected = true,
	})
end

function Document._call(self: Document, listener: Listener, ...: any)
	local args = table.pack(...)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		listener.callback(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end)
	if not ok then
		self._reportError(`listener error: {tostring(err)}`)
	end
end

-- Observers run first, then commit listeners, each group in the order it connected. A copy of each
-- list is walked so listeners can connect or disconnect while being called
function Document._notify(
	self: Document,
	previous: unknown,
	entries: { DiffEntry },
	record: CommitRecord
)
	for _, observer in table.clone(self._observers) do
		if not observer.connected then
			continue
		end
		local path = observer.path :: Path
		local derived = self:_derivedAt(path)
		local watched: { Path } = if derived then derived.deps else { path }
		local touched = false
		for _, entry in entries do
			for _, watchedPath in watched do
				if Path.related(entry.path, watchedPath) then
					touched = true
					break
				end
			end
			if touched then
				break
			end
		end
		if not touched then
			continue
		end
		if derived then
			local rest = table.move(path, 2, #path, 1, {})
			local old = Tree.get(derived.read(previous), rest)
			local new = Tree.get(derived.read(self._root), rest)
			if not Tree.equal(old, new) then
				self:_call(observer, new, old, record)
			end
		else
			local old = Tree.get(previous, path)
			local new = Tree.get(self._root, path)
			if old ~= new then
				self:_call(observer, new, old, record)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, listener in table.clone(self._commitListeners) do
		if listener.connected then
			self:_call(listener, record)
		end
	end
end

return Document

--!strict
-- Every part tagged "ConstellaSpinner" spins. Tag more parts in Studio
-- (Tag Editor / Properties > Tags) while playing and they start spinning too.
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Component =
	require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("Component"))

local Spinner = {
	Tag = "ConstellaSpinner",
	Filter = function(instance: Instance)
		return instance:IsA("BasePart")
	end,
}

function Spinner:Start()
	local part = self.Instance :: BasePart
	self.Cleanup:Connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime: number)
		part.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, deltaTime * 2, 0)
	end)
end

function Spinner:Stop()
	print("[Component] stopped spinning", self.Instance:GetFullName())
end

local spinners = Component.new(Spinner)
spinners.Added:Connect(function(object)
	print("[Component] spinning", object.Instance:GetFullName())
end)
spinners:Run()

-- Create a demo part, then untag it after 3 seconds.
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "SpinnerDemo"
part.Anchored = true
part.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
part.Position = Vector3.new(-12, 3, 20)
part.Parent = workspace
CollectionService:AddTag(part, Spinner.Tag)

task.delay(3, function()
	CollectionService:RemoveTag(part, Spinner.Tag) -- Stop runs, Heartbeat connection is cleaned
end)

-- Sound's methods, events and property rules: where Play starts, what
-- Stop, Pause and Resume do in each state, ends, loops and seeks.
local s = Instance.new("Sound")
s.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/action_falling.ogg" -- 10 s
-- Whether Loaded comes before or after a Play right after parenting
-- depends on Studio's cache, so it's only checked to have fired.
local loaded
s.Loaded:Connect(function(id)
    loaded = id
end)
local function near(x, target)
    return math.abs(x - target) < 0.12
end
local function state(tag)
    log(tag, s.Playing, s.IsPlaying, s.IsPaused)
end

s.Parent = workspace
for _ = 1, 100 do
    if s.IsLoaded then
        break
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
end
log("Loaded fired with", loaded)
for _, name in { "Played", "Paused", "Resumed", "Stopped", "Ended", "Loaded", "DidLoop" } do
    s[name]:Connect(function(...)
        log("event", name, ...)
    end)
end
state("before Play")
s:Play()
state("played")
task.wait(0.5)
log("time advances", near(s.TimePosition, 0.5))

-- Play while playing restarts, without Played.
s:Play()
log("restart", near(s.TimePosition, 0))
task.wait(0.5)

-- Pause keeps the place; Pause again and Stop on a paused sound do nothing.
s:Pause()
local paused = s.TimePosition
state("paused")
s:Pause()
s:Stop()
log("stop while paused keeps place", s.TimePosition == paused)
s:Resume()
log("resume from place", near(s.TimePosition, paused))
s:Resume()

-- Play starts where a script last set TimePosition, even after Pause.
s.TimePosition = 3
task.wait(0.3)
s:Pause()
s:Play()
log("play from last set", near(s.TimePosition, 3))
s:Stop()
state("stopped")
log("stop rewinds", s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
log("play after stop", near(s.TimePosition, 0))

-- Setting Playing directly fires no events and keeps the place.
task.wait(0.3)
s.Playing = false
local t = s.TimePosition
s.Playing = true
log("Playing set directly", near(s.TimePosition, t))

-- A seek past the end ends it; a negative one plays from the start.
s.TimePosition = 20
task.wait(0.2)
log("seek past end", s.Playing, s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
s.TimePosition = -1
log("negative reads", s.TimePosition)
task.wait(0.3)
log("negative plays from 0", near(s.TimePosition, 0.3))

-- The end: Ended, stopped and rewound; Play then starts where a script
-- last set the position.
s.TimePosition = 9.7
task.wait(0.6)
log("ended", s.Playing, s.TimePosition)
s:Play()
log("play after end", near(s.TimePosition, 9.7))
s:Stop()

-- Looped: DidLoop instead of Ended.
s.Looped = true
s.TimePosition = 9.8
s:Play()
task.wait(0.5)
log("looped", s.Playing, near(s.TimePosition, 0.3))
s.Looped = false
s:Stop()

-- PlaybackSpeed scales time; Volume and PlaybackSpeed are clamped.
s.PlaybackSpeed = 2
s.TimePosition = 1
s:Play()
task.wait(1)
-- Twice as far as the 1 s waited (wait overshoots, doubled here).
log("double speed", s.TimePosition > 2.8 and s.TimePosition < 3.3)
s:Stop()
for _, v in { -1, 25, math.huge } do
    s.PlaybackSpeed = v
    log("PlaybackSpeed", v, s.PlaybackSpeed, s.Pitch)
end
for _, v in { -1, 11 } do
    s.Volume = v
    log("Volume", v, s.Volume)
end
log("server PlaybackLoudness", s.PlaybackLoudness)
s:Destroy()

	end)

--!strict
-- Fires pooled projectiles: parts are reused instead of created and destroyed.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Pool = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("Pool"))

local template = Instance.new("Part")
template.Name = "PooledBullet"
template.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 2)
template.Anchored = true
template.CanCollide = false
template.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60)

local bullets = Pool.instances(template, {
	MaxIdle = 16, -- keep at most 16 spare bullets
	MaxActive = 32, -- never more than 32 in flight
	Prewarm = 8,
})

local function fire(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3)
	local bullet = bullets:TryAcquire()
	if bullet == nil then
		return -- pool exhausted: skip instead of creating unbounded parts
	end
	bullet.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction)
	bullet.Parent = workspace
	task.delay(0.5, function()
		bullets:Release(bullet) -- unparented and kept for reuse
	end)
end

for index = 1, 40 do
	fire(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(math.cos(index), 0, math.sin(index)))
	task.wait(0.05)
end

task.wait(1)

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Promise = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("Promise"))

-- Pretend to fetch something slow and flaky.
local attempts = 0
local function fetchLeaderboard()
	return Promise.new(function(resolve, reject)
		attempts += 1
		task.wait(0.2)
		if attempts < 2 then
			reject("service busy")
		else
			resolve({ "Ana", "Ben", "Cy" })
		end
	end)
end

-- Retry with backoff, give up after 3 seconds, and always log the outcome.
Promise.retry(fetchLeaderboard, { Attempts = 3, Delay = 0.1 })
	:Timeout(3)
	:Then(function(names: { string })
		print("[Promise] leaderboard after", attempts, "attempts:", table.concat(names, ", "))
	end)
	:Catch(function(reason)
		warn("[Promise] failed:", tostring(reason))
	end)
	:Finally(function(status)
		print("[Promise] finished with status", status)
	end)

-- Run work in parallel and wait for all of it.
local ok, results = Promise.all({
	Promise.delay(0.1):Then(function()
		return "map loaded"
	end),
	Promise.delay(0.2):Then(function()
		return "music loaded"
	end),
}):Await()
print("[Promise] all:", ok, table.concat(results, ", "))

-- Cancellation stops the work behind a chain.
local countdown = Promise.new(function(resolve, _, onCancel)
	local thread = task.delay(10, resolve)
	onCancel(function()
		task.cancel(thread)
		print("[Promise] countdown cancelled")
	end)
end)
countdown:Cancel()

-- The smallest Constella program: no app, no setup.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Constella = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"))

local cleanup = Constella.Cleanup.new()
local state = Constella.State.new(0)
cleanup:Add(state:Subscribe(function(newValue)
	print("[QuickStart] state is now", newValue)
end))
state:Set(10)

local rarity = Constella.Random.choose({
	{ Value = "Common", Weight = 75 },
	{ Value = "Rare", Weight = 20 },
	{ Value = "Legendary", Weight = 5 },
}, Random.new(1234))
print("[QuickStart] rolled", rarity)

cleanup:Destroy()

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Random_ = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("Random"))

local chest = Random_.lootTable({
	{ Value = "Wood Sword", Weight = 60 },
	{ Value = "Iron Sword", Weight = 30 },
	{ Value = "Star Blade", Weight = 9 },
	{ Value = "Constellation", Weight = 1 },
})

for _, chance in chest:GetChances() do
	print(("[Random] %-14s %.2f%%"):format(chance.Value, chance.Chance * 100))
end

-- Seeded: the same seed always produces the same rolls.
local rng = Random.new(2026)
print("[Random] five seeded rolls:", table.concat(chest:RollMany(5, rng), ", "))

-- Luck 0.5 = square-root weights: rare items become more likely.
print(
	("[Random] Constellation chance with Luck 0.5: %.2f%%"):format(
		chest:GetChance("Constellation", { Luck = 0.5 }) * 100
	)
)

print("[Random] 25% chance:", Random_.chance(0.25))
print("[Random] shuffled:", table.concat(Random_.shuffle({ "a", "b", "c", "d" }, Random.new(1)), ""))

-- UIListLayout's flex and wrapping and UIFlexItem: where they put three
-- children and what the list reports, in a fixed 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Rounded, and + 0 turns -0 (float noise) into 0.
local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Parent = screen
local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Parent = box
local items = {}
for i, w in { 50, 100, 30 } do
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "F" .. i
	f.LayoutOrder = i
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 20 + i * 10)
	f.Parent = box
	items[i] = f
end
local function dump(tag)
	local out = {}
	for _, f in items do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, table.concat(out, " "), "content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
end
local function sizes(a, b, c)
	items[1].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(a, 30)

list.HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None
item = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")

item.Parent = items[2]

other.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Shrink

list.Wraps = true

list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
list.HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetween
dump("wraps, SpaceBetween")
list.HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill
dump("wraps, Fill")
list.HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None
for _, name in { "Fill", "SpaceBetween", "SpaceEvenly" } do
	list.VerticalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment[name]
	dump("wraps, across " .. name)
end
list.VerticalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
dump("wraps, bottom, centered")
list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left

list.HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill

-- Where GUI objects go: UDim2 against the parent, AnchorPoint,
-- SizeConstraint, Folders, Rotation, UIScale, the size constraints and
-- AutomaticSize. Positions are logged from a fixed 400 x 300 box, so the
-- window's size doesn't matter.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Rounded, and + 0 turns -0 (float noise) into 0.
local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20)
box.Parent = screen
local function rect(name, f)
	log(name, v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition), v(f.AbsoluteSize))
end
local function frame(parent, size, position)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = size
	f.Position = position or UDim2.new()
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local top = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
log("inset", v(top), "screen height", camera.ViewportSize.Y - screen.AbsoluteSize.Y)

local f = frame(box, UDim2.new(0.5, 10, 0.25, -4), UDim2.new(0.1, 3, 0.2, 5))
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
rect("anchored", f)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(-100, 50)
rect("negative", f)
f:Destroy()

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Parent = box
rect("in folder", frame(folder, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)))
folder:Destroy()

local yy = frame(box, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
yy.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeYY
rect("RelativeYY", yy)
yy.SizeConstraint = Enum.SizeConstraint.RelativeXX
yy.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
rect("RelativeXX", yy)
yy:Destroy()

local r = frame(box, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 50), UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100))
r.Rotation = 90
local inside = frame(r, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10))
inside.Rotation = 15
rect("turned child", inside)
log("rotation", inside.AbsoluteRotation)
r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
rect("turned child, anchor 1,1", inside)
r:Destroy()

local c = frame(box, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
local sc = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
sc.MinSize = Vector2.new(10, 160)
sc.MaxSize = Vector2.new(120, 1000)
sc.Parent = c
rect("size constraint", c)
sc.MinSize = Vector2.new(200, 0)
sc.MaxSize = Vector2.new(100, 100)
rect("min above max", c)
sc:Destroy()
local ar = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
ar.AspectRatio = 0.5
ar.Parent = c
rect("aspect fit", c)
ar.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.ScaleWithParentSize
rect("aspect scale width", c)
ar.AspectRatio = 4
ar.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Height
rect("aspect scale height", c)
ar:Destroy()

local grandchild = frame(c, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0))
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Scale = 2
scale.Parent = c
rect("scaled", c)
rect("scaled child", grandchild)
scale.Parent = box
log("scaled box", v(box.AbsoluteSize))
rect("child of scaled box", grandchild)
scale:Destroy()
c:Destroy()

local auto = frame(box, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 10), UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5))
auto.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
local a1 = frame(auto, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(10, 50))
rect("automatic", auto)
auto.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
rect("automatic X", auto)
auto.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
a1.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
rect("automatic, anchored child", auto)
a1.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
padding.Parent = auto
rect("automatic, padded", auto)
rect("padded child", a1)
padding:Destroy()

-- An Inset border pads what's inside it; a Middle one by half.
auto.BorderSizePixel = 4
for _, mode in { Enum.BorderMode.Inset, Enum.BorderMode.Middle } do
	auto.BorderMode = mode
	rect(mode.Name .. " border, automatic", auto)
	rect(mode.Name .. " border child", a1)
end

screen:Destroy()

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
-- Require the module directly: only Signal is loaded.
local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("Signal"))

local damaged = Signal.new()

local connection = damaged:Connect(function(target: string, amount: number)
	print(("[Signal] %s took %d damage"):format(target, amount))
end)

damaged:Once(function()
	print("[Signal] first hit!")
end)

damaged:Fire("Dummy", 10) -- prints both
damaged:Fire("Dummy", 5) -- Once listener is gone

task.delay(0.1, damaged.Fire, damaged, "Boss", 99)
local target, amount = damaged:Wait()
print("[Signal] Wait returned", target, amount)

connection:Disconnect()
damaged:Destroy()

-- When layout happens: reading an Absolute property lays out at once;
-- otherwise the frame's layout does, after RenderStepped. Changed fires
-- only for values that moved.
--! client
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local f = Instance.new("Frame")
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
f.Parent = screen
local c = Instance.new("Frame")
c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
c.Parent = f
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

local events = {}
for _, o in { f, c } do
	o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		table.insert(events, (if o == f then "F " else "C ") .. tostring(o.AbsoluteSize))
	end)
end

f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 50)
log("before a frame", #events)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
log("after a frame", table.concat(events, ", "))

table.clear(events)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 30)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 50)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
log("set and set back", #events)

f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
log("read", c.AbsoluteSize)
task.wait()
log("after the read", table.concat(events, ", "))

screen:Destroy()

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local State = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Constella"):WaitForChild("State"))

local health = State.new(100)
local maxHealth = State.new(100)

local percent = State.computed({ health, maxHealth }, function(current: number, max: number)
	return math.floor(current / max * 100)
end)
local isLow = State.select(percent, function(value: number)
	return value <= 25
end)

percent:Observe(function(value: number)
	print(("[State] health %d%%"):format(value))
end)
isLow:Subscribe(function(low: boolean)
	print("[State] low health:", low)
end)

health:Set(100) -- equal value: nothing fires
health:Set(20) -- percent 20, low true

-- One notification for both writes.
State.batch(function()
	health:Set(150)
	maxHealth:Set(200)
end)

isLow:Destroy()
percent:Destroy()

-- UIPageLayout: where its pages are, CurrentPage, the jumps, and Stopped
-- after a turn; positions are read once each turn has settled.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Parent = screen
local layout = Instance.new("UIPageLayout")
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Animated = false
layout.Parent = box
local pages = {}
for i, s in { { 0.5, 0.5 }, { 1, 1 }, { 0.25, 0.5 }, { 0.5, 0.25 } } do
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "P" .. i
	f.LayoutOrder = i
	f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(s[1], s[2])
	f.Parent = box
	pages[i] = f
end
local stopped = {}
layout.Stopped:Connect(function(page)
	table.insert(stopped, page.Name)
end)
local function dump(tag)
	local out = {}
	for _, f in pages do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, tostring(layout.CurrentPage), table.concat(out, " "), "content", v(layout.AbsoluteContentSize))
end

dump("start")
layout:Next()
dump("next")
layout:JumpToIndex(3)
layout:Next()
dump("next at the end")
layout:Previous()
dump("previous")
layout:JumpToIndex(10)
dump("index out of range")
layout:JumpTo(pages[1])
dump("jump to P1")
layout:Previous()
dump("previous at the start")
layout.Circular = true
layout:Previous()
dump("circular previous")
layout.Circular = false
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0.1, 0)
dump("centered, padded")
layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
dump("vertical")
pages[3].Visible = false
layout:JumpToIndex(2)
dump("P3 hidden, index 2")
pages[3].Visible = true
layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)

layout.Animated = true
layout.TweenTime = 0.3
layout:JumpToIndex(1)
log("current at once", layout.CurrentPage)
task.wait(1)
dump("after a turn")
log("stopped", table.concat(stopped, ","))

screen:Destroy()

end)

	print("[Zone]", player.Name, "left the pad")
end)

-- ScrollingFrame: AbsoluteWindowSize and AbsoluteCanvasSize by canvas
-- size, bar insets, thickness, border and direction; CanvasPosition kept
-- within the canvas when set; children on the scrolled canvas; and
-- AutomaticCanvasSize. Each frame is 200 x 100 in a 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Parent = screen

local function scroller(props)
	local f = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 100)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.CanvasSize = props.CanvasSize or f.CanvasSize
	for k, value in props do
		f[k] = value
	end
	local c = Instance.new("Frame")
	c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20)
	c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	c.Parent = f
	f.Parent = box
	return f, c
end
local function sizes(name, props)
	local f, c = scroller(props)
	log(name, "window", v(f.AbsoluteWindowSize), "canvas", v(f.AbsoluteCanvasSize), "child", v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition), v(c.AbsoluteSize))
	f:Destroy()
end

local both = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 400)
sizes("default", {})
sizes("both", { CanvasSize = both })
sizes("vertical", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 400) })
sizes("horizontal", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 50) })
sizes("none", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50) })
sizes("pushed", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(195, 400) })
sizes("negative", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(-100, -100) })
sizes("scaled", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromScale(1, 2) })
sizes("inset", { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 400), VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar })
sizes("always", {
	CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50),
	VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always,
	HorizontalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always,
})
sizes("thick", { CanvasSize = both, ScrollBarThickness = 30 })
sizes("thin", { CanvasSize = both, ScrollBarThickness = 0 })
sizes("border", { CanvasSize = both, BorderSizePixel = 3 })
sizes("inset border", { CanvasSize = both, BorderSizePixel = 4, BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset })
sizes("x only", { CanvasSize = both, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X })
sizes("y only", { CanvasSize = both, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y })
sizes("disabled", { CanvasSize = both, ScrollingEnabled = false })
sizes("left", {
	CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 400),
	VerticalScrollBarPosition = Enum.VerticalScrollBarPosition.Left,
	VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,
})

local function scrolled(name, at, props)
	local f, c = scroller(props or { CanvasSize = both })
	f.CanvasPosition = at
	log(name, "position", v(f.CanvasPosition), "child", v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition))
	f:Destroy()
end
scrolled("scrolled", Vector2.new(30, 40))
scrolled("past the end", Vector2.new(1000, 1000))
scrolled("before the start", Vector2.new(-50, -50))
scrolled("between pixels", Vector2.new(10.6, 20.25))
scrolled("nothing to scroll", Vector2.new(30, 40), { CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50) })
scrolled("y only", Vector2.new(30, 40), { CanvasSize = both, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y })

local function automatic(name, axes, build)
	local f = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 100)
	f.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	f.AutomaticCanvasSize = axes
	build(f)
	f.Parent = box
	log(name, "window", v(f.AbsoluteWindowSize), "canvas", v(f.AbsoluteCanvasSize))
	f:Destroy()
end
local function kid(parent, x, y, w, h)
	local k = Instance.new("Frame")
	k.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	k.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	k.Parent = parent
	return k
end
automatic("auto y", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	kid(f, 0, 300, 50, 50)
end)
automatic("auto y over 500", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	f.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 500)
	kid(f, 0, 300, 50, 50)
end)
automatic("auto xy", Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, function(f)
	kid(f, 250, 10, 100, 20)
	kid(f, 10, 150, 10, 30)
end)
automatic("auto y padded", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	local p = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	p.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
	p.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 20)
	p.Parent = f
	kid(f, 0, 300, 50, 50)
end)
automatic("auto y hidden", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	kid(f, 0, 300, 50, 50).Visible = false
	kid(f, 0, 100, 50, 50)
end)
automatic("auto y deep", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	kid(kid(f, 0, 0, 50, 50), 0, 400, 50, 50)
end)
automatic("auto y list", Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, function(f)
	local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
	l.Parent = f
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		kid(f, 0, 0, 150, 60)
	end
end)

-- Kept within the grown canvas when set after the children.
local f = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 100)
f.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
f.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
Instance.new("UIListLayout").Parent = f
for _ = 1, 5 do
	kid(f, 0, 0, 100, 60)
end
f.Parent = box
f.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1000)
log("auto position", v(f.CanvasPosition))
kid(f, 0, 0, 100, 60)
f.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1000)
log("auto grown position", v(f.CanvasPosition))

screen:Destroy()

--!strict
-- Shows the player's coins, replicated from the server, in an on-screen
-- label. The client only reads: the server owns the value.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages")
local Constella = require(Packages:WaitForChild("Constella"))

local CoinsController = {
	Name = "CoinsController",
	Environment = "Client",

	-- Read-only: the server owns the value. Set in Start.
	Coins = (nil :: any) :: Constella.Computed<number?>,
}

export type CoinsController = typeof(CoinsController)

function CoinsController.Start(self: CoinsController, context: Constella.Context)
	local replica = context.Cleanup:Add(Constella.Replication.Client.new("Player"))
	self.Coins = replica:Get("Coins")

	local gui = context.Cleanup:Add(Instance.new("ScreenGui"))
	gui.Name = "ConstellaCoins"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 40)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -56)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	context.Cleanup:Add(Constella.State.bind(label, "Text", self.Coins, function(value: number?)
		return if value then ("Coins: %d"):format(value) else "Coins: ..."
	end))
	context.Cleanup:Add(self.Coins:Observe(function(value: number?)
		if value then
			print(("[Demo] Coins: %d"):format(value))
		end
	end))
end

return CoinsController

-- How far a legacy Style moves children in: each FrameStyle and
-- ButtonStyle at a large and two small sizes, with UIPadding and an Inset
-- border, and text. Style changes none of the properties scripts read.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 1000) / 1000 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 1000) / 1000 + 0)
end
local function inside(f)
	local c = Instance.new("Frame")
	c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	c.Parent = f
	return c
end

local styled = {}
for _, s in Enum.FrameStyle:GetEnumItems() do
	table.insert(styled, { "Frame", s })
end
for _, s in Enum.ButtonStyle:GetEnumItems() do
	table.insert(styled, { "TextButton", s })
end
for _, e in styled do
	local f = Instance.new(e[1])
	f.Style = e[2]
	f.Parent = screen
	local c = inside(f)
	local row = {}
	for _, size in { Vector2.new(120, 80), Vector2.new(200, 10), Vector2.new(30, 40) } do
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
		table.insert(row, v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition) .. " " .. v(c.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(e[2].Name, table.concat(row, " | "))
	f:Destroy()
end

local f = Instance.new("Frame")
f.Style = Enum.FrameStyle.RobloxSquare
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 80)
f.BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset
f.BorderSizePixel = 4
f.Parent = screen
local c = inside(f)
log("inset border", v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition), v(c.AbsoluteSize))
local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
pad.Parent = f
log("padded", v(c.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition), v(c.AbsoluteSize))
log("reads", f.BackgroundColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(163, 162, 165), f.BackgroundTransparency, f.BorderSizePixel)
f:Destroy()

local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
b.Style = Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxButton
b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40)
b.Text = "Hi"
b.TextSize = 14
b.Parent = screen
local custom = b:Clone()
custom.Style = Enum.ButtonStyle.Custom
custom.Parent = screen
log("text", b.TextBounds == custom.TextBounds, b.TextFits, b.AutoButtonColor)
b.TextScaled = true
custom.TextScaled = true
log("scaled text height", b.TextBounds.Y, custom.TextBounds.Y)
b:Destroy()
custom:Destroy()

local i = Instance.new("ImageButton")
i.Style = Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundButton
i.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 20)
i.Parent = screen
local ic = inside(i)
log("image button", v(ic.AbsolutePosition - i.AbsolutePosition), v(ic.AbsoluteSize))
i:Destroy()
screen:Destroy()

-- UITableLayout: where it puts two rows of cells and what it reports, in
-- a fixed 400 x 300 box.
--! client
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
-- A new table each time: Studio uses stale sizes when a live table's
-- MajorAxis changes.
local function table_of(tag, setup)
	local box = Instance.new("Frame")
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
	box.Parent = screen
	local layout = Instance.new("UITableLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	setup(layout)
	layout.Parent = box
	local all = {}
	for r, row in { { { 50, 20 }, { 80, 30 }, { 20, 10 } }, { { 70, 25 }, { 30, 40 } } } do
		local rf = Instance.new("Frame")
		rf.Name = "R" .. r
		rf.LayoutOrder = r
		rf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 5)
		rf.Parent = box
		table.insert(all, rf)
		for c, size in row do
			local cf = Instance.new("Frame")
			cf.Name = "C" .. r .. c
			cf.LayoutOrder = c
			cf.Size = if r == 1 and c == 1 and tag == "scaled cell"
				then UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				else UDim2.fromOffset(size[1], size[2])
			cf.Parent = rf
			table.insert(all, cf)
		end
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, f in all do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, table.concat(out, " "), "content", v(layout.AbsoluteContentSize))
	box:Destroy()
end

table_of("rows", function() end)
table_of("padded", function(t)
	t.Padding = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 7)
end)
table_of("fill columns", function(t)
	t.FillEmptySpaceColumns = true
end)
table_of("fill rows", function(t)
	t.FillEmptySpaceRows = true
end)
table_of("columns", function(t)
	t.MajorAxis = Enum.TableMajorAxis.ColumnMajor
end)
table_of("horizontal", function(t)

end)
table_of("centered, bottom", function(t)
	t.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	t.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
end)
table_of("scaled cell", function() end)

screen:Destroy()

--!strict
-- Asks the server to buy items. The server decides; the client only shows
-- the answer.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages")
local Constella = require(Packages:WaitForChild("Constella"))

local ShopController = {
	Name = "ShopController",
	Environment = "Client",
}

function ShopController.Start(_self: typeof(ShopController), _context: Constella.Context)
	local shop = Constella.Network.Client.new("Shop")
	local purchase = shop:Function("Purchase", { Timeout = 5 })

	task.wait(1) -- give the welcome reward time to arrive
	for _, item in { "Sword", "Shield" } do
		local ok, result, balance = purchase:Invoke(item)
		if ok then
			print(("[Demo] Buy %s: %s (balance %s)"):format(item, result, tostring(balance)))
		else
			warn(("[Demo] Buy %s failed: %s"):format(item, tostring(result)))
		end
	end
end

return ShopController

--! client

local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Rounded, and + 0 turns -0 (float noise) into 0.
local function v(p)
	return string.format("%g,%g", math.round(p.X * 100) / 100 + 0, math.round(p.Y * 100) / 100 + 0)
end
local box = Instance.new("Frame")
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 300)
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 20)
box.Parent = screen
local function dump(tag, list)
	local out = {}
	for _, f in list do
		table.insert(out, f.Name .. "@" .. v(f.AbsolutePosition - box.AbsolutePosition) .. "/" .. v(f.AbsoluteSize))
	end
	log(tag, table.concat(out, " "))
end
local function frame(name, size, order)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.Size = size
	f.LayoutOrder = order or 0
	f.Parent = box
	return f
end

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Parent = box
local c = frame("C", UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 2)
local a = frame("A", UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 1)
a.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(99, 99)
a.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
local b = frame("B", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.1), 1)
local items = { a, b, c }
list.Padding = UDim.new(0.1, 5)
dump("vertical", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
dump("centered", items)
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
dump("horizontal, right, bottom", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
c.Visible = false
dump("C hidden", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
c.Visible = true

local z = frame("Z", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 3)
local y = frame("Y", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 3)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name
local lower = frame("a", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10))
dump("by name", { a, b, c, y, z, lower })
z:Destroy()
y:Destroy()
lower:Destroy()
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 10)
list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.1, 0)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 13)
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
padding.Parent = box
dump("padded", items)
log("content", v(list.AbsoluteContentSize))
list:Destroy()
b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
dump("padded, no list", { b })
padding:Destroy()
for _, f in items do
	f:Destroy()
end

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name
grid.Parent = box
local cells = {}
for i = 1, 5 do
	cells[i] = frame("K" .. i, UDim2.fromOffset(50, 40), 6 - i)
end
dump("grid", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellSize), v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 50)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.1, 0)
grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
grid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.BottomRight
dump("two a row, from bottom right", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellSize), v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
grid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft
grid.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 0
grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
grid.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
dump("vertical, centered", cells)
log("cells", v(grid.AbsoluteCellCount), v(grid.AbsoluteContentSize))
local second = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
second.Parent = box
dump("a list after the grid", cells)

screen:Destroy()

-- GUI buttons under the mouse: the order of MouseButton1Down, Up, Click,
-- Activated (with its click count), InputBegan and InputEnded, GuiState
-- and UserInputService's events with gameProcessedEvent; pressing on one
-- button and releasing on another; button 2. A at (100, 100), B at
-- (300, 100), each 100 x 50.
--! client input 150,125 down up down 350,125 up 150,125 down2 up2 down up 600,400
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false

local releases = 0
local connections = {}
local function on(signal, f)
	table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(f))
end
local function button(name, x)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 100)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 50)
	for _, event in { "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up", "MouseButton2Down", "MouseButton2Up" } do
		on(b[event], function(px, py)
			log(name, event, px, py)
		end)
	end
	for _, event in { "MouseButton1Click", "MouseButton2Click", "MouseEnter", "MouseLeave" } do
		on(b[event], function()
			log(name, event)
		end)
	end
	on(b.Activated, function(input, count)
		log(name, "Activated", input.UserInputType, count)
	end)
	for _, event in { "InputBegan", "InputEnded" } do
		on(b[event], function(input)
			log(name, event, input.UserInputType, input.UserInputState)
		end)
	end
	on(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"), function()
		log(name, "GuiState", b.GuiState)
	end)
	b.Parent = screen
	return b
end
button("A", 100)
button("B", 300)
local mouse = { [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = true, [Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = true }
on(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
	if mouse[input.UserInputType] then
		log("UIS InputBegan", input.UserInputType, processed, input.Position)
	end
end)
on(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input, processed)
	if mouse[input.UserInputType] then
		log("UIS InputEnded", input.UserInputType, processed, input.Position)
		releases += 1
	end
end)
screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local start = os.clock()
while releases < 4 and os.clock() - start < 20 do
	task.wait()
end
task.wait(0.6)
for _, c in connections do
	c:Disconnect()
end
screen:Destroy()

--!strict
-- Loads and saves player data with Constella.Data.
--
-- The demo uses MemoryAdapter, which is NOT persistent (data resets when the
-- server stops). For a real game, install ProfileStore and swap the adapter:
--
--   local ProfileStore = require(ServerScriptService.ProfileStore)
--   Adapter = Constella.Data.ProfileStoreAdapter.new(ProfileStore),

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages")
local Constella = require(Packages:WaitForChild("Constella"))

local Data = Constella.Data

export type PlayerData = {
	Coins: number,
	WelcomeClaimed: boolean,
}

local TEMPLATE: PlayerData = {
	Coins = 0,
	WelcomeClaimed = false,
}

local PlayerDataService = {
	Name = "PlayerDataService",
	Environment = "Server",

	-- Created in Init so dependents can connect to Loaded in their own Init.
	Store = (nil :: any) :: Constella.Store<PlayerData>,
}

export type PlayerDataService = typeof(PlayerDataService)

function PlayerDataService.Init(self: PlayerDataService, _context: Constella.Context)
	self.Store = Data.Store.new({
		Name = "DemoPlayerData",
		Version = 1,
		Template = TEMPLATE,
		Adapter = Data.MemoryAdapter.new(),
		Logger = Constella.Debug.Logger.new("PlayerData"),
	})
end

function PlayerDataService.Start(self: PlayerDataService, _context: Constella.Context)
	-- Loads players as they join, releases (and saves) them as they leave.
	self.Store:BindPlayers()
end

function PlayerDataService.Stop(self: PlayerDataService, _context: Constella.Context)
	-- Stop also runs after a failed startup, when Init may not have finished.
	if self.Store then
		self.Store:Shutdown(15)
	end
end

return PlayerDataService

--!strict
-- Server-authoritative coins: stored in the player's profile, mirrored into
-- a State, and replicated to that player only.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages")
local Constella = require(Packages:WaitForChild("Constella"))

-- A type-only import: nothing is required at runtime. The instance itself
-- comes from context:Get, so the App still controls the startup order.
type PlayerDataService = typeof(require(script.Parent.PlayerDataService))

local WELCOME_REWARD = Constella.Random.lootTable({
	{ Value = 10, Weight = 70 },
	{ Value = 50, Weight = 25 },
	{ Value = 250, Weight = 5 },
})

local RewardService = {
	Name = "RewardService",
	Environment = "Server",
	Dependencies = { "PlayerDataService" },

	_coins = {} :: { [Player]: Constella.Value<number> },
	_sessions = {} :: { [Player]: Constella.Cleanup },
}

export type RewardService = typeof(RewardService)

function RewardService.Init(self: RewardService, context: Constella.Context)
	local playerData: PlayerDataService = context:Get("PlayerDataService")
	local store = playerData.Store
	local replicator = context.Cleanup:Add(Constella.Replication.Server.new("Player"))

	-- Signal:Connect keeps the listener's types (Cleanup:Connect takes any signal,
	-- so it can't), and Cleanup:Add disconnects it when the service stops.
	context.Cleanup:Add(store.Loaded:Connect(function(player, profile)
		local session = Constella.Cleanup.new()
		self._sessions[player] = session

		local coins: Constella.Value<number> = session:Add(Constella.State.new(profile.Data.Coins))
		self._coins[player] = coins
		session:Add(function()
			self._coins[player] = nil
		end)

		-- Every change is written to the profile (saved by the store)...
		session:Add(coins:Subscribe(function(value: number)
			if profile:IsActive() then
				profile:Set("Coins", value)
			end
		end))
		-- ...and replicated to this player only.
		session:Add(replicator:ShareWith(player, "Coins", coins), "Stop")

		if not profile.Data.WelcomeClaimed then
			profile:Set("WelcomeClaimed", true)
			local reward = WELCOME_REWARD:Roll()
			self:AddCoins(player, reward)
			print(("[Demo] %s received a welcome reward of %d coins"):format(player.Name, reward))
		end
	end))

	context.Cleanup:Add(store.Released:Connect(function(player)
		local session = self._sessions[player]
		if session then
			self._sessions[player] = nil
			session:Destroy()
		end
	end))
end

--- Server-only API. Amounts are validated here because callers may forward
--- values that originated from a client.
function RewardService.AddCoins(self: RewardService, player: Player, amount: number)
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 or amount % 1 ~= 0 or amount > 1e6 then
		error(("[RewardService] Invalid coin amount: %s"):format(tostring(amount)), 2)
	end
	local coins = self._coins[player]
	if not coins then
		error(("[RewardService] %s has no loaded profile"):format(player.Name), 2)
	end
	coins:Update(function(current: number)
		return current + amount
	end)
end

--- Removes coins if the player can afford it. Returns false otherwise.
function RewardService.SpendCoins(self: RewardService, player: Player, amount: number): boolean
	if type(amount) ~= "number" or amount ~= amount or amount <= 0 or amount % 1 ~= 0 then
		error(("[RewardService] Invalid coin amount: %s"):format(tostring(amount)), 2)
	end
	local coins = self._coins[player]
	if not coins or coins:Get() < amount then
		return false
	end
	coins:Update(function(current: number)
		return current - amount
	end)
	return true
end

function RewardService.GetCoins(self: RewardService, player: Player): number?
	local coins = self._coins[player]
	return if coins then coins:Get() else nil
end

return RewardService

--!strict
-- A server-authoritative shop. The client only says WHAT it wants; prices,
-- balances and the decision all live on the server.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages")
local Constella = require(Packages:WaitForChild("Constella"))
local Network = Constella.Network
local Check = Network.Check

-- A type-only import: the instance comes from context:Get.
type RewardService = typeof(require(script.Parent.RewardService))

local CATALOG: { [string]: number } = {
	Sword = 10,
	Shield = 100,
}

local ShopService = {
	Name = "ShopService",
	Environment = "Server",
	Dependencies = { "RewardService" },
}

function ShopService.Init(_self: typeof(ShopService), context: Constella.Context)
	local rewards: RewardService = context:Get("RewardService")
	local logger = Constella.Debug.Logger.new("ShopService")

	local server = context.Cleanup:Add(Network.Server.new("Shop", { Logger = logger }))

	local purchase = server:Function("Purchase", {
		Schema = { Check.literal("Sword", "Shield") },
		RateLimit = { Count = 2, Per = 1 },
	})

	purchase:SetHandler(function(player: Player, item: string)
		local price = CATALOG[item]
		if rewards:SpendCoins(player, price) then
			logger:Info("Purchase", { Player = player.Name, Item = item, Price = price })
			return "Purchased", rewards:GetCoins(player)
		end
		return "NotEnoughCoins", rewards:GetCoins(player)
	end)
end

return ShopService

-- addons not containing in "Client" or "Server" will run in both contexts (shared)
return function(_K)
	if _K.DEBUG then
		_K.log(`Hello World from ExampleAddon!`, "INFO")
	end

	_K.Registry.registerCommand(_K, {
		name = "customcommand",
		aliases = { "customcommandalias", "customcommandalias2" },
		description = "Custom command description.",

		-- The command group to sort the command by, this is what roles use to easily assign groups of commands.
		-- Default groups in order of abusability are "Utility", "Environment", "General", "Fun", "Moderation", "Administration", and "Creator"
		group = "General", -- Command group to use.
		noLog = false, -- If the command is not logged when used.

		--[[ ARGUMENT DEFINITIONS

		Default Argument Types
			"boolean" "booleans"
			"integer" "integers"
			"number" "numbers"
			"string" "strings"        - normal strings are filtered by default!
			"rawString" "rawStrings" - use rawStrings for commands that require an unfiltered input
			"chatString"             - messages between users, send them with _K.Chat.send so they are filtered
			                           and rate limited, like the message and pm commands
			"vector2"
			"vector3"

			"ban" "bans"
			"color"
			"command"
			"member" "members"
			"player" "players"
			"userId" "userIds"
			"role" "roles"
			"team" "teams"
			"timeSimple"
			"tool" "tools"

		Roblox Enum Types: Use any Roblox Enum as a type, for example:
			"Enum.Font" for a single Font enum
			"Enum.Fonts" for a list of Font enums

		Custom Enum Types: Create your own Enum types, for example:
			"Sunny,Rainy,Foggy" --IMPORTANT: NO SPACES

		Types can be unioned with a prefix, for example:
			"player # vector3" --IMPORTANT: MUST HAVE SPACES | Usage: "me" = Player, "#0,1,0" = Vector3

		Creating Custom Types:
			Check Kohl's Admin > Loader > MainModule > DefaultTypes for examples

		]]
		args = {
			{
				type = "string",
				name = "Message",
				description = "The message to send.", -- Description shown in command list.
				optional = true, -- If the command is optional, make sure to check if it's nil and not false!

				permissions = {}, -- Permission restrictions, hidden from users without the permissions and returns nil, see Kohl's Admin > Config > Settings for every permission

				-- player type options
				lowerRank = false, -- Only allows selecting players of a lower rank
				ignoreSelf = false, -- Only allows selecting other players
				shouldRequest = false, -- If the command should be requested on same rank or higher
			},
		},
		permissions = {}, -- Command permission restrictions, see Kohl's Admin > Config > Settings for every permission

		-- COMMAND ENVIRONMENTS

		env = function(_K)
			if _K.DEBUG or _K.IsStudio then
				_K.log(`Hello World from ExampleAddon customcommand env!`, "INFO")
			end
			return { countServer = 0 }
		end,

		envClient = function(_K)
			return { countClient = 0 }
		end,

		--[[ COMMAND EXECUTION

		Command context fields:
			_K         - reference to _K toplevel API
			alias      - alias used for this command
			array      - raw command string array result
			definition - reference to the command definition used in registerCommand
			env        - command environment
			from       - userId of the command caller
			fromPlayer - Player Instance of the command caller
			fromRank   - rank of the command caller
			text       - full command text
			undo       - if the alias starts with "un"

		]]

		run = function(context, message: string?)
			-- Text that other users can see must be rate limited to at least once a minute (Roblox chat guidelines)
			if message then
				local err = context._K.Chat.cooldown(context.from)
				if err then
					return err -- Returning a string shows it to the caller as an error
				end
			end

			-- Create a simple Roblox message object
			local messageInstance = Instance.new("Message")
			messageInstance.Text = if message == nil then "Default message" else message
			messageInstance.Parent = workspace

			-- Destroy the message after 5 seconds
			task.delay(5, messageInstance.Destroy, messageInstance)

			-- Number of times the command has been used on this server
			context.env.countServer += 1

			print("Custom command ran on server!", message, context.env.countServer)
			return
		end,

		runClient = function(context, message: string?)
			-- Number of times the command has been used on this client
			context.env.countClient += 1
			print("Custom command ran on the client!", message, context.env.countClient)
		end,
	})
end

-- SOFTWARE.

--!strict
--[=[
	Constella.Cleanup

	Owns resources and disposes them together.

	Supported resources (detected automatically)
	- function             -> called
	- thread               -> cancelled (task.cancel)
	- Instance             -> :Destroy()
	- RBXScriptConnection  -> :Disconnect()
	- table with Destroy, Disconnect or Cancel (e.g. Signal, Connection,
	  nested Cleanup, Promise)
	Any other value can be added with an explicit method name:
	`cleanup:Add(tween, "Cancel")`.

	Semantics
	- Resources are disposed in reverse order of addition (LIFO).
	- Clean/Destroy are idempotent: a resource is disposed at most once.
	- If a disposal fails, the remaining resources are still disposed; one
	  aggregated error is raised afterwards (nothing is silently swallowed).
	- After Destroy, anything added is disposed immediately. This makes
	  "async work finished after its owner died" races safe by default.
	- Clean leaves the manager usable; Destroy does not.
]=]

export type Cleanup = {
	Add: <T>(self: Cleanup, resource: T, method: string?) -> T,
	Set: <T>(self: Cleanup, key: any, resource: T, method: string?) -> T,
	Get: (self: Cleanup, key: any) -> any,
	Remove: (self: Cleanup, keyOrResource: any) -> boolean,
	Detach: (self: Cleanup, keyOrResource: any) -> any,
	--- Connects `callback` to `signal` (an RBXScriptSignal, a Constella Signal
	--- or anything with the same Connect method) and tracks the connection.
	--- The callback's parameters are checked against the signal's.
	Connect: <T...>(self: Cleanup, signal: { Connect: (any, (T...) -> ()) -> any }, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> any,
	Extend: (self: Cleanup) -> Cleanup,
	AttachToInstance: (self: Cleanup, instance: Instance) -> any,
	Clean: (self: Cleanup) -> (),
	Destroy: (self: Cleanup) -> (),
	Count: (self: Cleanup) -> number,
	IsDestroyed: (self: Cleanup) -> boolean,
}

-- Storage: two parallel arrays, so tracking a plain resource costs two
-- array slots instead of a table per resource. The method column holds a
-- method name (string) or one of these markers. Keyed resources (Set) are
-- stored as a small record { resource, method, key } marked KEYED.
local CALL = table.freeze({}) -- function: call it
local CANCEL = table.freeze({}) -- thread: cancel it
local KEYED = table.freeze({}) -- keyed record

local function getMember(value: any, name: string): any
	return value[name]
end

-- Indexing can raise (a missing Instance member, a strict __index), so it
-- runs under pcall; `getMember` is shared so no closure is created per check.
local function hasMethod(value: any, name: string): boolean
	local ok, member = pcall(getMember, value, name)
	return ok and type(member) == "function"
end

local function resolve(resource: any, method: string?, level: number): any
	if method ~= nil then
		if type(method) ~= "string" then
			error(("[Constella.Cleanup] Method name must be a string, got %s"):format(typeof(method)), level)
		end
		if not hasMethod(resource, method) then
			error(
				("[Constella.Cleanup] Resource of type %s has no method '%s'"):format(typeof(resource), method),
				level
			)
		end
		return method
	end

	local valueType = typeof(resource)
	if valueType == "function" then
		return CALL
	elseif valueType == "thread" then
		return CANCEL
	elseif valueType == "Instance" then
		return "Destroy"
	elseif valueType == "RBXScriptConnection" then
		return "Disconnect"
	elseif valueType == "table" then
		if hasMethod(resource, "Destroy") then
			return "Destroy"
		elseif hasMethod(resource, "Disconnect") then
			return "Disconnect"
		elseif hasMethod(resource, "Cancel") then
			return "Cancel"
		end
	end

	error(
		("[Constella.Cleanup] Don't know how to clean a value of type %s; pass a method name as the second argument"):format(
			valueType
		),
		level
	)
end

local function cancelThread(thread: thread)
	local status = coroutine.status(thread)
	if status == "suspended" then
		task.cancel(thread)
	elseif status ~= "dead" then
		-- The thread is currently running (e.g. it is cleaning up its own
		-- owner). It cannot be cancelled right now, so cancel it as soon as
		-- it yields.
		task.defer(function()
			if coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
				task.cancel(thread)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function dispose(resource: any, method: any)
	if method == CALL then
		resource()
	elseif method == CANCEL then
		cancelThread(resource)
	elseif method == KEYED then
		dispose(resource.resource, resource.method)
	else
		resource[method](resource)
	end
end

local function formatErrors(errors: { string }): string
	return ("[Constella.Cleanup] %d resource(s) failed to clean up (all others were cleaned):\n%s"):format(
		#errors,
		table.concat(errors, "\n")
	)
end

local Cleanup = {}

local CleanupClass = {}
CleanupClass.__index = CleanupClass

-- Position of a resource, looked up by key first, then by value.
local function indexOf(self: any, keyOrResource: any): number?
	local record = self._keys[keyOrResource]
	if record then
		return table.find(self._resources, record)
	end
	local methods = self._methods
	for index, resource in self._resources do
		if methods[index] == KEYED then
			if rawequal(resource.resource, keyOrResource) then
				return index
			end
		elseif rawequal(resource, keyOrResource) then
			return index
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Removes the entry at `index` and returns its stored resource and method.
local function removeAt(self: any, index: number): (any, any)
	local resource = table.remove(self._resources, index)
	local method = table.remove(self._methods, index)
	if method == KEYED and self._keys[resource.key] == resource then
		self._keys[resource.key] = nil
	end
	return resource, method
end

local function addEntry(self: any, resource: any, method: string?, key: any, level: number): any
	if resource == nil then
		error("[Constella.Cleanup] Cannot add nil", level)
	end
	local resolved = resolve(resource, method, level + 1)

	if self._destroyed then
		local ok, err = pcall(dispose :: any, resource, resolved)
		if not ok then
			error(
				("[Constella.Cleanup] A resource added after Destroy failed to clean up: %s"):format(tostring(err)),
				level
			)
		end
		return resource
	end

	if key ~= nil then
		local record = { resource = resource, method = resolved, key = key }
		table.insert(self._resources, record)
		table.insert(self._methods, KEYED)
		self._keys[key] = record
	else
		table.insert(self._resources, resource)
		table.insert(self._methods, resolved)
	end
	return resource
end

--- Adds a resource and returns it, so calls can be inlined:
--- `local part = cleanup:Add(Instance.new("Part"))`
function CleanupClass.Add(self: any, resource: any, method: string?): any
	-- Fast path for the most common resources: functions and threads need no
	-- method lookup, so they are appended directly.
	if method == nil and not self._destroyed then
		local kind = type(resource)
		local marker = if kind == "function" then CALL elseif kind == "thread" then CANCEL else nil
		if marker then
			local resources = self._resources
			local index = #resources + 1
			resources[index] = resource
			self._methods[index] = marker
			return resource
		end
	end
	return addEntry(self, resource, method, nil, 3)
end

--- Stores a resource under `key`. The previous resource under the same key
--- is cleaned. `Set(key, nil)` cleans and clears the key.
function CleanupClass.Set(self: any, key: any, resource: any, method: string?): any
	if key == nil then
		error("[Constella.Cleanup] Key must not be nil", 2)
	end
	local previous = self._keys[key]
	if previous and rawequal(previous.resource, resource) then
		return resource
	end
	if previous then
		local index = table.find(self._resources, previous)
		if index then
			removeAt(self, index)
		end
		self._keys[key] = nil
	end
	if resource ~= nil then
		addEntry(self, resource, method, key, 3)
	end
	if previous then
		local ok, err = pcall(dispose :: any, previous.resource, previous.method)
		if not ok then
			error(
				("[Constella.Cleanup] Previous resource under key %s failed to clean up: %s"):format(
					tostring(key),
					tostring(err)
				),
				2
			)
		end
	end
	return resource
end

--- Returns the resource stored under `key`, or nil.
function CleanupClass.Get(self: any, key: any): any
	local record = self._keys[key]
	return if record then record.resource else nil
end

--- Cleans a single resource now (looked up by key first, then by value).
--- Returns false if it was not found.
function CleanupClass.Remove(self: any, keyOrResource: any): boolean
	local index = indexOf(self, keyOrResource)
	if not index then
		return false
	end
	local resource, method = removeAt(self, index)
	local ok, err = pcall(dispose :: any, resource, method)
	if not ok then
		error(("[Constella.Cleanup] Remove failed to clean up resource: %s"):format(tostring(err)), 2)
	end
	return true
end

--- Stops tracking a resource WITHOUT cleaning it, and returns it.
function CleanupClass.Detach(self: any, keyOrResource: any): any
	local index = indexOf(self, keyOrResource)
	if not index then
		return nil
	end
	local resource, method = removeAt(self, index)
	return if method == KEYED then resource.resource else resource
end

--- Connects to an RBXScriptSignal or Constella Signal and tracks the connection.
function CleanupClass.Connect(self: any, signal: any, callback: (...any) -> ()): any
	return addEntry(self, signal:Connect(callback), nil, nil, 3)
end

--- Creates a child Cleanup that is destroyed together with this one.
function CleanupClass.Extend(self: any): any
	local child = Cleanup.new()
	return addEntry(self, child, "Destroy", nil, 3)
end

--- Destroys this Cleanup when `instance` is destroyed.
function CleanupClass.AttachToInstance(self: any, instance: Instance): any
	if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then
		error(("[Constella.Cleanup] AttachToInstance expects an Instance, got %s"):format(typeof(instance)), 2)
	end
	return addEntry(
		self,
		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			self:Destroy()
		end),
		nil,
		nil,
		3
	)
end

local function clean(self: any, level: number)
	if self._cleaning then
		-- Re-entrant call from inside a disposer: the outer loop finishes the job.
		return
	end
	self._cleaning = true
	local errors: { string }? = nil
	local resources, methods = self._resources, self._methods
	while true do
		local count = #resources
		if count == 0 then
			break
		end
		-- Last in, first out. Read and clear before disposing, because a
		-- disposer may add or remove resources on this same manager.
		local resource, method = resources[count], methods[count]
		resources[count] = nil
		methods[count] = nil
		local ok, err
		if method == CALL then
			-- The most common resource: call it directly (one call fewer).
			ok, err = pcall(resource)
		else
			if method == KEYED and self._keys[resource.key] == resource then
				self._keys[resource.key] = nil
			end
			ok, err = pcall(dispose :: any, resource, method)
		end
		if not ok then
			errors = errors or {}
			table.insert(errors :: { string }, tostring(err))
		end
	end
	self._cleaning = false
	if errors then
		error(formatErrors(errors), level)
	end
end

--- Cleans every resource. The manager stays usable afterwards.
function CleanupClass.Clean(self: any)
	clean(self, 3)
end

--- Cleans every resource and marks the manager destroyed. Idempotent.
function CleanupClass.Destroy(self: any)
	if self._destroyed then
		return
	end
	self._destroyed = true
	clean(self, 3)
end

function CleanupClass.Count(self: any): number
	return #self._resources
end

function CleanupClass.IsDestroyed(self: any): boolean
	return self._destroyed
end

function Cleanup.new(): Cleanup
	local self = setmetatable({

	return type(value) == "table" and getmetatable(value) == CleanupClass

        end)

        else
            gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                or game:GetService("CoreGui")
        end

        task.delay(3, function()
