const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion)

const Children = Fusion.Children

export type Handle = {
	Stunned: Fusion.Value<boolean>,
	Destroy: () -> (),
}

return function(character: Model): Handle
	const scope = Fusion.scoped(Fusion)
	const cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	const humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	const head = character:WaitForChild("Head") :: BasePart

	const player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	--- Above own head the bar and the nickname only get in the way of the camera,
	--- so the local player sees just the stun label.
	const isLocal = character == LocalPlayer.Character

	const Health = scope:Value(1)
	const Stunned = scope:Value(false)

	const UpdateHealth = function()
		const ratio = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
		Health:set(math.clamp(ratio, 0, 1))
	end

	UpdateHealth()
	cleaner:Connect(humanoid.HealthChanged, UpdateHealth)
	cleaner:Connect(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"), UpdateHealth)

	scope:New("BillboardGui")({
		Name = "HeadInfo",
		Active = true,
		AlwaysOnTop = true,
		MaxDistance = 50,
		Parent = head,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 2),
		StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,

		[Children] = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Main",
				Active = true,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),

				[Children] = {
					scope:New("CanvasGroup")({
						Name = "Health",
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 65, 35),
						BorderColor3 = Color3.new(),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.15),
						Visible = not isLocal,
						ZIndex = 5,

						[Children] = {
							scope:New("Frame")({
								Name = "Bar",
								BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 136),
								BorderColor3 = Color3.new(),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Size = scope:Spring(
									scope:Computed(function(use)
										return UDim2.fromScale(use(Health), 1)
									end),
									25
								),
							}),

							scope:New("UIStroke")({
								Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 54),
								Thickness = 2,
							}),
						},
					}),

					scope:New("TextLabel")({
						Name = "Nickname",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						FontFace = Font.new(
							"rbxasset://fonts/families/Balthazar.json",
							Enum.FontWeight.Bold,
							Enum.FontStyle.Normal
						),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.6),
						RichText = true,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.25),
						Text = player and player.DisplayName or character.Name,
						TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
						TextScaled = true,
						TextStrokeTransparency = 5,
						Visible = not isLocal,

						[Children] = {
							scope:New("UIStroke")({
								Thickness = 2,
							}),
						},
					}),

					scope:New("TextLabel")({
						Name = "Stunned",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						FontFace = Font.new(
							"rbxassetid://11702779409",
							Enum.FontWeight.Bold,
							Enum.FontStyle.Normal
						),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.2),
						RichText = true,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
						Text = "STUNNED",
						TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 39),
						TextScaled = true,
						TextStrokeTransparency = 5,
						Visible = Stunned,

						[Children] = {
							scope:New("UIStroke")({
								Thickness = 2,
							}),
						},
					}),
				},
			}),
		},
	})

	return {
		Stunned = Stunned,

		Destroy = function()
			cleaner:Destroy()
			scope:doCleanup()
		end,
	}
end

	- `Order.active(people, data?)`: the **active contributors**, people whose `GitHub` login has at least

	  has no name for goes last, by id, until the script runs again.

	Names come from the generated data, not from the page's live lookups, so both lists are known before the first
	entry is built and never move when live names arrive. .github/scripts/credits.py computes the 12-month window and
	repeats these orders to decide when Contributions.luau needs rewriting; both check themselves against
	test/unit/CreditsOrder.json, so change them together. `data` defaults to the generated module (specs pass
	their own).
]]
local Contributions = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Contributions"))
local Credits = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Credits"))

export type Person = Credits.Person
export type Data = Contributions.Contributions

local Order = {}

-- The commits in the window that make someone an active contributor (Credits.luau's `active`, shared with the script).
local ACTIVE = Credits.active.commits

type Rank = { person: Person, commits: number, displayName: string?, name: string? }

local function ranks(people: { Person }, source: Data): { Rank }
	-- GitHub logins are case-insensitive.
	local recent: { [string]: number } = {}
	for login, count in source.recent do
		local key = string.lower(login)
		recent[key] = (recent[key] or 0) + count
	end
	local out: { Rank } = {}
	for _, person in people do
		local names = source.names[person.Id]
		table.insert(out, {
			person = person,
			commits = if person.GitHub then recent[string.lower(person.GitHub)] or 0 else 0,
			displayName = names and string.lower(names.displayName),
			name = names and string.lower(names.name),
		})
	end
	return out
end

local function people(sorted: { Rank }): { Person }
	local out: { Person } = {}
	for index, rank in sorted do
		out[index] = rank.person
	end
	return out
end

function Order.active(list: { Person }, data: Data?): { Person }
	local chosen: { Rank } = {}
	for _, rank in ranks(list, data or Contributions) do
		if rank.commits >= ACTIVE then
			table.insert(chosen, rank)
		end
	end
	table.sort(chosen, function(a: Rank, b: Rank): boolean
		if a.commits ~= b.commits then
			return a.commits > b.commits
		end
		if (a.displayName == nil) ~= (b.displayName == nil) then
			return a.displayName ~= nil
		end
		if a.displayName and b.displayName and a.displayName ~= b.displayName then
			return a.displayName < b.displayName
		end
		if a.name and b.name and a.name ~= b.name then
			return a.name < b.name
		end
		return a.person.Id < b.person.Id
	end)
	return people(chosen)
end

function Order.plain(list: { Person }, data: Data?): { Person }
	local chosen: { Rank } = {}
	for _, rank in ranks(list, data or Contributions) do
		if rank.commits < ACTIVE then
			table.insert(chosen, rank)
		end
	end
	table.sort(chosen, function(a: Rank, b: Rank): boolean
		if (a.name == nil) ~= (b.name == nil) then
			return a.name ~= nil
		end
		if a.name and b.name and a.name ~= b.name then
			return a.name < b.name
		end
		return a.person.Id < b.person.Id
	end)
	return people(chosen)
end

return table.freeze(Order)

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const GameData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.GameData)

const Player = Crane:CreateComponent({
	Name = "Player",
} :: Crane.ComponentDef<Player>)

type PlayerModuleHost = {
	GetModule: (self: PlayerModuleHost, name: string) -> ClientPlayerModule?,
}

export type ClientPlayerModule = {
	Name: string,
	player: PlayerModuleHost,
	playerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	gameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>,
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new()),
	onInit: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
	onStart: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
	onCharacter: ((self: ClientPlayerModule, character: Model) -> ())?,
	onDestroy: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
}

function Player.onStart(self: typeof(Player))
	self.Modules = {}
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	self.CharacterModel = nil
	self.ModulesReady = false

	self.Cleaner:Connect(self.instance.CharacterAdded, function(character: Model)
		self:AttachCharacter(character)
	end)

	if self.instance.Character then self:AttachCharacter(self.instance.Character) end
end

function Player:AttachCharacter(character: Model)
	if self.Character then self.Character:Destroy() end

	self.Character = Crane:AddComponent(character, "Character")
	self:OnCharacter(character)
end

function Player:OnCharacter(character: Model)
	self.CharacterModel = character

	if not self.ModulesReady then return end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		const callback = module.onCharacter
		if not callback then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(callback, module, character)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onCharacter failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end
end

function Player.GetModule(self: typeof(Player), name: string): ClientPlayerModule?
	return self.Modules[name]
end

function Player.InitModules(
	self: typeof(Player),
	playerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	gameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>
)
	const folder = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client["player-modules"]
	if not folder then
		warn("[Player] player-modules folder is missing")
		return
	end

	for _, instance in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not instance:IsA("ModuleScript") then continue end

		const content = Crane.Utils.DeepClone(require(instance)) :: ClientPlayerModule
		content.Name = instance.Name
		content.player = self
		content.playerProxy = playerProxy
		content.gameProxy = gameProxy
		content.Cleaner = self.Cleaner:Scope()
		self.Modules[content.Name] = content
	end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		if not module.onInit then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(module.onInit, module)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onInit failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		if not module.onStart then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(module.onStart, module)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onStart failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end

	self.ModulesReady = true

	if self.CharacterModel then self:OnCharacter(self.CharacterModel) end
end

function Player.Destroy(self: typeof(Player))
	if self.Modules then
		for name, module in self.Modules do
			if module.onDestroy then
				const ok, err = pcall(module.onDestroy, module)
				if not ok then warn(`[Player] onDestroy failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
			end

			module.Cleaner:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if self.Cleaner then self.Cleaner:Destroy() end
end

return Player

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Package = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

local Command = require(Package.Shared.Process:WaitForChild("Command"))

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- RestrictedToRole is filled in once roles load, so name it only when known
local function restrictedMessage(commandText: string, commandDefinition: any): string
	local role = commandDefinition.RestrictedToRole
	return if role then `"{commandText}" command restricted to {role.name}` else `"{commandText}" command restricted`
end

local function findEarliestCommandStart(_K, message: string, prefixList: { string }, delimiter: string): number?
	if delimiter == "%s" then
		delimiter = " "
	end
	local escapedSplit = _K.Util.String.escapePattern(delimiter)
	local commandFormat = '%s[^%s"`,%s]'
	local earliest: number?
	for _, value in prefixList do
		local escapedPrefix = _K.Util.String.escapePattern(value)
		local ignorePrefix = if string.find(value, "^%w") then "" else escapedPrefix
		local found = string.find(message, string.format(commandFormat, escapedPrefix, ignorePrefix, escapedSplit))
		if found and (not earliest or found < earliest) then
			earliest = found
		end
	end
	return earliest
end

return function(_K, text, cursorPosition)
	local from = LocalPlayer.UserId
	local data = {
		commands = {},
		message = text,
		cursorPosition = cursorPosition,
		hasInvalidCommand = false,
		cursorInvalid = false,
		rawCommandsCount = 0,
		invalid = {
			-- {feedback, argPos, rawArg}
		},
	}

	local prefix = _K.getCommandPrefix(from)

	if text == prefix then
		data.argPos = #prefix + 1
		data.argIndex = 0
		data.rawArg = ""
		data.query = ""
		data.suggestionType = "History"
		return data
	end

	local prefixList = { prefix, unpack(_K.Data.settings.prefix) }
	local splitKey = _K.Data.settings.splitKey or " "
	local rawCommands = _K.Process.rawParse(text, prefixList, splitKey)
	if not rawCommands then
		local invalidPos = 1
		for _, candidate in prefixList do
			if type(candidate) == "string" and candidate ~= "" and string.sub(text, 1, #candidate) == candidate then
				invalidPos = math.max(invalidPos, #candidate + 1)
			end
		end
		data.hasInvalidCommand = true
		data.cursorInvalid = true
		table.insert(data.invalid, { "Invalid command string", invalidPos, string.sub(text, invalidPos) })
		return data -- invalid command string, show valid example
	end

	data.rawCommandsCount = #rawCommands

	local earliestStart = findEarliestCommandStart(_K, text, prefixList, splitKey)
	if earliestStart and earliestStart > 1 then
		local leading = string.sub(text, 1, earliestStart - 1)
		local leadStart, leadEnd = string.find(leading, "%S+")
		if leadStart and leadEnd then
			local leadToken = string.sub(leading, leadStart, leadEnd)
			data.hasInvalidCommand = true
			table.insert(data.invalid, { "Invalid command string", leadStart, leadToken })
			if cursorPosition < earliestStart then
				data.cursorInvalid = true
				data.argIndex = 1
				data.argPos = leadStart
				data.rawArg = leadToken
				data.query = leadToken
			end
		end
	end

	for _, commandArray in rawCommands do
		if not commandArray[1] then
			data.hasInvalidCommand = true
			continue
		end
		local commandPos, commandText = unpack(commandArray[1])
		local commandAlias = string.lower(commandText)
		local commandDefinition = _K.Registry.commands[commandAlias]

		local lastArgDefinition = commandDefinition and commandDefinition.args[#commandDefinition.args]
		local lastArgType = lastArgDefinition and _K.Registry.types[lastArgDefinition.type]
		local lastArg = commandArray[#commandArray]
		local commandEnd = lastArg[1] + #lastArg[2]
		local greedy = lastArgType ~= nil and lastArgType.freeText == true

		if cursorPosition < commandArray[1][1] or cursorPosition > commandEnd then --outside current query
			if (commandText == "" or not commandDefinition) and not greedy then
				data.hasInvalidCommand = true
				if not data.argIndex then
					data.argIndex = 1
					data.argPos = commandPos
					data.rawArg = commandText
					data.query = commandText
				end
				local feedback = if commandText == ""
					then "Invalid command"
					else `Invalid command: {commandText}, did you mean "{_K.Registry.suggestCommandAlias(
						commandAlias
					)}"?`
				table.insert(data.invalid, { feedback, commandPos, commandText })
				continue
			elseif commandDefinition then
				local command = Command.new(_K, commandAlias, commandDefinition, commandArray, from, text)
				table.insert(data.commands, command)
				if not commandDefinition.LocalPlayerAuthorized then
					data.hasInvalidCommand = true
					local message = restrictedMessage(commandText, commandDefinition)
					table.insert(data.invalid, { message, commandPos, commandText })
					continue
				end
				local ok, result = command:validate()
				if not ok then
					data.hasInvalidCommand = true
					if command.invalidArg then
						table.insert(
							data.invalid,
							{ command.argMissing or command.invalidMessage, command.invalidPos, command.invalidArg }
						)
					else
						table.insert(data.invalid, { result, commandPos, string.sub(text, commandPos, commandEnd) })
					end
					continue
				end
			end
			continue -- cursor not within commandArray
		end

		if cursorPosition <= commandPos + #commandText then -- within command suggestion
			data.argIndex = 1
			data.argPos = commandPos
			data.rawArg = commandText
			data.query = string.sub(commandText, 1, cursorPosition - commandPos)
			data.suggestionType = _K.Registry.types.command
			local rawSuggestions =
				_K.Util.Suggest.query(data.query, _K.Registry.types.command.suggestions(data.query, from))
			data.suggestions = table.create(#rawSuggestions)
			local invalidSuggestions = {}
			for _, suggestionData in rawSuggestions do
				local _name, _display, cmd = unpack(suggestionData)
				if cmd then
					if cmd.LocalPlayerAuthorized then
						table.insert(data.suggestions, suggestionData)
						data.validSuggestion = true
					else
						suggestionData[4] = true -- invalid
						table.insert(invalidSuggestions, suggestionData)
					end
				end
			end

			if #invalidSuggestions > 0 then
				_K.Util.Table.mergeList(data.suggestions, invalidSuggestions)
			end

			if commandDefinition then
				data.commandDefinition = commandDefinition
			elseif data.suggestions and data.suggestions[1] then
				data.commandDefinition = data.suggestions[1][3]
			end

			if commandDefinition then
				if commandDefinition.LocalPlayerAuthorized then
					local command = Command.new(_K, commandAlias, commandDefinition, commandArray, from, text)
					local ok = command:validate()
					if not ok and command.invalidArg and not command.argMissing then
						data.hasInvalidCommand = true
					end
					table.insert(data.commands, command)
				else
					data.hasInvalidCommand = true
					if
						#data.suggestions == 0
						or not string.find(string.lower(data.suggestions[1][1]), string.lower(data.query), 1, true)
					then
						local message = restrictedMessage(commandText, commandDefinition)
						data.cursorInvalid = true
						table.insert(data.invalid, { message, commandPos, commandText })
					end
				end
			elseif commandText ~= "" then
				local hasAuthorizedMatch = false
				if data.validSuggestion then
					local queryLower = string.lower(data.query)
					for _, s in data.suggestions do
						if not s[4] and string.find(string.lower(s[1]), queryLower, 1, true) then
							hasAuthorizedMatch = true
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if not hasAuthorizedMatch then
					data.hasInvalidCommand = true
				end
			end

			continue
		end

		if commandText == "" or not commandDefinition then
			local feedback = if commandText == ""
				then "Invalid command"
				else `Invalid command: {commandText}, did you mean "{_K.Registry.suggestCommandAlias(commandAlias)}"?`
			data.hasInvalidCommand = true
			data.cursorInvalid = true
			table.insert(data.invalid, { feedback, commandPos, commandText })
			continue
		elseif not commandDefinition.LocalPlayerAuthorized then
			local message = restrictedMessage(commandText, commandDefinition)
			data.hasInvalidCommand = true
			data.cursorInvalid = true
			table.insert(data.invalid, { message, commandPos, commandText })
			continue
		end

		data.commandDefinition = commandDefinition

		local command = Command.new(_K, commandAlias, commandDefinition, commandArray, from, text)
		local ok, result = command:validate()
		table.insert(data.commands, command)

		-- argument suggestions
		for i, arg in command.args do
			local isGreedy = greedy and i == #commandDefinition.args
			if cursorPosition < arg.argPos or (not isGreedy and cursorPosition > arg.argPos + #arg.rawArg) then
				continue
			end
			data.arg = arg
			data.argIndex = i + 1
			data.argPos = arg.argPos
			data.rawArg = arg.rawArg
			data.rawQuery = string.sub(arg.rawArg, 1, cursorPosition - arg.argPos)
			data.query = _K.Util.String.stripQuotes(data.rawQuery)
			data.argDefinition = arg.definition
			data.suggestionType = arg.rawType

			if
				arg.skipped
				and cursorPosition >= arg.argPos
				and (isGreedy or cursorPosition < arg.argPos + #arg.rawArg)
			then
				data.skipped = true
				data.rawQuery = string.sub(arg.skipped, 1, cursorPosition - arg.argPos)
				data.query = _K.Util.String.stripQuotes(data.rawQuery)
				local suggestions, values = arg.rawType.suggestions, nil
				if type(suggestions) == "function" then
					suggestions, values = arg.rawType.suggestions(data.query, from, arg.definition)
				end
				data.suggestions = suggestions and _K.Util.Suggest.query(data.query, suggestions, values)
				if data.suggestions and #data.suggestions > 0 then
					break
				end
			end

			local transformPos = arg.argPos
			for k, rawArg in arg.rawArgs do
				local transformedArg = arg.transformedArgs[k]
				local transformedType = arg.transformedTypes[k]
				local pos = transformPos
				transformPos += #rawArg + 1

				if cursorPosition < pos or (not isGreedy and cursorPosition > transformPos) then
					continue
				end

				data.argPos = if arg.prefix then pos + #arg.prefix else pos
				data.rawArg = rawArg
				data.rawQuery = string.sub(rawArg, 1, cursorPosition - pos)
				data.query = _K.Util.String.stripQuotes(data.rawQuery)
				data.transformedArg = transformedArg
				data.suggestionType = transformedType or data.suggestionType
				local suggestions, values = transformedType and transformedType.suggestions, nil
				if type(suggestions) == "function" then
					suggestions, values = transformedType.suggestions(data.query, from, arg.definition)
				end
				data.suggestions = suggestions and _K.Util.Suggest.query(data.query, suggestions, values)
			end
		end

		if
			not ok
			and not (
				data.suggestionType
				and (
					data.rawArg == ""
					or (
						data.suggestions
						and #data.suggestions > 1
						and if type(data.suggestions[1]) == "table"
							then data.suggestions[1][1] ~= data.rawArg
							else data.suggestions[1] ~= data.rawArg
					)
				)
			)
		then
			command.Error = result
			data.hasInvalidCommand = true
			if command.invalidArg then
				if not command.argMissing then
					data.cursorInvalid = true
					table.insert(data.invalid, { result, command.invalidPos, command.invalidArg })
				end
			else
				data.cursorInvalid = true
				table.insert(data.invalid, { result, commandPos, string.sub(text, commandPos, commandEnd) })
			end
			continue
		end
	end

	return data
end

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const JoystickBinds = require(script.Parent.Parent.controls.JoystickBinds)

-- Hold-to-cast tuning. The server still revalidates every request; these only
-- keep obvious duplicate/spam requests off the wire.
const BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.12
const MAX_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.4

-- First priority level. Candidates inside one slot are sorted by skill id.
const SLOT_RANK = { Spec = 1, SubSpec = 2 }

type Slot = "Spec" | "SubSpec"
type Bind = Enum.KeyCode | Enum.UserInputType

type SkillRef = {
	Slot: Slot,
	SkillId: string,
}

type Candidate = SkillRef & {
	Bind: Bind,
}

type HeldInput = SkillRef & {
	Hold: boolean,
	AttemptAt: number,
	Interval: number,
}

-- The analyzer's Roblox definitions don't list KeyCode.Unknown, but the engine
-- does. Keep the cast in one place instead of widening every bind to `any`.
const UNKNOWN_BIND: Bind = (Enum.KeyCode :: any).Unknown

--- Bundle the Chrono render timestamps with the activation itself: a separate
--- packet could arrive before/after the skill and leave the server with a
--- stale or mismatched aim instant.
const function sendStartSkill(skillId: string)
	const chrono = Crane:GetService("ChronoService")
	const aim = chrono:GetAim()

	Crane:GetPacket("StartSkill").send({
		Id = skillId,
		AimNormal = aim.Normal or 0,
		AimHalf = aim.Half or 0,
	})
end

const BindService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "BindService",
})
BindService.Binds = {} :: { [Bind]: { Candidate } }
BindService.Held = {} :: { [string]: HeldInput }

function BindService.onStart(self: typeof(BindService))
	const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	self.playerProxy =
		Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy :: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>
	self.clientSkills = Crane:GetService("ClientSkillService")
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Janitor.new()
	self.BindSignature = ""

	const function skillData(ref: SkillRef)
		const skills = self.playerProxy().Skills
		const slotSkills = skills and skills[ref.Slot]
		return slotSkills and slotSkills[ref.SkillId]
	end

	const function rebuildBinds()
		const all: { Candidate } = {}
		const parts: { string } = {}

		for slot, _rank in SLOT_RANK do
			const slotName = slot :: Slot
			const skills = self.playerProxy().Skills
			const slotSkills = skills and skills[slotName]
			if not slotSkills then continue end

			for skillId, data in slotSkills do
				const bind = data and data.Parameters and data.Parameters.Bind

				-- `Enum.KeyCode.Unknown` is also what a mouse click reports as
				-- its KeyCode. A skill left on the default bind would therefore
				-- fire on every click, so it must never enter the table.
				if bind == nil or bind == UNKNOWN_BIND then continue end

				table.insert(all, { Bind = bind :: Bind, Slot = slotName, SkillId = skillId })
				table.insert(parts, `{slotName}:{skillId}:{tostring(bind)}`)
			end
		end

		-- Deterministic priority: Spec before SubSpec, then alphabetically.
		table.sort(all, function(a, b)
			if SLOT_RANK[a.Slot] ~= SLOT_RANK[b.Slot] then
				return SLOT_RANK[a.Slot] < SLOT_RANK[b.Slot]
			end
			return a.SkillId < b.SkillId
		end)
		table.sort(parts)

		const signature = table.concat(parts, "|")
		-- Nested patches (ReleaseTime, Enabled, ...) also trigger this subtree
		-- subscription. Only a real rebind may invalidate held inputs.
		if signature ~= self.BindSignature then
			table.clear(self.Held)
			self.BindSignature = signature
		end

		table.clear(self.Binds)
		for _, candidate in all do
			const list = self.Binds[candidate.Bind]
			if list then
				table.insert(list, candidate)
			else
				self.Binds[candidate.Bind] = { candidate }
			end
		end
	end

	self.Cleaner:Add(self.playerProxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "Skills" }, rebuildBinds))
	rebuildBinds()

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		table.clear(self.Held)
	end))

	-- Keep the original InputObject intact: after a gamepad remap the old code
	-- replaced it with an EnumItem and then indexed `.KeyCode` on it.
	const function inputKey(input: InputObject): string
		const remapped = JoystickBinds[input.KeyCode]
		return tostring(input.KeyCode)
			.. "|"
			.. tostring(input.UserInputType)
			.. "|"
			.. tostring(remapped)
	end

	const function resolve(input: InputObject, remapped: Bind?): { Candidate }?
		if remapped then
			const found = self.Binds[remapped]
			if found then return found end
		end

		return self.Binds[input.KeyCode] or self.Binds[input.UserInputType]
	end

	const function canStart(candidate: Candidate): boolean
		const data = skillData(candidate)
		const parameters = data and data.Parameters
		if not parameters or not parameters.Enabled then return false end

		const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		if parameters.ReleaseTime > now then return false end

		return self.clientSkills:CanStart(candidate.SkillId)
	end

	const function isHold(candidate: Candidate): boolean
		const data = skillData(candidate)
		const parameters = data and data.Parameters
		return parameters ~= nil and parameters.Hold == true
	end

	const function pick(candidates: { Candidate }): (Candidate?, boolean?)
		-- Candidates are sorted by slot then skill id. The key belongs to the
		-- first one that can actually start right now: a cooldown, a disabled
		-- skill (e.g. OnlyForStand without a stand), an absent skill or a blocked
		-- state all pass the key to the next candidate in priority order.
		for _, candidate in candidates do
			if canStart(candidate) then return candidate, isHold(candidate) end
		end

		-- Nothing is ready, but a hold-capable candidate must wait for its
		-- window while the key stays down.
		for _, candidate in candidates do
			if isHold(candidate) then return candidate, true end
		end

		return nil
	end

	const function sendStart(candidate: Candidate, hold: boolean, key: string)
		self.clientSkills:Activate(candidate.SkillId)
		sendStartSkill(candidate.SkillId)

		self.Held[key] = {
			Slot = candidate.Slot,
			SkillId = candidate.SkillId,
			Hold = hold,
			AttemptAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL,
			Interval = BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL,
		}
	end

	self.Cleaner:Add(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then return end

		const key = inputKey(input)
		if self.Held[key] then return end -- dedupe OS / gamepad key repeat

		const remapped = JoystickBinds[input.KeyCode]
		const candidates = resolve(input, remapped)
		if not candidates then return end

		const chosen, hold = pick(candidates)
		if not chosen then return end

		sendStart(chosen, hold == true, key)
	end))

	-- Deliberately not gated by `gameProcessed`: a UI that consumes the release
	-- would otherwise leave the skill stuck in the held state.
	self.Cleaner:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		const key = inputKey(input)
		const held = self.Held[key]
		if not held then return end
		self.Held[key] = nil

		self.clientSkills:Stop(held.SkillId)
		Crane:GetPacket("StopSkill").send(held.SkillId)
	end))

	self.Cleaner:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		for _key, held in self.Held do
			if not held.Hold then continue end
			if now < held.AttemptAt then continue end

			held.AttemptAt = now + held.Interval

			const data = skillData(held)
			const parameters = data and data.Parameters
			if not parameters or not parameters.Enabled then continue end

			if parameters.ReleaseTime > now then
				-- Exact wake-up: no polling while the authoritative cooldown runs.
				held.AttemptAt = math.max(held.AttemptAt, parameters.ReleaseTime)
				held.Interval = BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL
				continue
			end

			if not self.clientSkills:CanStart(held.SkillId) then
				-- A stun has an exact replicated end time: wake up on it instead
				-- of polling. Other blocks (ragdoll, restraint, local prediction)
				-- fall back to a capped backoff.
				const state = self.playerProxy().CharacterState
				const stun = state and state.Parameters and state.Parameters.Stun
				if stun and stun.ExpiresAt > now then
					held.AttemptAt = math.max(held.AttemptAt, stun.ExpiresAt)
					held.Interval = BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL
				else
					held.Interval = math.min(held.Interval * 1.5, MAX_RETRY_INTERVAL)
				end
				continue
			end

			held.Interval = BASE_RETRY_INTERVAL
			self.clientSkills:Activate(held.SkillId)
			sendStartSkill(held.SkillId)
		end
	end))
end

return BindService

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Bridge = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Bridge)
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

--[[
	Client half of the Crane Bridge.

	Publishes ReplicatedStorage.Bridge, a Request/Response BindableEvent pair an
	agent can address directly from the client DataModel.

	The server never connects to this pair. The container replicates upward, but a
	BindableEvent signal only ever fires on the side that owns the connection, so
	nothing here is reachable from the other side of the boundary.

	Inert outside a Studio playtest. Nothing is created and nothing is stored on
	the service, so there is no callable surface to reach for either.
]]

const BridgeService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "BridgeService",
	LoadOrder = 1000,
})

function BridgeService:onInit()
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end

	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	self.Container = Bridge.CreateContainer(ReplicatedStorage, "Bridge")

	self.Cleaner:Add(self.Container.Folder)
	self.Cleaner:Connect(self.Container.Request.Event, function(payload)
		Bridge.Dispatch(payload, self.Container.Response)
	end)
end

return BridgeService

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const Chrono = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Chrono)
const LagCompensation = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.combat.LagCompensation)

const ChronoService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "ChronoService",
	LoadOrder = -500,
})

function ChronoService:onInit()
	Chrono.Start(ReplicatedStorage.shared.configs.Chrono)
end

--- The exact server-timeline instants this client is currently rendering.
--- Both clocks exist because distant entities are half-ticked and are shown
--- one extra tick behind. The server picks the right one per target.
function ChronoService:GetAim(): LagCompensation.AimSample
	const config = Chrono.Config.GetEntityType("PLAYER")
	const clocks = config.CLIENT_CLOCK

	local normal = 0
	local half = 0
	if clocks and clocks.NORMAL then normal = clocks.NORMAL:GetTargetRenderTime() end
	if clocks and clocks.HALF then
		half = clocks.HALF:GetTargetRenderTime()
	else
		half = normal
	end

	return { Normal = normal, Half = half }
end

return ChronoService

--!native
--!optimize 2

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const SkillsFolder = script.Parent.Parent.skills

--[=[ ClientSkillService

   A local-only skill layer that runs alongside the authoritative server
   skills. BindService still forwards every press/release to the server; this
   service adds immediate client-side prediction (movement, camera, UI) so the
   game feels responsive before replication lands.

   Improvements over the legacy tool-coupled system:
   * Skills are auto-discovered from `client/skills` — no manual registry.
   * Every activation owns a fresh Buttler cleaner, so a skill's state and
     connections can never leak across activations or respawns.
   * A single-activation guard plus an optional `Toggle` mode cover both
     hold-to-cast and press-to-flip skills with one contract.
   * `CanActivate` gates prediction on the replicated CharacterState, and the
     context hands the skill a `Deactivate` callback so it can resync itself
     when the server disagrees (interrupt, restraint, respawn).

   Contract (each module returns):
     Id: string                      -- matches the server skill id / bind
     Toggle: boolean?                -- press flips state; release is ignored
     CanActivate: (self, ctx) -> boolean?
     Activate: (self, ctx) -> ()     -- ctx.Cleaner owns this activation
     Stop: (self, ctx) -> ()?
]=]

export type ClientSkillContext = {
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new()),
	Character: Model,
	Humanoid: Humanoid,
	CharacterState: any,
	Deactivate: () -> (),
}

export type ClientSkill = {
	Id: string,
	Toggle: boolean?,
	-- One-shot skills (dash, jumps) must not be cut short by InputEnded: the
	-- skill owns its own lifetime through ctx.Deactivate().
	IgnoreRelease: boolean?,
	CanActivate: ((self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> boolean)?,
	Activate: (self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> (),
	Stop: ((self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> ())?,
}

type SkillEntry = {
	Module: ClientSkill,
	Active: boolean,
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new())?,
}

const ClientSkillService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "ClientSkillService",
	LoadOrder = 1,
})

function ClientSkillService.onStart(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	self.Skills = {} :: { [string]: SkillEntry }
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	-- Reused by CanStart so the per-frame input checks never allocate.
	self.CheckCleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	for _, module in SkillsFolder:GetDescendants() do
		if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then continue end

		const skill = require(module) :: ClientSkill
		const id = skill.Id or module.Name
		self.Skills[id] = { Module = skill, Active = false, Cleaner = nil }
	end

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		self:ResetAll()
	end))
end

-- Build the per-activation context. Returns nil when there is no living
-- character to act on, which is what keeps prediction off dead/absent rigs.
function ClientSkillService.MakeContext(
	self: typeof(ClientSkillService),
	skillId: string,
	cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new())
): ClientSkillContext?
	const character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return nil end

	const humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return nil end

	const source = Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy()
	const characterState = source and source.CharacterState

	return {
		Cleaner = cleaner,
		Character = character,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		CharacterState = characterState,
		Deactivate = function()
			self:Deactivate(skillId)
		end,
	}
end

--- Side-effect-free check used by BindService before it sends a StartSkill
--- packet. Skills with a client module use their own `CanActivate` gate; the
--- rest fall back to the replicated CharacterState, which is also what keeps
--- the check honest for skills that have no local prediction at all.
function ClientSkillService.CanStart(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const source = Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy()
	const state = source and source.CharacterState
	const parameters = state and state.Parameters
	if not state or not parameters then return false end

	const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if parameters.Ragdoll or parameters.Restrain then return false end
	if parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > now then return false end

	const character = LocalPlayer.Character
	const humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

	-- A restanding body is still physically down after the authoritative state
	-- cleared. Block local prediction until the humanoid actually stands up.
	if humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
		return false
	end

	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return true end
	if entry.Active then return false end

	const module = entry.Module
	if not module.CanActivate then return true end

	const ctx = self:MakeContext(skillId, self.CheckCleaner)
	if not ctx then return false end

	return module.CanActivate(module, ctx) ~= false
end

function ClientSkillService.Activate(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return false end

	const module = entry.Module

	-- Press-to-flip: a second press while active turns the skill back off.
	if module.Toggle and entry.Active then
		self:Deactivate(skillId)
		return true
	end

	-- Hold-to-cast: ignore repeats while already active.
	if entry.Active then return true end

	const cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	const ctx = self:MakeContext(skillId, cleaner)
	if not ctx then
		cleaner:Destroy()
		return false
	end

	if module.CanActivate and not module.CanActivate(module, ctx) then
		cleaner:Destroy()
		return false
	end

	entry.Active = true
	entry.Cleaner = cleaner
	module.Activate(module, ctx)
	return true
end

function ClientSkillService.Stop(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return false end

	-- Toggle and one-shot skills both ignore key release: the latter ends
	-- itself through ctx.Deactivate() when its movement is actually finished.
	if entry.Module.Toggle or entry.Module.IgnoreRelease then return true end

	self:Deactivate(skillId)
	return true
end

function ClientSkillService.Deactivate(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string)
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry or not entry.Active then return end

	-- Clear the flag first so a resync callback fired during cleanup cannot
	-- re-enter this path.
	entry.Active = false

	const cleaner = entry.Cleaner
	const ctx = cleaner and self:MakeContext(skillId, cleaner)
	if entry.Module.Stop and ctx then entry.Module.Stop(entry.Module, ctx) end

	entry.Cleaner = nil
	if cleaner then cleaner:Destroy() end
end

function ClientSkillService.ResetAll(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	for skillId in self.Skills do
		self:Deactivate(skillId)
	end
end

function ClientSkillService.IsActive(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	return entry ~= nil and entry.Active
end

function ClientSkillService.Destroy(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	self:ResetAll()
	self.Cleaner:Destroy()
	self.CheckCleaner:Destroy()
end

return ClientSkillService

--!optimize 2

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const MovementRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.MovementRules)

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--[=[ MovementService

   Applies the authoritative movement parameters replicated into the player
   proxy (`CharacterState.Parameters`) to the local Humanoid, layered with any
   number of client-side minimum WalkSpeed sources (Run prediction, cutscenes,
   etc.). The highest minimum wins, clamped by the server's maximum, so a local
   prediction can never override a server restraint.
]=]

const MovementService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "MovementService",
	LoadOrder = -5,
})

function MovementService.Apply(self: typeof(MovementService))
	const humanoid = self.Humanoid
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	-- The proxy is rebuilt on respawn and its CharacterState is briefly empty;
	-- applying defaults then would snap the humanoid.
	const source = self.PlayerService.Proxy()
	const characterState = source and source.CharacterState
	if not characterState or not characterState.Parameters then return end

	const parameters = characterState.Parameters
	local minWalkSpeed = parameters.MinWalkSpeed
	for _, speed in self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds do
		minWalkSpeed = math.max(minWalkSpeed, speed)
	end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = MovementRules.GetWalkSpeed(minWalkSpeed, parameters.MaxWalkSpeed)

	const jumpPower = MovementRules.GetJumpPower(parameters.MaxJumpPower)
	humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
	humanoid.JumpHeight = (jumpPower / MovementRules.BaseJumpPower)
		* StarterPlayer.CharacterJumpHeight
end

function MovementService.SetLocalMinWalkSpeed(
	self: typeof(MovementService),
	source: string,
	speed: number?
)
	if speed then
		self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds[source] = speed
	else
		self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds[source] = nil
	end

	self:Apply()
end

function MovementService.Attach(self: typeof(MovementService), character: Model)
	self.CharacterVersion += 1
	const version = self.CharacterVersion
	table.clear(self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds)

	self.Humanoid = nil
	const humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	if version ~= self.CharacterVersion then return end

	self.Humanoid = humanoid
	self:Apply()
end

function MovementService.onStart(self: typeof(MovementService))
	self.PlayerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds = {}
	self.CharacterVersion = 0
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	self.Cleaner:Add(
		self.PlayerService.Proxy:Subscribe(
			"AnyChange",
			{ "CharacterState", "Parameters" },
			function()
				self:Apply()
			end
		)
	)

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		self:Attach(character)
	end))

	if LocalPlayer.Character then self:Attach(LocalPlayer.Character) end
end

function MovementService.Destroy(self: typeof(MovementService))
	self.CharacterVersion += 1
	self.Cleaner:Destroy()
end

return MovementService

local ExplorerOrder = require(script:WaitForChild("ExplorerOrder"))

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Reflection = game:GetService("ReflectionService")

local DragScope = {
	Active = false,
	StartPos = Vector3.zero,
	Ghost = nil :: Instance?,
	TargetNode = nil,
}

local CLIPBOARD = {}
local SELECTION = {}
local SHOW_HIDDEN = false
local NODES = setmetatable({ [game] = { AncestorExpanded = true, Expanded = true, Instance = game } }, { __mode = "k" })

local scroller, updateListThrottled

local function isService(instance: Instance)
	local class = Reflection:GetClass(instance.ClassName)
	return class and class.Permits and class.Permits.GetService
end

local function setAncestorExpanded(node, value)
	local v = if node.Expanded then value else false
	for _, child in node.Instance:GetChildren() do
		local childNode = NODES[child]
		if childNode then
			childNode.AncestorExpanded = v
			setAncestorExpanded(childNode, v)
		end
	end
end

local function getFallbackIcon(instance: Instance)
	local path = if isService(instance)
		then "InsertableObjects/Dark/Standard/Service"
		else "Placeholder/Dark/Standard/Placeholder"

	return `rbxasset://studio_svg_textures/Shared/{path}.png`
end

local classIcons = {}
local function getClassIcon(instance: Instance)
	local existing = classIcons[instance.ClassName]
	if existing ~= nil then
		return existing or getFallbackIcon(instance)
	end

	return `rbxasset://studio_svg_textures/Shared/InsertableObjects/Dark/Standard/{instance.ClassName}.png`
end

local function setClassIcon(item, instance: Instance)
	local existing = classIcons[instance.ClassName]
	if existing ~= nil then
		item._instance.IconFrame.ImageLabel.Image = existing or getFallbackIcon(instance)
		return
	end

	item._instance.IconFrame.ImageLabel.Image =
		"rbxasset://studio_svg_textures/Shared/Placeholder/Dark/Standard/Placeholder.png"

	local texture = `rbxasset://studio_svg_textures/Shared/InsertableObjects/Dark/Standard/{instance.ClassName}.png`
	local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
	decal.Texture = texture

	task.spawn(
		ContentProvider.PreloadAsync,
		ContentProvider,
		{ decal },
		function(path: string, Status: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
			if Status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
				classIcons[instance.ClassName] = path
				if item.node.Instance == instance then
					item._instance.IconFrame.ImageLabel.Image = path
				end
			elseif Status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure or Status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut then
				classIcons[instance.ClassName] = false
				if item.node.Instance == instance then
					item._instance.IconFrame.ImageLabel.Image = getFallbackIcon(instance)
				end
			end
		end
	)
end

local function sortChildren(a, b)
	local orderA = ExplorerOrder[a.ClassName]
	local orderB = ExplorerOrder[b.ClassName]
	if orderA and orderB and orderA ~= orderB then
		return orderA < orderB
	end
	if a.ClassName == b.ClassName then
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end
	return a.ClassName < b.ClassName
end

local function sortNodes(A: Instance, B: Instance)
	local a, b = NODES[A], NODES[B]
	if not a or not b then
		return false
	end
	return a.Index < b.Index
end

local function traverse(instance: Instance, index: number, traverseAll: boolean?)
	local node = NODES[instance]
	if not node or not (node.AncestorExpanded or traverseAll) then
		return index
	end

	node.Index = index

	local children = instance:GetChildren()
	table.sort(children, sortChildren)

	for _, child in children do
		index = traverse(child, index + 1, traverseAll)
	end

	return index
end

local function instanceRemoving(instance: Instance)
	local parentNode = instance.Parent and NODES[instance.Parent]
	if parentNode and parentNode.Expanded then
		updateListThrottled(scroller)
	end
end

local function check(instance: Instance)
	return instance.AncestryChanged
end

local function isAncestorExpanded(instance: Instance)
	if instance == game then
		return true
	end

	local parent = instance.Parent
	while parent do
		if parent == game then
			return true
		end
		local node = NODES[parent]
		if node and not node.Expanded then
			return false
		end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end

	return false
end

local function cleanupNode(node)
	if node._ancestryConn then
		node._ancestryConn:Disconnect()
		node._ancestryConn = nil
	end
	if node._destroyingConn then
		node._destroyingConn:Disconnect()
		node._destroyingConn = nil
	end
	node.Connection = nil
	node.Selected = false
	local selIdx = table.find(SELECTION, node)
	if selIdx then
		table.remove(SELECTION, selIdx)
	end
	local clipIdx = table.find(CLIPBOARD, node.Instance)
	if clipIdx then
		table.remove(CLIPBOARD, clipIdx)
	end
	if DragScope.TargetNode == node then
		DragScope.TargetNode = nil
	end
	if _K and _K.Flux and _K.Flux.dispose then
		_K.Flux.dispose(node)
	end
end

local function removeNode(instance)
	local node = NODES[instance]
	if node then
		cleanupNode(node)
		NODES[instance] = nil
	end

	for _, descendant in instance:GetDescendants() do
		local descNode = NODES[descendant]
		if descNode then
			cleanupNode(descNode)
			NODES[descendant] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function refreshSubtreeDepth(rootInstance: Instance, rootNode: any)
	for _, desc in rootInstance:GetDescendants() do
		local descNode = NODES[desc]
		if descNode then
			local depth = rootNode.Depth
			local curr: Instance? = desc
			while curr and curr ~= rootInstance do
				depth += 1
				curr = curr.Parent
			end
			descNode.Depth = depth
			descNode.AncestorExpanded = isAncestorExpanded(desc)
		end
	end
end

local function instanceAdded(instance: Instance, parent: Instance?)
	if not pcall(check, instance) then
		return
	end

	if not parent then
		parent = instance.Parent
	end

	local existingNode = NODES[instance]
	local wasVisible = existingNode and existingNode.AncestorExpanded

	if not parent then
		if existingNode then
			removeNode(instance)
			if wasVisible or isAncestorExpanded(instance) then
				updateListThrottled(scroller)
			end
		end
		return
	end

	local tree, currParent = { instance }, parent
	while currParent do
		table.insert(tree, currParent)
		currParent = currParent.Parent
	end

	for i = #tree - 1, 1, -1 do
		local obj = tree[i]
		local objNode = NODES[obj]
		if not objNode then
			objNode = {
				AncestorExpanded = isAncestorExpanded(obj),
				Expanded = false,
				Selected = false,
				Instance = obj,
				Index = 0,
			}
			NODES[obj] = objNode
		end
		objNode.Depth = (#tree - i) - 1
	end

	local node = NODES[instance]
	if node then
		node.AncestorExpanded = isAncestorExpanded(instance)
		refreshSubtreeDepth(instance, node)
		if not node.Connection then
			node.Connection = true

			node._ancestryConn = instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				instanceAdded(instance, instance.Parent)
			end)
			node._destroyingConn = instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
				local parentNode = instance.Parent and NODES[instance.Parent]
				local destroyWasVisible = node.AncestorExpanded or (parentNode and parentNode.Expanded)
				removeNode(instance)
				if destroyWasVisible then
					updateListThrottled(scroller)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local parentNode = NODES[parent]
	if wasVisible or (parentNode and parentNode.Expanded) then
		updateListThrottled(scroller)
	end
end

local function parentInstanceUnsafe(instance: Instance, parent: Instance?)
	instance.Parent = parent
end

local function COPY()
	table.clear(CLIPBOARD)
	for _, node in SELECTION do
		local inst = node.Instance
		if inst and inst.Archivable and not inst:IsA("Player") and not inst:IsA("Terrain") and not isService(inst) then
			table.insert(CLIPBOARD, inst)
		end
	end
end

local function DELETE()
	local instances = table.create(#SELECTION)
	for _, node in SELECTION do
		local inst = node.Instance
		node.Selected = false
		if inst and not inst:IsA("Player") and not isService(inst) then
			table.insert(instances, inst)
		end
	end
	if scroller then
		for _, v in scroller._lineItemCache do
			v.selected(false)
		end
		for _, v in scroller._lineItemFree do
			v.selected(false)
		end
		UI.flush()
	end
	table.clear(SELECTION)
	if #instances == 0 then
		return
	end
	_K.Remote.Explorer:Fire("DELETE", instances)

	if _K.IsServer then
		for _, inst in instances do
			local _ = pcall(game.Destroy, inst)
		end
	end
end

local function PASTE()
	local selected = SELECTION[1]
	if not selected or not selected.Instance or not next(CLIPBOARD) then
		return
	end
	_K.Remote.Explorer:Fire("PASTE", CLIPBOARD, selected.Instance)

	if not selected.Expanded then
		selected.Expanded = true
		setAncestorExpanded(selected, true)
	end

	updateListThrottled(scroller)
end

	local function updateGhost(position: Vector3)
		if DragScope.Ghost then
			DragScope.Ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X + 6, position.Y - 10 + UI.TopbarInset:peek().Height)
		end
	end

	local function executeReparent()
		if not DragScope.TargetNode or not DragScope.TargetNode.Instance then
			return
		end

		local target = DragScope.TargetNode.Instance
		local instances = {}

		for _, node in SELECTION do
			local inst = node.Instance
			if
				inst
				and inst ~= target
				and not isService(inst)
				and not inst:IsA("Player")
				and not target:IsDescendantOf(inst)
				and inst.Parent ~= target
			then
				table.insert(instances, inst)
			end
		end

		if #instances > 0 then
			_K.Remote.Explorer:Fire("PARENT", instances, target)
			if _K.IsServer then
				for _, inst in instances do
					pcall(parentInstanceUnsafe, inst, target)
				end
			end
			if DragScope.TargetNode then
				DragScope.TargetNode.Expanded = true
				setAncestorExpanded(DragScope.TargetNode, DragScope.TargetNode.Expanded)
				updateListThrottled(scroller)
			end
		end
	end

	local _ = UI.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			if DragScope.Active then
				updateGhost(input.Position)
			end
		end
	end)

	local _ = UI.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if DragScope.Active then
				executeReparent()
				DragScope.Active = false
				DragScope.TargetNode = nil
				if DragScope.Ghost then
					DragScope.Ghost:Destroy()
					DragScope.Ghost = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local _ = UI.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
		if gameProcessed or not Explorer._instance.Visible then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local ctrl = UI.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C and ctrl then
				COPY()
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V and ctrl then
				PASTE()
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
				DELETE()
			end
		end
	end)

	scroller = UI.new "ScrollerFast" {
		Parent = Explorer,
		List = NODES,
		DictList = true,
		Enabled = true,
		FilterInput = true,
		Visible = true,
		ItemSize = itemSize,
		CreateItem = function(self)
			local item: { [string]: any } = {}
			local lastActivate = 0
			item._instance = UI.new "TextButton" {
				Parent = Explorer._content,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				BackgroundColor3 = UI.Theme.Secondary,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				TextTransparency = 1,
				Size = itemSize,

				UI.padding(0),

				UI.list {
					direction = "x",
					verticalAlign = "center",
				},

				UI.new "TextButton" {
					Name = "Expand",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),

					UI.new "ImageLabel" {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
						Image = UI.Theme.Image.Down,
						Rotation = -90,
					},

					Activated = function()
						if item._instance.Expand.ImageLabel.Visible then
							item.node.Expanded = not item.node.Expanded
							setAncestorExpanded(item.node, item.node.Expanded)

							scroller:refreshList()
						end
					end,
				},

				UI.new "Frame" {
					Name = "IconFrame",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),

					UI.new "ImageLabel" {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
						Image = UI.Theme.Image.Add,
					},
				},

				UI.new "TextLabel" {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans,
					TextSize = 16,
					TextColor3 = UI.Theme.PrimaryText,
					TextStrokeColor3 = UI.Theme.Primary,
					TextStrokeTransparency = UI.Theme.TextStrokeTransparency,
					TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.SplitWord,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0),
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				},

				-- LOGIC START --
				Activated = function()
					if item._instance.Expand.ImageLabel.Visible then
						local last = lastActivate
						lastActivate = os.clock()
						if lastActivate - last < 0.3 then
							item.node.Expanded = not item.node.Expanded
							setAncestorExpanded(item.node, item.node.Expanded)
							scroller:refreshList()
							return
						end
					end

					local ctrl = UI.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
					local shift = UI.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)

					if ctrl or shift then -- Toggle selection
						item.node.Selected = not item.node.Selected
						if item.node.Selected then
							table.insert(SELECTION, item.node)
							item.selected(true)
						else
							local idx = table.find(SELECTION, item.node)
							if idx then
								table.remove(SELECTION, idx)
								item.selected(false)
							end
						end
					else -- Single select
						for _, v in scroller._lineItemCache do
							v.selected(false)
						end
						for _, v in scroller._lineItemFree do
							v.selected(false)
						end
						for _, v in SELECTION do
							v.Selected = false
						end
						table.clear(SELECTION)

						item.node.Selected = true
						table.insert(SELECTION, item.node)
						item.selected(true)
					end
					UI.flush()
				end,

				TouchLongPress = function(input, processed)
					DragScope.StartPos = input.Position
				end,

				InputBegan = function(input, processed)
					if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
						DragScope.StartPos = input.Position
					end
				end,

				InputChanged = function(input, processed)
					if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
						if
							not DragScope.Active
							and UI.UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
							and item.node
							and item.node.Depth > 0
						then
							local delta = (input.Position - DragScope.StartPos).Magnitude
							if delta > 5 then
								DragScope.Active = true

								if item.node and not item.node.Selected then
									for _, v in SELECTION do
										v.Selected = false
									end
									table.clear(SELECTION)
									item.node.Selected = true
									table.insert(SELECTION, item.node)
									scroller:refreshList()
								end

								createGhost()
								updateGhost(input.Position)
							end
						end
					end
				end,
			}

			item.selected = UI.signal(false)
			item.hovering = UI.Interact.hover(item._instance, { within = true })
			local dragHoverEffect = UI.effect(UI.on(item.hovering, function(hover)
				if hover and DragScope.Active then
					DragScope.TargetNode = item.node
				elseif not hover and DragScope.TargetNode == item.node then
					DragScope.TargetNode = nil
				end
			end, true))
			dragHoverEffect:get()
			local bgTransparency = UI.computed(function()
				local hover = item.hovering()
				if item.selected() then
					return 0.75
				end
				return if hover then 0.875 else 1
			end)
			UI.edit(item._instance)({
				BackgroundTransparency = bgTransparency,
				__CLEAN = { item.selected, item.hovering, dragHoverEffect, bgTransparency },
			})

			return item
		end,
		RenderItem = function(self, item, instance)
			local node = NODES[instance]
			if node then
				item.node = node
				item._instance.TextLabel.Text = instance.Name
				item.selected(node.Selected == true)
				UI.flush()

				setClassIcon(item, instance)
				item._instance.Expand.ImageLabel.Visible = #instance:GetChildren() > 0
				item._instance.Expand.ImageLabel.Rotation = if node.Expanded then 0 else -90
				item._instance.UIPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, node.Depth * 10)
			end
		end,
	}

	UI.new "Tooltip" {
		Parent = scroller._input._instance.ImageLabel,
		Text = "Search uses game:QueryDescendants()",
	}

	updateListThrottled = _K.Util.Function.throttle(1, scroller.updateList)

	scroller:filter(function(self, list)
		local new = {}
		local rawFilter = scroller._input._input.Text
		local filter = rawFilter
		self._filter = filter

		local noFilter = string.find(self._filter, "^%s*$")
		local query

		if noFilter then
			for _, instance in list do
				if not ExplorerOrder[instance.ClassName] and not SHOW_HIDDEN then
					continue
				end
				local node = NODES[instance]
				if node and node.AncestorExpanded and node.Depth then
					table.insert(new, instance)
				end
			end
		else
			-- prefix names with "#"
			if string.find(filter, "^[%w_]+$") and not Reflection:GetClass(filter) then
				filter = "#" .. filter
			end

			local cache, count, ok = {}, 0, nil
			ok, query = pcall(game.QueryDescendants, game, filter)
			if not ok then
				query = {}
			end

			if #query > 0 then
				for _, instance in query do
					if not ExplorerOrder[instance.ClassName] and not SHOW_HIDDEN then
						continue
					end
					local node = NODES[instance]
					if node and node.Depth then
						count += 1
						cache[instance] = true

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerComponent = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.components.Player)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const PlayerService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "PlayerService",
	LoadOrder = -10,
})

function PlayerService.onInit(self: typeof(PlayerService))
	self.Player = Crane:AddComponent(Players.LocalPlayer, "Player")

	local proxies = {}

	Crane:GetPacket("RequestProxy").listen(function(data)
		proxies = data
	end)

	while #proxies == 0 do
		Crane:GetPacket("RequestProxy").send()
		task.wait()
	end

	self.Proxy = Proxy(proxies[1])
	self.GameProxy = Proxy(proxies[2])

	Crane:GetPacket("Patch").listen(function(data)
		self.Proxy:Patch(data[1])
		self.GameProxy:Patch(data[2])
	end)

	self.Player:InitModules(self.Proxy, self.GameProxy)
end

function PlayerService.onStart(self: typeof(PlayerService)) end

function PlayerService:GetPlayer()
	return self.Player
end

return PlayerService

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
const Mouse = Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
const Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const TargetLockService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "TargetLockService",
})

function TargetLockService:Lock()
	const humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	const root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart

	const target = Mouse.Target
	if not target then return end

	if (target.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then return end

	const targetHumanoid = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if not targetHumanoid then return end

	const targetRoot = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	if not targetRoot then return end

	--hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(1.75,0,0) -- I assume this is about the right camera offset.
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false --Disable the automatic rotation since we are the ones setting it.

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(
		"ShiftLock",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value,
		function(deltaTime)
			if humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then return end

			if not root or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end
			if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end

			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter --Set the mouse to center every frame.

			root.CFrame = root.CFrame:Lerp(
				CFrame.new(
					root.Position,
					Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, root.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
				),
				deltaTime * 5
			) --Set the root part to the camera's rotation
		end
	)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(
		"ShiftLockCamera",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 5,
		function(deltaTime)
			if not root or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end
			if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end

			const targetVector = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Unit
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, targetRoot.Position)
				:ToWorldSpace(CFrame.new(humanoid.CameraOffset + Vector3.new(3, 4, 14)))
		end
	)

	self.Locked = true
end

function TargetLockService:Unlock()
	const humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	const root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	humanoid.AutoRotate = true --Let the humanoid handle the camera rotations again.

	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShiftLock") -- Allow mouse to move freely.
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShiftLockCamera")
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

	self.Locked = false
end

function TargetLockService:onStart()
	self.Locked = false

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then return end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonSelect then
			if self.Locked then
				self:Unlock()
			else
				self:Lock()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return TargetLockService

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

const UIStartPoint = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.ui.main

const UIService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "UIService",
})

function UIService:onStart()
	const PlayerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")

	if UIStartPoint and UIStartPoint:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		require(UIStartPoint)(PlayerService.Proxy, PlayerService.GameProxy)
	end
end

return UIService

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const ForgeVFX = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.ForgeVFX)
const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerComponent = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.components.Player)
const Configuration = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.Configuration

const EffectsFolder = ReplicatedStorage.shared.effects

type Effect = {
	Validate: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> boolean,
	onStart: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> (),
	onStop: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> (),
}

const VFXService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "VFXService",
})
VFXService.Effects = {} :: { [string]: Effect }

function VFXService.onStart(self: typeof(VFXService))
	ForgeVFX.init()

	for i, module in EffectsFolder:QueryDescendants("ModuleScript") do
		self.Effects[module.Name] = require(module)
	end

	const StartVFXPacket = Crane:GetPacket("StartVFX")
	const StopVFXPacket = Crane:GetPacket("StopVFX")

	StartVFXPacket.listen(function(data: { name: string, args: { unknown } })
		self:StartEffect(data.name, data.args[1])
	end)

	StopVFXPacket.listen(function(data: { name: string, args: { unknown } })
		self:StopEffect(data.name, data.args[1])
	end)
end

function VFXService:StartEffect(name: string, data: any?)
	if not self.Effects[name] then
		Crane.Utils.Log(script.Name, `Can't find VFX with name {name}`, "error")
		return
	end

	const effect: Effect = self.Effects[name]
	if effect.Validate and not effect:Validate(data) then return end

	effect:onStart(data)
end

function VFXService:StopEffect(name: string, data: any?)
	if not self.Effects[name] then
		Crane.Utils.Log(script.Name, `Can't find VFX with name {name}`, "error")
		return
	end

	const effect: Effect = self.Effects[name]
	if effect.onStop then effect:onStop(data) end
end

return VFXService

--!native
--!optimize 2

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const DashMovement = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.DashMovement)
const ClientSkillService = require(script.Parent.Parent.services.ClientSkillService)

type Context = ClientSkillService.ClientSkillContext

--[=[ Dash (client prediction)

   The server stays authoritative for cooldown and i-frames, but the local
   player owns its own character physics. Applying the mover here makes the
   dash feel instant; the server skill deliberately skips it for player-owned
   characters and still creates one for NPCs.

   Animation is also owned by this client through the shared "Dash" effect, so
   the server never starts or stops an animation for the local player.
]=]

-- ReleaseTime is now server time and is directly comparable on the client.
-- The local timer still drives prediction on the same frame as the press;
-- the server remains the final validator.
local LastActivateAt = -math.huge

local function canActivate(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context): boolean
	const state = ctx.CharacterState
	if not state or not state.Parameters then return false end

	const parameters = state.Parameters
	const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	if ctx.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > now then return false end
	if parameters.Ragdoll then return false end
	if parameters.Restand then return false end
	if parameters.Restrain then return false end
	if
		ctx.Humanoid.PlatformStand
		or ctx.Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
	then
		return false
	end
	if now - LastActivateAt < DashMovement.Config.Cooldown then return false end

	return true
end

local function activate(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	LastActivateAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	const rootPart = ctx.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not rootPart then
		ctx.Deactivate()
		return
	end

	const playerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	const vfxService = Crane:GetService("VFXService")

	const moveDirection = DashMovement.GetDirection(ctx.Humanoid.MoveDirection, rootPart.CFrame)
	const mover = DashMovement.Apply(rootPart, moveDirection, ctx.Humanoid)
	ctx.Cleaner:Set("DashMover", mover, "Destroy")

	-- The shared Dash effect derives the animation direction from the vector
	-- itself. No server-side start/stop for the local player.
	-- Proxy().Spec / .SubSpec hold spec UUIDs, not config names. Skins are keyed
	-- by the name inside Specs[uuid], so resolve it first (and prefer the slot
	-- that actually owns Dash).
	const playerData = playerService.Proxy()
	const skills = playerData.Skills
	const dashSlot = if skills and skills.SubSpec and skills.SubSpec.Dash then "SubSpec" else "Spec"
	const specId = if dashSlot == "SubSpec" then playerData.SubSpec else playerData.Spec
	const specConfig = playerData.Specs and playerData.Specs[specId]
	const specName = specConfig and specConfig.Name
	if specName and specName ~= "None" then
		vfxService:StartEffect("Dash", {
			Character = ctx.Character,
			SpecData = { SpecId = specName, SkinId = "None" },
			-- The effect picks the animation from the object-space normal; a
			-- world vector would select the wrong Dash side.
			Normal = mover.LocalDirection,
		})
	end

	ctx.Cleaner:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		-- Finish only when the shared tick says the slide / air cap is done.
		-- A fixed timer would drop the mover before the cap is reached and the
		-- leftover inertia would still carry the player too far in the air.
		if not DashMovement.Update(mover, deltaTime) then ctx.Deactivate() end
	end))

	-- Resync: if the authoritative state says the character can no longer dash,
	-- drop the local prediction immediately instead of waiting for key release.
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(
		playerService.Proxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "CharacterState", "Parameters" }, function()
			const state = playerService.Proxy().CharacterState
			if not state or not state.Parameters then return end

			const parameters = state.Parameters
			if
				parameters.Ragdoll
				or parameters.Restand
				or parameters.Restrain
				or ctx.Humanoid.PlatformStand
				or ctx.Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
				or ctx.Humanoid.Health <= 0
				or (parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
			then
				ctx.Deactivate()
			end
		end)
	)
end

local function stop(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	ctx.Cleaner:Remove("DashMover")
end

const Dash: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill = {
	Id = "Dash",
	IgnoreRelease = true,
	CanActivate = canActivate,
	Activate = activate,
	Stop = stop,
}

return Dash

--!native
--!optimize 2

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const MovementRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.MovementRules)
const ClientSkillService = require(script.Parent.Parent.services.ClientSkillService)

type Context = ClientSkillService.ClientSkillContext

--[=[ Run (client prediction)

   Press-to-flip sprint. The server owns the real `MinWalkSpeed` parameter;
   this skill only predicts it locally so the speed change is felt on the same
   frame as the press, then resyncs itself the moment the authoritative value
   disagrees (server toggled it off, an interrupt landed, the character died).

   No tool state is involved: the gate reads the replicated CharacterState
   directly through MovementRules.CanRun.
]=]

const Run: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill = {
	Id = "Run",
	Toggle = true,
}

function Run.CanActivate(self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context): boolean
	const characterState = ctx.CharacterState
	if not characterState or not characterState.Parameters then return false end

	const parameters = characterState.Parameters
	const humanoidState = ctx.Humanoid:GetState()

	return MovementRules.CanRun({
		Alive = ctx.Character.Parent ~= nil and humanoidState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,
		Stunned = parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		Ragdolled = parameters.Ragdoll,
		Restrained = parameters.Restrain,
		Blocking = characterState.Blocking,
		Physics = humanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
	})
end

function Run.Activate(self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	const movement = Crane:GetService("MovementService")
	movement:SetLocalMinWalkSpeed("Run", MovementRules.RunSpeed)
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(function()
		movement:SetLocalMinWalkSpeed("Run", nil)
	end)

	-- Resync: when the server's authoritative minimum drops below the sprint
	-- speed, the prediction is stale — hand it back without waiting for a press.
	const playerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(
		playerService.Proxy:Subscribe(
			"AnyChange",
			{ "CharacterState", "Parameters", "MinWalkSpeed" },
			function()
				const state = playerService.Proxy().CharacterState
				const min = state and state.Parameters and state.Parameters.MinWalkSpeed or 0
				if min < MovementRules.RunSpeed then ctx.Deactivate() end
			end
		)
	)
end

return Run

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const GameData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.GameData)
const ChargeState = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.combat.ChargeState)

const peek = Fusion.peek

const HamonView = require(script.Parent.Parent.views.HamonView)

type HamonSnapshot = ChargeState.Snapshot

return function(
	scope: Fusion.Scope,
	playerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	gameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>
)
	const hamonScope = scope:innerScope()

	const readSnapshot = function(): HamonSnapshot?
		const source = playerProxy()
		if not source or not source.CharacterState then return nil end
		const parameters = source.CharacterState.Parameters
		if not parameters then return nil end
		return parameters.HamonCharge
	end

	const snapshot = hamonScope:Value(readSnapshot())
	const liveAmount = hamonScope:Value(0)

	const updateLive = function()
		const state = peek(snapshot)
		liveAmount:set(
			if state then ChargeState.Effective(state, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) else 0
		)
	end

	updateLive()

	table.insert(
		hamonScope,
		playerProxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "CharacterState", "Parameters" }, function()
			const nextState = readSnapshot()
			if not nextState then return end
			snapshot:set(nextState)
			updateLive()
		end)
	)

	table.insert(hamonScope, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(updateLive))

	const text = hamonScope:Computed(function(use)
		const state = use(snapshot)
		return ("Hamon: %.1f / %d"):format(use(liveAmount), (if state then state.Max else 100))
	end)

	return HamonView(hamonScope, {
		Text = text,
	})
end
