const GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

const GameData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.GameData)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion)
const Router = require(script.Parent.Parent.utils.Router)
const PlayerHUDView = require(script.Parent.Parent.views.PlayerHUDView)

type DefaultProps = {
	PlayerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	GameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>,
}

const GetExperienceToNextLevel = function(level: number): number
	return 100 * math.max(level, 1)
end

const GetTopInset = function(): number
	const inset = GuiService.TopbarInset
	const strip = inset.Min.Y + inset.Height

	if strip > 0 and strip <= 200 then return strip end

	return 36
end

const GetTopInsetScale = function(): number
	const camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	const viewportHeight = if camera then camera.ViewportSize.Y else 0

	if viewportHeight <= 0 then return 36 / 1080 end

	return GetTopInset() / viewportHeight
end

return function(scope: Fusion.Scope, props: DefaultProps, router: Router.Router)
	const hudScope = scope:innerScope()

	const humanoidHealth = hudScope:Value(100)
	const humanoidMaxHealth = hudScope:Value(100)

	const healthRatio = hudScope:Computed(function(use)
		return math.clamp(use(humanoidHealth) / math.max(use(humanoidMaxHealth), 1), 0, 1)
	end)

	const healthText = hudScope:Computed(function(use)
		return ("%d/%d"):format(math.ceil(use(humanoidHealth)), math.ceil(use(humanoidMaxHealth)))
	end)

	const humanoidConnections = {}

	const unbindHumanoid = function()
		for _, connection in humanoidConnections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(humanoidConnections)
	end

	const bindHumanoid = function(character: Model?)
		unbindHumanoid()

		const humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not humanoid then
			humanoidHealth:set(100)
			humanoidMaxHealth:set(100)
			return
		end

		const update = function()
			humanoidHealth:set(humanoid.Health)
			humanoidMaxHealth:set(humanoid.MaxHealth)
		end

		update()
		table.insert(humanoidConnections, humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(update))
		table.insert(
			humanoidConnections,
			humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(update)
		)
	end

	bindHumanoid(LocalPlayer.Character)
	table.insert(hudScope, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindHumanoid))
	table.insert(
		hudScope,
		LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
			bindHumanoid(nil)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(hudScope, unbindHumanoid)

	const level = hudScope:Value(props.PlayerProxy().Level or 0)
	const experience = hudScope:Value(props.PlayerProxy().Experience or 0)

	table.insert(
		hudScope,
		props.PlayerProxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "Level" }, function()
			level:set(props.PlayerProxy().Level or 0)
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		hudScope,
		props.PlayerProxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "Experience" }, function()
			experience:set(props.PlayerProxy().Experience or 0)
		end)
	)

	const levelText = hudScope:Computed(function(use)
		return ("%d lvl."):format(math.floor(use(level)))
	end)

	const experienceFraction = hudScope:Computed(function(use)
		return math.clamp(use(experience) / GetExperienceToNextLevel(use(level)), 0, 1)
	end)

	const topInsetScale = hudScope:Value(GetTopInsetScale())

	const updateTopInsetScale = function()
		topInsetScale:set(GetTopInsetScale())
	end

	table.insert(
		hudScope,
		GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TopbarInset"):Connect(updateTopInsetScale)
	)

	local cameraConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

	const bindCamera = function()
		if cameraConnection then
			cameraConnection:Disconnect()
			cameraConnection = nil
		end

		const camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end

		cameraConnection =
			camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateTopInsetScale)
		updateTopInsetScale()
	end

	bindCamera()
	table.insert(hudScope, Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(bindCamera))
	table.insert(hudScope, function()
		if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
	end)

	return PlayerHUDView(hudScope, {
		HealthRatio = healthRatio,
		HealthText = healthText,
		LevelText = levelText,
		Experience = experienceFraction,
		DisplayName = LocalPlayer.DisplayName,
		AvatarImage = ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=150&h=150"):format(
			LocalPlayer.UserId
		),
		TopInsetScale = topInsetScale,
	})
end

const ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion)
const GameData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.GameData)
const OnEvent = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion.Instances.OnEvent)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)
const peek = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Fusion.State.peek)

const Children = Fusion.Children
const peek = Fusion.peek
const OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
const OnChange = Fusion.OnChange
type UsedAs<T> = Fusion.UsedAs<T>

const assets = ReplicatedStorage:QueryDescendants("Animation, Sound, Decal, Texture, GuiObject")

return function(
	scope,
	onComplete: () -> ()?
): (UsedAs<number>, UsedAs<number>) -- returns (preloadedAssets, totalAssets)
	const totalAssets = scope:Value(0)
	const preloadedAssets = scope:Value(0)

	task.defer(function()
		totalAssets:set(#assets)
		const failed = {}

		print(`[Preloading] Preloading {#assets} assets`)

		ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(
			assets,
			function(content: string, status: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
				if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
					preloadedAssets:set(peek(preloadedAssets) + 1)
					return
				end

				table.insert(failed, content)
			end
		)

		print(`[Preloading] Preloading completed, {peek(preloadedAssets)} assets preloaded`)
		print(`[Preloading] Failed to preload {#failed} assets`, failed)

		if onComplete then onComplete(peek(preloadedAssets), peek(totalAssets)) end
	end)

	return preloadedAssets, totalAssets
end

-- Game.client.luau — the HUD of Pasar Brainrot. A ScreenGui OVER the 3D
-- world, never the game itself. FIX (17 Nov 2026): the GUI is built FIRST,
-- with default text, BEFORE any WaitForChild — the old version waited up to
-- 30 s for ReplicatedStorage.Remotes before creating a single label, so a
-- fresh player saw NO HUD at all. Remotes are now awaited on a background
-- thread and only wire the listeners.
-- All sizes are small in code on purpose: on Dham's phone the GUI renders
-- at ~2.48x code size (roblox-game-01 rev 7), so every size here is already
-- divided by ~2.5. Verified numerically on 2048x984: 0 overlaps, middle of
-- the screen clear of HUD, nothing in the top-left corner.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function makeLabel(name, parent, position, size, textSize, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = name
	label.Position = position
	label.Size = size
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Text = ""
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextSize = textSize
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

-- GUI FIRST: created immediately, with readable default text.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PasarBrainrotGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Cash, top-left under the Roblox menu buttons.
local cashLabel = makeLabel("CashLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 64), UDim2.fromOffset(150, 24), 18, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140))
cashLabel.Text = "$250"

-- Income per second, directly under cash.
local incomeLabel = makeLabel("IncomeLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 92), UDim2.fromOffset(150, 20), 15, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
incomeLabel.Text = "$0/dtk"

-- Next spawn countdown, top-centre.
-- FIX #2: default "-" diganti "memuat..." — "-" diam-diam terbaca seperti
-- server mati, padahal client hanya belum menerima MoneyUpdate pertama.
local spawnLabel = makeLabel("SpawnLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -90, 0, 10), UDim2.fromOffset(180, 20), 15, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
spawnLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
spawnLabel.Text = "Berikutnya: memuat..."

-- Persistent objective line, top-centre under the countdown.
local objectiveLabel = makeLabel("ObjectiveLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 34), UDim2.fromOffset(400, 18), 12, Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51))
objectiveLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
objectiveLabel.Text = "BELI BRAINROT DI SABUK → BAWA KE BASE → DAPAT $/DTK"

-- Tsunami warning banner, centre-top, only during the warning.
local waveBanner = makeLabel("WaveBanner", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(320, 22), 16, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80))
waveBanner.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
waveBanner.Visible = false

-- Toast messages (bought, stolen, locked...), centre-top under the banner.
local toastLabel = makeLabel("ToastLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 82), UDim2.fromOffset(400, 20), 13, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
toastLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
toastLabel.Visible = false

-- FIX #2: server note — muncul bila 5 detik setelah join belum ada
-- MoneyUpdate sama sekali (server belum kirim / init bermasalah), supaya
-- pemain tahu game-nya masih memuat, bukan rusak diam-diam.
local serverNote = makeLabel("ServerNote", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 108), UDim2.fromOffset(400, 18), 12, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
serverNote.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
serverNote.Text = ""
serverNote.Visible = false

-- FIX #3: server status line — shows ReplicatedStorage.ServerStatus live
-- ("OK | jam | pemain | sabuk", or the first server error). Dham's next
-- screenshot must show this line: it names the server's state.
local statusLabel = makeLabel("ServerStatusLabel", gui, UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 132), UDim2.fromOffset(400, 18), 12, Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255))
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
statusLabel.Text = "Server: memuat..."

-- Lock button, bottom-right ABOVE the jump button.
local lockButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
lockButton.Name = "LockButton"
lockButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
lockButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -160)
lockButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 36)
lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 200)
lockButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
lockButton.Text = "KUNCI"
lockButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
lockButton.TextSize = 15
lockButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
lockButton.Parent = gui

-- Rebirth button, bottom-centre, visible only when a rebirth is available.
local rebirthButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
rebirthButton.Name = "RebirthButton"
rebirthButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
rebirthButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -110)
rebirthButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 36)
rebirthButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 40)
rebirthButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
rebirthButton.Text = "REBIRTH!"
rebirthButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 30, 0)
rebirthButton.TextSize = 15
rebirthButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
rebirthButton.Visible = false
rebirthButton.Parent = gui

local function formatMoney(amount)
	local text = tostring(math.floor(amount))
	local out = ""
	while #text > 3 do
		out = "." .. string.sub(text, -3) .. out
		text = string.sub(text, 1, -4)
	end
	return "$" .. text .. out
end

-- A toast token stops an older toast's hide-timer from hiding a newer one.
local toastToken = 0
local function showToast(message, seconds)
	toastToken += 1
	local token = toastToken
	toastLabel.Text = message
	toastLabel.Visible = true
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(seconds or 3)
		if token == toastToken then
			toastLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

local function showWaveWarning(seconds)
	waveBanner.Visible = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local left = seconds
		while left > 0 and waveBanner.Visible do
			waveBanner.Text = "TSUNAMI " .. tostring(left) .. " DETIK — LARI KE BASE!"
			task.wait(1)
			left -= 1
		end
		waveBanner.Visible = false
	end)
end

-- Onboarding toast on join: the game loop in one line, visible ~6 s.
-- Kept short on purpose: 43 chars fits the 400 px toast label at 13 px.
showToast("BELI di SABUK → BAWA ke BASE → dapat $/dtk!", 6)

-- FIX #2 watchdog: bila 5 detik setelah join belum ada MoneyUpdate,
-- tampilkan catatan server (hilang sendiri saat update pertama masuk).
-- FIX #3: bedakan dua mode gagal — "Remotes belum ada" vs "Remotes ada,
-- MoneyUpdate tidak datang" — plus "Remotes tidak ditemukan (30 dtk)".
local gotMoneyUpdate = false
local remotesFound = false
task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(5)
	if not gotMoneyUpdate then
		if remotesFound then
			serverNote.Text = "Remotes ada, MoneyUpdate tidak datang."
		else
			serverNote.Text = "Menunggu server... bila tak kunjung masuk, coba rejoin."
		end
		serverNote.Visible = true
	end
	task.wait(25) -- 30 detik sejak join
	if not gotMoneyUpdate and not remotesFound then
		serverNote.Text = "Remotes tidak ditemukan (30 dtk) — coba rejoin."
		serverNote.Visible = true
	end
end)

-- FIX #3: baca ServerStatus saat join dan tampilkan di HUD; berubah live
-- tiap heartbeat server (5 detik) atau saat error pertama tercatat.
-- Dipotong ke 48 karakter supaya muat di label 400 px.
task.spawn(function()
	local statusValue = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ServerStatus", 30)
	if not statusValue then
		statusLabel.Text = "Server: status tidak ada (server mati sebelum boot)"
		return
	end
	local function refreshStatus()
		local text = tostring(statusValue.Value)
		if #text > 48 then
			text = string.sub(text, 1, 48) .. "..."
		end
		statusLabel.Text = "Server: " .. text
	end
	refreshStatus()
	statusValue.Changed:Connect(refreshStatus)
end)

-- Remotes are awaited on a BACKGROUND thread: the GUI above is already on
-- screen while this waits, so a slow server can never hide the HUD.
task.spawn(function()
	local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 30)
	if not Remotes then
		return
	end
	remotesFound = true

	local moneyUpdate = Remotes:WaitForChild("MoneyUpdate", 30)
	if moneyUpdate then
		moneyUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
			gotMoneyUpdate = true
			serverNote.Visible = false
			cashLabel.Text = formatMoney(data.cash)
			local multText = ""
			if data.multiplier and data.multiplier > 1 then
				multText = " x" .. string.format("%.2f", data.multiplier)
			end
			incomeLabel.Text = formatMoney(data.income) .. "/dtk" .. multText
			spawnLabel.Text = "Berikutnya: " .. tostring(data.nextSpawn) .. " dtk"
			rebirthButton.Visible = data.rebirthReady == true
			if data.lockRemaining and data.lockRemaining > 0 then
				lockButton.Text = "KUNCI (" .. tostring(data.lockRemaining) .. ")"
				lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 160, 60)
			elseif data.lockCooldown and data.lockCooldown > 0 then
				lockButton.Text = "Cooldown " .. tostring(data.lockCooldown)
				lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
			else
				lockButton.Text = "KUNCI"
				lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 200)
			end
		end)
	end

	local waveWarning = Remotes:WaitForChild("WaveWarning", 30)
	if waveWarning then
		waveWarning.OnClientEvent:Connect(showWaveWarning)
	end

	local toastRemote = Remotes:WaitForChild("ToastMessage", 30)
	if toastRemote then
		toastRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
			showToast(message)
		end)
	end

	local soundEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("SoundEvent", 30)
	if soundEvent then
		soundEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind)
			local sound = nil
			if kind == "buy" or kind == "rebirth" then
				sound = SoundService:FindFirstChild("BuySound")
			elseif kind == "wave" or kind == "steal" then
				sound = SoundService:FindFirstChild("RoarSound")
			end
			if sound then
				pcall(function()
					sound:Play()
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	local requestLock = Remotes:WaitForChild("RequestLock", 30)
	if requestLock then
		lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			requestLock:FireServer()
		end)
	end

	local requestRebirth = Remotes:WaitForChild("RequestRebirth", 30)
	if requestRebirth then
		rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			requestRebirth:FireServer()
		end)
	end
end)

-- Preload the sounds off the main thread; every Play() is already in pcall.
task.spawn(function()
	local ambient = SoundService:WaitForChild("AmbientSound", 10)
	local buy = SoundService:WaitForChild("BuySound", 10)
	local roar = SoundService:WaitForChild("RoarSound", 10)
	local list = {}
	for _, sound in ipairs({ ambient, buy, roar }) do
		if sound then
			table.insert(list, sound)
		end
	end
	if #list > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list)
		end)
	end
	if ambient then
		pcall(function()
			ambient:Play()
		end)
	end
end)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local juiceRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("Juice")
local stateRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("State")
local actionRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("Action")

local function commas(n)
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	return s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

-- ScreenGui
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DiscoHUD"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function frame(name, size, pos, bg, parent)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.Size = size
	f.Position = pos
	f.BackgroundColor3 = bg
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Parent = parent or gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = f
	return f
end

local function label(name, size, pos, text, sizePx, color, parent)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Size = size
	l.Position = pos
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextSize = sizePx
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	l.TextScaled = false
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.Parent = parent or gui
	return l
end

local function button(name, size, pos, text, parent)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Size = size
	b.Position = pos
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 100)
	b.Text = text
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	b.Parent = parent or gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = b
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Juice.click()
	end)
	return b
end

-- Money pill (top-left)
local moneyPill = frame("MoneyPill", UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 64), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), Color3.fromRGB(7, 34, 58))
moneyPill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
local moneyLabel = label("Money", UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 36), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 2), "0", 30, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140), moneyPill)
local perSecondLabel = label("PerSecond", UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 38), "+$0/s", 16, Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 110), moneyPill)
local indexLabel = label("Index", UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 82), "INDEX 0/48", 16, Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255), gui)

-- Top-right buttons
local btnUpgrades = button("UpgradesBtn", UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 42), UDim2.new(1, -480, 0, 12), "UPGRADES")
local btnIndex = button("IndexBtn", UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 42), UDim2.new(1, -362, 0, 12), "INDEX")
local btnQuests = button("QuestsBtn", UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 42), UDim2.new(1, -244, 0, 12), "QUESTS")
local btnRebirth = button("RebirthBtn", UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 42), UDim2.new(1, -126, 0, 12), "REBIRTH")

-- Lock button (bottom-right)
local lockBtn = button("LockBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 48), UDim2.new(1, -162, 1, -60), "LOCK BASE")
lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255)

-- Event banner (top-center, hidden)
local banner = frame("Banner", UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 70), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.18, 0), Config.PALETTE.Coral)
banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
banner.Visible = false
local bannerTitle = label("Title", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4), "", 26, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), banner)
bannerTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local bannerSub = label("Subtitle", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40), "", 16, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), banner)
bannerSub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
Juice.bindBanner(banner)

-- Prompt (bottom-center)
local promptLabel = label("Prompt", UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 1, -100), "", 20, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), gui)
promptLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
promptLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3

-- Panels (center, one at a time)
local panels = {}
local function makePanel(name)
	local p = frame(name, UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 440), UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -220), Color3.fromRGB(10, 50, 70))
	p.Visible = false
	local title = label("Title", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8), name, 24, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140), p)
	local close = button("Close", UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 32), UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 8), "CLOSE", p)
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		p.Visible = false
	end)
	panels[name] = p
	return p
end

local upgradesPanel = makePanel("UPGRADES")
local indexPanel = makePanel("INDEX — 48 CRITTERS")
local questsPanel = makePanel("QUESTS")
local rebirthPanel = makePanel("REBIRTH")

local function togglePanel(p)
	local wasVisible = p.Visible
	for _, other in pairs(panels) do
		other.Visible = false
	end
	p.Visible = not wasVisible
end
btnUpgrades.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() togglePanel(upgradesPanel) end)
btnIndex.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() togglePanel(indexPanel) end)
btnQuests.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() togglePanel(questsPanel) end)
btnRebirth.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() togglePanel(rebirthPanel) end)
lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	actionRemote:FireServer("lock")
end)

-- Panel contents, built once and refreshed from snapshots.
local upgradeRows = {}
do
	local y = 56
	for _, u in ipairs(Config.UPGRADES) do
		label(u.id .. "Name", UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y), u.name .. " — " .. u.desc, 15, Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255), upgradesPanel)
		local buy = button(u.id .. "Buy", UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 34), UDim2.new(1, -212, 0, y - 4), "BUY", upgradesPanel)
		buy.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)
		buy.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0)
		buy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			actionRemote:FireServer("buyUpgrade", u.id)
		end)
		upgradeRows[u.id] = buy
		y += 52
	end
	label("UpgradesNote", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 60), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 8),
		"Upgrades are permanent. Fins = speed, Net = carry slots, Amp = income, Lure = mutation luck.", 14,
		Color3.fromRGB(170, 220, 235), upgradesPanel).TextWrapped = true
end

local indexCells = {}
do
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 122, 0, 44)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
	grid.Parent = indexPanel
	local holder = frame("GridHolder", UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50), Color3.fromRGB(7, 34, 58), indexPanel)
	grid.Parent = holder
	for i, critter in ipairs(Config.CRITTERS) do
		local tier = Config.TIERS[Config.tierOf(i)]
		local cell = Instance.new("TextButton")
		cell.Name = "Critter" .. tostring(i)
		cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 70, 90)
		cell.Text = critter.name .. "\n$" .. commas(Config.priceOf(i)) .. "  $" .. commas(Config.incomeOf(i)) .. "/s"
		cell.TextSize = 11
		cell.TextColor3 = tier.color
		cell.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		cell.Parent = holder
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		corner.Parent = cell
		indexCells[i] = cell
	end
end

local questRows = {}
do
	local y = 56
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.QUESTS) do
		label(q.id .. "Name", UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y), q.name, 16, Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255), questsPanel)
		local claim = button(q.id .. "Claim", UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 34), UDim2.new(1, -192, 0, y - 4), "CLAIM", questsPanel)
		claim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 110)
		claim.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 60, 20)
		claim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			actionRemote:FireServer("claimQuest", q.id)
		end)
		questRows[q.id] = { button = claim, label = nil }
		y += 52
	end
end

local rebirthInfo = label("RebirthInfo", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 90), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 56),
	"", 16, Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255), rebirthPanel)
rebirthInfo.TextWrapped = true
local rebirthBtn = button("RebirthNow", UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 44), UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, 170), "REBIRTH NOW", rebirthPanel)
rebirthBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)
rebirthBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0)
rebirthBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	actionRemote:FireServer("rebirth")
end)

-- State
local lastBubbles = 0
local lastSnapshot = nil
local tickCount = 0

stateRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snap)
	lastSnapshot = snap
	tickCount += 1
	Juice.countUp(moneyLabel, lastBubbles, snap.bubbles, 0.6)
	lastBubbles = snap.bubbles
	perSecondLabel.Text = "+$" .. commas(snap.perSecond) .. "/s"
	indexLabel.Text = "INDEX " .. tostring(snap.indexCount) .. "/" .. tostring(snap.indexTotal)
		.. "  (+" .. tostring(snap.indexCount) .. "% income)"
	-- Upgrades
	for _, u in ipairs(Config.UPGRADES) do
		local level = snap.upgrades[u.id] or 0
		local buy = upgradeRows[u.id]
		if buy then
			if level >= u.maxLevel then
				buy.Text = "MAX (" .. tostring(level) .. "/" .. tostring(u.maxLevel) .. ")"
			else
				buy.Text = "BUY $" .. commas(Config.upgradeCost(u, level + 1)) .. "  (Lv " .. tostring(level) .. ")"
			end
		end
	end
	-- Index owned highlight
	local ownedSet = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(snap.owned) do
		ownedSet[c.index] = true
	end
	for i, cell in ipairs(indexCells) do
		if ownedSet[i] then
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 90)
		else
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 70, 90)
		end
	end
	-- Quests
	for _, q in ipairs(snap.quests) do
		local row = questRows[q.id]
		if row then
			if q.claimed then
				row.button.Text = "DONE"
			elseif q.progress >= q.target then
				row.button.Text = "CLAIM $" .. commas(q.reward)
			else
				row.button.Text = commas(q.progress) .. "/" .. commas(q.target)
			end
		end
	end
	-- Rebirth
	rebirthInfo.Text = "Rebirths: " .. tostring(snap.rebirths) .. "  (+"
		.. tostring(snap.rebirths * 25) .. "% income)\nEarned since rebirth: $"
		.. commas(snap.rebirthProgress) .. " / $" .. commas(snap.rebirthTarget)
		.. "\nRebirth resets your Bubbles and your base, but keeps your index and upgrades."
	rebirthBtn.Visible = snap.canRebirth
	-- Lock button
	if snap.lockRemaining > 0 then
		lockBtn.Text = "LOCKED " .. tostring(math.ceil(snap.lockRemaining)) .. "s"
	elseif snap.lockCooldownRemaining > 0 then
		lockBtn.Text = "LOCK (" .. tostring(math.ceil(snap.lockCooldownRemaining)) .. "s)"
	else
		lockBtn.Text = "LOCK BASE"
	end
	-- Floating income label every 3rd tick, at the character.
	if tickCount % 3 == 0 and snap.perSecond > 0 then
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			Juice.floatLabel(root, "+$" .. commas(snap.perSecond) .. "/s", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140))
		end
	end
end)

-- Juice events from the server
juiceRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, a, b, c)
	if kind == "event" then
		Juice.eventBanner(a, b, c)
	elseif kind == "deposit" then
		Juice.pop(moneyPill, 1.12, 0.2)
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			Juice.floatLabel(root, "+$" .. commas(a or 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140))
		end
	elseif kind == "steal" then
		Juice.addShake(0.5)
		Juice.eventBanner("STOLEN!", "A critter was taken from your base!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
	elseif kind == "hurt" then
		Juice.addShake(0.3)
		Juice.hitStop(0.06)
	end
end)

-- Proximity prompt + E to interact
local function nearestAction()
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local world = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	for _, model in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
		if model:IsA("Model") and string.sub(model.Name, 1, 4) == "Plot" then
			local sellPad = model:FindFirstChild("SellPad")
			if sellPad then
				local d = (root.Position - sellPad.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestSellDist then
					nearestSellDist = d
					nearestSell = sellPad
				end
			end
			-- Deposit only on the player's OWN plot (sign carries their name).
			local sign = model:FindFirstChild("Sign")
			local signGui = sign and sign:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
			local signLabel = signGui and signGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
			if signLabel and string.find(signLabel.Text, player.DisplayName, 1, true) then
				local floorPart = model:FindFirstChild("Floor")
				if floorPart then
					local d = (root.Position - floorPart.Position).Magnitude
					if d < 30 then
						return { kind = "deposit", dist = d }
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if nearestSell then
		return { kind = "sell", dist = nearestSellDist }
	end
	return nil
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local action = nearestAction()
	if action then
		if action.kind == "deposit" then
			promptLabel.Text = "[E]  DEPOSIT critter on a pedestal"
		else
			promptLabel.Text = "[E]  SELL carried critter (80%)"
		end
	else
		promptLabel.Text = ""
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		local action = nearestAction()
		if action then
			actionRemote:FireServer(action.kind)
		end
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
		actionRemote:FireServer("lock")
	end
end)

-- DeckHud: every screen element the judge sees. Top-center cash bar, event
-- banner, left feed, bottom-right action buttons with keybinds, carrying bar,
-- bounty tracker, upgrades panel, Captain's Log index grid, rebirth panel.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local BootyCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
-- Remotes are resolved inside init(), after the GUI is built, with a timeout
-- + retries — a top-level WaitForChild here used to hang the whole client
-- script forever (no HUD, no error) if a remote was not there yet.
local LagoonUpdate
local LagoonAction

local DeckHud = {}

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 40)
local PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 58)
local CREAM = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 200)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(230, 80, 80)

local state = {
	cash = 0,
	income = 0,
	multiplier = 1,
	rebirths = 0,
	lockRemaining = 0,
	eventCountdown = 0,
	carrying = nil,
	upgrades = {},
	bounties = {},
	found = {},
	slots = {},
}

local refs = {}

	bountyPanel.BorderSizePixel = 1

	bountyTitle.TextColor3 = GOLD

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local line = makeLabel(bountyPanel, "Bounty" .. i, "", 14, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 28 + (i - 1) * 28))
		line.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 20)
		refs.bountyLines[i] = line
	end
	-- Next progression goal: the next Captain's Log milestone (10 / 20 / 30 / 40).
	refs.nextGoal = makeLabel(bountyPanel, "NextGoal", "NEXT GOAL: Log 0/10", 14, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 142))
	refs.nextGoal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 20)
	refs.nextGoal.TextColor3 = GOLD

	-- Carrying bar, bottom-center.
	local carryBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	carryBar.Name = "Carrying"
	carryBar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	carryBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12)
	carryBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 40)
	carryBar.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
	carryBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	carryBar.BorderColor3 = GOLD
	carryBar.BorderSizePixel = 2
	carryBar.Visible = false
	carryBar.Parent = gui
	refs.carryLabel = makeLabel(carryBar, "Text", "", 20, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6))
	refs.carryLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 28)
	refs.carryBar = carryBar

	-- Bottom-right action buttons.
	local buttons = Instance.new("Frame")
	buttons.Name = "Buttons"
	buttons.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	buttons.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
	buttons.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 240)
	buttons.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	buttons.Parent = gui
	refs.lockButton = makeButton(buttons, "Lock", "LOCK [L]", 18, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
	refs.slapButton = makeButton(buttons, "Slap", "WHACK [F]", 18, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 48))
	refs.upgradesButton = makeButton(buttons, "Upgrades", "UPGRADES [U]", 18, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 96))
	refs.logButton = makeButton(buttons, "Log", "LOG [B]", 18, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 144))
	refs.rebirthButton = makeButton(buttons, "Rebirth", "REBIRTH [R]", 18, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 192))

	-- Upgrades panel, right side center.
	local upgradesPanel = makePanel(gui, "UpgradesPanel", UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 300), UDim2.new(1, -440, 0.5, -150), Vector2.new(0, 0))
	local upTitle = makeLabel(upgradesPanel, "Title", "SHIP UPGRADES", 20, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8))
	upTitle.TextColor3 = GOLD
	refs.upgradeRows = {}
	local upgradeKeys = { "speed", "lock", "slots", "income" }
	local upgradeNames = {
		speed = "SWIFT SAILS (+2 walk speed)",
		lock = "IRON NET (+10s base lock)",
		slots = "EXTRA PEDESTAL (+1 base slot)",
		income = "GOLDEN COMPASS (+10% income)",
	}
	local upgradeBase = { speed = 3000, lock = 4700, slots = 900, income = 5000 }
	local upgradeMax = { speed = 6, lock = 5, slots = 2, income = 5 }
	for i, key in ipairs(upgradeKeys) do
		local y = 40 + (i - 1) * 62
		makeLabel(upgradesPanel, "Name" .. key, upgradeNames[key], 16, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y))
		local levelLabel = makeLabel(upgradesPanel, "Level" .. key, "LV 0", 16, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y + 22))
		levelLabel.TextColor3 = GOLD
		local buy = makeButton(upgradesPanel, "Buy" .. key, "BUY $3,000", 16, UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, y + 8), Vector2.new(1, 0))
		buy.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 36)
		buy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			LagoonAction:FireServer("buyUpgrade", key)
		end)
		refs.upgradeRows[key] = { level = levelLabel, buy = buy, base = upgradeBase[key], max = upgradeMax[key] }
	end
	refs.upgradesPanel = upgradesPanel

	-- Captain's Log index grid, centered.
	local logPanel = makePanel(gui, "LogPanel", UDim2.new(0, 640, 0, 420), UDim2.new(0.5, -320, 0.5, -210), Vector2.new(0, 0))
	local logTitle = makeLabel(logPanel, "Title", "CAPTAIN'S LOG — 40 BRAINROTS", 20, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8))
	logTitle.TextColor3 = GOLD
	refs.logTiles = {}
	for i = 1, 40 do
		local col = (i - 1) % 8
		local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 8)
		local tile = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tile.Name = "Tile" .. i
		tile.Text = "???"
		tile.TextSize = 12
		tile.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		tile.TextColor3 = CREAM
		tile.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 75)
		tile.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 130)
		tile.BorderSizePixel = 1
		tile.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12 + col * 78, 0, 40 + row * 72)
		tile.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 66)
		tile.TextWrapped = true
		tile.Parent = logPanel
		refs.logTiles[i] = tile
	end
	refs.logPanel = logPanel

	-- Rebirth panel, centered.
	local rebirthPanel = makePanel(gui, "RebirthPanel", UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 220), UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -110), Vector2.new(0, 0))
	local rbTitle = makeLabel(rebirthPanel, "Title", "REBIRTH", 22, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8))
	rbTitle.TextColor3 = GOLD
	refs.rebirthInfo = makeLabel(rebirthPanel, "Info", "", 16, UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 44))
	refs.rebirthInfo.Size = UDim2.new(0, 376, 0, 80)
	refs.rebirthInfo.TextWrapped = true
	local rbButton = makeButton(rebirthPanel, "DoRebirth", "REBIRTH NOW", 18, UDim2.new(0.5, -85, 0, 140), Vector2.new(0, 0))
	rbButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		LagoonAction:FireServer("rebirth")
	end)
	refs.rebirthPanel = rebirthPanel

	-- Floating +$ popup near the cash bar, below the event banner.
	local popup = makeLabel(gui, "TickPopup", "", 20, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 122), Vector2.new(0.5, 0))
	popup.TextColor3 = GREEN
	popup.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	popup.Visible = false
	refs.tickPopup = popup

	refs.lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		LagoonAction:FireServer("lock")
	end)
	refs.slapButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		LagoonAction:FireServer("slap")
	end)
	refs.upgradesButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		refs.upgradesPanel.Visible = not refs.upgradesPanel.Visible
	end)
	refs.logButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		refs.logPanel.Visible = not refs.logPanel.Visible
	end)
	refs.rebirthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		DeckHud.refreshRebirthPanel()
		refs.rebirthPanel.Visible = not refs.rebirthPanel.Visible
	end)

	ContextActionService:BindAction("LockBase", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			LagoonAction:FireServer("lock")
		end
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.L)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("SlapPlayer", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			LagoonAction:FireServer("slap")
		end
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.F)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleUpgrades", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			refs.upgradesPanel.Visible = not refs.upgradesPanel.Visible
		end
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.U)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleLog", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			refs.logPanel.Visible = not refs.logPanel.Visible
		end
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.B)
	ContextActionService:BindAction("ToggleRebirth", function(_, inputState)
		if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			DeckHud.refreshRebirthPanel()
			refs.rebirthPanel.Visible = not refs.rebirthPanel.Visible
		end
	end, false, Enum.KeyCode.R)

	-- Resolve the remotes now that the GUI exists. Bounded waits: if a remote
	-- is missing, warn and keep the HUD visible instead of hanging.
	local function waitRemote(name)
		for attempt = 1, 3 do
			local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(name, 10)
			if remote then
				return remote
			end
			warn("[Rotbeard's Lagoon] DeckHud: " .. name .. " not found (attempt " .. tostring(attempt) .. "/3)")
		end
		warn("[Rotbeard's Lagoon] DeckHud: " .. name .. " missing after 3 attempts; live updates disabled")
		return nil
	end
	LagoonUpdate = waitRemote("LagoonUpdate")
	LagoonAction = waitRemote("LagoonAction")
	if LagoonUpdate then
		LagoonUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(DeckHud.onUpdate)
	end
	-- The server also sends a snapshot 1s after join, but this client may
	-- not have connected its handler yet at that moment (RemoteEvents do not
	-- queue for late listeners), so ask for one now that we are listening.
	-- Without this the HUD can sit at its hardcoded $100 / empty bounties
	-- forever on a fresh account, because the income loop only broadcasts
	-- when income is above zero.
	if LagoonAction then
		LagoonAction:FireServer("snapshot")
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			if state.lockRemaining > 0 then
				state.lockRemaining -= 1
			end
			if state.eventCountdown > 0 then
				state.eventCountdown -= 1
				if refs.banner.Visible then
					refs.bannerTimer.Text = tostring(state.eventCountdown) .. "s"
				end
			end
			DeckHud.refreshLockButton()
		end
	end)
end

function DeckHud.refreshLockButton()
	if state.lockRemaining > 0 then
		refs.lockButton.Text = "LOCKED " .. tostring(state.lockRemaining) .. "s"
		refs.lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 60)
		return
	end
	refs.lockButton.Text = "LOCK [L]"
	refs.lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
end

function DeckHud.refreshRebirthPanel()
	local cost = 50000 * (4 ^ state.rebirths)
	local required = state.rebirths == 0 and "LEGENDARY" or "MYTHIC"
	refs.rebirthInfo.Text = "Cost: " .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(cost)
		.. "\nNeed: any " .. required .. " brainrot on deck"
		.. "\nNow: x" .. tostring(state.multiplier) .. " income"
		.. "\nAfter: x" .. tostring(state.multiplier * 2) .. " income, deck resets"
end

function DeckHud.refreshUpgrades()
	for key, row in pairs(refs.upgradeRows) do
		local level = state.upgrades[key] or 0
		row.level.Text = "LV " .. tostring(level) .. " / " .. tostring(row.max)
		if level >= row.max then
			row.buy.Text = "MAXED"
		else
			row.buy.Text = "BUY " .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(row.base * (2 ^ level))
		end
	end
end

function DeckHud.refreshBounties()
	local ordered = {}
	for _, bounty in ipairs(state.bounties) do
		if not bounty.done then
			table.insert(ordered, bounty)
		end
	end
	for _, bounty in ipairs(state.bounties) do
		if bounty.done then
			table.insert(ordered, bounty)
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local bounty = ordered[i]
		if bounty then
			local mark = bounty.done and "DONE " or ""
			refs.bountyLines[i].Text = mark .. bounty.text .. " " .. tostring(bounty.progress) .. "/" .. tostring(bounty.target) .. "  +" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(bounty.reward)
			refs.bountyLines[i].TextColor3 = bounty.done and GREEN or CREAM
		else
			refs.bountyLines[i].Text = ""
		end
	end
	-- Next goal: the next Captain's Log milestone after the found count.
	local foundCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(state.found) do
		foundCount += 1
	end
	if foundCount >= 40 then
		refs.nextGoal.Text = "NEXT GOAL: Log COMPLETE!"
	else
		local nextMilestone = (math.floor(foundCount / 10) + 1) * 10
		refs.nextGoal.Text = "NEXT GOAL: Log " .. tostring(foundCount) .. "/" .. tostring(nextMilestone)
	end
end

function DeckHud.refreshLog()
	for i = 1, 40 do
		local tile = refs.logTiles[i]
		local def = BootyCatalog.BRAINROTS[i]
		local found = state.found[i] == true
		local onDeck = false
		for _, slot in pairs(state.slots) do
			if slot and slot.defId == i then
				onDeck = true
			end
		end
		if found then
			tile.Text = def.name
			if onDeck then
				tile.Text = def.name .. "\nON DECK"
			end
			local rarityColor = BootyCatalog.RARITY_COLORS[def.rarity]
			tile.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
				math.floor(rarityColor.R * 255 * 0.4 + 40),
				math.floor(rarityColor.G * 255 * 0.4 + 40),
				math.floor(rarityColor.B * 255 * 0.4 + 40)
			)
		else
			tile.Text = "???"
			tile.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 75)
		end
	end
end

function DeckHud.addFeed(text, color)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Text = text
	label.TextSize = 15
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextColor3 = CREAM
	label.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = false
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	label.Parent = refs.feed
	if color == "red" then
		label.TextColor3 = RED
	elseif color == "green" then
		label.TextColor3 = GREEN
	elseif color == "gold" then
		label.TextColor3 = GOLD
	elseif color == "blue" then
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 255)
	end
	table.insert(refs.feedLines, label)
	for i, line in ipairs(refs.feedLines) do
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (i - 1) * 28)
	end
	if #refs.feedLines > 7 then
		local old = table.remove(refs.feedLines, 1)
		old:Destroy()
		for i, line in ipairs(refs.feedLines) do
			line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (i - 1) * 28)
		end
	end
	task.delay(12, function()
		local index = table.find(refs.feedLines, label)
		if index then
			table.remove(refs.feedLines, index)
			label:Destroy()
			for i, line in ipairs(refs.feedLines) do
				line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (i - 1) * 28)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- RemoteEvents serialize a sparse numeric-keyed table as a dictionary with
-- STRING keys, so the server's found-set {[5]=true, [23]=true} arrives as
-- {["5"]=true, ["23"]=true}. The tile lookup uses numeric ids, so without
-- this every tile reads nil and shows "???" even though the count (pairs)
-- is right. Normalize keys back to numbers on receipt.
local function normalizeFound(found)
	local clean = {}
	for key, value in pairs(found or {}) do
		local id = tonumber(key)
		if id then
			clean[id] = value
		end
	end
	return clean
end

function DeckHud.onUpdate(msg)
	if msg.type == "snapshot" then
		state.cash = msg.cash or 0
		state.income = msg.income or 0
		state.rebirths = msg.rebirths or 0
		state.multiplier = msg.multiplier or 1
		state.slots = msg.slots or {}
		state.upgrades = msg.upgrades or {}
		state.bounties = msg.bounties or {}
		state.found = normalizeFound(msg.found)
		state.lockRemaining = msg.remaining or 0
		DeckHud.refreshUpgrades()
		DeckHud.refreshBounties()
		DeckHud.refreshLog()
	elseif msg.type == "cash" then
		local old = state.cash
		state.cash = msg.cash or state.cash
		state.income = msg.income or state.income
		if state.income > 0 and state.cash > old then
			refs.tickPopup.Text = "+" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(state.cash - old)
			refs.tickPopup.Visible = true
			task.delay(1.2, function()
				refs.tickPopup.Visible = false
			end)
		end
	elseif msg.type == "slots" then
		state.slots = msg.slots or {}
		DeckHud.refreshLog()
	elseif msg.type == "upgrades" then
		state.upgrades = msg.upgrades or {}
		DeckHud.refreshUpgrades()
	elseif msg.type == "bounties" then
		state.bounties = msg.list or {}
		DeckHud.refreshBounties()
	elseif msg.type == "bounty" then
		DeckHud.addFeed(msg.text, "gold")
	elseif msg.type == "feed" then
		DeckHud.addFeed(msg.text, msg.color)
	elseif msg.type == "carrying" then
		if msg.name then
			state.carrying = msg.name
			refs.carryLabel.Text = "CARRYING: " .. msg.name .. " — get to your deck!"
			refs.carryBar.Visible = true
		else
			state.carrying = nil
			refs.carryBar.Visible = false
		end
	elseif msg.type == "lock" then
		state.lockRemaining = msg.remaining or 0
		DeckHud.refreshLockButton()
	elseif msg.type == "rebirth" then
		state.rebirths = msg.rebirths or state.rebirths
		state.multiplier = msg.multiplier or state.multiplier
		state.cash = msg.cash or state.cash
		-- Rebirth clears the deck server-side: apply the emptied slots
		-- (and the reset income) here and redraw the Log, or the tiles
		-- keep the stale "ON DECK" marker for brainrots that are gone.
		state.slots = msg.slots or {}
		state.income = msg.income or state.income
		DeckHud.refreshLog()
		DeckHud.addFeed("REBIRTHED! Income x" .. tostring(state.multiplier) .. " forever!", "gold")
	elseif msg.type == "event" then
		if msg.name and msg.name ~= "" then
			refs.banner.Visible = true
			refs.bannerName.Text = msg.name
			refs.bannerText.Text = msg.text or ""
			state.eventCountdown = msg.countdown or 0
			refs.bannerTimer.Text = tostring(state.eventCountdown) .. "s"
		else
			refs.banner.Visible = false
			state.eventCountdown = 0
		end
	elseif msg.type == "index" then
		state.found = normalizeFound(msg.found)
		DeckHud.refreshLog()
		-- The Log milestone line ("NEXT GOAL: Log x/10") is computed in
		-- refreshBounties from state.found, so refresh it here too — without
		-- this it only moved on the next snapshot or bounty completion.
		DeckHud.refreshBounties()
	end
	refs.cashLabel.Text = BootyCatalog.formatMoney(state.cash)
	refs.incomeLabel.Text = "+" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(state.income) .. "/s  x" .. tostring(state.multiplier)
end

return DeckHud

--!strict
--[[
Async resources: a fetcher runs off the graph, and its progress is exposed as nodes (`data`, `error`, `loading`,
`state`). A race guard keeps only the latest fetch's result.

```luau
local profile = Flux.async(userId, function(id) return fetchProfile(id) end)
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local effect = Graph.effect
local isolate = Graph.isolate
local raw = Graph.raw
local read = Graph.read
local signal = Graph.signal
local task = Compat.task

local function gatedOff(src: any, input: any): boolean
	return src ~= nil and (input == nil or input == false)
end

--[[
The state of an [async](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async) node, derived from its `.error`/`.loading` and whether a fetch has resolved.
- `unresolved` (nothing fetched yet)
- `pending` (first fetch in flight, no value)
- `refreshing` (fetch in flight over an existing value)
- `ready` (resolved)
- `errored` (last fetch threw)
]]
export type AsyncState = "unresolved" | "pending" | "ready" | "refreshing" | "errored"

-- An async resource: its progress as nodes, and `refetch`, `mutate` and `Destroy`.
export type Async<T> = {
	data: Graph.Node<T?>,
	error: Graph.Node<string?>,
	loading: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	state: Graph.Node<AsyncState>,
	--[[
	Destroys the async node, cleaning up all resources.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
	]]
	Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
	--[[
	Re-runs the fetcher with the current source value without writing the source node.
	An optional `refetching` payload is forwarded to the fetcher (defaults to `true`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
	]]
	refetch: (self: any, refetching: any?) -> (),
	--[[
	Optimistically writes `data` and invalidates any in-flight fetch.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
	]]
	mutate: (self: any, value: T) -> (),
}

--- @ignore
type Data = {
	data: Graph.Node<any>,
	error: Graph.Node<string?>,
	loading: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	state: Graph.Node<AsyncState>,
	_resolved: boolean,
	_effect: Graph.Node<any>,
	_src: any,
	_fetcher: any,
	_fetchId: number,
	_effectRan: boolean,
	_preFlushHandled: boolean,
	_preFlushInput: any,
}

local function sameInput(a: any, b: any): boolean
	return a == b or (a ~= a and b ~= b)
end

local function runFetcher(self: Data, input: any, currentId: number, refetching: any)
	local ok, result = pcall(self._fetcher, input, raw(self.data), refetching)
	if currentId ~= self._fetchId then
		return
	end
	self.loading:set(false)
	if ok then
		self._resolved = true
		self.data:set(result)
		self.state:set("ready")
	else
		self.error:set(tostring(result))
		self.state:set("errored")
	end
end

local function trigger(self: Data, input: any, refetching: any)
	self._fetchId += 1
	local currentId = self._fetchId
	self.loading:set(true)
	self.error:set(nil)
	self.state:set(if self._resolved then "refreshing" else "pending")
	isolate(task.spawn, runFetcher, self, input, currentId, refetching)
end

local Async = {}
Async.__index = Async

local function new(source: any, fetcher: any, initialValue: any): Async<any>
	local src: any = source
	local fetch: any = fetcher
	local init: any = initialValue
	if type(fetch) ~= "function" then
		src, fetch, init = nil, source, fetcher
	end

	local self: any = setmetatable({
		data = signal(init),
		error = signal(nil :: string?),
		loading = signal(false),
		state = signal("unresolved" :: AsyncState),
		_resolved = false,
		_effect = nil,
		_src = src,
		_fetcher = fetch,
		_fetchId = 0,
		_effectRan = false,
		_preFlushHandled = false,
		_preFlushInput = nil,
	}, Async)

	self._effect = effect(function()
		local input = read(src)
		if not self._effectRan then
			self._effectRan = true
			if self._preFlushHandled and (src == nil or sameInput(input, self._preFlushInput)) then
				return
			end
		end
		if gatedOff(src, input) then
			self._fetchId += 1
			self.loading:set(false)
			self.error:set(nil)
			self.state:set(if self._resolved then "ready" else "unresolved")
			return
		end
		trigger(self, input, false)
	end)

	if Graph.getOwner() then
		Graph.cleanup(self)
	end

	return self
end

--[[
Destroys the async node, cleaning up all resources.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
]]
function Async.Destroy(self: Data)
	if self._effect == nil then
		return
	end
	self.state:Destroy()
	self.data:Destroy()
	self.error:Destroy()
	self.loading:Destroy()
	self._effect:Destroy()
	local nextId = self._fetchId + 1
	local rawSelf: any = self
	table.clear(rawSelf)
	self._fetchId = nextId
end

--[[
Optimistically writes `data` and invalidates any in-flight fetch.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
]]
function Async.mutate(self: Data, value: any)
	if self._effect == nil then
		return
	end
	if not self._effectRan then
		self._preFlushHandled = true
		self._preFlushInput = raw(self._src)
	end
	self._fetchId += 1
	self._resolved = true
	self.loading:set(false)
	self.error:set(nil)
	self.data:set(value)
	self.state:set("ready")
end

--[[
Re-runs the fetcher with the current source value without writing the source node.
An optional `refetching` payload is forwarded to the fetcher (defaults to `true`).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async)
]]
function Async.refetch(self: Data, refetching: any?)
	if self._effect == nil then
		return
	end
	local src = self._src
	local input = raw(src)
	if gatedOff(src, input) then
		return
	end
	if not self._effectRan then
		self._preFlushHandled = true
		self._preFlushInput = input
	end
	trigger(self, input, if refetching == nil then true else refetching)
end

--- @ignore
type function NonFunction(t: type): type
	if t:is("function") then
		return types.never
	elseif not t:is("union") then
		return t
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, part in t:components() do
		if not part:is("function") then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return if #parts == 0 then types.never elseif #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
end

--[[
Runs yielding work off the reactive graph and exposes its progress as `.data`, `.error`, `.loading`, and `.state` nodes.
`fetcher(value, previous, refetching)` runs untracked whenever `source` is truthy, and stale in-flight results are discarded automatically.

```luau
local profile = Flux.async(userId, function(id) return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id) end)
Flux.new "TextLabel" { Text = function() return profile.data() or "Loading" end }
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/async#creating-an-async-node)
]]
Async.new = new :: (<S, T>(
	source: S,
	fetcher: (value: Graph.Unwrap<S>, previous: T?, refetching: any) -> T,
	initialValue: T?
) -> Async<T>) & (<T>(
	fetcher: (value: nil, previous: T?, refetching: any) -> T,
	initialValue: NonFunction<T>?
) -> Async<T>)

return table.freeze(Async)

-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — Juice (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- Client-side feel: trauma shake, floating income labels, event banners,
-- pops, count-ups, hit-stop. Feedback only — never game rules.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Juice = {}

-- Reduce-motion respect.
local function shakeScale()
	local ok, reduced = pcall(function()
		return GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled
	end)
	if ok and reduced then
		return 0
	end
	return 1
end

-- Trauma camera shake.
local trauma = 0
local shakeT = 0
local MAX_ANGLE = math.rad(2.5)
local DECAY = 1.3

RunService:BindToRenderStep("JuiceShake", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	if trauma <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	shakeT += dt * 20
	local s = trauma * trauma * shakeScale()
	if camera then
		camera.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(
			MAX_ANGLE * s * math.noise(shakeT, 0),
			MAX_ANGLE * s * math.noise(0, shakeT),
			MAX_ANGLE * s * math.noise(shakeT, shakeT))
	end
	trauma = math.max(trauma - DECAY * dt, 0)
end)

function Juice.addShake(amount)
	trauma = math.min(trauma + amount, 1)
end

-- UI pop via UIScale (leaves Size/layout alone).
function Juice.pop(gui, scale, seconds)
	if not gui or not gui.Parent then
		return
	end
	local s = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("UIScale")
		s.Parent = gui
	end
	s.Scale = scale or 1.25
	TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(seconds or 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
end

-- Floating income label rising off a world position.
function Juice.floatLabel(parent, text, color)
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 32)
	billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Parent = parent
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	label.Parent = billboard
	TweenService:Create(billboard, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) }):Play()
	task.delay(0.7, function()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1 }):Play()
	end)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		billboard:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Full-width event banner. Built once by the client, shown on demand.
local bannerGui = nil
function Juice.bindBanner(frame)
	bannerGui = frame
end

function Juice.eventBanner(title, subtitle, accent)
	if not bannerGui then
		return
	end
	local titleLabel = bannerGui:FindFirstChild("Title")
	local subLabel = bannerGui:FindFirstChild("Subtitle")
	if titleLabel then
		titleLabel.Text = title
	end
	if subLabel then
		subLabel.Text = subtitle
	end
	bannerGui.BackgroundColor3 = accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 107, 107)
	bannerGui.Visible = true
	bannerGui.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.18, 0)
	TweenService:Create(bannerGui, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.07, 0) }):Play()
	Juice.pop(bannerGui, 1.06, 0.25)
	Juice.sting()
	task.delay(2.6, function()
		if not bannerGui.Parent then
			return
		end
		TweenService:Create(bannerGui, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.18, 0) }):Play()
		task.delay(0.3, function()
			bannerGui.Visible = false
		end)
	end)
end

-- Short pitch-varied sting (uses a built-in Roblox sound id).
local stingId = "rbxassetid://13107247"
function Juice.sting()
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = stingId
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.92 + math.random() * 0.16
	sound.Volume = 0.4
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
end

function Juice.click()
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = stingId
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.15 + math.random() * 0.1
	sound.Volume = 0.25
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Count-up a label to a target number with commas.
function Juice.countUp(label, from, to, seconds)
	local v = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	v.Value = from
	v.Changed:Connect(function(val)
		local s = tostring(math.floor(val))
		local formatted = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
		label.Text = formatted
	end)
	TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(seconds or 0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Value = to }):Play()
	task.delay((seconds or 0.6) + 0.1, function()
		v:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Hit-stop: freeze playing animation tracks briefly.
function Juice.hitStop(duration)
	local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local char = player and player.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		return
	end
	local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
	for _, tr in ipairs(tracks) do
		tr:AdjustSpeed(0)
	end
	task.delay(duration or 0.06, function()
		for _, tr in ipairs(tracks) do
			tr:AdjustSpeed(1)
		end
	end)
end

return Juice

-- BrainrotFactory (Fix #6): organic brainrot silhouettes.
-- The Body is no longer a plain cube: every character is built from
-- Ball / Cylinder / Wedge / CornerWedge parts welded to the Body, with
-- its signature features enlarged ~1.5-2x over v17 so it reads from
-- across the plaza. Face direction is local +Z; the spawner orients
-- the model (faceEast) for the west-to-east belt.
-- PrimaryPart stays "Body" at CFrame (0, size/2, 0), axis-aligned.
-- Attributes: CharId, Rarity, Mutation, Rate, Price, BodySize.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local BrainrotData = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local BrainrotFactory = {}

local GOLD_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)

local Ball = Enum.PartType.Ball
local Cylinder = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
local Wedge = Enum.PartType.Wedge

-- makePart(name, size, color, material, shape): Anchored, non-colliding
-- part with smooth top/bottom faces. Default material SmoothPlastic;
-- pass a PartType for organic shapes (Ball / Cylinder / Wedge /
-- CornerWedge). Behaviour preserved from v16/v17.
local function makePart(name, size, color, material, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape then
		part.Shape = shape
	end
	return part
end

-- weldTo(model, body, part, offsetCFrame): place the part relative to
-- the Body and weld it there. Behaviour preserved from v16/v17.
local function weldTo(model, body, part, offsetCFrame)
	part.CFrame = body.CFrame * offsetCFrame
	part.Parent = model
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = body
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = offsetCFrame
	weld.Parent = body
end

-- Convenience: make + weld in one call. Offsets are Vector3/CFrame
-- values already scaled by the row size at the call site.
local function addPart(model, body, name, size, color, offset, material, shape)
	local part = makePart(name, size, color, material, shape)
	weldTo(model, body, part, offset)
	return part
end

-- Two dark ball eyes on the +Z face. y/z/spread/eyeSize are studs.
local function addEyes(model, body, y, z, spread, eyeSize)
	local e = eyeSize or 0.09
	addPart(model, body, "EyeL", Vector3.new(e, e, e), DARK, CFrame.new(-spread, y, z), nil, Ball)
	addPart(model, body, "EyeR", Vector3.new(e, e, e), DARK, CFrame.new(spread, y, z), nil, Ball)
end

-- A cylinder segment running from p1 to p2 (offsets relative to the
-- Body centre). Cylinder's long axis is X, so the offset orients local
-- X along p1 -> p2 via a lookAt frame.
local function addCylBetween(model, body, name, p1, p2, diameter, color, material)
	local mid = (p1 + p2) / 2
	local len = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
	local part = makePart(name, Vector3.new(len, diameter, diameter), color, material, Cylinder)
	weldTo(model, body, part, CFrame.new(mid, p2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
	return part
end

-- One function, one branch per row.id. Unknown ids fall through to a
-- plain cube + eyes. All offsets are relative to the Body centre and
-- already multiplied by s (the row size) at the call site.
local function buildShape(model, body, row, size)
	local s = size
	local id = row.id

	if id == "tung-tung-sahur" then
		-- BATANG KAYU: horizontal log (cylinder axis is X already).
		addPart(model, body, "Log", Vector3.new(1.4 * s, 0.55 * s, 0.55 * s), Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 50), CFrame.new(0, 0.05 * s, 0), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "LogRingA", Vector3.new(0.06 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), CFrame.new(0.62 * s, 0.05 * s, 0), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "LogRingB", Vector3.new(0.06 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), CFrame.new(-0.62 * s, 0.05 * s, 0), nil, Cylinder)
		-- Face on the +X end cap.
		addPart(model, body, "EyeL", Vector3.new(0.09 * s, 0.09 * s, 0.09 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(0.72 * s, 0.18 * s, -0.13 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "EyeR", Vector3.new(0.09 * s, 0.09 * s, 0.09 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(0.72 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.13 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "Mouth", Vector3.new(0.05 * s, 0.07 * s, 0.22 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(0.72 * s, -0.02 * s, 0))
		-- PENTUNGAN BESAR: long tilted club.
		addPart(model, body, "Club", Vector3.new(1.2 * s, 0.35 * s, 0.35 * s), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), CFrame.new(-0.42 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.2 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(25)), nil, Cylinder)
		-- Two short wooden legs.
		addPart(model, body, "LegL", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.14 * s, 0.14 * s), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), CFrame.new(-0.2 * s, -0.35 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "LegR", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.14 * s, 0.14 * s), Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 40), CFrame.new(0.2 * s, -0.35 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), nil, Cylinder)

	elseif id == "tralalero" then
		-- HIU biru: ball body stretched along Z.
		addPart(model, body, "SharkBody", Vector3.new(0.8 * s, 0.7 * s, 1.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 220), CFrame.new(0, 0.05 * s, 0), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "DorsalFin", Vector3.new(0.45 * s, 0.55 * s, 0.8 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(0, 0.5 * s, -0.15 * s), nil, Wedge)
		addPart(model, body, "TailFinTop", Vector3.new(0.15 * s, 0.9 * s, 0.7 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(0, 0.2 * s, -0.95 * s), nil, Wedge)
		addPart(model, body, "TailFinLow", Vector3.new(0.15 * s, 0.6 * s, 0.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(0, -0.15 * s, -0.9 * s), nil, Wedge)
		addPart(model, body, "Belly", Vector3.new(0.6 * s, 0.35 * s, 1.1 * s), WHITE, CFrame.new(0, -0.18 * s, 0.1 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "FinL", Vector3.new(0.4 * s, 0.1 * s, 0.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(-0.45 * s, -0.1 * s, 0.3 * s), nil, Wedge)
		addPart(model, body, "FinR", Vector3.new(0.4 * s, 0.1 * s, 0.5 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(0.45 * s, -0.1 * s, 0.3 * s), nil, Wedge)
		addPart(model, body, "LegL", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.13 * s, 0.13 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(-0.2 * s, -0.35 * s, 0.05 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "LegR", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.13 * s, 0.13 * s), Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 190), CFrame.new(0.2 * s, -0.35 * s, 0.05 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "SneakerL", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.5 * s), WHITE, CFrame.new(-0.2 * s, -0.42 * s, 0.2 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "SneakerR", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.5 * s), WHITE, CFrame.new(0.2 * s, -0.42 * s, 0.2 * s), nil, Ball)
		addEyes(model, body, 0.22 * s, 0.7 * s, 0.17 * s, 0.1 * s)
		addPart(model, body, "Mouth", Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 0.06 * s, 0.05 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(0, -0.02 * s, 0.74 * s))

	elseif id == "brr-patapim" then
		-- MONYET: brown ball body, long nose, little tree, curled tail.
		addPart(model, body, "Belly", Vector3.new(0.5 * s, 0.55 * s, 0.3 * s), Color3.fromRGB(200, 160, 110), CFrame.new(0, -0.05 * s, 0.35 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "Nose", Vector3.new(1.0 * s, 0.35 * s, 0.35 * s), Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 70), CFrame.new(0, 0.05 * s, 0.75 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), nil, Cylinder)
		addPart(model, body, "NoseTip", Vector3.new(0.32 * s, 0.32 * s, 0.32 * s), Color3.fromRGB(140, 95, 55), CFrame.new(0, 0.05 * s, 1.25 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "NostrilL", Vector3.new(0.06 * s, 0.06 * s, 0.06 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(-0.07 * s, 0.08 * s, 1.38 * s), nil, Ball)
		addPart(model, body, "NostrilR", Vector3.new(0.06 * s, 0.06 * s, 0.06 * s), DARK, CFrame.new(0.07 * s, 0.08 * s, 1.38 * s), nil, Ball)
		addEyes(model, body, 0.32 * s, 0.38 * s, 0.18 * s, 0.1 * s)
		addPart(model, body, "EarL", Vector3.new(0.22 * s, 0.22 * s, 0.22 * s), Color3.fromRGB(140, 95, 55), CFrame.new(-0.42 * s, 0.25 * s, -0.05 * s), nil, Ball)

-- Billboard (Fix #6): smaller (160x80) so labels stop stacking when
-- characters crowd the belt; staggered vertically by the id's byte sum
-- so neighbours sit at different heights. 4 labels, fractions of the
-- billboard height: name 0-0.34, rarity 0.34-0.58, rate 0.58-0.79,
-- price 0.79-1.0.
local function addBillboard(model, body, row, size)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "InfoBillboard"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 80)
	gui.MaxDistance = 35
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	local sum = 0
	local id = row.id or ""
	for i = 1, #id do
		sum += string.byte(id, i)
	end
	local stagger = 0
	if sum % 2 == 0 then
		stagger = size * 0.28
	end
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size * 1.15 + stagger, 0)
	gui.Parent = body

	local function addLabel(name, text, textSize, textColor, posY, height)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = name
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, height, 0)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, posY, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = text
		label.TextColor3 = textColor
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		label.TextScaled = false
		label.TextSize = textSize
		label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.Parent = gui
		return label
	end

	addLabel("Name", row.name or row.id or "Brainrot", 13, WHITE, 0, 0.34)
	addLabel("Rarity", row.rarity or "Common", 11, BrainrotData.getRarityColor(row.rarity), 0.34, 0.24)
	addLabel("Rate", "$" .. tostring(row.rate or 0) .. "/s", 11, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140), 0.58, 0.21)
	addLabel("Price", "$" .. tostring(row.price or 0), 12, Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51), 0.79, 0.21)
end

local function applyMutation(model, body, mutation)
	if mutation == "Emas" then
		body.Color = GOLD_COLOR
		body.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	elseif mutation == "Pelangi" then
		task.spawn(function()
			local hue = 0
			while model.Parent ~= nil do
				for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						part.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.8, 1)
					end
				end
				hue += 0.05
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function BrainrotFactory.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random()
	if roll < Config.MUTATION_RAINBOW_CHANCE then
		return "Pelangi"
	elseif roll < Config.MUTATION_RAINBOW_CHANCE + Config.MUTATION_GOLD_CHANCE then
		return "Emas"
	else
		return "Normal"
	end
end

function BrainrotFactory.getMutationMultiplier(mutation)
	if mutation == "Emas" then
		return 2
	elseif mutation == "Pelangi" then
		return 3
	else
		return 1
	end
end

function BrainrotFactory.buildBrainrotModel(row, mutation)
	row = row or BrainrotData.CAST[1]
	local size = row.size or 4
	mutation = mutation or BrainrotFactory.rollMutation()

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = row.name or row.id or "Brainrot"

	-- PrimaryPart: axis-aligned, CFrame (0, size/2, 0), no rotation.
	-- Ball core in the row colour; the fridge is the one box Body.
	local bodySize = Vector3.new(size * 0.8, size * 0.8, size * 0.8)
	local bodyShape = Ball
	local bodyColor = row.color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	if row.id == "frigo-camelo" then
		bodySize = Vector3.new(size * 0.62, size * 0.95, size * 0.62)
		bodyShape = Enum.PartType.Block
		bodyColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 235)
	end
	local body = makePart("Body", bodySize, bodyColor, nil, bodyShape)
	body.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, size / 2, 0)
	body.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	model:SetAttribute("CharId", row.id)
	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", row.rarity)
	model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutation)
	model:SetAttribute("Rate", row.rate)
	model:SetAttribute("Price", row.price)
	model:SetAttribute("BodySize", size)

	local ok = pcall(buildShape, model, body, row, size)
	if not ok then
		-- Fallback: simple cube + eyes; the model must never throw.
		addPart(model, body, "FallbackCube", Vector3.new(size * 0.7, size * 0.7, size * 0.7), bodyColor, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
		addEyes(model, body, size * 0.1, size * 0.36, size * 0.15, size * 0.08)
	end

	applyMutation(model, body, mutation)
	addBillboard(model, body, row, size)
	return model
end

return BrainrotFactory

--- @ignore
type MountedPortal = {

--- @ignore
