--- @ignore
export type Portal = Type.Portal

-- The source that currently drives each instance property or attribute (attributes keyed with a `$` prefix). An edit
-- that sets the key again, bound or static, releases the previous claim first, so the newest value wins and stays
-- instead of racing the original source whenever it changes. A claim is a list of releasers: its unbind, then anything
-- edit attached to it (the node it made from a function, a model's read-back connection).
type Claim = { (() -> ()) | Graph.Node<any> }
local claims: { [Instance]: { [string]: Claim } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function claimKey(property: string, isAttribute: boolean?): string
	return if isAttribute then "$" .. property else property
end

local function release(instance: Instance, property: string, isAttribute: boolean?)
	local owned = claims[instance]
	if owned == nil then
		return
	end
	local key = claimKey(property, isAttribute)
	local claim = owned[key]
	if claim == nil then
		return
	end
	owned[key] = nil
	if next(owned) == nil then
		claims[instance] = nil
	end
	for _, releaser in claim do
		if type(releaser) == "function" then
			releaser()
		else
			Graph.dispose(releaser)
		end
	end
end
local pinnedOrder: { [Instance]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local autoOrder: { [Instance]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local staticOrder: { [Instance]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local parentSlots: { [Instance]: { OrderSlot } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function applyLayoutOrder(child: Instance, order: number): number
	if child:IsA("GuiObject") and not pinnedOrder[child] then
		local gui = child :: GuiObject
		local current = gui.LayoutOrder
		if current == 0 or autoOrder[child] == current then
			gui.LayoutOrder = order
			autoOrder[child] = order
			return order + 1
		end
	end
	return order
end

local function stepOrderSlot(
	parent: Instance,
	slot: OrderSlot,
	order: number,
	skipChild: Instance?,
	skipBind: ChildrenState?
): (boolean, number)
	if slot.kind == "single" then
		local child = slot.child
		if child ~= nil and child ~= skipChild and child.Parent == parent then
			return true, applyLayoutOrder(child, order)
		end
		return false, order
	end
	local bindState = slot.bind
	if bindState ~= nil and bindState ~= skipBind and bindState.parent == parent then
		local effOrder = order
		if slot.offset ~= nil and effOrder < slot.offset then
			effOrder = slot.offset
		end
		bindState.order = effOrder
		for _, child in bindState.list do
			if child.Parent == parent then
				effOrder = applyLayoutOrder(child, effOrder)
			end
		end
		bindState.lastEndOrder = effOrder
		return true, effOrder
	end
	return false, order
end

local function compactOrderSlots(
	parent: Instance,
	slots: { OrderSlot },
	startIndex: number,
	startOrder: number,
	skipChild: Instance?,
	skipBind: ChildrenState?
): number
	local writeIdx = startIndex
	local order = startOrder
	for readIdx = startIndex, #slots do
		local slot = slots[readIdx]
		local keep, nextOrder = stepOrderSlot(parent, slot, order, skipChild, skipBind)
		if keep then
			order = nextOrder
			if writeIdx ~= readIdx then
				slots[writeIdx] = slot
			end
			writeIdx += 1
		end
	end
	for i = writeIdx, #slots do
		slots[i] = nil
	end
	return order
end

local function refreshParentSlots(parent: Instance)
	local slots = parentSlots[parent]
	if slots == nil then
		return
	end
	compactOrderSlots(parent, slots, 1, (staticOrder[parent] or 0) + 1, nil, nil)
	if #slots == 0 then
		parentSlots[parent] = nil
	end
end

local function placeChildOrder(parent: Instance, child: Instance)
	if not child:IsA("GuiObject") then
		return
	end
	local slots = parentSlots[parent]
	if slots == nil then
		local nextOrder = (staticOrder[parent] or 0) + 1
		if applyLayoutOrder(child, nextOrder) > nextOrder then
			staticOrder[parent] = nextOrder
		end
		return
	end
	local order = compactOrderSlots(parent, slots, 1, (staticOrder[parent] or 0) + 1, child, nil)
	applyLayoutOrder(child, order)
	table.insert(slots, { kind = "single", child = child })
end

local function attachChildrenSlot(parent: Instance, bindState: ChildrenState, offset: number?): number
	local slots = parentSlots[parent]
	if slots == nil then
		slots = {}
		parentSlots[parent] = slots
	end
	local order = compactOrderSlots(parent, slots, 1, (staticOrder[parent] or 0) + 1, nil, bindState)
	if offset ~= nil and order < offset then
		order = offset
	end
	table.insert(slots, { kind = "children", bind = bindState, offset = offset })
	return order
end

local function removeChildrenSlot(parent: Instance?, bindState: ChildrenState)
	if parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local slots = parentSlots[parent]
	if slots == nil then
		return
	end
	for i = 1, #slots do
		if slots[i].bind == bindState then
			table.remove(slots, i)
			refreshParentSlots(parent)
			return
		end
	end
end

local function refreshAfterChildrenSlot(parent: Instance, bindState: ChildrenState, endOrder: number)
	local slots = parentSlots[parent]
	if slots == nil then
		return
	end
	for i = 1, #slots do
		if slots[i].bind == bindState then
			for prefixIdx = 1, i - 1 do
				local pre = slots[prefixIdx]
				local alive = if pre.kind == "single"
					then pre.child ~= nil and pre.child.Parent == parent
					else pre.bind ~= nil and pre.bind.parent == parent
				if not alive then
					refreshParentSlots(parent)
					return
				end
			end
			if slots[i + 1] ~= nil then
				compactOrderSlots(parent, slots, i + 1, endOrder, nil, nil)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

local function isInstance(value: any): boolean
	return kindOf(value) == "Instance"
end

local function isPortal(value: unknown): boolean
	local rawValue: any = value
	return type(value) == "table" and rawget(rawValue, 1) == PORTAL_SYMBOL
end

local mountPortal: (portal: any) -> () -> ()

local function stopPortals(portals: { () -> () }?)
	if portals == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, stop in portals do
		stop()
	end
	table.clear(portals)
end

local function stopMountedPortals(portals: { MountedPortal }?)
	if portals == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, entry in portals do
		entry.stop()
	end
	table.clear(portals)
end

local function collectChildren(value: any, into: { Instance }, portals: { any }): { Instance }
	if isInstance(value) then
		table.insert(into, value)
	elseif isNode(value) then
		collectChildren(get(value), into, portals)
	elseif isPortal(value) then
		table.insert(portals, value)
	elseif type(value) == "table" then
		for _, child in value do
			collectChildren(child, into, portals)
		end
	end
	return into
end

local function syncPortals(data: any, portals: { any }, count: number)
	local oldPortals = data.portals
	if count == 0 then
		stopMountedPortals(oldPortals)
		return
	end
	local mounted = data.nextPortals
	if mounted == nil then
		mounted = {}
	else
		data.nextPortals = nil
		table.clear(mounted)
	end
	if oldPortals ~= nil and oldPortals[1] ~= nil then
		local nOld = #oldPortals
		for i = 1, count do
			local spec = portals[i]
			local matched: MountedPortal? = nil
			for j = 1, nOld do
				local oldEntry = oldPortals[j]
				if oldEntry and oldEntry.spec == spec then
					matched = oldEntry
					oldPortals[j] = false :: any
					break
				end
			end
			mounted[i] = matched or { spec = spec, stop = NOOP }
		end
		for j = 1, nOld do
			local oldEntry = oldPortals[j]
			if oldEntry then
				oldEntry.stop()
			end
		end
		table.clear(oldPortals)
	else
		for i = 1, count do
			mounted[i] = { spec = portals[i], stop = NOOP }
		end
	end
	data.portals = mounted
	if oldPortals ~= nil then
		data.nextPortals = oldPortals
	end
	for i = 1, count do
		local entry = mounted[i]
		if entry.stop == NOOP then
			entry.stop = isolate(mountPortal, entry.spec)
		end
	end
end

local function applyChildren(bind: BindData, value: any)
	local data = bind.children
	if data == nil then
		return
	end
	while isNode(value) do
		value = get(value)
	end
	local parent = data.parent
	if parent == nil then
		return
	end

	local children: { Instance }? = nil
	local portals: { any }? = nil
	local kind = 0 -- 0 = single/none, 1 = single portal, 2 = table
	if isPortal(value) then
		portals = bind.scratchPortals or {}
		bind.scratchPortals = nil
		(portals :: { any })[1] = value
		kind = 1
	elseif type(value) == "table" and not isInstance(value) then
		children = bind.scratchChildren or {}
		bind.scratchChildren = nil
		portals = bind.scratchPortals or {}
		bind.scratchPortals = nil
		collectChildren(value, children :: { Instance }, portals :: { any })
		kind = 2
	end

	local function commitDom()
		local list = data.list
		local layoutOrder = data.order or 1
		if kind == 1 then
			for _, child in list do
				if child.Parent == parent then
					child.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			table.clear(list)
			local portalList = portals :: { any }
			syncPortals(data, portalList, 1)
			table.clear(portalList)
			bind.scratchPortals = portalList
		elseif kind == 2 then
			local childList = children :: { Instance }
			local portalList = portals :: { any }
			if list[1] ~= nil then
				if childList[2] == nil then
					local first = childList[1]
					for _, child in list do
						if child.Parent == parent and child ~= first then
							child.Parent = nil
						end
					end
				else
					local incoming: { [Instance]: true } = bind.scratchIncoming or {}
					bind.scratchIncoming = nil
					for _, child in childList do
						incoming[child] = true
					end
					for _, child in list do
						if child.Parent == parent and incoming[child] == nil then
							child.Parent = nil
						end
					end
					table.clear(incoming)
					bind.scratchIncoming = incoming
				end
				table.clear(list)
			end
			for count, child in childList do
				layoutOrder = applyLayoutOrder(child, layoutOrder)
				list[count] = child
				if child.Parent ~= parent then
					child.Parent = parent
				end
			end
			syncPortals(data, portalList, #portalList)
			table.clear(childList)
			table.clear(portalList)
			bind.scratchChildren = childList
			bind.scratchPortals = portalList
		else
			for _, child in list do
				if child.Parent == parent and child ~= value then
					child.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			table.clear(list)
			syncPortals(data, list, 0)
			if value ~= nil and isInstance(value) then
				local child = value :: Instance
				layoutOrder = applyLayoutOrder(child, layoutOrder)
				list[1] = child
				if child.Parent ~= parent then
					child.Parent = parent
				end
			end
		end
		data.lastEndOrder = layoutOrder
		refreshAfterChildrenSlot(parent, data, layoutOrder)
	end

	isolate(commitDom)
end

local function setAttribute(instance: Instance, attr: string, value: any)
	instance:SetAttribute(attr, value)
end

local function setProperty(instance: Instance, prop: string, value: any)
	local rawInstance: any = instance
	rawInstance[prop] = value
end

local function resolveKey(name: string, isAttribute: boolean?): (string, boolean, boolean)
	if isAttribute ~= nil then
		return name, isAttribute, false
	end
	local first = string.byte(name)
	if first == 36 then
		local attr = string.sub(name, 2)
		if attr == "" then
			error('attribute name after "$" cannot be empty', 4)
		end
		return attr, true, false
	elseif first == 35 then
		local tag = string.sub(name, 2)
		if tag == "" then
			error('tag name after "#" cannot be empty', 4)
		end
		return tag, false, true
	elseif first == 95 then
		if string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "_attr_" then
			local attr = string.sub(name, 7)
			if attr == "" then
				error('attribute name after "_attr_" cannot be empty', 4)
			end
			return attr, true, false
		elseif string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "_tag_" then
			local tag = string.sub(name, 6)
			if tag == "" then
				error('tag name after "_tag_" cannot be empty', 4)
			end
			return tag, false, true
		end
	end
	return name, false, false
end

local function onTagChanged(instance: Instance, tag: string, fn: (hasTag: boolean) -> ()): () -> ()
	local collectionService = Compat.getService("CollectionService")
	if collectionService == nil then
		return NOOP
	end
	local last = instance:HasTag(tag)
	local function check(inst: Instance)
		if inst == instance then
			local current = instance:HasTag(tag)
			if current ~= last then
				last = current
				fn(current)
			end
		end
	end
	local added = collectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(check)
	local removed = collectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(check)
	local ancestry = instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		check(instance)
	end)
	local destroying: RBXScriptConnection
	local function disconnect()
		added:Disconnect()
		removed:Disconnect()
		ancestry:Disconnect()
		destroying:Disconnect()
	end
	destroying = instance.Destroying:Connect(disconnect)
	return disconnect
end

local function onChanged(
	instance: Instance,
	name: string,
	isAttribute: boolean?,
	fn: (value: any) -> ()
): RBXScriptConnection
	if isAttribute then
		return instance:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			fn(instance:GetAttribute(name))
		end)
	end
	local rawInstance: any = instance
	return instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
		fn(rawInstance[name])
	end)
end

local function writeInstance(bind: BindData, value: any)
	for instance, syncTo in bind.rbx do
		local attrs = syncTo[1]
		if attrs then
			for attr in attrs do
				setAttribute(instance, attr, value)
			end
		end
		local props = syncTo[2]
		if props then
			for prop in props do
				setProperty(instance, prop, value)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function writeBinds(bind: BindData, value: any)
	if next(bind.rbx) ~= nil and not pcall(writeInstance, bind, value) then
		for instance, syncTo in bind.rbx do
			local attrs = syncTo[1]
			if attrs then
				for attr in attrs do
					local ok, result = pcall(setAttribute, instance, attr, value)
					if not ok then
						warn(`[Flux] failed to set attribute "{attr}" of {instance:GetFullName()}: {result}`)
					end
				end
			end
			local props = syncTo[2]
			if props then
				for prop in props do
					local ok, result = pcall(setProperty, instance, prop, value)
					if not ok then
						warn(`[Flux] failed to set property "{prop}" of {instance:GetFullName()}: {result}`)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local bindDestroy: (node: Graph.Node<any>, disconnect: () -> ()) -> () -> ()

local function releaseBindDataIfIdle<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>)
	local data = bindData[node]
	if data == nil or data.pin ~= nil or #data.fn > 0 or next(data.rbx) ~= nil or data.children ~= nil then
		return
	end
	bindData[node] = nil
	local stopDestroy = data.destroyCleanup
	data.destroyCleanup = nil
	if stopDestroy ~= nil then
		stopDestroy()
	end
	if data.eff ~= nil then
		data.eff:Destroy()
		data.eff = nil
	end
	data.flushed = false
	data.value = nil
end

local function releaseSignalEffectIfIdle<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, data: BindData)
	if data.pin == nil and #data.fn == 0 and next(data.rbx) == nil then
		if data.eff ~= nil then
			data.eff:Destroy()
			data.eff = nil
		end
		data.flushed = false
		data.value = nil
	end
	releaseBindDataIfIdle(node)
end

local function cleanupChildrenBind<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, parent: Instance?)
	local data = bindData[node]
	local children = data and data.children
	if not children then
		return
	end
	if children.cleanupConnection then
		children.cleanupConnection:Disconnect()
		children.cleanupConnection = nil
	end
	if children.eff ~= nil then
		children.eff:Destroy()
		children.eff = nil
	end
	removeChildrenSlot(parent or children.parent, children)
	stopMountedPortals(children.portals)
	for _, child in children.list do
		local current = child and child.Parent
		if current ~= nil and (parent == nil or current == parent) then
			child.Parent = nil
		end
	end
	table.clear(children.list)
	table.clear(children)
	data.children = nil
	releaseBindDataIfIdle(node)
end

local function dispatchListener(entry: ListenerEntry, value: any, ver: number?)
	local fn = entry.fn
	if fn == nil then
		return
	end
	local skipVer = entry.skipVer
	if skipVer ~= nil then
		entry.skipVer = nil
		if ver == skipVer then
			return
		end
	end
	compatTask.spawn(fn, value)
end

local function startBindEffect(node: Graph.Node<any>, data: BindData): Graph.Node<any>
	data.flushed = false
	-- Writing instance properties fires engine listeners (`Changed`, `GetPropertyChangedSignal`, `AncestryChanged`)
	-- synchronously. Run the writes untracked and ownerless so those listeners neither subscribe this effect to
	-- what they read nor hand it the instances they create (which it would destroy on its next run).
	local pending: any = nil
	local pendingVer: number? = nil
	local notifyListeners = false
	local function write()
		local value = pending
		local ver = pendingVer
		local shouldNotify = notifyListeners
		pending = nil
		pendingVer = nil
		notifyListeners = false
		if shouldNotify then
			local fns = data.fn
			local count = #fns
			if count == 1 then
				dispatchListener(fns[1], value, ver)
			elseif count > 1 then
				local list = table.move(fns, 1, count, 1, table.create(count) :: { ListenerEntry })
				for _, entry in list do
					dispatchListener(entry, value, ver)
				end
			end
		end
		writeBinds(data, value)
	end
	local eff = isolate(effect, function()
		local notify = data.flushed
		data.flushed = true
		local value = get(node)
		local ver = nodeVersion(node)
		data.value = value
		data.ver = ver
		local hasFn = notify and #data.fn > 0
		if hasFn or next(data.rbx) ~= nil then
			pending = value
			pendingVer = ver
			notifyListeners = hasFn
			isolate(write)
		end
	end)
	return eff
end

function bindDestroy(node: Graph.Node<any>, disconnect: () -> ()): () -> ()
	local rawNode: any = node
	local done = false
	local destroyingNode = false
	local disconnectOnce: () -> ()
	local function onNodeDestroy()
		destroyingNode = true
		disconnectOnce()
	end
	function disconnectOnce()
		if done then
			return
		end
		done = true
		if not destroyingNode then
			local inner = rawget(rawNode, 1)
			local destroys = inner and inner.destroys
			if destroys then
				local idx = table.find(destroys, onNodeDestroy)
				if idx then
					table.remove(destroys, idx)
				end
			end
		end
		disconnect()
	end
	node:onDestroy(onNodeDestroy)
	return disconnectOnce
end

local function ensureBindData<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>): BindData
	local data: any = bindData[node]
	if data == nil then
		data = { fn = {}, rbx = {}, children = nil, eff = nil, flushed = false, value = nil }
		bindData[node] = data
		data.destroyCleanup = bindDestroy(node, function()
			if bindData[node] ~= data then
				return
			end
			if data.eff ~= nil then
				data.eff:Destroy()
				data.eff = nil
			end
			for _, entry in data.fn do
				entry.fn = nil
			end
			table.clear(data.fn)
			table.clear(data.rbx)
			if data.children ~= nil then
				cleanupChildrenBind(node)
			end
			bindData[node] = nil
		end)
	end
	return data
end

local function ensureSignalEffect<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, data: BindData): Graph.Node<any>
	if data.eff == nil then
		data.eff = startBindEffect(node, data)
	end
	return data.eff :: Graph.Node<any>
end

local Bind = {
	--- @ignore
	pinOrder = function(instance: Instance)
		pinnedOrder[instance] = true
		autoOrder[instance] = nil
	end,
	--- @ignore
	placeChildOrder = placeChildOrder,
	--- @ignore
	applyLayoutOrder = applyLayoutOrder,
	--- @ignore
	setAttribute = setAttribute,
	--- @ignore
	setProperty = setProperty,
	--- @ignore
	onChanged = onChanged,
	--- @ignore
	onTagChanged = onTagChanged,
	--- @ignore
	syncPortals = syncPortals,
	--- @ignore
	bindDestroy = bindDestroy,
}

--[[
Wraps a reactive [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for two-way binding on an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, attribute, or tag.
Updates the instance from `node` and writes changes back to `node` when the instance fires its changed signal.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key)
]]
function Bind.model<T>(node: { read get: (any) -> T, read peek: (any) -> T, read set: (any, ...any) -> any }): T
	if not isNode(node) then
		error("Flux.model expects a reactive node", 2)
	end
	local wrapped: any = table.freeze({ MODEL_SYMBOL, node })
	return wrapped
end

--[[
Returns `true` when `value` is a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key)
]]
function Bind.isModel(value: unknown): boolean
	local rawValue: any = value
	return type(value) == "table" and rawget(rawValue, 1) == MODEL_SYMBOL
end

--[[
Returns the underlying node from a [`Flux.model`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key) wrapper, or `nil` if `value` is not a model.

```luau
local node = Flux.modelNode(props.value)
if node then
	node:set(text)
end
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#flux-model-two-way-binding-in-one-key)
]]
function Bind.modelNode(value: unknown): Graph.Node<any>?
	local rawValue: any = value
	return if Bind.isModel(value) then rawValue[2] else nil
end

--- @ignore
function Bind.children<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, parent: Instance, layoutOrder: number?): () -> ()
	local data = ensureBindData(node)
	bindGeneration += 1
	local token = bindGeneration
	local children: ChildrenState
	local function disconnectBind()
		local current = data.children
		if current ~= nil and current.token == token then
			cleanupChildrenBind(node, parent)
		end
	end

	local existing = data.children
	local oldParent: Instance? = nil
	if existing == nil then
		local fresh: ChildrenState = { list = {} }
		children = fresh
		data.children = fresh
	else
		children = existing
		if children.cleanupConnection then
			children.cleanupConnection:Disconnect()
			children.cleanupConnection = nil
		end
		if children.eff ~= nil then
			children.eff:Destroy()
			children.eff = nil
		end
		oldParent = children.parent
		if oldParent ~= nil and oldParent ~= parent then
			removeChildrenSlot(oldParent, children)
			for _, child in children.list do
				if child and child.Parent == oldParent then
					child.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			table.clear(children.list)
		end
	end
	children.cleanupConnection = parent.Destroying:Once(disconnectBind)
	children.offset = layoutOrder
	children.order = attachChildrenSlot(parent, children, layoutOrder)
	children.lastEndOrder = children.order
	children.parent = parent
	children.token = token

	local childEff = isolate(effect, function()
		applyChildren(data, get(node))
	end)
	children.eff = childEff
	local ok, err: any = pcall(function()
		childEff:peek()
	end)
	if not ok then
		if data.children == children and children.token == token then
			cleanupChildrenBind(node, parent)
		else
			childEff:Destroy()
		end
		error(err, 0)
	end
	return disconnectBind
end

--[[
Subscribes `fn` to updates of `node` with [`RBXScriptSignal:Connect`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptSignal#Connect) semantics and returns an unsubscribe function.
Fires on each flush after `node` changes, spawning `fn(value)` on its own thread via [`task.spawn`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/libraries/task#spawn) so callbacks may yield freely.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#bridging-to-external-systems)
]]
function Bind.listen<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, fn: (value: T) -> ()): () -> ()
	if not isNode(node) then
		error(`Flux.listen expects a reactive node, got {compatTypeof(node)}`, 2)
	elseif type(fn) ~= "function" then
		error(`Flux.listen expects a function, got {compatTypeof(fn)}`, 2)
	end
	local data = ensureBindData(node)
	local eff = ensureSignalEffect(node, data)
	local fnData = data.fn
	if not data.flushed or #fnData == 0 then
		eff:peek()
	end
	local entry: ListenerEntry = { fn = fn }
	if #fnData > 0 then
		local curVer = nodeVersion(node)
		if curVer ~= data.ver then
			entry.skipVer = curVer
		end
	end
	table.insert(fnData, entry)
	return function()
		if entry.fn == nil then
			return
		end
		entry.fn = nil
		entry.skipVer = nil
		local idx = table.find(fnData, entry)
		if idx ~= nil then
			table.remove(fnData, idx)
		end
		releaseSignalEffectIfIdle(node, data)
	end
end

--- @ignore
function Bind.from<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, instance: Instance, property: string, isAttribute: boolean?)
	local name, attribute, isTag = resolveKey(property, isAttribute)
	local rawNode: any = node
	local rawInstance: any = instance
	local disconnect: any
	if isTag then
		rawNode:set(instance:HasTag(name))
		disconnect = onTagChanged(instance, name, function(hasTag)
			rawNode:set(hasTag)
		end)
	else
		rawNode:set(if attribute then instance:GetAttribute(name) else rawInstance[name])
		local connection = onChanged(instance, name, attribute, function(value)
			rawNode:set(value)
		end)
		disconnect = function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	local destroyConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local stop = bindDestroy(node, function()
		local conn = destroyConn
		destroyConn = nil
		if conn ~= nil then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		disconnect()
	end)
	destroyConn = instance.Destroying:Once(stop)
	if getOwner() ~= nil then
		cleanup(stop)
	end
	return node, stop
end

local function follow(instance: Instance, property: string): Graph.Node<any>
	return (Bind.from(signal(NO_VALUE), instance, property))
end

local function readSignalConnector(obj: any): ((any, (any) -> ()) -> any)?
	local ok, connect = pcall(function()
		return obj.Connect
	end)
	if ok and type(connect) == "function" then
		return connect
	end
	local okLower, lower = pcall(function()
		return obj.connect
	end)
	return if okLower and type(lower) == "function" then lower else nil
end

local function getSignalConnector(obj: any): ((any, (any) -> ()) -> any)?
	if isNode(obj) or isInstance(obj) then
		return nil
	end
	if kindOf(obj) == "RBXScriptSignal" then
		return (obj :: any).Connect
	end
	local objType = type(obj)
	if objType ~= "table" and objType ~= "userdata" then
		return nil
	end
	if objType == "table" and getmetatable(obj :: any) == nil then
		local connect = rawget(obj :: any, "Connect")
		if type(connect) == "function" then
			return connect
		end
		local lower = rawget(obj :: any, "connect")
		return if type(lower) == "function" then lower else nil
	end
	return isolate(readSignalConnector, obj)
end

local function fromSignal(sig: any, initial: any): Graph.Node<any>
	local connect = getSignalConnector(sig)
	if connect == nil then
		error(`Flux.fromSignal expects an RBXScriptSignal or signal with :Connect(), got {compatTypeof(sig)}`, 2)
	end
	local node = signal(initial)
	local destroyed = false
	local conn: any = nil
	local stop = bindDestroy(node, function()
		destroyed = true
		if conn ~= nil then
			local active = conn
			conn = nil
			dispose(active)
		end
	end)
	local ok, connected = isolate(pcall, connect, sig, function(value: any)
		if not destroyed then
			node:set(value)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		node:Destroy()
		error(connected, 0)
	end
	if destroyed then
		dispose(connected)
	else
		conn = connected
		if getOwner() ~= nil then
			cleanup(stop)
		end
	end
	return node
end

--[[
Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#bridging-signals) updated from the first argument of an
[`RBXScriptSignal`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/datatypes/RBXScriptSignal) or signal table with
`:Connect()` / `:connect()`, seeding from `initial` and deduplicating equal values. Disconnects automatically when the node or its owning scope is destroyed.
]]
Bind.fromSignal = fromSignal :: (<S>(
	signal: S & (RBXScriptSignal | { Connect: any } | { connect: any })
) -> Graph.Node<Type.SignalPayload<S>?>) & (<S, I>(
	signal: S & (RBXScriptSignal | { Connect: any } | { connect: any }),
	initial: I
) -> Graph.Node<Type.SignalPayload<S> | I>)

-- The `"Name"` singleton in `property`'s type keeps a literal argument from widening to `string`, so `K` stays the key.
--[[
Creates a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) mirroring an [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance) property, an attribute (`$Name` or `_attr_Name`), or a [`CollectionService`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/CollectionService) tag (`#Tag` or `_tag_Tag`).
Disconnects automatically when `instance`, the node, or its owning scope is destroyed.

```luau
local text = Flux.property(textBox, "Text")
local health = Flux.property(character, "$Health")
local isEnemy = Flux.property(character, "#Enemy")
```

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#binding-from-an-instance-property)
]]
function Bind.property<I, K>(instance: I & Instance, property: K | "Name"): Graph.Node<Type.PropertyType<I, K>>
	if not isInstance(instance) then
		error(`Flux.property expects an Instance, got {compatTypeof(instance)}`, 2)
	elseif type(property) ~= "string" then
		error(`Flux.property expects a property, "$Attribute", or "#Tag" name, got {compatTypeof(property)}`, 2)
	end
	return follow(instance, property)
end

-- The core constructor behind `Flux(...)`: a value becomes a signal, a function a computed, an Instance with a
-- property, `"$Attribute"` / `"_attr_Attribute"`, or `"#Tag"` / `"_tag_Tag"` name a `Bind.property` node, and an
-- `RBXScriptSignal` a `Bind.fromSignal` node.
--- @ignore
function Bind.node(obj: any, second: any?): Graph.Node<any>
	if isInstance(obj) then
		if type(second) ~= "string" then
			error(
				`Flux(instance, property) expects a property, "$Attribute", or "#Tag" name, got {compatTypeof(second)}`,
				3
			)
		end
		return follow(obj, second)
	elseif kindOf(obj) == "RBXScriptSignal" then
		return (Bind.fromSignal :: any)(obj, second)
	elseif second ~= nil then
		error(
			`Flux(value) takes a single argument; only an Instance takes a property name (or an RBXScriptSignal an initial value)`,
			3
		)
	end
	return new(obj)
end

--[[
Wraps `fn` so a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) tracks only `deps` and runs `fn(input, prevInput, prevResult)` untracked.
Pass `defer = true` to skip the initial run and fire only when `deps` change.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-on)
]]
type OnFn =
	(<D, R>(
		deps: D,
		fn: (input: Type.OnInput<D>, prevInput: Type.OnInput<D>?, prevResult: R?) -> R
	) -> (prevResult: R?) -> R)
	& (<D, R>(
		deps: D,
		fn: (input: Type.OnInput<D>, prevInput: Type.OnInput<D>?, prevResult: R?) -> R,
		defer: boolean
	) -> (prevResult: R?) -> R?)

local function on<D, R>(
	deps: D,
	fn: (input: Type.OnInput<D>, prevInput: Type.OnInput<D>?, prevResult: R?) -> R,
	defer: boolean?
): (prevResult: R?) -> R?
	local rawDeps: any = deps
	local rawFn: (any, any, any) -> any = fn
	local isArray = type(rawDeps) == "table"
		and not isNode(rawDeps)
		and getmetatable(rawDeps) == nil
		and (rawDeps[1] ~= nil or next(rawDeps) == nil)
	local count = if isArray then #(rawDeps :: { any }) else 0
	local prevInput: any = nil
	local curInput: any = nil
	local curPrevResult: any = nil
	local function runOnFn(): R
		local input, prevRes = curInput, curPrevResult
		curInput, curPrevResult = nil, nil
		return rawFn(input, prevInput, prevRes)
	end

	return function(prevResult: R?): R?
		local input
		if isArray then
			input = table.create(count)
			for i = 1, count do
				input[i] = read(rawDeps[i])
			end
		else
			input = read(rawDeps)
		end

		if defer then
			defer = false
			prevInput = input
			return prevResult
		end

		curInput, curPrevResult = input, prevResult
		local result = untrack(runOnFn)
		prevInput = input
		return result
	end
end

Bind.on = on :: OnFn

--- @ignore
function Bind.to<T>(node: Graph.Node<T>, instance: Instance, property: string, isAttribute: boolean?)
	local data = ensureBindData(node)
	ensureSignalEffect(node, data)
	data.pin = (data.pin or 0) + 1
	local attribute = isAttribute == true
	local index = if attribute then 1 else 2
	local ok, err: any = pcall(function()
		release(instance, property, attribute)

		local value = raw(node)
		if attribute then
			isolate(setAttribute, instance, property, value)
		else
			isolate(setProperty, instance, property, value)
		end
	end)
	local pin = (data.pin or 1) - 1
	data.pin = if pin > 0 then pin else nil
	if not ok then
		releaseSignalEffectIfIdle(node, data)
		error(err, 0)
	end
	if bindData[node] ~= data then
		return NOOP
	end

	local binds = data.rbx[instance]
	if binds == nil then
		local newBinds: { { [string]: any }? } = {}
		binds = newBinds
		data.rbx[instance] = newBinds
	end
	local bucket = binds[index]
	if bucket == nil then
		bucket = {}
		binds[index] = bucket
	end

	bindGeneration += 1
	local token = bindGeneration
	bucket[property] = token

	local function unbind()
		if bucket[property] ~= token then
			return
		end
		bucket[property] = nil
		if (binds[1] == nil or next(binds[1]) == nil) and (binds[2] == nil or next(binds[2]) == nil) then
			data.rbx[instance] = nil
		end
		releaseSignalEffectIfIdle(node, data)
	end

	local key = claimKey(property, attribute)
	local claim: Claim = { unbind }
	local owned = claims[instance]
	if owned == nil then
		owned = {}
		claims[instance] = owned
	end
	owned[key] = claim

	return function()
		local current = claims[instance]
		if current and current[key] == claim then
			current[key] = nil
			if next(current) == nil then
				claims[instance] = nil
			end
		end
		unbind()
	end
end

--- @ignore
--- Releases the source currently bound to an instance property or attribute, so a static write replaces it.
Bind.release = release

--- @ignore
--- Ties `releaser` (a cleanup function or cleanable) to the current binding of a key, run when a later edit replaces it.
function Bind.attach(instance: Instance, property: string, isAttribute: boolean?, releaser: any)
	local owned = claims[instance]
	local claim = owned and owned[claimKey(property, isAttribute)]
	if claim then
		table.insert(claim, releaser)
	end
end

--- @ignore
function Bind.isPortal(value: unknown): boolean
	return isPortal(value)
end

--[[
Creates a portal mounting `children` into `target` (static [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance)
or reactive target node) without transferring ownership of `target`.
Mounted children are unparented when the owning scope tears down, the target changes, or the portal host is destroyed.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#portals-flux-portal)
]]
function Bind.portal(target: Graph.Reactive<Instance?>, children: any): Portal
	if target ~= nil and not isInstance(target) and not Graph.isDynamic(target) then
		error(`Flux.portal expects an Instance, reactive target, or nil, got {compatTypeof(target)}`, 2)
	end
	local wrapped: any = table.freeze({ PORTAL_SYMBOL, target, children })
	return wrapped
end

local UNMOUNTED = table.freeze({})

--- @ignore
function mountPortal(portal: any): () -> ()
	local targetSpec = portal[2]
	local content = portal[3]
	local mountedInstances: { Instance } = {}
	local subCleanups: { () -> () } = {}
	local targetConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local currentTarget: Instance? = nil
	local eff: any = nil
	local stopped = false

	local function clearMounted()
		if targetConn ~= nil then
			targetConn:Disconnect()
			targetConn = nil
		end
		stopPortals(subCleanups)
		local target = currentTarget
		currentTarget = nil
		if target ~= nil then
			for _, inst in mountedInstances do
				if inst.Parent == target then
					inst.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			if #mountedInstances > 0 then
				refreshParentSlots(target)
			end
		end
		table.clear(mountedInstances)
	end

	local function mountItem(target: Instance, item: any)
		if isInstance(item) then
			if parentSlots[target] == nil then
				parentSlots[target] = {}
			end
			placeChildOrder(target, item)
			table.insert(mountedInstances, item)
			item.Parent = target
		elseif isNode(item) then
			table.insert(subCleanups, Bind.children(item, target))
		elseif isPortal(item) then
			table.insert(subCleanups, mountPortal(item))
		elseif type(item) == "table" then
			for _, sub in item do
				mountItem(target, sub)
			end
		end
	end

	local function mountTo(target: any)
		isolate(function()
			clearMounted()
			if stopped or target == nil then
				return
			end
			if not isInstance(target) then
				error(`Flux.portal target must resolve to an Instance or nil, got {compatTypeof(target)}`, 2)
			end
			currentTarget = target
			targetConn = target.Destroying:Once(clearMounted)
			local ok, err: any = pcall(mountItem, target, content)
			if not ok then
				clearMounted()
				error(err, 0)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function stop()
		if stopped then
			return
		end
		stopped = true
		if eff ~= nil then
			(eff :: any):Destroy()
			eff = nil
		end
		isolate(clearMounted)
	end

	if Graph.isDynamic(targetSpec) then
		local mountedTarget: any = UNMOUNTED
		eff = isolate(effect, function()
			local nextTarget = read(targetSpec)
			if nextTarget ~= mountedTarget then
				mountedTarget = nextTarget
				mountTo(nextTarget)
			end
		end)
	else
		mountTo(targetSpec)
	end

	if getOwner() ~= nil then
		cleanup(stop)
	end

	return stop
end

--- @ignore
Bind.mountPortal = mountPortal

return table.freeze(Bind)

-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — Bases (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- Player plots, pedestals, carry / deposit / sell / steal / lock.
-- The server owns every transfer: a client can only request, never take.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local Economy = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Economy"))

local Bases = {}
local plots = {} -- [plotIndex] = {owner, position, pedestals = { {part, ownedId, model} }, sellPad}
local playerPlot = {} -- [player] = plotIndex
local carried = {} -- [player] = { {model, index, mutation, income, price, fromPlot, fromPedestal} }
local touchConns = {} -- [model] = RBXScriptConnection

local PLOT_COUNT = 8
local PLOT_RADIUS = 72
local PLOT_COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 107, 107), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60),
	Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 110), Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255),
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200), Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255),
	Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 220), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 90),
}

local function part(name, size, color, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	return p
end

function Bases.buildPlots(parent)
	for i = 1, PLOT_COUNT do
		local angle = (i - 1) / PLOT_COUNT * math.pi * 2
		local pos = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * PLOT_RADIUS, 0, math.sin(angle) * PLOT_RADIUS)
		local plot = Instance.new("Model")
		plot.Name = "Plot" .. tostring(i)
		plot.Parent = parent

		local floor = part("Floor", Vector3.new(28, 1, 28), PLOT_COLORS[i], Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		floor.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		floor.Parent = plot

		-- Owner sign
		local sign = part("Sign", Vector3.new(8, 3, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(240, 248, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		sign.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 5, -13)
		sign.Parent = plot
		local signGui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		signGui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		signGui.Parent = sign
		local signLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		signLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		signLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		signLabel.Text = "EMPTY PLOT"
		signLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 40, 60)
		signLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		signLabel.TextScaled = true
		signLabel.Parent = signGui

		-- 12 pedestals, 3 rows x 4
		local pedestals = {}
		for row = 1, 3 do
			for col = 1, 4 do
				local ped = part("Pedestal", Vector3.new(4, 1, 4), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon)
				ped.Position = pos + Vector3.new((col - 2.5) * 5.5, 1.5, (row - 2) * 6)
				ped.Parent = plot
				table.insert(pedestals, { part = ped, ownedId = nil, model = nil })
			end
		end

		-- Sell pad at the plot entrance
		local sell = part("SellPad", Vector3.new(6, 1, 6), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60), Enum.Material.Neon)
		sell.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 13)
		sell.Parent = plot
		local sellGui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		sellGui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
		sellGui.Parent = sell
		local sellLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		sellLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		sellLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sellLabel.Text = "SELL 80%"
		sellLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0)
		sellLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		sellLabel.TextScaled = true
		sellLabel.Parent = sellGui

		plots[i] = {
			owner = nil, position = pos, pedestals = pedestals,
			sellPad = sell, signLabel = signLabel, model = plot,
		}
	end
end

function Bases.assign(player)
	for i, plot in ipairs(plots) do
		if plot.owner == nil then
			plot.owner = player
			playerPlot[player] = i
			plot.signLabel.Text = player.DisplayName .. "'s BASE"
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Bases.getPlot(player)
	local i = playerPlot[player]
	if i then
		return plots[i]
	end
	return nil
end

function Bases.plotIndexOf(player)
	return playerPlot[player]
end

function Bases.isLocked(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	return os.clock() < s.LockUntil
end

function Bases.carriedCount(player)
	local list = carried[player]
	return list and #list or 0
end

local function setAnchored(model, anchored)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = anchored
			d.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

local function attachToPlayer(player, model)
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not model.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	setAnchored(model, false)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = model.PrimaryPart
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	weld.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	return true
end

local function detachCarry(model)
	local weld = model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
	if weld then
		weld:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Called when a player touches a critter model (conveyor or pedestal).
function Bases.handleTouch(model, hit)
	local char = hit.Parent
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Conveyor critter: free pickup.
	if model:GetAttribute("OnConveyor") == true then
		Bases.tryPickup(player, model)
		return
	end
	-- Pedestal critter: steal from another player's base.
	if model:GetAttribute("OnPedestal") == true then
		Bases.trySteal(player, model)
	end
end

function Bases.armTouch(model)
	if touchConns[model] then
		return
	end
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return
	end
	touchConns[model] = primary.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		Bases.handleTouch(model, hit)
	end)
end

function Bases.disarmTouch(model)
	local conn = touchConns[model]
	if conn then
		conn:Disconnect()
		touchConns[model] = nil
	end
end

-- Pick up a conveyor critter. Returns true on success.
function Bases.tryPickup(player, model)
	if not model.Parent then
		return false
	end
	if Bases.carriedCount(player) >= Economy.carrySlots(player) then
		return false
	end
	if not attachToPlayer(player, model) then
		return false
	end
	model:SetAttribute("OnConveyor", false)
	local list = carried[player]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		carried[player] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, {
		model = model,
		index = model:GetAttribute("CritterIndex"),
		mutation = model:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "",
		income = model:GetAttribute("Income") or 0,
		price = model:GetAttribute("Price") or 0,
		fromPlot = nil,
		fromPedestal = nil,
	})
	return true
end

-- Steal a critter off another player's pedestal.
function Bases.trySteal(player, model)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	if os.clock() < s.StealCooldownUntil then
		return false
	end
	local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	if not ownerId or ownerId == player.UserId then
		return false
	end
	local victim = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
	if not victim then
		return false
	end
	if Bases.isLocked(victim) then
		return false
	end
	if Bases.carriedCount(player) >= Economy.carrySlots(player) then
		return false
	end
	-- Find and clear the pedestal slot.
	local plot = Bases.getPlot(victim)
	if not plot then
		return false
	end
	for i, ped in ipairs(plot.pedestals) do
		if ped.model == model then
			ped.model = nil
			ped.ownedId = nil
			break
		end
	end
	Economy.removeOwned(victim, model:GetAttribute("OwnedId"))
	model:SetAttribute("OnPedestal", false)
	if not attachToPlayer(player, model) then
		return false
	end
	s.StealCooldownUntil = os.clock() + 10
	local list = carried[player]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		carried[player] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, {
		model = model,
		index = model:GetAttribute("CritterIndex"),
		mutation = model:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "",
		income = model:GetAttribute("Income") or 0,
		price = model:GetAttribute("Price") or 0,
		fromPlot = Bases.plotIndexOf(victim),
		fromPedestal = nil,
		stolenFrom = victim,
	})
	return true
end

-- Deposit the first carried critter onto a free pedestal of the player's plot.
-- Returns the owned entry or nil.
function Bases.deposit(player)
	local list = carried[player]
	if not list or #list == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local plot = Bases.getPlot(player)
	if not plot then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = list[1]
	local slot = nil
	local slotIndex = nil
	for i, ped in ipairs(plot.pedestals) do
		if ped.model == nil then
			slot = ped
			slotIndex = i
			break
		end
	end
	if not slot then
		return nil
	end
	detachCarry(entry.model)
	setAnchored(entry.model, true)
	local target = slot.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target))
	entry.model:SetAttribute("OnPedestal", true)
	entry.model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	local owned = Economy.addOwned(player, entry.index, entry.mutation, entry.income)
	if not owned then
		return nil
	end
	entry.model:SetAttribute("OwnedId", owned.id)
	slot.model = entry.model
	slot.ownedId = owned.id
	Bases.armTouch(entry.model) -- pedestal critters can be stolen: touch must stay armed
	table.remove(list, 1)
	return owned
end

-- Sell the first carried critter for 80% of its price.
function Bases.sell(player)
	local list = carried[player]
	if not list or #list == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = list[1]
	table.remove(list, 1)
	local payout = math.floor(entry.price * Config.SELL_FRACTION + 0.5)
	Bases.disarmTouch(entry.model)
	entry.model:Destroy()
	Economy.addBubbles(player, payout)
	return payout
end

-- Drop carried critters at the player's position (on death).
function Bases.dropCarried(player)
	local list = carried[player]
	if not list then
		return
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local dropPos = root and root.Position or Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		if entry.model.Parent then
			detachCarry(entry.model)
			setAnchored(entry.model, true)
			entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dropPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), 2, math.random(-4, 4))))
			entry.model:SetAttribute("OnConveyor", true)
			Bases.armTouch(entry.model)
		end
	end
	carried[player] = {}
end

-- Clear a base entirely (rebirth).
function Bases.clearBase(player)
	local plot = Bases.getPlot(player)
	if not plot then
		return
	end
	for _, ped in ipairs(plot.pedestals) do
		if ped.model then
			Bases.disarmTouch(ped.model)
			ped.model:Destroy()
			ped.model = nil
			ped.ownedId = nil
		end
	end
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	s.Owned = {}
end

function Bases.freePlot(player)
	local i = playerPlot[player]
	if i and plots[i] then
		plots[i].owner = nil
		plots[i].signLabel.Text = "EMPTY PLOT"
	end
	playerPlot[player] = nil
	local list = carried[player]
	if list then
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			if entry.model.Parent then
				entry.model:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	carried[player] = nil
end

function Bases.getCarried(player)
	return carried[player] or {}
end

return Bases

-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
-- CarryAndPlace.luau — buy a brainrot off the belt, carry it above your
-- head, place it on one of your base's 8 pedestals, sell it back for half
-- price. Also builds the pedestals, the base lock posts and their prompts
-- at runtime, and refreshes each pedestal's prompts and $/s sign.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
local ConveyorSpawner = require(script.Parent.ConveyorSpawner)

local CarryAndPlace = {}

-- Set by init.server.luau: the Remotes folder (ToastMessage, SoundEvent).
CarryAndPlace.Remotes = nil

local pedestals = {} -- pedestals[baseIndex][slot] = pedestal table
local BASE_FOLDER = nil

local function toast(player, message)
	if CarryAndPlace.Remotes then
		local remote = CarryAndPlace.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ToastMessage")
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, message)
		end
	end
end

local function playSound(player, kind)
	if CarryAndPlace.Remotes then
		local remote = CarryAndPlace.Remotes:FindFirstChild("SoundEvent")
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, kind)
		end
	end
end

local function makePedestalPart(base, slot, position)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Pedestal_" .. tostring(base) .. "_" .. tostring(slot)
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 3, 3)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 225, 210)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = BASE_FOLDER

	-- FIX #4: pedestal sign is NOT AlwaysOnTop any more, hides beyond
	-- 45 studs, fixed TextSize — 32 AlwaysOnTop "KOSONG" signs stacking
	-- across the plaza was the overlapping-text mess in Dham's screenshot.
	local sign = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	sign.Name = "PedestalSign"
	sign.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 28)
	sign.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	sign.AlwaysOnTop = false
	sign.MaxDistance = 45
	sign.Parent = part

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "SignLabel"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "KOSONG"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = false
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Parent = sign
	return part
end

local function makePrompt(parent, actionText, objectText, holdDuration)
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.HoldDuration = holdDuration
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 7
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.Parent = parent
	return prompt
end

-- Refreshes one pedestal's prompts and $/s sign after any change.
-- FIX #2: direct indexing (part.PedestalSign.SignLabel) throws and kills
-- the caller if the sign ever failed to build — use FindFirstChild.
function CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	local pedestal = pedestals[baseIndex] and pedestals[baseIndex][slot]
	if not pedestal then
		return
	end
	local record = pedestal.record
	local sign = pedestal.part:FindFirstChild("PedestalSign")
	local label = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SignLabel")
	if label then
		if record then
			label.Text = "$" .. tostring(record.rate) .. "/dtk"
		else
			label.Text = "KOSONG"
		end
	end
	if record then
		pedestal.placePrompt.Enabled = false
		pedestal.sellPrompt.Enabled = true
		pedestal.stealPrompt.Enabled = true
	else
		pedestal.placePrompt.Enabled = true
		pedestal.sellPrompt.Enabled = false
		pedestal.stealPrompt.Enabled = false
	end
end

function CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	return pedestals[baseIndex] and pedestals[baseIndex][slot] or nil
end

-- Builds 8 pedestals per base (2 rows of 4) plus a lock post, from Config.BASES.
-- FIX #2: one base's build runs in its own pcall — a failure on one base
-- cannot stop the other three from being built.
local function buildOneBase(baseIndex, base)
	pedestals[baseIndex] = {}
	local center = base.pos
	local slot = 0
	-- FIX #2: columns 7 studs apart (was 5) — a Mythic body is 7.0 studs
	-- wide, so two Mythics side by side now only just touch, never overlap.
	for _, rowZ in ipairs({ -6, 6 }) do
		for _, colX in ipairs({ -10.5, -3.5, 3.5, 10.5 }) do
			slot += 1
			local pos = Vector3.new(center.X + colX, 1.5, center.Z + rowZ)
			local part = makePedestalPart(baseIndex, slot, pos)
			local pedestal = {
				baseIndex = baseIndex,
				slot = slot,
				part = part,
				record = nil,
			}
			pedestal.placePrompt = makePrompt(part, "Letakkan", "Brainrot di kepalamu", 0.5)
			pedestal.sellPrompt = makePrompt(part, "Jual", "50% harga beli kembali", 0.5)
			pedestal.stealPrompt = makePrompt(part, "Curi!", "Tahan 2 detik", Config.STEAL_HOLD_S)
			pedestal.placePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				CarryAndPlace.placeOnPedestal(player, baseIndex, slot)
			end)
			pedestal.sellPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				CarryAndPlace.sellBrainrot(player, baseIndex, slot)
			end)
			pedestal.stealPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				local StealAndLock = require(script.Parent.StealAndLock)
				StealAndLock.tryStealBrainrot(player, baseIndex, slot)
			end)
			pedestals[baseIndex][slot] = pedestal
			CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
		end
	end

	-- Lock post at the base's outer corner: hold E to lock the base 30 s.
	local lockPost = Instance.new("Part")
	lockPost.Name = "LockPost_" .. tostring(baseIndex)
	lockPost.Size = Vector3.new(1, 3, 1)
	lockPost.Position = Vector3.new(center.X + 10, 2.5, center.Z + 10)
	lockPost.Color = base.color
	lockPost.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	lockPost.Anchored = true
	lockPost.Parent = BASE_FOLDER
	local lockPrompt = makePrompt(lockPost, "Kunci Base", "Aman 30 detik", 0.5)
	lockPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local StealAndLock = require(script.Parent.StealAndLock)
		StealAndLock.lockBaseForPlayer(player)
	end)
end

function CarryAndPlace.buildBasePedestals()
	BASE_FOLDER = Instance.new("Folder")
	BASE_FOLDER.Name = "Bases"
	BASE_FOLDER.Parent = workspace

	for baseIndex, base in ipairs(Config.BASES) do
		local ok, err = pcall(buildOneBase, baseIndex, base)
		if not ok then
			warn("[PasarBrainrot] buildBasePedestals gagal untuk base " .. tostring(baseIndex) .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

-- Buys the brainrot off the belt: checks cash, deducts, welds it above the
-- player's head. Called from the belt brainrot's ProximityPrompt.
function CarryAndPlace.buyBrainrot(player, model)
	if not model.Parent or not ConveyorSpawner.isOnBelt(model) then
		return
	end
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.carried then
		toast(player, "Kamu sudah membawa satu brainrot!")
		return
	end
	local price = model:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
	if state.cash < price then
		toast(player, "Uang kurang! Butuh $" .. tostring(price))
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then
		return
	end
	-- FIX #2: cek PrimaryPart SEBELUM uang dipotong (dulu ceknya sesudah
	-- spendCash — body nil = uang hilang, brainrot tak didapat).
	local body = model.PrimaryPart
	if not body then
		return
	end
	if not PlayerState.spendCash(player, price) then
		return
	end
	ConveyorSpawner.removeFromBelt(model)
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	-- FIX #2: carry height scales with the model — a Mythic body is 7.0
	-- studs wide, so the fixed 3.2 offset buried it in the player's head.
	local carryY = (model:GetAttribute("BodySize") or 2) / 2 + 2.2
	body.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, carryY, 0)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = head
	weld.Part1 = body
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, carryY, 0)
	weld.Parent = head
	PlayerState.setCarried(player, model)
	playSound(player, "buy")
	toast(player, "Dibeli: " .. model.Name .. " — bawa ke basemu!")
end

-- Drops whatever the player carries back onto the belt (wave hit, tag, leave).
function CarryAndPlace.dropCarried(player)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state or not state.carried then
		return
	end
	local model = state.carried
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local weld = character:FindFirstChild("Head") and character.Head:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
		if weld then
			weld:Destroy()
		end
	end
	PlayerState.setCarried(player, nil)
	if model.Parent then
		ConveyorSpawner.returnToBelt(model)
	end
end

-- Places the carried brainrot on an empty pedestal of the player's own base.
function CarryAndPlace.placeOnPedestal(player, baseIndex, slot)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	if not state or not pedestal then
		return
	end
	if pedestal.record then
		toast(player, "Pedestal ini sudah terisi!")
		return
	end
	if state.baseIndex ~= baseIndex then
		toast(player, "Itu base pemain lain!")
		return
	end
	local model = state.carried
	if not model or not model.Parent then
		toast(player, "Bawa dulu brainrot dari sabuk!")
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local weld = character:FindFirstChild("Head") and character.Head:FindFirstChild("CarryWeld")
		if weld then
			weld:Destroy()
		end
	end
	PlayerState.setCarried(player, nil)
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = true
		end
	end
	local size = model:GetAttribute("BodySize") or 2
	local base = Config.BASES[baseIndex]
	local yaw = math.atan2(-base.pos.X, -base.pos.Z)
	model:PivotTo(
		CFrame.new(pedestal.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 + size / 2 + 0.05, 0))
			* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	)
	local record = {
		model = model,
		rowId = model:GetAttribute("CharId"),
		rate = model:GetAttribute("Rate"),
		price = model:GetAttribute("Price"),
	}
	pedestal.record = record
	PlayerState.setOwned(player, slot, record)
	CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	playSound(player, "buy")
	toast(player, model.Name .. " mulai menghasilkan $" .. tostring(record.rate) .. "/dtk!")
end

-- Sells the brainrot on your own pedestal back for half its buy price.
function CarryAndPlace.sellBrainrot(player, baseIndex, slot)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	if not state or not pedestal or not pedestal.record then
		return
	end
	if state.baseIndex ~= baseIndex then
		toast(player, "Itu bukan pedestalmu!")
		return
	end
	local record = pedestal.record
	local refund = math.floor(record.price * Config.SELL_REFUND + 0.5)
	pedestal.record = nil
	PlayerState.clearOwnedSlot(player, slot)
	if record.model.Parent then
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
	PlayerState.addCash(player, refund)
	CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	playSound(player, "buy")
	toast(player, "Terjual! +$" .. tostring(refund))
end

-- Removes one owned brainrot without refund (rebirth, steal). Returns the model.
function CarryAndPlace.takeOwnedBrainrot(baseIndex, slot)
	local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	if not pedestal or not pedestal.record then
		return nil
	end
	local record = pedestal.record
	pedestal.record = nil
	CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	return record.model
end

function CarryAndPlace.clearPlayerPedestals(player)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	for slot, record in pairs(PlayerState.getOwned(player)) do
		local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(state.baseIndex, slot)
		if pedestal then
			pedestal.record = nil
			CarryAndPlace.refreshPedestal(state.baseIndex, slot)
		end
		if record.model.Parent then
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	PlayerState.clearOwned(player)
end

return CarryAndPlace

--!strict
--[[
Shared clock for timers, frame callbacks, and deterministic stepping in tests.
Defaults to live mode in Roblox (`os.clock()`, `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()`, `task.*`, `RunService`) and manual mode
outside Roblox (`Clock.manual(false)` opts into live mode outside Roblox).

```luau
local Clock = Flux.Clock
Clock.manual(true)
Clock.delay(1, function() print("one second later") end)
Clock.step(1) -- advances 1 second in 1/60s frames
```
]]

local IS_ROBLOX = game ~= nil

export type Phase = "PreRender" | "RenderStepped" | "Heartbeat"

local EPOCH = 1767225600 -- 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
local EPSILON = 1e-9
local DRAIN_LIMIT = 10000

local osClock = os.clock
type TaskLib = {
	spawn: (...any) -> thread,
	delay: (number?, any, ...any) -> thread,
	wait: (number?) -> number,
	defer: (any, ...any) -> thread,
	cancel: (thread) -> (),
}
local engineTask: TaskLib? = task :: any
local RunService: any = nil
if IS_ROBLOX then
	local getService: (DataModel, string) -> Instance = game.GetService
	local ok, svc = pcall(getService, game, "RunService")
	if ok then
		RunService = svc
	end
end

local manual = not IS_ROBLOX
local virtualNow = 0

--- @ignore
type Timer = {
	due: number,
	seq: number,
	thread: thread,
	start: number?,
	args: { any }?,
	cancelled: boolean?,
}

--- @ignore
type Deferred = {
	thread: thread,
	args: { any }?,
	cancelled: boolean?,
}

local heap: { Timer } = {}
local seq = 0
local timerOf: { [thread]: Timer } = {}

local queue: { Deferred } = {}
local head, tail = 1, 0
local deferredOf: { [thread]: Deferred } = {}

type Subscriber = {
	fn: (dt: number) -> (),
	active: boolean,
	live: boolean,
	conn: RBXScriptConnection?,
}

local render: { Subscriber } = {}
local heartbeat: { Subscriber } = {}
local stepping = false

local frameHook: ((dt: number) -> ())? = nil
local report: (...any) -> () = if IS_ROBLOX then warn else print

local function before(a: Timer, b: Timer): boolean
	return a.due < b.due or (a.due == b.due and a.seq < b.seq)
end

local function push(timer: Timer)
	local index = #heap + 1
	heap[index] = timer
	while index > 1 do
		local parent = index // 2
		if not before(heap[index], heap[parent]) then
			break
		end
		heap[index], heap[parent] = heap[parent], heap[index]
		index = parent
	end
end

local function pop(): Timer
	local top = heap[1]
	local last = table.remove(heap) :: Timer
	local size = #heap
	if size > 0 then
		heap[1] = last
		local index = 1
		while true do
			local left, right, smallest = index * 2, index * 2 + 1, index
			if left <= size and before(heap[left], heap[smallest]) then
				smallest = left
			end
			if right <= size and before(heap[right], heap[smallest]) then
				smallest = right
			end
			if smallest == index then
				break
			end
			heap[index], heap[smallest] = heap[smallest], heap[index]
			index = smallest
		end
	end
	return top
end

local function resume(thread: thread, ...: any)
	if coroutine.status(thread) ~= "suspended" then
		return
	end
	if (IS_ROBLOX or not manual) and engineTask ~= nil and engineTask.spawn ~= nil then
		engineTask.spawn(thread, ...)
		return
	end
	local ok, err = coroutine.resume(thread, ...)
	if not ok then
		report(debug.traceback(thread, `[Flux] Clock: error in a resumed thread: {err}`))
	end
end

local function resumeArgs(thread: thread, args: any)
	if args then
		resume(thread, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	else
		resume(thread)
	end
end

local function toThread(fnOrThread: any): thread
	return if type(fnOrThread) == "thread" then fnOrThread else coroutine.create(fnOrThread)
end

local function scheduleTimer(seconds: number?, thread: thread, start: number?, args: { any }?)
	local prior = timerOf[thread]
	if prior then
		prior.cancelled = true
		prior.args = nil
	end
	local priorDef = deferredOf[thread]
	if priorDef then
		priorDef.cancelled = true
		priorDef.args = nil
		deferredOf[thread] = nil
	end
	local waitSec = if seconds ~= nil and seconds == seconds and seconds > 0 then seconds else 0
	seq += 1
	local timer: Timer = {
		due = virtualNow + waitSec,
		seq = seq,
		thread = thread,
		start = start,
		args = args,
	}
	timerOf[thread] = timer
	push(timer)
end

local function canWait(): boolean
	if not coroutine.isyieldable() then
		return false
	elseif IS_ROBLOX then
		return true
	end
	local level, bottom = 2, nil
	while true do
		local fn = debug.info(level, "f")
		if fn == nil then
			break
		end
		bottom = fn
		level += 1
	end
	if bottom == nil or debug.info(bottom, "s") == "[C]" then
		return true
	end
	local params, vararg = debug.info(bottom, "a")
	return not (debug.info(bottom, "l") <= 1 and params == 0 and vararg)
end

local Clock = {}

--[[
Seconds on a monotonic clock, for measuring intervals: `os.clock()` in a game, virtual time on a manual clock.
]]
function Clock.now(): number
	return if manual then virtualNow else osClock()
end

--[[
Unix time in seconds, for dates and countdowns shared between players: `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()` in a game,
`2026-01-01T00:00:00Z + now()` on a manual clock.
]]
function Clock.wall(): number
	if manual then
		return EPOCH + virtualNow
	end
	return if IS_ROBLOX and workspace ~= nil then workspace:GetServerTimeNow() else os.time()
end

local function pack(...: any): { any }?
	if select("#", ...) == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local packed: { any } = table.pack(...)
	return packed
end

--[[
Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) after `seconds`, like `task.delay`. Returns the thread, for `cancel`.
]]
function Clock.delay<A...>(seconds: number?, fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread
	if not manual then
		if engineTask == nil or engineTask.delay == nil then
			error("Clock.delay requires a task scheduler or Clock.manual(true)", 2)
		end
		return engineTask.delay(seconds, fn, ...)
	end
	local thread = toThread(fn)
	scheduleTimer(seconds, thread, nil, pack(...))
	return thread
end

--[[
Yields the running thread for `seconds` (default: one frame), like `task.wait`, and returns the time it waited. On a
manual clock it waits for a `step` to pass the deadline, so it needs a coroutine to yield.
]]
function Clock.wait(seconds: number?): number
	if not manual then
		if engineTask == nil or engineTask.wait == nil then
			error("Clock.wait requires a task scheduler or Clock.manual(true)", 2)
		end
		return engineTask.wait(seconds)
	end
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	if not canWait() then
		error("Clock.wait on a manual clock needs a yieldable coroutine; run it in a thread a step can resume", 2)
	end
	scheduleTimer(seconds, thread, virtualNow, nil)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

--[[
Runs `fn(...)` (or resumes a thread) once the current work finishes, like `task.defer`. On a manual clock it waits for
`drain()` (which every `step` frame calls). Returns the thread, for `cancel`.
]]
function Clock.defer<A...>(fn: ((A...) -> ...any) | thread, ...: A...): thread
	if not manual then
		if engineTask ~= nil and engineTask.defer ~= nil then
			return engineTask.defer(fn, ...)
		end
		local thread = toThread(fn)
		resume(thread, ...)
		return thread
	end
	local thread = toThread(fn)
	local prior = deferredOf[thread]
	if prior then
		prior.cancelled = true
		prior.args = nil
	end
	local priorTimer = timerOf[thread]
	if priorTimer then
		priorTimer.cancelled = true
		priorTimer.args = nil
		timerOf[thread] = nil
	end
	local entry: Deferred = { thread = thread, args = pack(...) }
	deferredOf[thread] = entry
	tail += 1
	queue[tail] = entry
	return thread
end

--[[
Cancels a thread from `delay`, `defer` or a `wait`, like `task.cancel`.
]]
function Clock.cancel(thread: thread)
	if not manual then
		if engineTask ~= nil and engineTask.cancel ~= nil then
			engineTask.cancel(thread)
		elseif coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
			coroutine.close(thread)
		end
		return
	end
	local timer = timerOf[thread]
	if timer then
		timer.cancelled = true
		timer.args = nil
		timerOf[thread] = nil
	end
	local entry = deferredOf[thread]
	if entry then
		entry.cancelled = true
		entry.args = nil
		deferredOf[thread] = nil
	end
	if IS_ROBLOX and engineTask ~= nil and engineTask.cancel ~= nil then
		if coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
			engineTask.cancel(thread)
		end
	elseif coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
		coroutine.close(thread)
	end
end

--[[
Calls `fn(dt)` every frame at `phase` ("PreRender", "RenderStepped" or "Heartbeat"). Returns a function that
disconnects it. A manual clock calls it from `step` instead of the engine's frames.
]]
function Clock.connect(phase: Phase, fn: (dt: number) -> ()): () -> ()
	local list = if phase == "Heartbeat"
		then heartbeat
		elseif phase == "PreRender" or phase == "RenderStepped" then render
		else error(`Clock.connect: unknown phase "{phase}" (PreRender, RenderStepped or Heartbeat)`, 2)
	if not manual then
		if RunService == nil then
			error("Clock.connect requires Roblox RunService or Clock.manual(true)", 2)
		end
		local entry: Subscriber = {
			fn = fn,
			active = true,
			live = true,
			conn = nil,
		}
		entry.conn = RunService[phase]:Connect(function(dt: number)
			if not manual and entry.active then
				fn(dt)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(list, entry)
		return function()
			if not entry.active then
				return
			end
			entry.active = false
			if entry.conn ~= nil then
				entry.conn:Disconnect()
				entry.conn = nil
			end
			local index = table.find(list, entry)
			if index then
				table.remove(list, index)
			end
		end
	end
	local entry: Subscriber = {
		fn = fn,
		active = true,
		live = false,
		conn = nil,
	}
	table.insert(list, entry)
	return function()
		if not entry.active then
			return
		end
		entry.active = false
		local index = table.find(list, entry)
		if index then
			table.remove(list, index)
		end
	end
end

--[[
Toggles manual clock mode for deterministic tests (defaults to `false` live mode in Roblox and `true` outside Roblox).
Disabling manual mode clears pending tasks via `Clock.reset()`.
]]
function Clock.manual(on: boolean)
	if on == manual then
		return
	end
	if on then
		virtualNow = math.max(virtualNow, osClock())
		manual = true
	else
		Clock.reset()
		manual = false
	end
end

--[[
Tests only: whether the clock is manual.
]]
function Clock.isManual(): boolean
	return manual
end

--[[
Tests only: runs deferred work until none is left, including work it defers in turn. Errors after 10000 calls, when
deferred work keeps deferring more.
]]
function Clock.drain()
	local count = 0
	while head <= tail do
		count += 1
		if count > DRAIN_LIMIT then
			table.clear(queue)
			table.clear(deferredOf)
			head, tail = 1, 0
			error(`Clock.drain: deferred work did not settle after {DRAIN_LIMIT} calls`, 2)
		end
		local entry = queue[head]
		queue[head] = nil
		head += 1
		if not entry.cancelled then
			if deferredOf[entry.thread] == entry then
				deferredOf[entry.thread] = nil
			end
			resumeArgs(entry.thread, entry.args)
		end
	end
	head, tail = 1, 0
end

local function runFrame(dt: number)
	local last = seq
	local tol = math.max(EPSILON, math.abs(virtualNow) * 1e-12)
	local deferredNext: { Timer }? = nil
	while heap[1] ~= nil and heap[1].due <= virtualNow + tol do
		local timer = pop()
		if timer.cancelled then
			continue
		end
		if timer.seq > last then
			if deferredNext == nil then
				deferredNext = { timer }
			else
				table.insert(deferredNext :: { Timer }, timer)
			end
			continue
		end
		if timerOf[timer.thread] == timer then
			timerOf[timer.thread] = nil
		end
		if timer.start then
			resume(timer.thread, virtualNow - timer.start)
		else
			resumeArgs(timer.thread, timer.args)
		end
	end
	if deferredNext ~= nil then
		for _, timer in deferredNext do
			if not timer.cancelled then
				push(timer)
			end
		end
	end
	Clock.drain()
	if #render > 0 then
		for _, subscriber in table.clone(render) do
			if subscriber.active then
				subscriber.fn(dt)
			end
		end
		Clock.drain()
	end
	if frameHook then
		frameHook(dt)
		Clock.drain()
	end
	if #heartbeat > 0 then
		for _, subscriber in table.clone(heartbeat) do
			if subscriber.active then
				subscriber.fn(dt)
			end
		end
		Clock.drain()
	end
end

--[[
Tests only: advances a manual clock by `seconds`, in frames of at most `frameLength` seconds (default 1/60). `step(0)`
runs one frame of zero length: due timers, subscribers, a Flux step and the deferred work.
]]
function Clock.step(seconds: number, frameLength: number?)
	if not manual then
		error("Clock.step needs a manual clock; call Clock.manual(true) first", 2)
	elseif stepping then
		error("Clock.step cannot be called re-entrantly", 2)
	end
	local length = if frameLength == nil then 1 / 60 else frameLength
	assert(
		type(seconds) == "number" and seconds >= 0 and seconds < math.huge,
		"Clock.step: seconds must be a finite non-negative number"
	)
	assert(
		type(length) == "number" and length > 0 and length < math.huge,
		"Clock.step: the frame length must be a finite positive number"
	)
	local start = virtualNow
	local frames = math.max(math.ceil(seconds / length - EPSILON), 1)
	stepping = true
	local ok, err = (pcall :: (any) -> (boolean, any))(function()
		for index = 1, frames do
			if not manual then
				break
			end
			local target = if index == frames then start + seconds else start + index * length
			local dt = if index < frames then length else math.max(seconds - (frames - 1) * length, 0)
			virtualNow = target
			runFrame(dt)
		end
	end)
	stepping = false
	if not ok then
		error(err, 0)
	end
end

local function pruneManualSubscribers(list: { Subscriber })
	local writeIdx = 1
	for readIdx = 1, #list do
		local entry = list[readIdx]
		if entry.live and entry.active then
			if writeIdx ~= readIdx then
				list[writeIdx] = entry
			end
			writeIdx += 1
		else
			entry.active = false
		end
	end
	for i = writeIdx, #list do
		list[i] = nil
	end
end

--[[
Tests only: drops every pending timer, `wait`, deferred call and manual subscriber. `now` keeps its value.
]]
function Clock.reset()
	table.clear(heap)
	table.clear(timerOf)
	table.clear(queue)
	table.clear(deferredOf)
	head, tail = 1, 0
	pruneManualSubscribers(render)
	pruneManualSubscribers(heartbeat)
end

-- Internal, not part of `Flux.Clock`: init.luau installs the Flux frame step, Compat routes errors through its `warn`
-- and runs its headless `task.spawn` through `resume`.
--- @ignore
Clock._internal = table.freeze({
	setFrame = function(fn: ((dt: number) -> ())?)
		frameHook = fn
	end,
	setReport = function(fn: (message: string) -> ())
		report = fn
	end,
	spawn = function(fnOrThread: any, ...: any): thread
		if (IS_ROBLOX or not manual) and engineTask ~= nil and engineTask.spawn ~= nil then
			return engineTask.spawn(fnOrThread, ...)
		end
		local thread = toThread(fnOrThread)
		resume(thread, ...)
		return thread
	end,
})

return table.freeze(Clock)
