-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — Economy (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- Owns all player state: Bubbles, owned critters, upgrades, rebirths,
-- quests, index, locks. DataStore guarded with pcall everywhere so a
-- save/load failure can never break the game.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local Economy = {}
local states = {}
local feverUntil = 0
local store = nil
pcall(function()
	store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("DSD2_PlayerData_v1")
end)

local function defaultState()
	return {
		Bubbles = 0,
		TotalEarned = 0,
		EarnedSinceRebirth = 0,
		Collected = 0,
		Index = {}, -- [index] = true
		IndexCount = 0,
		Owned = {}, -- {id, index, mutation, income}
		Upgrades = { fins = 0, net = 0, amp = 0, lure = 0 },
		Rebirths = 0,
		Quests = {}, -- [id] = {claimed = bool}
		LockUntil = 0,
		LockCooldownUntil = 0,
		StealCooldownUntil = 0,
	}
end

function Economy.getState(player)
	local s = states[player]
	if not s then
		s = defaultState()
		states[player] = s
	end
	return s
end

function Economy.setFever(untilTime)
	feverUntil = untilTime
end

function Economy.isFever()
	return os.clock() < feverUntil
end

function Economy.feverRemaining()
	return math.max(0, feverUntil - os.clock())
end

function Economy.carrySlots(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	return Config.CARRY_BASE + (s.Upgrades.net or 0)
end

function Economy.walkSpeed(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	return 16 + 4 * (s.Upgrades.fins or 0)
end

function Economy.mutationLuck(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	return 1 + 0.25 * (s.Upgrades.lure or 0)
end

function Economy.incomePerSecond(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	local base = 0
	for _, c in ipairs(s.Owned) do
		base += c.income
	end
	local mult = 1
	mult *= 1 + 0.10 * (s.Upgrades.amp or 0)
	mult *= 1 + Config.INDEX_BONUS_PER_CRITTER * s.IndexCount
	mult *= 1 + Config.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER * s.Rebirths
	if Economy.isFever() then
		mult *= 2
	end
	return math.floor(base * mult + 0.5)
end

function Economy.addBubbles(player, amount)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	s.Bubbles += amount
	if amount > 0 then
		s.TotalEarned += amount
		s.EarnedSinceRebirth += amount
	end
end

-- Adds a critter to the player's owned list (called on deposit).
-- Returns the owned entry, or nil if the player already owns 12.
function Economy.addOwned(player, index, mutation, income)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	if #s.Owned >= Config.MAX_PEDESTALS then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		index = index,
		mutation = mutation or "",
		income = income,
	}
	table.insert(s.Owned, entry)
	s.Collected += 1
	if not s.Index[index] then
		s.Index[index] = true
		s.IndexCount += 1
	end
	return entry
end

function Economy.removeOwned(player, id)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	for i, c in ipairs(s.Owned) do
		if c.id == id then
			table.remove(s.Owned, i)
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Economy.hasLegendary(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	for _, c in ipairs(s.Owned) do
		if Config.tierOf(c.index) >= 5 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Economy.questProgress(player, quest)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	if quest.kind == "collect" then
		return math.min(s.Collected, quest.target)
	elseif quest.kind == "earn" then
		return math.min(s.TotalEarned, quest.target)
	elseif quest.kind == "legendary" then
		return Economy.hasLegendary(player) and 1 or 0
	end
	return 0
end

function Economy.snapshot(player)
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	local owned = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(s.Owned) do
		table.insert(owned, { id = c.id, index = c.index, mutation = c.mutation, income = c.income })
	end
	local quests = {}
	for _, q in ipairs(Config.QUESTS) do
		local qstate = s.Quests[q.id] or {}
		table.insert(quests, {
			id = q.id,
			name = q.name,
			target = q.target,
			reward = q.reward,
			progress = Economy.questProgress(player, q),
			claimed = qstate.claimed == true,
		})
	end
	return {
		bubbles = s.Bubbles,
		perSecond = Economy.incomePerSecond(player),
		indexCount = s.IndexCount,
		indexTotal = #Config.CRITTERS,
		owned = owned,
		upgrades = s.Upgrades,
		rebirths = s.Rebirths,
		quests = quests,
		lockUntil = s.LockUntil,
		lockCooldownUntil = s.LockCooldownUntil,
		lockRemaining = math.max(0, s.LockUntil - os.clock()),
		lockCooldownRemaining = math.max(0, s.LockCooldownUntil - os.clock()),
		feverRemaining = Economy.feverRemaining(),
		canRebirth = s.EarnedSinceRebirth >= Config.REBIRTH_REQUIRE_EARNED and s.Rebirths < Config.REBIRTH_MAX,
		rebirthProgress = math.min(s.EarnedSinceRebirth, Config.REBIRTH_REQUIRE_EARNED),
		rebirthTarget = Config.REBIRTH_REQUIRE_EARNED,
	}
end

function Economy.save(player)
	local s = states[player]
	if not s or not store then
		return
	end
	local data = {
		Bubbles = s.Bubbles,
		TotalEarned = s.TotalEarned,
		EarnedSinceRebirth = s.EarnedSinceRebirth,
		Collected = s.Collected,
		Index = s.Index,
		Owned = s.Owned,
		Upgrades = s.Upgrades,
		Rebirths = s.Rebirths,
		Quests = s.Quests,
	}
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. tostring(player.UserId), data)
	end)
end

function Economy.load(player)
	if not store then
		return
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("player_" .. tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local s = Economy.getState(player)
	if type(data.Bubbles) == "number" then s.Bubbles = data.Bubbles end
	if type(data.TotalEarned) == "number" then s.TotalEarned = data.TotalEarned end
	if type(data.EarnedSinceRebirth) == "number" then s.EarnedSinceRebirth = data.EarnedSinceRebirth end
	if type(data.Collected) == "number" then s.Collected = data.Collected end
	if type(data.Rebirths) == "number" then s.Rebirths = data.Rebirths end
	if type(data.Index) == "table" then
		s.Index = data.Index
		local count = 0
		for _ in pairs(s.Index) do count += 1 end
		s.IndexCount = count
	end
	if type(data.Owned) == "table" then s.Owned = data.Owned end
	if type(data.Upgrades) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(data.Upgrades) do
			if s.Upgrades[k] ~= nil and type(v) == "number" then
				s.Upgrades[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	if type(data.Quests) == "table" then s.Quests = data.Quests end
end

-- Income tick + autosave. Runs on the server only.
function Economy.start(stateRemote)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local perSecond = Economy.incomePerSecond(player)
				if perSecond > 0 then
					Economy.addBubbles(player, perSecond)
				end
				stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
			end
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(60)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				Economy.save(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function Economy.clearOnLeave(player)
	Economy.save(player)
	states[player] = nil
end

-- BountyService.luau
-- Twelve bounties with doubloon rewards. Progress is counted by the services
-- that own each action; this module owns the table, the list, and completion.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)
local BootyCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))

local BountyService = {}

-- The twelve bounties. Fields: id, kind, target, text, reward (doubloons).
BountyService.BOUNTIES = {
	{ id = "buy1", kind = "buy", target = 1, text = "Buy your first brainrot", reward = 100 },
	{ id = "buy5", kind = "buy", target = 5, text = "Buy 5 brainrots", reward = 500 },
	{ id = "ownEpic", kind = "ownEpic", target = 1, text = "Own an EPIC or better", reward = 1000 },
	{ id = "ownMythic", kind = "ownMythic", target = 1, text = "Own a MYTHIC or better", reward = 5000 },
	{ id = "steal1", kind = "steal", target = 1, text = "Steal a brainrot", reward = 1500 },
	{ id = "steal3", kind = "steal", target = 3, text = "Steal 3 brainrots", reward = 5000 },
	{ id = "lock1", kind = "lock", target = 1, text = "Lock your deck", reward = 800 },
	{ id = "survive1", kind = "survive", target = 1, text = "Survive a Kraken Surge", reward = 2000 },
	{ id = "rebirth1", kind = "rebirth", target = 1, text = "Rebirth once", reward = 10000 },
	{ id = "index10", kind = "index", target = 10, text = "Find 10 brainrots in the Log", reward = 2000 },
	{ id = "index25", kind = "index", target = 25, text = "Find 25 brainrots in the Log", reward = 10000 },
	{ id = "upgrade3", kind = "upgrades", target = 3, text = "Buy 3 upgrades", reward = 1500 },
}

-- Returns the 1-based index of a rarity name in the rarity ladder, or 0.
local function rarityIndex(rarityName)
	for index, name in ipairs(BootyCatalog.RARITY_ORDER) do
		if name == rarityName then
			return index
		end
	end
	return 0
end

-- Computes the progress for one bounty kind for a player.
-- index -> found count; ownEpic / ownMythic -> owned-rarity check;
-- every other kind -> the player's counter for that kind.
local function progressForKind(player, kind)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	if kind == "index" then
		return PirateState.getFoundCount(player)
	end
	if kind == "ownEpic" or kind == "ownMythic" then
		return BountyService.countOwnedRarity(player, kind)
	end
	local counters = state.bounties
	if not counters then
		return 0
	end
	return counters[kind] or 0
end

-- Returns 1 if any brainrot on the player's deck has a rarity index at or
-- above the wanted index (EPIC = 3 for ownEpic, MYTHIC = 5 for ownMythic),
-- else 0. Returns 0 if the player has no state.
function BountyService.countOwnedRarity(player, kind)
	local wantedIndex = 0
	if kind == "ownEpic" then
		wantedIndex = 3
	elseif kind == "ownMythic" then
		wantedIndex = 5
	else
		return 0
	end
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
		if slot and slot.defId then
			local def = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(slot.defId)
			if def and def.rarity then
				if rarityIndex(def.rarity) >= wantedIndex then
					return 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return 0
end

-- Returns the bounty list for a player: one entry per bounty with id, text,
-- target, reward, current progress, and whether it is done.
function BountyService.getBountyList(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	local doneSet = state and state.bountiesDone or {}
	local list = {}
	for _, bounty in ipairs(BountyService.BOUNTIES) do
		table.insert(list, {
			id = bounty.id,
			text = bounty.text,
			target = bounty.target,
			reward = bounty.reward,
			progress = progressForKind(player, bounty.kind),
			done = doneSet[bounty.id] == true,
		})
	end
	return list
end

-- Checks every bounty that is not yet done. When a bounty's progress reaches
-- its target, it is marked done, the reward is paid into cash at once, a
-- bounty message is broadcast, and the refreshed bounty list is broadcast.
function BountyService.checkBountyCompletion(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if not state.bountiesDone then
		state.bountiesDone = {}
	end
	local changed = false
	for _, bounty in ipairs(BountyService.BOUNTIES) do
		if state.bountiesDone[bounty.id] ~= true then
			local progress = progressForKind(player, bounty.kind)
			if progress >= bounty.target then
				state.bountiesDone[bounty.id] = true
				changed = true
				PirateState.addCash(player, bounty.reward)
				PirateState.broadcast(player, {
					type = "bounty",
					text = "BOUNTY DONE: " .. bounty.text .. " +" .. BootyCatalog.formatMoney(bounty.reward),
					reward = bounty.reward,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	if changed then
		PirateState.broadcast(player, {
			type = "bounties",
			list = BountyService.getBountyList(player),
		})
	end
end

-- Adds amount (default 1) to the player's counter for a kind, then checks
-- whether any bounty completed.
function BountyService.addBountyProgress(player, kind, amount)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if not state.bounties then
		state.bounties = {}
	end
	local add = amount or 1
	state.bounties[kind] = (state.bounties[kind] or 0) + add
	BountyService.checkBountyCompletion(player)
end

return BountyService

-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
-- ConveyorSpawner.luau — the Sabuk Brainrot: every SPAWN_INTERVAL_S a
-- brainrot appears at the west end of the belt, walks east at BELT_SPEED,
-- and despawns at the east end if nobody buys it. Buying is a ProximityPrompt
-- (hold E 0.5 s, or tap on mobile); the buy itself lives in CarryAndPlace,
-- wired in by init.server.luau as ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler.

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local BrainrotData = require(Shared.BrainrotData)
local BrainrotFactory = require(script.Parent.BrainrotFactory)

local ConveyorSpawner = {}

-- Set by init.server.luau: function(player, model) — the buy.
ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler = nil

local beltModels = {} -- [Model] = true while it walks the belt
local nextSpawnAt = 0

-- FIX #4: gentle walk bob (±0.15 stud) + sway (±5°) so the belt feels alive.
local function faceEast(model, x)
	if not model or not model.PrimaryPart then
		return
	end
	local size = model:GetAttribute("BodySize") or 2
	local bob = math.sin(os.clock() * 5 + x * 0.3) * 0.15
	local sway = math.sin(os.clock() * 2 + x * 0.2) * 5
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, Config.BELT_Y + size / 2 + bob, Config.BELT_Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90 + sway), 0))
end

function ConveyorSpawner.isOnBelt(model)
	return beltModels[model] == true
end

function ConveyorSpawner.getNextSpawnIn()
	return math.max(0, nextSpawnAt - os.clock())
end

function ConveyorSpawner.getBeltCount()
	local count = 0
	for _, _ in pairs(beltModels) do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

-- Walks one model along the belt until it is bought, returned, or reaches
-- the east end (then it despawns).
local function walkBelt(model)
	task.spawn(function()
		while model.Parent and beltModels[model] do
			-- FIX #2: GetPivot throw bila model dihancurkan antar-tick —
			-- tangkap, jangan matikan thread jalan ini.
			local pivotOk, pivot = pcall(function()
				return model:GetPivot()
			end)
			if not pivotOk then
				return
			end
			local x = pivot.Position.X + Config.BELT_SPEED * 0.1
			if x >= Config.BELT_END_X then
				ConveyorSpawner.removeFromBelt(model)
				model:Destroy()
				return
			end
			-- FIX #2: satu langkah jalan yang throw (mis. model hancur di
			-- tengah jalan) tidak boleh mematikan thread jalan ini.
			local ok, err = pcall(faceEast, model, x)
			if not ok then
				warn("[PasarBrainrot] walkBelt gagal: " .. tostring(err))
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

function ConveyorSpawner.spawnNextBrainrot(startX)
	-- FIX #4: belt cap — never more than BELT_MAX_MODELS walking at once.
	if ConveyorSpawner.getBeltCount() >= (Config.BELT_MAX_MODELS or 7) then
		return nil
	end
	local row = BrainrotData.rollCharacter()
	local mutation = BrainrotFactory.rollMutation()
	-- FIX #2: satu roll/model yang gagal build tidak boleh melempar ke
	-- pemanggil (start() / loop timer) — kembalikan nil saja.
	local ok, model = pcall(BrainrotFactory.buildBrainrotModel, row, mutation)
	if not ok or typeof(model) ~= "Instance" or not model.PrimaryPart then
		warn("[PasarBrainrot] buildBrainrotModel gagal: " .. tostring(model))
		return nil
	end
	model.Parent = workspace

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Beli"
	prompt.ObjectText = model.Name .. " — $" .. tostring(model:GetAttribute("Price"))
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler then
			ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler(player, model)
		end
	end)

	beltModels[model] = true
	faceEast(model, startX or Config.BELT_START_X)
	walkBelt(model)
	return model
end

-- A dropped or stolen brainrot goes back to the west end and walks again.
function ConveyorSpawner.returnToBelt(model)
	if not model.Parent then
		return
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = true
		end
	end
	local primary = model.PrimaryPart
	if not primary then
		return
	end
	local prompt = primary:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Beli"
		prompt.ObjectText = model.Name .. " — $" .. tostring(model:GetAttribute("Price"))
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
		prompt.Parent = model.PrimaryPart
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler then
				ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler(player, model)
			end
		end)
	end
	prompt.Enabled = true
	beltModels[model] = true
	faceEast(model, Config.BELT_START_X)
	walkBelt(model)
end

function ConveyorSpawner.removeFromBelt(model)
	beltModels[model] = nil
	local prompt = model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if prompt then
		prompt.Enabled = false
	end
end

function ConveyorSpawner.start()
	-- FIX #4: six brainrots are ON the belt the moment the server starts
	-- (spaced 10 studs apart — a 7.0-stud Mythic body never overlaps its
	-- neighbour), so the first player never joins to an empty belt.
	-- FIX #2: tiap spawn awal dalam pcall sendiri — satu roll gagal tidak
	-- boleh membatalkan spawn lainnya atau mematikan init.
	for _, offset in ipairs(Config.INITIAL_SPAWN_OFFSETS or { 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 }) do
		local ok, err = pcall(ConveyorSpawner.spawnNextBrainrot, Config.BELT_START_X + offset)
		if not ok then
			warn("[PasarBrainrot] spawn awal gagal: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	nextSpawnAt = os.clock() + Config.SPAWN_INTERVAL_S
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local waitFor = nextSpawnAt - os.clock()
			if waitFor > 0 then
				task.wait(waitFor)
			end
			nextSpawnAt = os.clock() + Config.SPAWN_INTERVAL_S
			-- FIX #2: satu spawn yang throw tidak boleh membunuh loop
			-- timer selamanya — spawn berikutnya tetap jalan 6 dtk lagi.
			local ok, err = pcall(ConveyorSpawner.spawnNextBrainrot)
			if not ok then
				warn("[PasarBrainrot] spawn timer gagal: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
end

return ConveyorSpawner

--!strict
local Clock = require("./Clock")

local IS_ROBLOX = game ~= nil

type Task = {
	spawn: (fnOrThread: any, ...any) -> thread,
	defer: (fnOrThread: any, ...any) -> thread,
	delay: (seconds: number?, fnOrThread: any, ...any) -> thread,
	wait: (seconds: number?) -> number,
	cancel: (thread: thread) -> (),
}

type Compat = {
	isRoblox: boolean,
	traceback: (err: any, level: number?) -> any,
	warn: (...any) -> (),
	setWarnHook: (hook: ((message: string) -> ())?) -> (),
	task: Task,
	clock: () -> number,
	typeof: (value: any) -> string,
	getService: (name: string) -> any,
	requireRoblox: (name: string) -> (),
	robloxStubs: (prefix: string, names: { string }) -> { [string]: any },
	services: { [string]: any },
	Instance: any,
	Color3: typeof(Color3),
	UDim: typeof(UDim),
	UDim2: typeof(UDim2),
	Vector2: typeof(Vector2),
	Vector3: typeof(Vector3),
	CFrame: typeof(CFrame),
	Rect: typeof(Rect),
	NumberRange: typeof(NumberRange),
	Font: typeof(Font),
	TweenInfo: typeof(TweenInfo),
	Enum: typeof(Enum),
	ColorSequence: typeof(ColorSequence),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint: typeof(ColorSequenceKeypoint),
	NumberSequence: typeof(NumberSequence),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint: typeof(NumberSequenceKeypoint),
}

local rawWarn: (...any) -> () = warn or print
local warnHook: ((message: string) -> ())? = nil

local function warn(...: any)
	local hook = warnHook
	if hook then
		local parts: any = table.pack(...)
		for i = 1, parts.n do
			parts[i] = tostring(parts[i])
		end
		hook(table.concat(parts, " ", 1, parts.n))
		return
	end
	rawWarn(...)
end

local function setWarnHook(hook: ((message: string) -> ())?)
	warnHook = hook
end

local function traceback(err: any, level: number?): any
	return if type(err) == "string" then debug.traceback(err, level) else err
end

Clock._internal.setReport(warn)

local compatTask: any = table.freeze({
	spawn = Clock._internal.spawn,
	defer = Clock.defer,
	delay = Clock.delay,
	wait = Clock.wait,
	cancel = Clock.cancel,
})

local Compat: any = {
	isRoblox = IS_ROBLOX,
	traceback = traceback,
	warn = warn,
	setWarnHook = setWarnHook,
	task = compatTask,
	clock = Clock.now,
	typeof = typeof,
	services = if IS_ROBLOX
		then setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(self: { [string]: any }, name: string): any
				local getService: (DataModel, string) -> Instance = game.GetService
				local ok, service = pcall(getService, game, name)
				if ok and service ~= nil then
					self[name] = service
					return service
				end
				return nil
			end,
		})
		else {} :: { [string]: any },
	Instance = if IS_ROBLOX then Instance else nil,
	Color3 = Color3,
	UDim = UDim,
	UDim2 = UDim2,
	Vector2 = Vector2,
	Vector3 = Vector3,
	CFrame = CFrame,
	Rect = Rect,
	NumberRange = NumberRange,
	Font = Font,
	TweenInfo = TweenInfo,
	Enum = Enum,
	ColorSequence = ColorSequence,
	ColorSequenceKeypoint = ColorSequenceKeypoint,
	NumberSequence = NumberSequence,
	NumberSequenceKeypoint = NumberSequenceKeypoint,
}

function Compat.getService(name: string): any
	return Compat.services[name]
end

function Compat.requireRoblox(name: string)
	if Compat.Instance == nil then
		error(`{name} requires a Roblox environment`, 3)
	end
end

function Compat.robloxStubs(prefix: string, names: { string }): { [string]: any }
	local stubs: { [string]: any } = {}
	for _, name in names do
		local message = `{prefix}.{name} requires a Roblox environment`
		stubs[name] = function()
			error(message, 2)
		end
	end
	return table.freeze(stubs)
end

if IS_ROBLOX then
	table.freeze(Compat)
end

return Compat :: Compat

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

	banner("DISCO FEVER!", "2x money for 45 seconds", Config.PALETTE.Coral)
end

local function buildCrab()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "NetNabber"
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = Vector3.new(3.4, 1.4, 2.6)
	body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 80)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	body.Anchored = true
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	body.Parent = model
	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local eye = Instance.new("Part")
		eye.Name = "Eye"
		eye.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
		eye.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		eye.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		eye.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		eye.Anchored = true
		eye.CanCollide = false
		eye.Position = Vector3.new(side * 0.6, 1.9, 1.2)
		eye.Parent = model
		local claw = Instance.new("Part")
		claw.Name = "Claw"
		claw.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
		claw.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)
		claw.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		claw.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		claw.Anchored = true
		claw.CanCollide = false
		claw.Position = Vector3.new(side * 2.0, 1.0, 0.8)
		claw.Parent = model
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

local function netNabber()
	-- Pick a random unlocked base with at least one critter.
	local candidates = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if not Bases.isLocked(player) then
			local plot = Bases.getPlot(player)
			if plot then
				for _, ped in ipairs(plot.pedestals) do
					if ped.model then
						table.insert(candidates, { player = player, plot = plot, ped = ped })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return
	end
	local target = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local victim = target.player
	local stolen = target.ped.model
	Economy.removeOwned(victim, target.ped.ownedId)
	target.ped.model = nil
	target.ped.ownedId = nil
	stolen:SetAttribute("OnPedestal", false)

	local crab = buildCrab()
	crab:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.plot.position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)))
	crab.Parent = world
	banner("NET NABBER!", "A thief crab stole a critter — TAG it to make it drop!", Config.PALETTE.Coral)
	if juice then
		juice:FireClient(victim, "steal", stolen.Position)
	end

	-- Crab carries the critter above its head and scuttles to the portal.
	stolen:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target.plot.position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)))
	stolen.Parent = world
	local startPos = crab.PrimaryPart.Position
	local portalPos = Vector3.new(0, 1, -95)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local duration = 25
	local dropped = false
	local conn
	conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local t = math.min((os.clock() - startTime) / duration, 1)
		local pos = startPos:Lerp(portalPos, t)
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, 1.2 + math.sin(os.clock() * 8) * 0.15, pos.Z)
		crab:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
		if stolen.Parent then
			stolen:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)))
		end
		if t >= 1 and not dropped then
			dropped = true
			conn:Disconnect()
			crab:Destroy()
			if stolen.Parent then
				stolen:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
	-- Tag the crab: touch drops the critter as a free pickup.
	local tagConn
	tagConn = crab.PrimaryPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local char = hit.Parent
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
		if not player then
			return
		end
		if dropped then
			return
		end
		dropped = true
		conn:Disconnect()
		tagConn:Disconnect()
		crab:Destroy()
		if stolen.Parent then
			stolen:PivotTo(CFrame.new(crab.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)))
			stolen:SetAttribute("OnConveyor", true)
			Bases.armTouch(stolen)
		end
		banner("CRAB TAGGED!", player.DisplayName .. " saved the critter!", Config.PALETTE.Lime)
	end)
	task.delay(duration + 1, function()
		if conn.Connected then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		if tagConn.Connected then
			tagConn:Disconnect()
		end
		if crab.Parent then
			crab:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function buildShark()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Shark"
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 7)
	body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 170)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	body.Anchored = true
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Position = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	body.Parent = model
	local fin = Instance.new("Part")
	fin.Name = "Fin"
	fin.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 1.6, 1.6)
	fin.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 140)
	fin.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	fin.Shape = Enum.PartType.Wedge
	fin.Anchored = true
	fin.CanCollide = false
	fin.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5.6, 0)
	fin.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	return model
end

local function sharkSweep()
	local shark = buildShark()
	local z = math.random(-50, 50)
	local startPos = Vector3.new(-90, 4, z)
	local endPos = Vector3.new(90, 4, z)
	shark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPos))
	shark.Parent = world
	banner("SHARK SWEEP!", "A shark is crossing the floor — get out of the way!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local duration = 12
	local conn
	conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local t = math.min((os.clock() - startTime) / duration, 1)
		local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
		shark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
		-- Knock players close to the shark.
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local char = player.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude < 9 then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 18, 0) + (root.Position - pos).Unit * 22
				if juice then
					juice:FireClient(player, "hurt")
				end
			end
		end
		if t >= 1 then
			conn:Disconnect()
			shark:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	task.delay(duration + 1, function()
		if conn.Connected then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		if shark.Parent then
			shark:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function goDark()
	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local oldAmbient = lighting.Ambient
	local oldBrightness = lighting.Brightness
	lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 15)
	lighting.Brightness = 0.4
	-- All bases lock while the lights are out: nobody can steal.
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local s = Economy.getState(player)
		s.LockUntil = math.max(s.LockUntil, os.clock() + DARK_DURATION)
	end
	banner("GO DARK!", "Lights out for 20 seconds — all bases locked", Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 160))
	task.delay(DARK_DURATION, function()
		lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient
		lighting.Brightness = oldBrightness
	end)
end

function Events.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(45)
		while true do
			discoFever()
			task.wait(FEVER_EVERY)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(90)
		while true do
			netNabber()
			task.wait(NABBER_EVERY)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(130)
		while true do
			sharkSweep()
			task.wait(SHARK_EVERY)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(180)
		while true do
			goDark()
			task.wait(DARK_EVERY)
		end
	end)
end

return Events

-- DoubloonService: every brainrot on a deck earns doubloons every second.
-- The per-second value already includes the rebirth multiplier, the income
-- upgrade and the Golden Tide x2, so the payout is just that value.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)

local DoubloonService = {}

function DoubloonService.startIncomeLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local perSecond = PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player)
				if perSecond > 0 then
					PirateState.addCash(player, perSecond)
					PirateState.broadcast(player, { type = "tick", amount = perSecond })
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return DoubloonService

-- Main.server.luau — bootstrap only: creates the RemoteEvents and the
-- ServerStatus diagnostic FIRST, then requires every system module inside
-- pcall, wires them together, assigns each joining player a corner base,
-- hides the default name tags, then starts every system.
--
-- FIX #3 (18 Nov 2026): the old init.server.luau DIED AT REQUIRE TIME.
-- Rojo turns a folder holding init.server.luau into a Script named after
-- the folder, so ServerScriptService.Server WAS the init script itself —
-- and its `require(script.Parent.PlayerState)` looked for PlayerState
-- under ServerScriptService, where it does not exist. The very first
-- require threw, the script died before the Remotes folder existed, and
-- no MoneyUpdate ever reached any client (empty belt, "Menunggu server..."
-- forever). The fix: this file is Main.server.luau, so the Server folder
-- stays a Folder, Main is a normal Script inside it, and script.Parent is
-- the folder holding every module. Remotes + ServerStatus are now created
-- BEFORE any require, every require is pcall-wrapped, and a 5 s heartbeat
-- keeps ServerStatus fresh so the client's HUD line proves the server is
-- alive (or names the first error).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Remotes FIRST — before any require can fail. A client that finds this
-- folder knows the server script is at least alive.
local Remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
Remotes.Name = "Remotes"
Remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function makeRemote(name)
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = Remotes
	return remote
end

makeRemote("MoneyUpdate") -- server -> one client: cash, income, timers, lock, rebirth
makeRemote("WaveWarning") -- server -> all clients: tsunami warning seconds
makeRemote("ToastMessage") -- server -> one client: short message
makeRemote("SoundEvent") -- server -> one client: "buy" | "wave" | "steal" | "rebirth"
local requestLock = makeRemote("RequestLock") -- client -> server: lock my base
local requestRebirth = makeRemote("RequestRebirth") -- client -> server: rebirth now

-- ServerStatus: the one diagnostic the client can read. "OK ..." + a
-- heartbeat timestamp while the core loop is healthy; the FIRST
-- require/start error while it is broken. The client shows this line on
-- the HUD, so the next screenshot names the server's state.
local ServerStatus = Instance.new("StringValue")
ServerStatus.Name = "ServerStatus"
ServerStatus.Value = "BOOT: Remotes dibuat, memuat modul..."
ServerStatus.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local firstError = nil
local function setStatus(text)
	pcall(function()
		ServerStatus.Value = text
	end)
end
local function recordError(stage, err)
	warn("[PasarBrainrot] " .. stage .. " gagal: " .. tostring(err))
	if not firstError then
		firstError = stage .. ": " .. tostring(err)
	end
end

local function safeRequire(name, fn)
	local ok, mod = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		recordError("require " .. name, mod)
		return nil
	end
	return mod
end

-- Shared is part of the place file, so this returns at once; the 10 s
-- timeout only stops a hang if it ever failed to replicate.
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	recordError("require Shared", "ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end

local PlayerState = safeRequire("PlayerState", function()
	return require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
end)
local Config = nil
if Shared then
	Config = safeRequire("Config", function()
		return require(Shared.Config)
	end)
end
local ConveyorSpawner = safeRequire("ConveyorSpawner", function()
	return require(script.Parent.ConveyorSpawner)
end)
local CarryAndPlace = safeRequire("CarryAndPlace", function()
	return require(script.Parent.CarryAndPlace)
end)
local MoneyTick = safeRequire("MoneyTick", function()
	return require(script.Parent.MoneyTick)
end)
local StealAndLock = safeRequire("StealAndLock", function()
	return require(script.Parent.StealAndLock)
end)
local TsunamiEvent = safeRequire("TsunamiEvent", function()
	return require(script.Parent.TsunamiEvent)
end)
local ThiefBot = safeRequire("ThiefBot", function()
	return require(script.Parent.ThiefBot)
end)
local RebirthSystem = safeRequire("RebirthSystem", function()
	return require(script.Parent.RebirthSystem)
end)

-- Wire the shared Remotes folder into every module that toasts or plays sounds.
if CarryAndPlace then
	CarryAndPlace.Remotes = Remotes
end
if MoneyTick then
	MoneyTick.Remotes = Remotes
end
if StealAndLock then
	StealAndLock.Remotes = Remotes
end
if TsunamiEvent then
	TsunamiEvent.Remotes = Remotes
end
if RebirthSystem then
	RebirthSystem.Remotes = Remotes
end

-- The belt's buy prompt calls CarryAndPlace through this handler.
if ConveyorSpawner and CarryAndPlace then
	ConveyorSpawner.buyHandler = CarryAndPlace.buyBrainrot
end

requestLock.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if StealAndLock then
		StealAndLock.lockBaseForPlayer(player)
	end
end)

requestRebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if RebirthSystem then
		RebirthSystem.doRebirth(player)
	end
end)

-- Bases are assigned round-robin as players join (4 bases, shared if more).
local nextBase = 0
local function assignBase(player)
	nextBase = (nextBase % 4) + 1
	if PlayerState then
		PlayerState.initPlayer(player, nextBase)
	end
	local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn" .. tostring(nextBase))
	if spawn then
		player.RespawnLocation = spawn
	end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	task.wait(0.5)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		-- Hide the default name tag: only our own labels show.
		humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	-- FIX #3: one player's bad init must never kill the handler for the
	-- next player (or the whole bootstrap) — caught here, warned, counted.
	local ok, err = pcall(assignBase, player)
	if not ok then
		recordError("initPlayer " .. player.Name, err)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if CarryAndPlace then
		CarryAndPlace.dropCarried(player)
		CarryAndPlace.clearPlayerPedestals(player)
	end
	if PlayerState then
		PlayerState.removePlayer(player)
	end
end)

-- World signs: Rojo 7.7.1 cannot express UDim2 in default.project.json, so
-- the sign boards are parts in the project and their BillboardGui labels are
-- built here at runtime (board part name -> text, colour, billboard size).
local function buildWorldSigns()
	local signs = {
		-- Fix #6 (20 Nov 2026): the three big labels used to stack on top
		-- of each other from the play camera, so each now carries a world
		-- offset that puts it in its own lane: SABUK (conveyor) far west
		-- (-52, 3, 0), SABUK (beacon) high and south (0, 23, 10),
		-- PASAR BRAINROT far north on its wall (0, 7, -58),
		-- SUDUT MALING far south (0, 4, 56).
		{ part = "ConveyorSign", text = "SABUK BRAINROT", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51), size = UDim2.new(10, 0, 3, 0), offset = Vector3.new(-8, 0, 0) },
		-- FIX (17 Nov 2026): floating beacon label above the belt beam, so
		-- the belt reads from every spawn, even at 60 studs away.
		{ part = "BeltBeacon", text = "▼ SABUK BRAINROT ▼", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51), size = UDim2.new(26, 0, 4, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 8, 10) },
		{ part = "TitleSign", text = "PASAR BRAINROT", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51), size = UDim2.new(18, 0, 3, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) },
		{ part = "BaseSignRed", text = "BASE MERAH", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 89, 89), size = UDim2.new(10, 0, 2, 0) },
		{ part = "BaseSignBlue", text = "BASE BIRU", color = Color3.fromRGB(102, 166, 255), size = UDim2.new(10, 0, 2, 0) },
		{ part = "BaseSignGreen", text = "BASE HIJAU", color = Color3.fromRGB(102, 255, 128), size = UDim2.new(10, 0, 2, 0) },
		{ part = "BaseSignYellow", text = "BASE KUNING", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 217, 51), size = UDim2.new(10, 0, 2, 0) },
		{ part = "ThiefSignSouth", text = "SUDUT MALING", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 89, 89), size = UDim2.new(6, 0, 1.5, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) },
	}
	for _, sign in ipairs(signs) do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local board = workspace:FindFirstChild(sign.part)
			if board then
				local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				gui.Name = "SignGui"
				gui.Size = sign.size
				gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = sign.offset or Vector3.zero
				gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				gui.Parent = board
				local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				label.Name = "SignText"
				label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				label.Text = sign.text
				label.TextColor3 = sign.color
				label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
				label.TextScaled = true
				label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				label.Parent = gui
			end
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[PasarBrainrot] buildWorldSigns gagal untuk " .. sign.part .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

-- FIX #2 (17 Nov 2026): startup antipetir. Setiap build/start jalan dalam
-- pcall-nya sendiri dengan warn(), jadi satu sistem yang gagal TIDAK BOLEH
-- mematikan init atau sistem sesudahnya. MoneyTick start PALING DULU:
-- detak MoneyUpdate 1 detik adalah heartbeat HUD, dan sabuk / tsunami /
-- bot tidak boleh menghalanginya walau mereka gagal total.
-- FIX #3: a nil module (failed require) is recorded, not called.
local function safeStart(name, fn)
	if not fn then
		recordError(name, "modul tidak termuat, start dilewati")
		return false
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		recordError(name, err)
	end
	return ok
end

-- Build the world pieces the project JSON does not hold: pedestals + lock posts.
if CarryAndPlace then
	safeStart("buildBasePedestals", CarryAndPlace.buildBasePedestals)
else
	recordError("buildBasePedestals", "CarryAndPlace tidak termuat")
end
safeStart("buildWorldSigns", buildWorldSigns)

-- Start every system. MoneyTick first — its 1 s MoneyUpdate is the HUD's
-- heartbeat; the belt, the wave and the bots must never block it.
local moneyTickOk = false
if MoneyTick then
	moneyTickOk = safeStart("MoneyTick", MoneyTick.start)
else
	recordError("MoneyTick", "modul tidak termuat")
end
if ConveyorSpawner then
	safeStart("ConveyorSpawner", ConveyorSpawner.start)
else
	recordError("ConveyorSpawner", "modul tidak termuat")
end
if TsunamiEvent then
	safeStart("TsunamiEvent", TsunamiEvent.start)
else
	recordError("TsunamiEvent", "modul tidak termuat")
end
if ThiefBot then
	safeStart("ThiefBot", ThiefBot.start)
else
	recordError("ThiefBot", "modul tidak termuat")
end

-- The core loop is PlayerState + MoneyTick + ConveyorSpawner. Only when all
-- three are up does the heartbeat report OK; otherwise ServerStatus names
-- the first error, so the client's HUD line tells the truth either way.
local coreOk = PlayerState ~= nil and moneyTickOk and ConveyorSpawner ~= nil

-- FIX #3 heartbeat: every 5 s refresh ServerStatus with a live timestamp
-- plus player and belt counts, so the HUD line proves the server is alive
-- (not just booted once). A partial failure stays visible after the OK.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		if coreOk then
			local playerCount = 0
			local beltCount = 0

--[[
Control flow, list mapping, and keyed selection helpers (`show`, `showKeyed`, `switch`, `presence`, `pick`, `fallback`, `forValue`, `forKey`, `forIndex`, `selector`).

```luau
Flux.show(loggedIn, function() return Profile {} end, function() return SignIn {} end)
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")
local Type = require("./Type")

local warn = Compat.warn
local computed = Graph.computed
local dispose = Graph.dispose
local effect = Graph.effect
local newValue = Graph.signal
local raw = Graph.raw
local read = Graph.read
local get = Graph.Node.get
local set = Graph.Node.set
local destroyNode = Graph.Node.Destroy
local untrack = Graph.untrack
local retrack = Graph.retrack
local scope = Graph.scope
local withOwner = Graph.withOwner
local isReactive = Graph.isReactive
local isStale = Graph.isStale
local isObserved = Graph.isObserved

--- @ignore
type Node<T> = Graph.Node<T>
--- @ignore
type Item<L> = index<Graph.Unwrap<L>, number>

--- @ignore
type NonNil<T> = Type.NonNil<T>
--- @ignore
type Truthy<T> = Type.Truthy<T>

local OTHERWISE: any = table.freeze({ type = "SwitchOtherwise" })
local UNSET = table.freeze({})
local NAN_KEY: any = table.freeze({ type = "NaNKey" })
local NIL_KEY: any = table.freeze({ type = "NilKey" })
local NO_VALUE: any = nil

-- Conditional (show, showKeyed, switch, presence, pick, fallback) -----------------------------------------------------

local function bindLifetime(output: Node<any>)
	if Graph.getOwner() ~= nil then
		Graph.cleanup(output)
	end
end

local function mountBranch(fn: any, a: any, b: any): (boolean, any, any)
	local ok, branch, result = pcall(withOwner, NO_VALUE, function()
		return scope(function(): any
			return fn(a, b)
		end)
	end)
	if ok then
		return true, branch, result
	end
	return false, branch, nil
end

local function mount(
	source: any,
	selectBranch: (value: any, a: any, b: any, c: any) -> (any, ((value: () -> any) -> any)?),
	argA: any,
	argB: any,
	argC: any
): Node<any>
	local activeKey: any = UNSET
	local activeBranch: Node<any>? = nil
	local lastValid: any = NO_VALUE
	local output = newValue(NO_VALUE)
	local destroyed = false

	local function valueOf()
		local current = read(source)
		local key = selectBranch(current, argA, argB, argC)
		if key == activeKey or (key ~= key and activeKey ~= activeKey) then
			lastValid = current
			return current
		end
		return lastValid
	end

	local driver = effect(function()
		local value = read(source)
		local key, factory = selectBranch(value, argA, argB, argC)

		if key == activeKey or (key ~= key and activeKey ~= activeKey) then
			lastValid = value
			return
		end

		untrack()
		local previous = activeBranch
		activeBranch = nil
		if previous ~= nil then
			previous:Destroy()
		end
		if destroyed then
			retrack()
			return
		end
		activeKey = key
		lastValid = value

		if factory ~= nil then
			local ok, branch, result = mountBranch(factory, valueOf)
			if destroyed then
				if ok and branch ~= nil then
					branch:Destroy()
				end
				retrack()
				return
			end
			if ok then
				activeBranch = branch
				set(output, result)
			else
				set(output, nil)
				activeKey = UNSET
				retrack()
				error(branch, 0)
			end
		else
			set(output, nil)
		end
		retrack()
	end)

	output:onDestroy(function()
		destroyed = true
		driver:Destroy()
		local branch = activeBranch
		activeBranch = nil
		if branch ~= nil then
			branch:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	bindLifetime(output)

	return output
end

local function showSelect(value: any, component: any, fallback: any, keyed: any): (any, any)
	local factory = if value then component else fallback
	return (if keyed then value else not not value), factory
end

local function switchSelect(value: any, map: { [any]: any }): (any, any)
	local factory = map[value]
	if factory == nil then
		local otherwise = map[OTHERWISE]
		if otherwise ~= nil then
			return OTHERWISE, otherwise
		end
	end
	return value, factory
end

local function show<T, F>(
	condition: unknown,
	component: (value: () -> any) -> T,
	fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?
): Node<T | F>
	return mount(condition, showSelect, component, fallback, false)
end

local function showKeyed<T, F>(
	condition: unknown,
	component: (value: () -> any) -> T,
	fallback: ((value: () -> any) -> F)?
): Node<T | F>
	return mount(condition, showSelect, component, fallback, true)
end

--[[
Mounts the branch factory matching `source`'s current value in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
Use `[Flux.otherwise]` in `map` as a catch-all branch for unmatched values.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#switching-between-many-branches)
]]
local function switch<S>(source: S)
	return function<T>(map: { [Graph.Unwrap<S>]: (value: () -> Graph.Unwrap<S>) -> T }): Node<T?>
		local mounted: any = mount(source, switchSelect, map, nil, nil)
		return mounted
	end
end

--[[
Mounts `component(exiting, done)` while `condition` is truthy and keeps it mounted while `exiting()` is `true` until `done()` is called.
If `condition` turns truthy again before `done()` runs, `exiting` flips back to `false` without remounting.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#animating-exits-with-presence)
]]
local function presence<T>(condition: unknown, component: (exiting: Node<boolean>, done: () -> ()) -> T): Node<T?>
	local output: any = newValue(NO_VALUE)
	local branch: Node<any>? = nil
	local exiting: Node<boolean>? = nil
	local finished = newValue(0)
	local handled = 0
	local destroyed = false

	local driver = effect(function()
		local present = read(condition)
		local finishes = get(finished)

		untrack()
		local current, leaving = branch, exiting
		if present then
			handled = finishes
			if current == nil then
				local exit = newValue(false)
				local function done()
					if exiting == exit and exit:peek() then
						set(finished, finished:peek() + 1)
					end
				end
				local ok, mounted, result = mountBranch(component, exit, done)
				if destroyed then
					destroyNode(exit)
					if ok and mounted ~= nil then
						mounted:Destroy()
					end
					retrack()
					return
				end
				if not ok then
					destroyNode(exit)
					set(output, nil)
					retrack()
					error(mounted, 0)
				end
				branch, exiting = mounted, exit
				set(output, result)
			elseif leaving ~= nil and leaving:peek() then
				set(leaving, false)
			end
		elseif current ~= nil and leaving ~= nil then
			if not leaving:peek() then
				handled = finishes
				set(leaving, true)
			elseif finishes ~= handled then
				branch, exiting = nil, nil
				current:Destroy()
				destroyNode(leaving)
				set(output, nil)
			end
		end
		retrack()
	end)

	output:onDestroy(function()
		destroyed = true
		driver:Destroy()
		local current, leaving = branch, exiting
		branch, exiting = nil, nil
		if leaving ~= nil then
			destroyNode(leaving)
		end
		destroyNode(finished)
		if current ~= nil then
			current:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	bindLifetime(output)

	return output
end

--[[
Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `whenTrue` while `condition` is truthy and `whenFalse` otherwise.
Only the active branch is read, and no branch scope is created.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#picking-between-values)
]]
local pick = function(condition: unknown, whenTrue: any, whenFalse: any?): Node<any>
	return computed(function(): any
		return if read(condition) then read(whenTrue) else read(whenFalse)
	end)
end :: (<A, B>(condition: unknown, whenTrue: A, whenFalse: B) -> Node<Graph.Unwrap<A> | Graph.Unwrap<B>>) & (<A>(condition: unknown, whenTrue: A) -> Node<Graph.Unwrap<A>?>)

--[[
Derives a [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) returning `value` when non-`nil`, or `default` when `value` is `nil`.
Preserves `false` instead of replacing it like `or`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#defaulting-a-nil-value)
]]
local function fallback<V, D>(value: V, default: D): Node<NonNil<Graph.Unwrap<V>> | Graph.Unwrap<D>>
	return computed(function(): any
		local current = read(value)
		return if current == nil then read(default) else current
	end)
end

-- For (forIndex, forValue, forKey) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sweepMapperRows(
	nodes: { [any]: Node<any> },
	items: { [any]: Node<any> }?,
	cache: { [any]: any },
	currentKeys: { [any]: boolean }
): number
	local liveN = 0
	for key, node in nodes do
		if currentKeys[key] == nil then
			destroyNode(node)
			nodes[key] = nil
			if items ~= nil then
				destroyNode(items[key])
				items[key] = nil
			end
			dispose(cache[key])
			cache[key] = nil
		else
			liveN += 1
		end
	end
	return liveN
end

local function destroyMapperRows(
	nodes: { [any]: Node<any> },
	items: { [any]: Node<any> }?,
	cache: { [any]: any },
	currentKeys: { [any]: boolean }
)
	for key, node in nodes do
		destroyNode(node)
		if items ~= nil then
			destroyNode(items[key])
		end
		dispose(cache[key])
	end
	table.clear(nodes)
	if items ~= nil then
		table.clear(items)
	end
	table.clear(cache)
	table.clear(currentKeys)
end

local function createMapper(
	list: any,
	mapFn: any,
	keyedByValue: boolean,
	keyOf: ((any) -> any)?,
	fallbackFn: any?
): Node<any>
	local map: (any, any) -> any = mapFn
	assert(type(mapFn) == "function", "mapFn must be a function")
	local emptyFn: (() -> any)? = nil
	if fallbackFn ~= nil then
		local fb: () -> any = fallbackFn
		assert(type(fallbackFn) == "function", "fallback must be a function")
		emptyFn = fb
	end
	local cache: { [any]: any } = {}
	local nodes: { [any]: Node<any> } = {}
	local items: { [any]: Node<any> }? = if keyOf ~= nil then {} else nil
	local currentKeys: { [any]: boolean } = {}
	local cacheN = 0
	local rebuildAborted = false
	local rowA: any, rowB: any
	local fallbackOwner: Node<any>? = nil
	local fallbackItem: any = nil
	local fallbackOut: { any }? = nil
	local destroyed = false

	local function clearFallback()
		local owner = fallbackOwner
		if owner ~= nil then
			local item = fallbackItem
			fallbackOwner = nil
			fallbackItem = nil
			fallbackOut = nil
			destroyNode(owner)
			dispose(item)
		end
	end

	local function build()
		local a, b = rowA, rowB
		rowA, rowB = nil, nil
		return map(a, b)
	end

	local self = computed(function()
		local current = read(list) :: { any }
		if type(current) ~= "table" then
			if cacheN > 0 or rebuildAborted or next(nodes) ~= nil or fallbackOwner ~= nil then
				untrack()
				clearFallback()
				destroyMapperRows(nodes, items, cache, currentKeys)
				cacheN = 0
				rebuildAborted = false
				retrack()
			end
			return {}
		end

		table.clear(currentKeys)
		local out = table.create(#current)

		local mustScan = rebuildAborted
		rebuildAborted = true
		untrack()

		local getKey = keyOf
		local itemsMap = items
		local seen, added = 0, 0
		for index, value in current do
			if destroyed then
				retrack()
				return {}
			end
			local key: any, held: any = index, value
			if keyedByValue then
				if getKey ~= nil then
					local okKey, rawKey = pcall(getKey, value)
					if not okKey then
						retrack()
						error(rawKey, 0)
					end
					if rawKey ~= rawKey then
						warn("[Flux] Flux.forKey: NaN key fell back to item identity; keys must not be NaN")
						key = value
					else
						key = if rawKey == nil then value else rawKey
					end
				else
					if value == nil then
						warn("[Flux] Flux.forValue: nil item skipped; use Flux.forIndex for sparse lists")
						continue
					end
					key = value
				end
				if key ~= key then
					key = NAN_KEY
				end
				held = index
				if currentKeys[key] ~= nil then
					warn(
						if getKey ~= nil
							then "[Flux] Flux.forKey: duplicate keys share one mapped instance; keys must be unique"
							else "[Flux] Flux.forValue: duplicate values share one mapped instance (the value is the cache key); use Flux.forIndex"
					)
					seen -= 1
				end
			end
			currentKeys[key] = true
			seen += 1
			local node = nodes[key]
			if node ~= nil then
				set(node, held)
				if itemsMap ~= nil then
					set(itemsMap[key], value)
				end
				out[index] = cache[key]
			else
				node = newValue(held)
				local itemNode: Node<any>? = nil
				if itemsMap ~= nil then
					itemNode = newValue(value)
					rowA, rowB = node, itemNode
				elseif keyedByValue then
					rowA, rowB = node, value
				else
					rowA, rowB = index, node
				end
				local ok, mapped = pcall(withOwner, node, build)
				if destroyed then
					rowA, rowB = nil, nil
					destroyNode(node)
					if itemNode ~= nil then
						destroyNode(itemNode)
					end
					if ok then
						dispose(mapped)
					end
					retrack()
					return {}
				end
				if not ok then
					rowA, rowB = nil, nil
					destroyNode(node)
					if itemNode ~= nil then
						destroyNode(itemNode)
					end
					retrack()
					error(mapped, 0)
				end
				if itemNode ~= nil then
					(itemsMap :: { [any]: Node<any> })[key] = itemNode
				end
				cache[key] = mapped
				nodes[key] = node
				added += 1
				out[index] = mapped
			end
		end

		rebuildAborted = false

		if mustScan or seen ~= cacheN + added then
			cacheN = sweepMapperRows(nodes, itemsMap, cache, currentKeys)
		else
			cacheN += added
		end

		if seen == 0 and emptyFn ~= nil then
			if fallbackOwner == nil then
				local ok, branch, mapped = mountBranch(emptyFn, nil, nil)
				if destroyed then
					if ok then
						if branch ~= nil then
							destroyNode(branch)
						end
						dispose(mapped)
					end
					retrack()
					return {}
				end
				if not ok then
					retrack()
					error(branch, 0)
				end
				fallbackOwner = branch
				fallbackItem = mapped
				fallbackOut = if mapped == nil then {} else { mapped }
			end
			retrack()
			return fallbackOut :: { any }
		end

		clearFallback()
		retrack()
		return out
	end)

	self:onDestroy(function()
		destroyed = true
		clearFallback()
		destroyMapperRows(nodes, items, cache, currentKeys)
	end)

	return self
end

--[[
Maps `list` by numeric index, running `mapFn(index, item)` once per slot and updating `item` in place when the value at that index changes.
When `fallback` is given, mounts `fallback()` in a child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) while `list` is empty.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/mapping#flux-forindex-keyed-by-index)
]]
local function forIndex(list: any, mapFn: any, fallback: any?): Node<any>
	return createMapper(list, mapFn, false, nil, fallback)
end

--[[
Maps `list` by item identity, running `mapFn(index, value)` once per unique value and updating `index` when an item moves.
Values must be unique (use `Flux.forIndex` for primitive or duplicate values).
When `fallback` is given, mounts `fallback()` in a child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) while `list` is empty.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/mapping#flux-forvalue-keyed-by-value)
]]
local function forValue(list: any, mapFn: any, fallback: any?): Node<any>
	return createMapper(list, mapFn, true, nil, fallback)
end

--[[
Maps `list` by `keyOf(item)`, running `mapFn(index, item)` once per unique key and updating both `index` and `item` in place when entries with that key move or rebuild.
Entries whose key is `nil` fall back to item identity. Keys must be unique.
When `fallback` is given, mounts `fallback()` in a child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) while `list` is empty.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/mapping#flux-forkey-keyed-by-function)
]]
local function forKey(list: any, keyOf: any, mapFn: any, fallback: any?): Node<any>
	assert(type(keyOf) == "function", "keyOf must be a function")
	return createMapper(list, mapFn, true, keyOf, fallback)
end

-- Selector ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local SWEEP_MIN = 32
local SWEEP_REQUESTED = math.huge

-- A selector: `selector(key)` or `selector:get(key)` reads whether `key` is selected.
export type Selector<K> = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Reactively reads whether `key` matches the selector's source.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/selectors#reading-a-selection)
	]]
	get: (self: any, key: K) -> boolean,
	--[[
	Destroys the selector and disposes its internal watcher and per-key nodes.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/selectors#cleaning-up)
	]]
	Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
}, { __call: (self: any, key: K) -> boolean }>

--- @ignore
type SelectorData = {
	_nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<boolean> },
	_count: number,
	_sweepAt: number,
	_watcher: Graph.Node<any>,
	_sweepSignal: Graph.State<boolean>,
	_equals: ((sourceValue: any, key: any) -> boolean)?,
	_active: any,
}

--- @class Selector
local SelectorMT = {}
SelectorMT.__index = SelectorMT

local function keyToSlot(key: any): any
	return if key == nil then NIL_KEY elseif key ~= key then NAN_KEY else key
end

local function slotToKey(slot: any): any
	return if slot == NIL_KEY then nil elseif slot == NAN_KEY then 0 / 0 else slot
end

local function sweep(self: SelectorData)
	local nodes = self._nodes
	local count = 0
	for key, node in nodes do
		if isObserved(node) then
			count += 1
		else
			nodes[key] = nil
			destroyNode(node)
		end
	end
	self._count = count
	self._sweepAt = math.max(SWEEP_MIN, 2 * count)
end

--[[
Reactively reads whether `key` matches the selector's source.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/selectors#reading-a-selection)
]]
function SelectorMT.get(self: SelectorData, key: any): boolean
	if self._watcher == nil then
		error("Cannot read a destroyed selector", 2)
	end
	if isStale(self._watcher) then
		raw(self._watcher)
	end
	local nodes = self._nodes
	local slot = keyToSlot(key)
	local node = nodes[slot]
	if node ~= nil then
		return get(node :: Graph.Node<boolean>)
	end

	local equals = self._equals
	local selected = if equals ~= nil then equals(self._active, key) else self._active ~= UNSET and self._active == key
	if not isReactive() then
		return selected
	end

	if self._count >= self._sweepAt then
		self._sweepAt = SWEEP_REQUESTED
		set(self._sweepSignal, true, true)
	end
	node = newValue(selected)
	nodes[slot] = node
	self._count += 1
	return get(node)
end

SelectorMT.__call = SelectorMT.get

--[[
Destroys the selector and disposes its internal watcher and per-key nodes.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/selectors#cleaning-up)
]]
function SelectorMT.Destroy(self: SelectorData)
	if self._watcher ~= nil then
		self._watcher:Destroy()
	end
end

--[[
Creates a keyed selector that tracks which key matches `source` in O(1) (or O(observed keys) with a custom `equals` comparator).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/selectors#creating-a-selector)
]]
local function selector<S, K>(source: S, equals: ((sourceValue: Graph.Unwrap<S>, key: K) -> boolean)?): Selector<K>
	local sweepSignal = newValue(false)
	local nodes: { [any]: Graph.Node<boolean> } = {}
	local self: any = setmetatable({
		_nodes = nodes,
		_count = 0,
		_sweepAt = SWEEP_MIN,
		_equals = equals,
		_active = UNSET,
		_watcher = NO_VALUE,
		_sweepSignal = sweepSignal,
	}, SelectorMT)

	self._watcher = effect(function()
		local value = read(source)
		local prev = self._active
		if equals == nil and (prev == value or (prev ~= prev and value ~= value)) then
			return
		end
		self._active = value
		if self._count == 0 then
			return
		end

		untrack()
		if equals == nil then
			if prev ~= UNSET and prev == prev then
				local prevNode = nodes[keyToSlot(prev)]
				if prevNode ~= nil then
					set(prevNode, false)
				end
			end
			if value == value then
				local nextNode = nodes[keyToSlot(value)]
				if nextNode ~= nil then
					set(nextNode, true)
				end
			end
		else
			for key, node in nodes do
				set(node, equals(value, slotToKey(key)))
			end
		end
		retrack()
	end)

	local sweeper = effect(function()
		get(sweepSignal)
		if self._sweepAt == SWEEP_REQUESTED then
			sweep(self)
		end
	end)

	self._watcher:onDestroy(function()
		for _, node in nodes do
			destroyNode(node)
		end
		sweeper:Destroy()
		destroyNode(sweepSignal)
		table.clear(self)
	end)

	return self
end

--- @ignore
type function NonUnknown(t: type): type
	if t:is("unknown") or t:is("never") then
		return types.never
	end
	return t
end

return table.freeze({
	--[[
	Catch-all branch key for [`Flux.switch`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#a-catch-all-branch) maps when `source` matches no explicit key.

	```luau
	Flux.switch(state) {
		loading = function() return Spinner {} end,
		[Flux.otherwise] = function(value) return Label { text = value } end,
	}
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#a-catch-all-branch)
	]]
	otherwise = OTHERWISE,
	--[[
	Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy, or `fallback` when falsy, in its own child [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes).
	Rebuilds only when truthiness flips (use [`Flux.showKeyed`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#keyed-show) to rebuild on every identity change).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#showing-one-of-two-branches)
	]]
	show = show :: (<S, T>(condition: S, component: (value: () -> Truthy<Graph.Unwrap<S>>) -> T) -> Node<T?>) & (<S, T, F>(
		condition: S,
		component: (value: () -> Truthy<Graph.Unwrap<S>>) -> T,
		fallback: (value: () -> Graph.Unwrap<S>) -> F
	) -> Node<(T | F)?>),
	--[[
	Mounts `component` while `condition` is truthy (or `fallback` when falsy) and remounts in a fresh [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) whenever `condition` changes identity.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/conditionals#keyed-show)
	]]
	showKeyed = showKeyed :: (<S, T>(condition: S, component: (value: () -> Truthy<Graph.Unwrap<S>>) -> T) -> Node<T?>) & (<S, T, F>(
		condition: S,
		component: (value: () -> Truthy<Graph.Unwrap<S>>) -> T,
		fallback: (value: () -> Graph.Unwrap<S>) -> F
	) -> Node<(T | F)?>),
	switch = switch,
	presence = presence,
	pick = pick,
	fallback = fallback,
	forIndex = forIndex :: <L, U, F>(
		list: L,
		mapFn: (index: number, item: Node<Item<L>>) -> U,
		fallback: (() -> F)?
	) -> Node<{ U | NonUnknown<F> }>,
	forValue = forValue :: <L, U, F>(
		list: L,
		mapFn: (index: Node<number>, value: Item<L>) -> U,
		fallback: (() -> F)?
	) -> Node<{ U | NonUnknown<F> }>,
	forKey = forKey :: <L, U, F>(
		list: L,
		keyOf: (item: Item<L>) -> any,
		mapFn: (index: Node<number>, item: Node<Item<L>>) -> U,
		fallback: (() -> F)?
	) -> Node<{ U | NonUnknown<F> }>,
	selector = selector,
})

-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — Spawner (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- The conveyor: critters spawn at the west end, dance-walk east along
-- the belt, and despawn at the end if nobody picks them up.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local CritterFactory = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("CritterFactory"))
local Economy = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Economy"))
local Bases = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Bases"))

local Spawner = {}
local walkers = {} -- {model, progress, speed, baseY}
local conveyor = nil

local BELT_START = Vector3.new(-45, 1.6, 0)
local BELT_END = Vector3.new(45, 1.6, 0)
local BELT_LENGTH = 90
local WALK_TIME = 42 -- seconds end to end
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 4

function Spawner.buildConveyor(parent)
	local belt = Instance.new("Part")
	belt.Name = "Conveyor"
	belt.Size = Vector3.new(BELT_LENGTH + 4, 1, 8)
	belt.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	belt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 60, 90)
	belt.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	belt.Anchored = true
	belt.CanCollide = true
	belt.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	belt.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	belt.Parent = parent
	conveyor = belt
	-- Belt chevrons
	for x = -40, 40, 10 do
		local stripe = Instance.new("Part")
		stripe.Name = "Stripe"
		stripe.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.15, 7.6)
		stripe.Position = Vector3.new(x, 1.55, 0)
		stripe.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 170, 190)
		stripe.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		stripe.Anchored = true
		stripe.CanCollide = false
		stripe.Parent = parent
	end
	-- Spawn + despawn gates
	for _, x in ipairs({ -46, 46 }) do
		local gate = Instance.new("Part")
		gate.Name = "Gate"
		gate.Size = Vector3.new(1, 8, 10)
		gate.Position = Vector3.new(x, 5, 0)
		gate.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60)
		gate.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		gate.Anchored = true
		gate.CanCollide = false
		gate.Transparency = 0.5
		gate.Parent = parent
	end
end

local function rollIndex(luck)
	-- Weighted: early critters common, late critters rare.
	local total = 0
	local weights = {}
	for i = 1, #Config.CRITTERS do
		local w = 1 / (1 + (i - 1) * 0.35)
		weights[i] = w
		total += w
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for i, w in ipairs(weights) do
		roll -= w
		if roll <= 0 then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

local function rollMutation(luck)
	local roll = math.random()
	local cumulative = 0
	for _, mut in ipairs(Config.MUTATIONS) do
		cumulative += mut.chance * luck
		if roll <= cumulative then
			return mut.name
		end
	end
	return ""
end

local function spawnOne()
	-- Luck uses the average online player's lure level (simple, fair).
	local luck = 1
	local players = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
	if #players > 0 then
		local sum = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(players) do
			sum += Economy.mutationLuck(p)
		end
		luck = sum / #players
	end
	local index = rollIndex(luck)
	local mutation = rollMutation(luck)
	local model = CritterFactory.build(index, mutation)
	if not model then
		return
	end
	model:SetAttribute("OnConveyor", true)
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(BELT_START))
	model.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("World")
	table.insert(walkers, {
		model = model,
		progress = 0,
		speed = 1 / WALK_TIME,
		phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
	})
	Bases.armTouch(model)
end

function Spawner.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
			spawnOne()
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		for i = #walkers, 1, -1 do
			local w = walkers[i]
			if not w.model.Parent then
				table.remove(walkers, i)
			else
				w.progress += w.speed * dt
				if w.progress >= 1 then
					Bases.disarmTouch(w.model)
					w.model:Destroy()
					table.remove(walkers, i)
				else
					-- Dance-walk: bob + sway while moving east.
					local x = BELT_START.X + (BELT_END.X - BELT_START.X) * w.progress
					local bob = math.sin(os.clock() * 6 + w.phase) * 0.25
					local sway = math.sin(os.clock() * 3 + w.phase) * 0.15
					w.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, BELT_START.Y + bob, sway) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Spawner

-- MoneyTick.luau — every 1 second each player's brainrots pay out:
-- cash += sum of owned rates x rebirth multiplier. Updates the Cash and
-- Income leaderstats and pushes the live HUD numbers to that player only.

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
local ConveyorSpawner = require(script.Parent.ConveyorSpawner)
local TsunamiEvent = require(script.Parent.TsunamiEvent)
local RebirthSystem = require(script.Parent.RebirthSystem)

local MoneyTick = {}

-- Set by init.server.luau: the Remotes folder (MoneyUpdate).
MoneyTick.Remotes = nil

function MoneyTick.start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1)
			-- FIX #2: the tick loop must NEVER die. One player's bad state
			-- (or one failed FireClient) is caught per player, and the
			-- whole tick is caught too — the 1 s heartbeat keeps flowing.
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				for _, player in ipairs(PlayerState.getAllPlayers()) do
					local pok, perr = pcall(function()
						local income = PlayerState.getIncomeRate(player)
						if income > 0 then
							PlayerState.addCash(player, income)
						end
						PlayerState.setIncomeLeaderstat(player, income)
						if MoneyTick.Remotes then
							local remote = MoneyTick.Remotes:FindFirstChild("MoneyUpdate")
							if remote then
								local lockRemaining, lockCooldown = PlayerState.getLockRemaining(player)
								remote:FireClient(player, {
									cash = PlayerState.getCash(player),
									income = income,
									nextSpawn = math.ceil(ConveyorSpawner.getNextSpawnIn()),
									waveIn = math.ceil(TsunamiEvent.getSecondsUntilWave()),
									rebirthReady = RebirthSystem.canRebirth(player),
									rebirths = PlayerState.getRebirths(player),
									multiplier = PlayerState.getMultiplier(player),
									lockRemaining = math.ceil(lockRemaining),
									lockCooldown = math.ceil(lockCooldown),
									ownedCount = PlayerState.getOwnedCount(player),
								})
							end
						end
					end)
					if not pok then
						warn("[PasarBrainrot] MoneyTick gagal untuk " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(perr))
					end
				end
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[PasarBrainrot] MoneyTick gagal: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MoneyTick

-- LegendService: rebirth. Cash and deck reset for a permanent x2 income
-- multiplier, a golden aura, and (from rebirth 2) the LEGEND tier opens.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BootyCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))
local PirateState = require(script.Parent.PirateState)
local BountyService = require(script.Parent.BountyService)

local LegendService = {}

function LegendService.getRebirthCost(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then return 50000 end
	return 50000 * (4 ^ state.rebirths)
end

function LegendService.getRequiredRarity(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then return "LEGENDARY" end
	if state.rebirths == 0 then
		return "LEGENDARY"
	else
		return "MYTHIC"
	end
end

function LegendService.canPlayerRebirth(player)
	local state = PirateState.getState(player)
	if not state then return false end
	if state.cash < LegendService.getRebirthCost(player) then
		return false
	end
	local required = LegendService.getRequiredRarity(player)
	local requiredIndex = table.find(BootyCatalog.RARITY_ORDER, required) or 4
	for _, slot in pairs(state.slots) do
		if slot then
			local def = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(slot.defId)
			if def then
				local defIndex = table.find(BootyCatalog.RARITY_ORDER, def.rarity) or 1
				if defIndex >= requiredIndex then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function LegendService.performPlayerRebirth(player)
	if not LegendService.canPlayerRebirth(player) then
		return false
	end
	PirateState.incrementRebirth(player)
	LegendService.applyRebirthAura(player)
	BountyService.addBountyProgress(player, "rebirth", 1)
	PirateState.broadcastAll({ type = "feed", text = player.Name .. " REBIRTHED! Income x" .. tostring(PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player)) .. " forever!", color = "gold" })
	return true
end

function LegendService.applyRebirthAura(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local sparkles = Instance.new("Sparkles")
	sparkles.Name = "RebirthAura"
	sparkles.SparkleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	sparkles.Parent = root
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Name = "RebirthLight"
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	light.Range = 8
	light.Brightness = 1
	light.Parent = root
end

return LegendService
