-- Find ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local FIND_SYMBOL: any = table.freeze({ type = "Symbol" })
local rawGame: any = game

local function indexParent(instance: Instance): Instance?
	return instance.Parent
end

local function queryFirst(instance: Instance, query: string): Instance?
	return instance:QueryDescendants(query)[1]
end

local function findPath(instance: Instance, pathStr: string): Instance?
	local cur: Instance = instance
	for _, segment in string.split(pathStr, ".") do
		if segment == "" then
			continue
		end
		local nextInst = if segment == "Parent" or segment == "^" then cur.Parent else cur:FindFirstChild(segment)
		if not nextInst then
			return nil
		end
		cur = nextInst
	end
	return cur
end

local function makeSelector(find: any): any
	local fn = if type(find) ~= "string"
		then find
		elseif IS_ROBLOX then rawGame[find]
		else function(instance: any, query: string): any
			return instance[find](instance, query)
		end
	return function(query: string)
		return function(properties: Type.Map<any>)
			return { FIND_SYMBOL, fn, properties, query }
		end
	end
end

--- @ignore
type Fallback<Name> = index<Type.Editable & { [string]: Instance }, Name>

export type Selection = { any }
export type ClassSelector = <T>(className: T | keyof<Type.Editable>) -> (Type.EditProperties<Fallback<T>>) -> Selection
-- A name, path or query says nothing about the class it finds, so its property table is untyped.
export type QuerySelector = (query: string) -> (Type.Map<any>) -> Selection
export type ParentSelector = () -> (Type.Map<any>) -> Selection

local function warnFind(query: string?, value: any)
	local desc = if query == nil then "a Find selector" else `query "{query}"`
	warn(`[Flux] Instance expected for {desc}, got {compatTypeof(value)}`)
end

local function resolveFind(
	applied: { any },
	instance: Instance,
	applyProps: (Instance, Type.Map<any>, ...any) -> ...any
)
	local query = applied[4]
	local result = applied[2](instance, query)
	local properties = applied[3]
	local kind = kindOf(result)

	if kind == "Instance" then
		applyProps(result, properties)
	elseif kind == "table" then
		for _, item in result do
			if kindOf(item) == "Instance" then
				applyProps(item, properties)
			else
				warnFind(query, item)
			end
		end
	else
		warnFind(query, result)
	end
end

local Find = table.freeze({
	--[[
	Selects the first ancestor named `name` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstAncestor`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstAncestor)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#available-selectors)
	]]
	Ancestor = makeSelector("FindFirstAncestor") :: QuerySelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first ancestor of class `className` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstAncestorOfClass)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#available-selectors)
	]]
	AncestorClass = makeSelector("FindFirstAncestorOfClass") :: ClassSelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first ancestor matching `IsA(className)` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#available-selectors)
	]]
	AncestorIsA = makeSelector("FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA") :: ClassSelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first direct child named `name` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstChild`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstChild)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Child = makeSelector("FindFirstChild") :: QuerySelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first direct child of class `className` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstChildOfClass`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstChildOfClass)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#available-selectors)
	]]
	ChildClass = makeSelector("FindFirstChildOfClass") :: ClassSelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first direct child matching `IsA(className)` via
	[`Instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#FindFirstChildWhichIsA)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#available-selectors)
	]]
	ChildIsA = makeSelector("FindFirstChildWhichIsA") :: ClassSelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first descendant named `name` via `Instance:FindFirstChild(name, true)` and applies the property
	table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Descendant = makeSelector(function(instance: Instance, name: string): Instance?
		return instance:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	end) :: QuerySelector,
	--[[
	Selects the target's [`Instance.Parent`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#Parent)
	and applies the property table to it (`Find.Parent() { ... }`).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Parent = makeSelector(indexParent) :: ParentSelector,
	--[[
	Walks a `.`-separated child path from the target (`Parent` or `^` climbs to `Instance.Parent`) and applies the
	property table to the final [`Instance`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Path = makeSelector(findPath) :: QuerySelector,
	--[[
	Selects every descendant matching a Roblox query string via
	[`Instance:QueryDescendants`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#QueryDescendants)
	and applies the property table to each match.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	Query = makeSelector("QueryDescendants") :: QuerySelector,
	--[[
	Selects the first descendant matching a Roblox query string via
	[`Instance:QueryDescendants`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/Instance#QueryDescendants)
	and applies the property table to it.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/hydration#instance-selectors-flux-find)
	]]
	QueryFirst = makeSelector(queryFirst) :: QuerySelector,
})

-- A handle returned by `Flux.portal(target, children)` that mounts UI into `target`.
--- @ignore
export type Portal = Bind.Portal
-- A component schema marker returned by `Flux.prop(default)`.
--- @ignore
export type DefaultProp<T> = Type.DefaultProp<T>

-- `T` with every property optional.
--- @ignore
export type Partial<T> = Type.Partial<T>

-- The members of `T` a `split` group named by `G` receives. Required members stay required. When the names are only known as `string` (an unannotated array), every member is optional.
--- @ignore
export type Pick<T, G> = Type.Pick<T, G>
-- The members of `T` that no `split` group took: properties forwarded to the root instance.
--- @ignore
export type Omit<T, G> = Type.Omit<T, G>

local PROP_DEFAULT: any = table.freeze({ type = "PropDefault" })
local mergeSources: { [any]: { n: number, [number]: any } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local MergeMT: { [string]: any } = {
	__index = function(self: any, key: any): any
		local sources = mergeSources[self]
		if sources == nil then
			return nil
		end
		for index = sources.n, 1, -1 do
			local source = sources[index]
			if source ~= nil then
				local value = source[key]
				if value ~= nil then
					return value
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end,
	__newindex = function()
		error("Flux.merge tables are read-only", 2)
	end,
	__len = function(self: any): number
		local sources = mergeSources[self]
		if sources == nil then
			return 0
		end
		local maxLen = 0
		for index = 1, sources.n do
			local source = sources[index]
			if source ~= nil then
				local len = #source
				if len > maxLen then
					maxLen = len
				end
			end
		end
		return maxLen
	end,
	__iter = function(self: any)
		local sources = mergeSources[self]
		local snap: { [any]: any } = {}
		if sources ~= nil then
			for index = 1, sources.n do
				local source = sources[index]
				if source ~= nil then
					for key, value in source do
						snap[key] = value
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return next, snap
	end,
}

local function merge(...: any): any
	local count = select("#", ...)
	for index = 1, count do
		local source = select(index, ...)
		if source ~= nil and type(source) ~= "table" then
			error(`Flux.merge expects tables or nil, got {compatTypeof(source)}`, 2)
		end
	end
	local proxy = setmetatable({}, MergeMT)
	mergeSources[proxy] = table.pack(...)
	return proxy
end

type MergeProps = <A, B, C, D>(a: A & {}, b: (B & {})?, c: (C & {})?, d: (D & {})?) -> Type.MergeTables<A, B, C, D>

local function clonePlainDefault(value: any, seen: { [any]: any }?): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" or getmetatable(value) ~= nil or table.isfrozen(value) then
		return value
	end
	if seen and seen[value] ~= nil then
		return seen[value]
	end
	local copy = table.clone(value)
	local nextSeen = seen
	if nextSeen ~= nil then
		nextSeen[value] = copy
	end
	for k, v in copy do
		if type(v) == "table" and getmetatable(v) == nil and not table.isfrozen(v) then
			if nextSeen == nil then
				nextSeen = { [value] = copy }
			end
			copy[k] = clonePlainDefault(v, nextSeen)
		end
	end
	return copy
end

local function isKeyList(group: { [any]: any }): boolean
	local first = group[1]
	if first == nil then
		return false
	end
	return first ~= true and (type(first) ~= "table" or rawget(first, 1) ~= PROP_DEFAULT)
end

local function applySchemaDefaults(own: { [any]: any }, schema: { [any]: any })
	for key, spec in schema do
		if own[key] == nil and type(spec) == "table" and rawget(spec, 1) == PROP_DEFAULT then
			own[key] = clonePlainDefault(rawget(spec, 2))
		end
	end
end

local function split(props: any, keys: any, ...: any): ...any
	if keys == nil and select("#", ...) == 0 then
		if type(props) ~= "table" then
			return {}
		elseif getmetatable(props) ~= nil then
			local out: { [any]: any } = {}
			for key, value in props do
				out[key] = value
			end
			return out
		end
		return table.clone(props)
	elseif select("#", ...) == 0 then
		if type(keys) ~= "table" then
			return {}, split(props, nil)
		end
		local own = {}
		local rest = {}
		if isKeyList(keys) then
			if type(props) == "table" then
				for _, key in keys do
					local val = props[key]
					if val ~= nil then
						own[key] = val
					end
				end
				for key, value in props do
					if own[key] == nil then
						rest[key] = value
					end
				end
			end
		else
			if type(props) == "table" then
				for key, value in props do
					local target = if keys[key] ~= nil then own else rest
					target[key] = value
				end
			end
			applySchemaDefaults(own, keys)
		end
		return own, rest
	end

	local groups = table.pack(keys, ...)
	local count = groups.n
	local owners: { [any]: number } = {}
	local isSchemaGroup: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local results: any = {}

	for index = 1, count do
		results[index] = {}
		local group = groups[index]
		if type(group) ~= "table" then
			isSchemaGroup[index] = false
			continue
		end
		local keyList = isKeyList(group)
		isSchemaGroup[index] = not keyList
		if keyList then
			for _, key in group do
				if owners[key] == nil then
					owners[key] = index
				end
			end
		else
			for key in group do
				if owners[key] == nil then
					owners[key] = index
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local rest = {}
	results[count + 1] = rest
	if type(props) == "table" then
		for key, value in props do
			local owner = owners[key]
			local target = if owner ~= nil then results[owner] else rest
			target[key] = value
		end
	end

	for index = 1, count do
		if isSchemaGroup[index] then
			local group = groups[index]
			local target = results[index]
			for key, spec in group do
				if
					owners[key] == index
					and target[key] == nil
					and type(spec) == "table"
					and rawget(spec, 1) == PROP_DEFAULT
				then
					target[key] = clonePlainDefault(rawget(spec, 2))
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return table.unpack(results, 1, count + 1)
end

type Split =
	(<T>(props: T) -> Type.CloneProps<T>)
	& (<T, G>(props: T, keys: G) -> (Pick<T, G>, Omit<T, G>))
	& (<T>(props: T, first: { [any]: any }, second: { [any]: any }, ...{ [any]: any }) -> ...Partial<T>)

-- Marks a key in a component prop schema at runtime; pair with a type cast (`Flux.prop() :: Flux.Reactive<string>`)
-- or pass a `default` value (`Flux.prop(16)`).
type Prop = (() -> any) & (<T>(default: T) -> Type.DefaultProp<T>)

local function prop(...: any): any
	if select("#", ...) == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local default = select(1, ...)
	if default == nil then
		return true
	end
	return table.freeze({ PROP_DEFAULT, default })
end

type Own = <A, B, C, D>(a: (A & {})?, b: (B & {})?, c: (C & {})?, d: (D & {})?) -> Type.MergeOwn<A, B, C, D>

local function own(...: { [string]: any }): any
	local schema = {}
	for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local part: any = select(index, ...)
		if part ~= nil then
			if type(part) ~= "table" then
				error(`Flux.own expected table at argument #{index}, got {compatTypeof(part)}`, 2)
			end
			for key, value in part do
				schema[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
	return table.freeze(schema)
end

-- Edit & Construct ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function bindModel(node: any, instance: Instance, property: string, _CLEAN: { any }, isAttribute: boolean)
	table.insert(_CLEAN, bindTo(node, instance, property, isAttribute))
	local _, disconnect = bindFrom(node, instance, property, isAttribute)
	table.insert(_CLEAN, disconnect)
	attachToBinding(instance, property, isAttribute, disconnect)
end

local tagCounts: { [Instance]: { [string]: number } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function rawAddTag(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	instance:AddTag(tag)
end

local function rawRemoveTag(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	instance:RemoveTag(tag)
end

local function addTagRef(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	local counts = tagCounts[instance]
	if not counts then
		counts = {}
		tagCounts[instance] = counts
	end
	local count = counts[tag]
	counts[tag] = (count or 0) + 1
	if not count then
		isolate(rawAddTag, instance, tag)
	end
end

local function decrementTagRef(instance: Instance, tag: string): boolean
	local counts = tagCounts[instance]
	local count = if counts then counts[tag] else nil
	if count and count > 1 then
		counts[tag] = count - 1
		return false
	end
	if counts then
		counts[tag] = nil
		if next(counts) == nil then
			tagCounts[instance] = nil
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function removeTagRef(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	if decrementTagRef(instance, tag) then
		isolate(rawRemoveTag, instance, tag)
	end
end

local function releaseTagRefOnly(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	decrementTagRef(instance, tag)
end

local function bindTag(instance: Instance, tagValue: any, _CLEAN: { any })
	if type(tagValue) == "string" then
		addTagRef(instance, tagValue)
		local released = false
		table.insert(_CLEAN, function()
			if not released then
				released = true
				releaseTagRefOnly(instance, tagValue)
			end
		end)
		return
	elseif isModel(tagValue) then
		error("__TAG does not accept Flux.model; use _tag_Name = Flux.model(node) for a two-way tag", 0)
	elseif type(tagValue) == "function" then
		tagValue = newNode(tagValue)
		table.insert(_CLEAN, tagValue)
	end

	if isNode(tagValue) then
		local node = tagValue :: Graph.Node<any>
		local currentSet: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		local disposed = false

		local function updateTags(newTag: string | { string })
			if disposed then
				return
			end
			local newSet: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			if type(newTag) == "table" then
				for _, tag in newTag do
					newSet[tag] = true
				end
			elseif type(newTag) == "string" then
				newSet[newTag] = true
			end
			for tag in newSet do
				if not currentSet[tag] then
					addTagRef(instance, tag)
				end
			end
			for tag in currentSet do
				if not newSet[tag] then
					removeTagRef(instance, tag)
				end
			end
			currentSet = newSet
		end

		updateTags(node:peek())
		table.insert(
			_CLEAN,
			effect(function()
				updateTags(get(node))
			end)
		)
		table.insert(_CLEAN, function()
			if disposed then
				return
			end
			disposed = true
			for tag in currentSet do
				releaseTagRefOnly(instance, tag)
			end
			table.clear(currentSet)
		end)
	elseif type(tagValue) == "table" then
		for _, value in tagValue do
			bindTag(instance, value, _CLEAN)
		end
	end
end

local function stripUnmanagedTag(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	local counts = tagCounts[instance]
	if (not counts or not counts[tag]) and instance:HasTag(tag) then
		isolate(rawRemoveTag, instance, tag)
	end
end

local namedTagClaims: { [Instance]: { [string]: (strip: boolean) -> () } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function releaseNamedTag(instance: Instance, tag: string)
	local claims = namedTagClaims[instance]
	if not claims then
		return
	end
	local release = claims[tag]
	if not release then
		return
	end
	claims[tag] = nil
	if next(claims) == nil then
		namedTagClaims[instance] = nil
	end
	release(true)
end

local function cleanupNamedTag(instance: Instance, tag: string, release: (strip: boolean) -> ())
	local claims = namedTagClaims[instance]
	if claims and claims[tag] == release then
		claims[tag] = nil
		if next(claims) == nil then
			namedTagClaims[instance] = nil
		end
		release(false)
	end
end

local function claimNamedTag(instance: Instance, tag: string, release: (strip: boolean) -> (), _CLEAN: { any })
	local claims = namedTagClaims[instance]
	if not claims then
		claims = {}
		namedTagClaims[instance] = claims
	end
	claims[tag] = release
	table.insert(_CLEAN, function()
		cleanupNamedTag(instance, tag, release)
	end)
end

local function bindNamedTag(instance: Instance, tag: string, tagValue: any, _CLEAN: { any })
	if isModel(tagValue) then
		local modelNode = tagValue[2]
		bindNamedTag(instance, tag, modelNode, _CLEAN)
		modelNode:set(instance:HasTag(tag))
		local disconnect = Bind.bindDestroy(
			modelNode,
			onTagChanged(instance, tag, function(hasTag)
				modelNode:set(hasTag)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(_CLEAN, disconnect)
		local claims = namedTagClaims[instance]
		local prevRelease = claims and claims[tag]
		if prevRelease then
			local wrappedRelease = function(strip: boolean)
				disconnect()
				prevRelease(strip)
			end
			claims[tag] = wrappedRelease
			table.insert(_CLEAN, function()
				cleanupNamedTag(instance, tag, wrappedRelease)
			end)
		end
		return
	end

	releaseNamedTag(instance, tag)

	local made: Graph.Node<any>? = nil
	if type(tagValue) == "function" then
		made = newNode(tagValue)
		tagValue = made
		table.insert(_CLEAN, made)
	end

	if isNode(tagValue) then
		local node = tagValue :: Graph.Node<any>
		local active = not not node:peek()
		if active then
			addTagRef(instance, tag)
		else
			stripUnmanagedTag(instance, tag)
		end
		local eff = effect(function()
			local shouldHave = not not get(node)
			if shouldHave ~= active then
				active = shouldHave
				if shouldHave then
					addTagRef(instance, tag)
				else
					removeTagRef(instance, tag)
				end
			elseif not shouldHave then
				stripUnmanagedTag(instance, tag)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(_CLEAN, eff)
		claimNamedTag(instance, tag, function(strip: boolean)
			eff:Destroy()
			if made then
				made:Destroy()
			end
			if active then
				active = false
				if strip then
					removeTagRef(instance, tag)
				else
					releaseTagRefOnly(instance, tag)
				end
			end
		end, _CLEAN)
	elseif tagValue then
		addTagRef(instance, tag)
		local released = false
		claimNamedTag(instance, tag, function(strip: boolean)
			if not released then
				released = true
				if strip then
					removeTagRef(instance, tag)
				else
					releaseTagRefOnly(instance, tag)
				end
			end
		end, _CLEAN)
	else
		stripUnmanagedTag(instance, tag)
	end
end

local function applyBindingOrValue(
	instance: Instance,
	name: any,
	value: any,
	isAttribute: boolean,
	seen: { [any]: boolean }?,
	_CLEAN: { any }
)
	if seen then
		if seen[name] then
			return
		end
		seen[name] = true
	end

	local made = nil
	if type(value) == "function" then
		value = newNode(value)
		made = value
		table.insert(_CLEAN, value)
	end

	if isModel(value) then
		if not isAttribute and name == "LayoutOrder" then
			Bind.pinOrder(instance)
		end
		bindModel(value[2], instance, name, _CLEAN, isAttribute)
	elseif isNode(value) then
		if not isAttribute and name == "LayoutOrder" then
			Bind.pinOrder(instance)
		end
		table.insert(_CLEAN, bindTo(value, instance, name, isAttribute))
		if made then
			attachToBinding(instance, name, isAttribute, made)
		end
	elseif isAttribute then
		releaseBinding(instance, name, true)
		isolate(setAttribute, instance, name, value)
	else
		releaseBinding(instance, name, false)
		isolate(setProperty, instance, name, value)
		if name == "LayoutOrder" then
			Bind.pinOrder(instance)
		end
	end
end

local function connectChanged(
	instance: Instance,
	name: string,
	isAttribute: boolean,
	isTag: boolean,
	value: any,
	label: string,
	_CLEAN: { any }
)
	if isNode(value) then
		error(
			`{label} is a node: use Flux.model(node) for two-way binding or Flux.property(instance, prop) to follow a property`,
			0
		)
	elseif type(value) ~= "function" then
		error(`{label} expects a function called with the new value, got {compatTypeof(value)}`, 0)
	end
	local rawInstance: any = instance
	if not isAttribute and not isTag and kindOf(rawInstance[name]) == "RBXScriptSignal" then
		error(`{label} is an event, not a property: connect \`{name}\` as a top-level key`, 0)
	end
	if isTag then
		table.insert(_CLEAN, onTagChanged(instance, name, bindContext(value)))
	else
		table.insert(_CLEAN, onChanged(instance, name, isAttribute, bindContext(value)))
	end
end

local function applyPrefixKey(
	instance: Instance,
	property: string,
	value: any,
	seenAttrs: { [any]: boolean }?,
	seenProps: { [any]: boolean }?,
	_CLEAN: { any }
)
	local second = string.byte(property, 2)
	if second == 97 and string.sub(property, 1, 6) == "_attr_" then
		local attrName = string.sub(property, 7)
		if attrName == "" then
			error('attribute name after "_attr_" cannot be empty', 0)
		end
		applyBindingOrValue(instance, attrName, value, true, seenAttrs, _CLEAN)
		return
	elseif second == 116 and string.sub(property, 1, 5) == "_tag_" then
		local tagName = string.sub(property, 6)
		if tagName == "" then
			error('tag name after "_tag_" cannot be empty', 0)
		end
		if seenProps then
			if seenProps[property] then
				return
			end
			seenProps[property] = true
		end
		bindNamedTag(instance, tagName, value, _CLEAN)
		return
	end

	if second == nil then
		error('property name after "_" cannot be empty', 0)
	end
	local name = string.sub(property, 2)
	local isAttr = false
	local isTag = false
	if second == 95 then
		if string.sub(property, 1, 7) == "__attr_" then
			name = string.sub(property, 8)
			if name == "" then
				error('attribute name after "__attr_" cannot be empty', 0)
			end
			isAttr = true
		elseif string.sub(property, 1, 6) == "__tag_" then
			name = string.sub(property, 7)
			if name == "" then
				error('tag name after "__tag_" cannot be empty', 0)
			end
			isTag = true
		end
	end
	if seenProps then
		if seenProps[property] then
			return
		end
		seenProps[property] = true
	end
	connectChanged(instance, name, isAttr, isTag, value, `"{property}"`, _CLEAN)
end

local function applyDirectives(
	instance: Instance,
	properties: Type.Map<any>,
	seenAttrs: { [any]: boolean }?,
	_CLEAN: { any }
)
	local _ATTR = properties.__ATTR
	if _ATTR then
		for attrName, attrVal in _ATTR do
			applyBindingOrValue(instance, attrName, attrVal, true, seenAttrs, _CLEAN)
		end
	end

	local _TAG = properties.__TAG
	if _TAG then
		bindTag(instance, _TAG, _CLEAN)
	end

	local _EVENT = properties.__EVENT
	if _EVENT then
		local _EVENT_ATTR = _EVENT.__ATTR
		local _EVENT_TAG = _EVENT.__TAG
		for property, value in _EVENT do
			if property == "__ATTR" or property == "__TAG" then
				continue
			end
			connectChanged(instance, property, false, false, value, `__EVENT.{property}`, _CLEAN)
		end
		if _EVENT_ATTR then
			for attribute, value in _EVENT_ATTR do
				connectChanged(instance, attribute, true, false, value, `__EVENT.__ATTR.{attribute}`, _CLEAN)
			end
		end
		if _EVENT_TAG then
			for tag, value in _EVENT_TAG do
				connectChanged(instance, tag, false, true, value, `__EVENT.__TAG.{tag}`, _CLEAN)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function finalizeEdit(
	instance: Instance,
	properties: Type.Map<any>,
	childKeys: { number }?,
	actions: { any }?,
	signals: { any }?,
	parent: any,
	seenAttrs: { [any]: boolean }?,
	seenProps: { [any]: boolean }?,
	_CLEAN: { any },
	isRoot: boolean,
	applyEdit: (
		Instance,
		Type.Map<any>,
		{ [any]: boolean }?,
		{ [any]: boolean }?,
		{ any }?,
		boolean?,
		{ any }?
	) -> any,
	findEdit: (Instance, Type.Map<any>) -> Instance
): any
	if childKeys then
		if #childKeys > 1 then
			table.sort(childKeys)
		end
		for _, key in childKeys do
			local child: any = properties[key]
			if kindOf(child) == "Instance" then
				Bind.placeChildOrder(instance, child)
				child.Parent = instance
			elseif type(child) == "function" then
				if actions == nil then
					actions = {}
				end
				table.insert(actions :: { any }, child)
			elseif isNode(child) then
				table.insert(_CLEAN, Bind.children(child, instance))
			elseif Bind.isPortal(child) then
				table.insert(_CLEAN, Bind.mountPortal(child))
			elseif rawget(child, 1) == FIND_SYMBOL then
				resolveFind(child, instance, findEdit)
			else
				local nestedParent = applyEdit(instance, child, seenAttrs, seenProps, _CLEAN, false, actions)
				if parent == nil and nestedParent ~= nil then
					parent = nestedParent
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local _REF: any = properties.__REF
	if _REF then
		if type(_REF) == "function" then
			local callRef: (Instance) -> any = _REF
			local refClean = callRef(instance)
			if refClean ~= nil then
				table.insert(_CLEAN, refClean)
			end
		elseif isNode(_REF) then
			_REF:set(instance)
		end
	end

	if signals then
		for index = 1, #signals, 2 do
			local connected: any = signals[index]:Connect(bindContext(signals[index + 1]))
			table.insert(_CLEAN, connected)
		end
	end

	if not isRoot then
		return parent
	end

	local madeParent = nil
	if type(parent) == "function" then
		parent = newNode(parent)
		madeParent = parent
		table.insert(_CLEAN, parent)
	end
	local parentIsNode = isNode(parent)
	local hasActions = actions ~= nil and #actions > 0
	local cleaned = false

	if parentIsNode or next(_CLEAN) ~= nil or hasActions then
		local function cleanAll()
			cleaned = true
			dispose(_CLEAN)
			table.clear(_CLEAN)
		end
		table.insert(_CLEAN, instance.Destroying:Once(cleanAll))
		if getOwner() then
			cleanup(cleanAll)
		end
	end

	if parent then
		if parentIsNode then
			table.insert(_CLEAN, bindTo(parent, instance, "Parent", false))
			if madeParent then
				attachToBinding(instance, "Parent", false, madeParent)
			end
		else
			releaseBinding(instance, "Parent", false)
			isolate(setProperty, instance, "Parent", parent)
		end
	end

	if hasActions and actions ~= nil and not cleaned then
		for _, action in actions do
			table.insert(_CLEAN, task.defer(bindContext(action), instance))
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function ensureFlattenSeen(
	properties: Type.Map<any>,
	existingAttrs: { [any]: boolean }?,
	existingProps: { [any]: boolean }?
): ({ [any]: boolean }, { [any]: boolean })
	if existingAttrs and existingProps then
		return existingAttrs, existingProps
	end
	local nextAttrs: { [any]: boolean } = existingAttrs or {}
	local _ATTR = properties.__ATTR
	if _ATTR then
		for attrName in _ATTR do
			nextAttrs[attrName] = true
		end
	end
	local nextProps: { [any]: boolean } = existingProps or {}
	for key in properties do
		if type(key) ~= "number" then
			nextProps[key] = true
			if type(key) == "string" and string.sub(key, 1, 6) == "_attr_" then
				nextAttrs[string.sub(key, 7)] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return nextAttrs, nextProps
end

local editInstance: (instance: Instance, properties: Type.Map<any>) -> Instance

local function edit(
	instance: Instance,
	properties: Type.Map<any>,
	seenAttrs: { [any]: boolean }?,
	seenProps: { [any]: boolean }?,
	_CLEAN: { any },
	isRoot: boolean,
	actions: { any }?
): any
	local signals: { any }? = nil
	local childKeys: { number }? = nil
	local hasFlatten = false
	local rawInstance: any = instance
	local applyEdit: any = edit
	local _USER_CLEAN = properties.__CLEAN
	if _USER_CLEAN ~= nil then
		table.insert(_CLEAN, _USER_CLEAN)
	end
	if properties.__ATTR ~= nil and seenAttrs == nil then
		seenAttrs = {}
	end
	local parent = properties.Parent
	if parent and seenProps then
		if seenProps.Parent then
			parent = nil
		else
			seenProps.Parent = true
		end
	end
	for property, value in properties do
		if
			property == "Parent"
			or property == "__TAG"
			or property == "__ATTR"
			or property == "__CLEAN"
			or property == "__EVENT"
			or property == "__REF"
		then
			continue
		end
		local propType = type(property)
		if propType == "string" then
			if string.byte(property) == 95 then
				applyPrefixKey(instance, property, value, seenAttrs, seenProps, _CLEAN)
				continue
			end
		elseif propType == "number" and property == math.floor(property) then
			if kindOf(value) == "Instance" or type(value) == "function" then
				childKeys = childKeys or {}
				table.insert(childKeys :: { number }, property)
			elseif type(value) == "table" then
				if not isModel(value) then
					if rawget(value, 1) ~= FIND_SYMBOL and not Bind.isPortal(value) and not isNode(value) then
						hasFlatten = true
					end
					childKeys = childKeys or {}
					table.insert(childKeys :: { number }, property)
				end
			end
			continue
		end
		if type(value) == "function" then
			local signal = rawInstance[property]
			if kindOf(signal) == "RBXScriptSignal" then
				signals = signals or {}
				table.insert(signals :: { any }, signal)
				table.insert(signals :: { any }, value)
				continue
			end
		end
		applyBindingOrValue(instance, property, value, false, seenProps, _CLEAN)
	end
	applyDirectives(instance, properties, seenAttrs, _CLEAN)
	if hasFlatten then
		seenAttrs, seenProps = ensureFlattenSeen(properties, seenAttrs, seenProps)
		if isRoot and actions == nil then
			actions = {}
		end
	end
	return finalizeEdit(
		instance,
		properties,
		childKeys,
		actions,
		signals,
		parent,
		seenAttrs,
		seenProps,
		_CLEAN,
		isRoot,
		applyEdit,
		editInstance
	)
end

function editInstance(instance: Instance, properties: Type.Map<any>): Instance
	Compat.requireRoblox("Flux.edit")
	local clean = {}
	local ok, err = (pcall :: (any) -> (boolean, any))(function()
		edit(instance, properties, nil, nil, clean, true, nil)
	end)
	if not ok then
		dispose(clean)
		table.clear(clean)
		error(err, 0)
	end
	return instance
end

local function assign(instance: Instance, values: { [string]: unknown }?)
	if values then
		local rawInstance: any = instance
		for key, value in values do
			rawInstance[key] = value
		end
	end
end

local function new(className: string, properties: any): Instance
	Compat.requireRoblox("Flux.new")
	local instance = Compat.Instance.new(className)
	assign(instance, if Flags.defaults then Defaults[className] else nil)
	local ok, res = pcall(editInstance, instance, properties)
	if not ok then
		instance:Destroy()
		error(res, 0)
	end
	if getOwner() then
		cleanup(instance)
	end
	return res
end

local EMPTY_PORTALS: { any } = table.freeze({} :: { any })

local function collectMountedPortals(item: any, into: { any })
	while isNode(item) do
		item = get(item)
	end
	if item == nil then
		return
	elseif Bind.isPortal(item) then
		table.insert(into, item)
	elseif type(item) == "table" and kindOf(item) ~= "Instance" then
		for _, child in item do
			collectMountedPortals(child, into)
		end
	end
end

local function mountTopPortals(item: any)
	if item == nil then
		return
	elseif Bind.isPortal(item) then
		cleanup(Bind.mountPortal(item))
	elseif isNode(item) then
		local portalData: { portals: any?, nextPortals: any? } = {}
		local stopped = false
		local function stopAll()
			if stopped then
				return
			end
			stopped = true
			Bind.syncPortals(portalData, EMPTY_PORTALS, 0)
		end
		cleanup(stopAll)
		local eff = effect(function()
			if stopped then
				return
			end
			local desired: { any } = {}
			collectMountedPortals(item, desired)
			Bind.syncPortals(portalData, desired, #desired)
		end)
		eff:peek()
	elseif type(item) == "table" and kindOf(item) ~= "Instance" then
		for _, child in item do
			mountTopPortals(child)
		end
	end
end

local function mount(fn: () -> any, target: Graph.Reactive<Instance?>?): () -> ()
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		error(`Flux.mount expects a function, got {compatTypeof(fn)}`, 2)
	elseif target ~= nil and kindOf(target) ~= "Instance" and not Graph.isDynamic(target) then
		error(`Flux.mount expects an Instance target, reactive target, or nil, got {compatTypeof(target)}`, 2)
	end

	local root = Graph.scope(function()
		local result = fn()
		if target ~= nil then
			cleanup(Bind.mountPortal(Bind.portal(target, result)))
		elseif result ~= nil then
			mountTopPortals(result)
		end
	end)

	local done = false
	local targetConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function disconnectTarget()
		if targetConn ~= nil then
			targetConn:Disconnect()
			targetConn = nil
		end
	end
	local function unmount()
		if done then
			return
		end
		done = true
		disconnectTarget()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	root:onDestroy(disconnectTarget)
	if target ~= nil and kindOf(target) == "Instance" then
		targetConn = (target :: Instance).Destroying:Once(unmount)
	end
	return unmount
end

return table.freeze({
	edit = editInstance,
	new = new,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` inside a new root [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes), mounts the returned UI into `target` (or mounts returned portals when `target` is omitted), and returns an idempotent `unmount` function. Never destroys `target`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/roblox/creation#mounting-a-root-flux-mount)
	]]
	mount = mount,
	portal = Bind.portal,
	Flags = Flags,
	Defaults = Defaults,
	Find = Find,
	--[[
	Partitions `props` into one table per `keys` group plus a final table holding every remaining key, leaving `props`
	untouched. Pass a `Flux.prop()` / `Flux.own()` schema or an annotated key-literal array (`{ "label" | "onClick" }`)
	to preserve exact `Pick` and `Omit` types on a single group.

	```luau
	local OWN = {
		label = Flux.prop() :: Flux.Reactive<string>,
		onClick = Flux.prop() :: ((...any) -> ())?,
	}
	local own, rest = Flux.split(props, OWN)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#splitting-props-with-flux-split)
	]]
	split = split :: Split,
	--[[
	Marks a key in a component prop schema for `Flux.split`; cast a bare call to declare the type (`Flux.prop() :: Flux.Reactive<string>`), or pass `default` (`Flux.prop(16)`) to fill missing/`nil` values automatically.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#splitting-props-with-flux-split)
	]]
	prop = prop :: Prop,
	--[[
	Merges one or more component prop schemas into a single frozen schema table for `Flux.Props` and `Flux.split`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#splitting-props-with-flux-split)
	]]
	own = own :: Own,
	--[[
	Returns a shallow read-only live view merging 1-4 prop tables left-to-right where the rightmost non-`nil` value wins
	per key. Nest `{ base, rest }` arrays or chain `Flux.edit` to combine children and directives instead.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#merging-props-with-flux-merge)
	]]
	merge = merge :: MergeProps,
})

-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — init.server (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- Bootstrap: builds the world, wires remotes, handles player actions.
-- The server owns every transfer; the client can only request.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local Economy = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Economy"))
local Bases = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Bases"))
local Spawner = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Spawner"))
local Events = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Events"))

-- Remotes (folder created by default.project.json)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local juiceRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
juiceRemote.Name = "Juice"
juiceRemote.Parent = remotes
local stateRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
stateRemote.Name = "State"
stateRemote.Parent = remotes
local actionRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
actionRemote.Name = "Action"
actionRemote.Parent = remotes

-- World
local world = Instance.new("Model")
world.Name = "World"
world.Parent = workspace

local function part(name, size, color, material, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = world
	return p
end

-- Lighting: deep water at night, lit by the disco.
local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(10, 40, 60)
lighting.Brightness = 1.6
lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(8, 30, 50)
lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(7, 34, 58)
lighting.FogStart = 60
lighting.FogEnd = 220
lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Future

-- Ocean floor
local floor = part("OceanFloor", Vector3.new(240, 2, 240), Config.PALETTE.DeepWater, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
floor.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)

-- Dance floor: 8x8 neon tiles in the center.
local tileColors = {
	Config.PALETTE.Coral, Config.PALETTE.Aqua, Config.PALETTE.Lime,
	Config.PALETTE.Pink, Config.PALETTE.Gold, Config.PALETTE.Purple,
}
for row = 1, 8 do
	for col = 1, 8 do
		local tile = part("DanceTile", Vector3.new(5, 0.5, 5), tileColors[(row + col - 1) % #tileColors + 1], Enum.Material.Neon)
		tile.Position = Vector3.new((col - 4.5) * 5.2, 0.25, (row - 4.5) * 5.2)
	end
end

-- Disco ball: faceted metal sphere + point light, slowly rotating.
local ball = part("DiscoBall", Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Ball)
ball.Reflectance = 0.7
ball.Position = Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)
local ballLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
ballLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255)
ballLight.Range = 90
ballLight.Brightness = 2
ballLight.Parent = ball
local rod = part("BallRod", Vector3.new(0.4, 10, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80), Enum.Material.Metal)
rod.Position = Vector3.new(0, 33, 0)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	ball.CFrame = ball.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, dt * 0.4, 0)
end)

-- Coral + kelp decorations around the edges.
local coralColors = { Config.PALETTE.Coral, Config.PALETTE.Pink, Config.PALETTE.Purple, Config.PALETTE.Gold }
for i = 1, 12 do
	local a = (i - 1) / 12 * math.pi * 2 + 0.3
	local r = 100 + (i % 3) * 8
	local coral = part("Coral", Vector3.new(3, 6 + (i % 4) * 2, 3), coralColors[(i - 1) % #coralColors + 1], Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	coral.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 2, math.sin(a) * r)
end
for i = 1, 16 do
	local a = (i - 1) / 16 * math.pi * 2 + 0.15
	local r = 88 + (i % 4) * 6
	local kelp = part("Kelp", Vector3.new(0.6, 10 + (i % 5) * 3, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 110), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	kelp.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 5 + (i % 5) * 1.5, math.sin(a) * r)
end

-- Escape portal for the Net Nabber (north edge).
local portal = part("Portal", Vector3.new(10, 12, 1), Config.PALETTE.Purple, Enum.Material.Neon)
portal.Position = Vector3.new(0, 6, -95)

-- Plots + conveyor
Bases.buildPlots(world)
Spawner.buildConveyor(world)
Events.init(world, juiceRemote)

-- Player lifecycle
local function onCharacterAdded(player, char)
	local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Economy.walkSpeed(player)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		Bases.dropCarried(player)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	Economy.load(player)
	local plotIndex = Bases.assign(player)
	if not plotIndex then
		player:Kick("All disco plots are full — try again soon!")
		return
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		onCharacterAdded(player, char)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacterAdded(player, player.Character)
	end
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	Economy.clearOnLeave(player)
	Bases.freePlot(player)
end)

-- Actions from the client. Every action is validated server-side.
actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg1)
	if typeof(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local s = Economy.getState(player)

	if action == "deposit" then
		local plot = Bases.getPlot(player)
		if not plot or not root then
			return
		end
		if (root.Position - plot.position).Magnitude > 30 then
			return
		end
		local owned = Bases.deposit(player)
		if owned then
			juiceRemote:FireClient(player, "deposit", owned.income)
			stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
		end
	elseif action == "sell" then
		local plot = Bases.getPlot(player)
		if not plot or not root then
			return
		end
		if (root.Position - plot.sellPad.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
			return
		end
		local payout = Bases.sell(player)
		if payout then
			juiceRemote:FireClient(player, "deposit", payout)
			stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
		end
	elseif action == "buyUpgrade" then
		if typeof(arg1) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local upgrade = nil
		for _, u in ipairs(Config.UPGRADES) do
			if u.id == arg1 then
				upgrade = u
				break
			end
		end
		if not upgrade then
			return
		end
		local level = s.Upgrades[upgrade.id] or 0
		if level >= upgrade.maxLevel then
			return
		end
		local cost = Config.upgradeCost(upgrade, level + 1)
		if s.Bubbles < cost then
			return
		end
		s.Bubbles -= cost
		s.Upgrades[upgrade.id] = level + 1
		if upgrade.id == "fins" and char then
			local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = Economy.walkSpeed(player)
			end
		end
		stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
	elseif action == "lock" then
		if os.clock() < s.LockCooldownUntil then
			return
		end
		s.LockUntil = os.clock() + Config.LOCK_DURATION
		s.LockCooldownUntil = os.clock() + Config.LOCK_COOLDOWN
		stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
	elseif action == "rebirth" then
		if s.EarnedSinceRebirth < Config.REBIRTH_REQUIRE_EARNED or s.Rebirths >= Config.REBIRTH_MAX then
			return
		end
		Bases.clearBase(player)
		s.Bubbles = 0
		s.EarnedSinceRebirth = 0
		s.Rebirths += 1
		juiceRemote:FireClient(player, "event", "REBIRTH!", "+" .. tostring(Config.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER * 100) .. "% income forever", Config.PALETTE.Gold)
		stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
	elseif action == "claimQuest" then
		if typeof(arg1) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local quest = nil
		for _, q in ipairs(Config.QUESTS) do
			if q.id == arg1 then
				quest = q
				break
			end
		end
		if not quest then
			return
		end
		local qstate = s.Quests[quest.id] or {}
		if qstate.claimed then
			return
		end
		if Economy.questProgress(player, quest) < quest.target then
			return
		end
		qstate.claimed = true
		s.Quests[quest.id] = qstate
		Economy.addBubbles(player, quest.reward)
		stateRemote:FireClient(player, Economy.snapshot(player))
	end
end)

-- Start the loops.
Economy.start(stateRemote)
Spawner.start()
Events.start()

-- PlayerState.luau — the one place that holds every player's state:
-- cash, lifetime earned, rebirths, multiplier, carried brainrot, owned
-- pedestals, base assignment and base lock. Every other server module
-- reads and writes player state through here, never its own copy.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)

local PlayerState = {}

local players = {} -- [Player] = state table

function PlayerState.initPlayer(player, baseIndex)
	local state = {
		cash = Config.START_CASH,
		lifetimeEarned = 0,
		rebirths = 0,
		multiplier = 1,
		baseIndex = baseIndex,
		carried = nil, -- Model the player carries above their head, or nil
		owned = {}, -- [pedestalSlot] = { model, row, mutation, rate, price }
		lockedUntil = 0, -- os.clock() timestamp, 0 = not locked
		lockCooldownUntil = 0,
	}
	players[player] = state

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local cashValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashValue.Name = "Cash"
	cashValue.Value = state.cash
	cashValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local incomeValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	incomeValue.Name = "Income"
	incomeValue.Value = 0
	incomeValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local rebirthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirthValue.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirthValue.Value = 0
	rebirthValue.Parent = leaderstats

	state.leaderstats = leaderstats
	return state
end

function PlayerState.removePlayer(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state then
		if state.carried and state.carried.Parent then
			state.carried:Destroy()
		end
		players[player] = nil
	end
end

function PlayerState.get(player)
	return players[player]
end

function PlayerState.getAllPlayers()
	local list = {}
	for player, _ in pairs(players) do
		table.insert(list, player)
	end
	return list
end

function PlayerState.getCash(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.cash or 0
end

-- Adds cash; positive amounts also count toward lifetime earned (rebirth progress).
function PlayerState.addCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.cash += amount
	if amount > 0 then
		state.lifetimeEarned += amount
	end
	local cashValue = state.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cashValue then
		cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
end

function PlayerState.spendCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state or state.cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	state.cash -= amount
	local cashValue = state.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cashValue then
		cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
	return true
end

function PlayerState.getIncomeRate(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local total = 0
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		total += record.rate
	end
	return math.floor(total * state.multiplier + 0.5)
end

function PlayerState.getMultiplier(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.multiplier or 1
end

function PlayerState.getLifetimeEarned(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.lifetimeEarned or 0
end

function PlayerState.getRebirths(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.rebirths or 0
end

function PlayerState.getBaseIndex(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.baseIndex or 1
end

function PlayerState.getCarried(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.carried or nil
end

function PlayerState.setCarried(player, model)
	local state = players[player]
	if state then
		state.carried = model
	end
end

function PlayerState.setOwned(player, slot, record)
	local state = players[player]
	if state then
		state.owned[slot] = record
	end
end

function PlayerState.clearOwnedSlot(player, slot)
	local state = players[player]
	if state then
		state.owned[slot] = nil
	end
end

function PlayerState.clearOwned(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state then
		state.owned = {}
	end
end

function PlayerState.getOwned(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and state.owned or {}
end

function PlayerState.getOwnedCount(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, _ in pairs(state.owned) do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

-- Every occupied pedestal in the game, for the thief bots.
function PlayerState.getAllOwnedPedestals()
	local list = {}
	for player, state in pairs(players) do
		for slot, record in pairs(state.owned) do
			table.insert(list, { owner = player, baseIndex = state.baseIndex, slot = slot, record = record })
		end
	end
	return list
end

function PlayerState.isBaseLocked(player)
	local state = players[player]
	return state and os.clock() < state.lockedUntil or false
end

function PlayerState.getLockRemaining(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0, 0
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	return math.max(0, state.lockedUntil - now), math.max(0, state.lockCooldownUntil - now)
end

-- Locks the player's base for LOCK_DURATION_S. Returns true, or false + reason.
function PlayerState.lockBase(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return false, "no-state"
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < state.lockedUntil then
		return false, "already-locked"
	end
	if now < state.lockCooldownUntil then
		return false, "cooldown"
	end
	state.lockedUntil = now + Config.LOCK_DURATION_S
	state.lockCooldownUntil = state.lockedUntil + Config.LOCK_COOLDOWN_S
	return true
end

-- Rebirth reset: cash back to start, brainrots cleared by the caller,
-- rebirths +1, multiplier x1.25. Returns the new multiplier.
function PlayerState.applyRebirth(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 1
	end
	state.cash = Config.START_CASH
	state.lifetimeEarned = 0
	state.rebirths += 1
	state.multiplier *= Config.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER
	state.carried = nil
	local cashValue = state.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cashValue then
		cashValue.Value = state.cash
	end
	local rebirthValue = state.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
	if rebirthValue then
		rebirthValue.Value = state.rebirths
	end
	return state.multiplier
end

function PlayerState.setIncomeLeaderstat(player, income)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local incomeValue = state.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Income")
	if incomeValue then
		incomeValue.Value = income
	end
end

return PlayerState

-- PirateState.luau
-- The single store for all player state. Every player's money, base, deck,
-- lock, rebirths, collection, upgrades, bounties, and carried brainrot live
-- here. No other script keeps player state of its own; every other server
-- module reads and mutates state only through this module's functions
-- (or through the state record returned by getState).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")

local BootyCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("BootyCatalog"))

local PirateState = {}

-- Module-level tables.
local players = {} -- player -> state record
local baseOccupants = { A = 0, B = 0 }
local pedestalModels = {} -- player -> slot -> pedestal Model

-- The LagoonUpdate RemoteEvent is created by init.server before any require.
-- Reuse it; only create it here if it does not already exist.
local LagoonUpdate = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("LagoonUpdate")
if not LagoonUpdate then
	LagoonUpdate = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	LagoonUpdate.Name = "LagoonUpdate"
	LagoonUpdate.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- The starting cash for every new player.
local STARTING_CASH = 250000
-- The cash a player is reset to after a rebirth.
local REBIRTH_CASH = 100
-- The base number of usable deck slots (before EXTRA PEDESTAL).
local BASE_DECK_SLOTS = 6
-- The absolute maximum number of deck slots.
local MAX_DECK_SLOTS = 8

-- Records the pedestal Model for a player's slot, creating the player's
-- sub-table if needed.
function PirateState.setPedestalModel(player, slot, model)
	if not pedestalModels[player] then
		pedestalModels[player] = {}
	end
	pedestalModels[player][slot] = model
end

-- Returns the recorded pedestal Model for a player's slot, or nil.
function PirateState.getPedestalModel(player, slot)
	local byPlayer = pedestalModels[player]
	if not byPlayer then
		return nil
	end
	return byPlayer[slot]
end

-- Destroys the recorded pedestal Model for a player's slot if any, and
-- clears the record.
function PirateState.destroyPedestalModel(player, slot)
	local byPlayer = pedestalModels[player]
	if not byPlayer then
		return
	end
	local model = byPlayer[slot]
	if model then
		model:Destroy()
	end
	byPlayer[slot] = nil
end

-- Sends a LagoonUpdate message to one player.
function PirateState.broadcast(player, payload)
	LagoonUpdate:FireClient(player, payload)
end

-- Sends a LagoonUpdate message to every player.
function PirateState.broadcastAll(payload)
	LagoonUpdate:FireAllClients(payload)
end

-- Assigns the less-occupied base (ties go to A) and increments its
-- occupant count. Returns "A" or "B".
function PirateState.assignBase()
	local base = "A"
	if baseOccupants.B < baseOccupants.A then
		base = "B"
	end
	baseOccupants[base] = baseOccupants[base] + 1
	return base
end

-- Creates the state record for a player joining the server and returns it.
function PirateState.initPlayerState(player)
	local state = {
		cash = STARTING_CASH,
		base = PirateState.assignBase(),
		slots = {},
		lockUntil = 0,
		lockCooldownUntil = 0,
		rebirths = 0,
		found = {},
		upgrades = { speed = 0, income = 0, lock = 0, slots = 0 },
		bounties = {},
		bountiesDone = {},
		carrying = nil,
	}
	for slot = 1, MAX_DECK_SLOTS do
		state.slots[slot] = nil
	end
	players[player] = state
	return state
end

-- Removes a player's state: destroys all pedestal models and the carried
-- model if any, decrements the base occupant count (never below 0), and
-- removes the record.
function PirateState.removePlayerState(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	for slot = 1, MAX_DECK_SLOTS do
		PirateState.destroyPedestalModel(player, slot)
	end
	local carrying = state.carrying
	if carrying and carrying.model then
		carrying.model:Destroy()
	end
	if state.base and baseOccupants[state.base] then
		baseOccupants[state.base] = math.max(0, baseOccupants[state.base] - 1)
	end
	players[player] = nil
	pedestalModels[player] = nil
end

-- Returns the state record for a player, or nil.
function PirateState.getState(player)
	return players[player]
end

-- Returns the player's current cash, or 0 if there is no state.
function PirateState.getCash(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	return state.cash
end

-- Adds cash and broadcasts a cash message (cash + current income per second).
function PirateState.addCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.cash = state.cash + amount
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "cash",
		cash = state.cash,
		income = PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player),
	})
end

-- Deducts cash if the player can afford it. Returns false (and changes
-- nothing) if cash is insufficient; otherwise deducts, broadcasts a cash
-- message, and returns true.
function PirateState.spendCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	if state.cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	state.cash = state.cash - amount
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "cash",
		cash = state.cash,
		income = PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player),
	})
	return true
end

-- Returns 2 ^ rebirths (1 if there is no state).
function PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 1
	end
	return 2 ^ state.rebirths
end

-- Returns the income per second: floor of (sum over occupied slots of that
-- brainrot's income at its mutation and the player's rebirth multiplier)
-- x (1 + 0.10 x GOLDEN COMPASS level) x (Golden Tide multiplier, 2 or 1).
-- Returns 0 if there is no state.
function PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local multiplier = PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player)
	local total = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
		if slot and slot.defId then
			local def = BootyCatalog.getBrainrotDefinition(slot.defId)
			if def then
				total = total + BootyCatalog.calculateBrainrotIncome(def, slot.mutation, multiplier)
			end
		end
	end
	local compassLevel = PirateState.getUpgradeLevel(player, "income")
	local compassFactor = 1 + 0.10 * compassLevel
	-- Lazy require: StormService requires PirateState at top level, so a
	-- top-level require here would be a circular require that errors on
	-- live Roblox ("requested module was required recursively").
	local StormService = require(script.Parent.StormService)
	local tideMultiplier = StormService.getGoldenTideMultiplier()
	return math.floor(total * compassFactor * tideMultiplier)
end

-- Returns the lowest empty slot number within the usable cap
-- (6 + EXTRA PEDESTAL level, at most 8), or nil if the deck is full.
function PirateState.getFreeSlot(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return nil
	end
	local cap = math.min(BASE_DECK_SLOTS + PirateState.getUpgradeLevel(player, "slots"), MAX_DECK_SLOTS)
	for slot = 1, cap do
		if state.slots[slot] == nil then
			return slot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Assigns a brainrot to a slot. Fails (false) if there is no state or the
-- slot is already occupied; otherwise records { defId, mutation }, marks the
-- brainrot found, broadcasts a slots message, and returns true.
function PirateState.assignBrainrotToSlot(player, slot, defId, mutation)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	if state.slots[slot] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	state.slots[slot] = { defId = defId, mutation = mutation }
	PirateState.markFound(player, defId)
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "slots",
		slots = state.slots,
	})
	return true
end

-- Clears a slot, destroys its pedestal model, and broadcasts a slots
-- message. Returns the old slot entry (or nil).
function PirateState.clearBaseSlot(player, slot)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return nil
	end
	local old = state.slots[slot]
	state.slots[slot] = nil
	PirateState.destroyPedestalModel(player, slot)
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "slots",
		slots = state.slots,
	})
	return old
end

-- Sets the lock expiry, broadcasts a lock message with the remaining whole
-- seconds, and broadcasts a feed message to all players.
function PirateState.setBaseLockUntil(player, untilTime)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.lockUntil = untilTime
	local remaining = math.max(0, math.floor(untilTime - os.clock()))
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "lock",
		remaining = remaining,
	})
	PirateState.broadcastAll({
		type = "feed",
		text = player.Name .. "'s deck is LOCKED!",
		color = "blue",
	})
end

-- Returns true while the clock is before the player's lock expiry.
function PirateState.isBaseLocked(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	return os.clock() < state.lockUntil
end

-- Returns the remaining lock seconds (0 when not locked).
function PirateState.getBaseLockRemaining(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, state.lockUntil - os.clock())
end

-- Applies a rebirth: rebirths +1, cash reset to $100, all 8 slots cleared
-- and their pedestal models destroyed, and a rebirth message broadcast
-- carrying rebirths, the new multiplier, cash, the (now empty) slots table,
-- and the reset income per second.
function PirateState.incrementRebirth(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.rebirths = state.rebirths + 1
	state.cash = REBIRTH_CASH
	for slot = 1, MAX_DECK_SLOTS do
		state.slots[slot] = nil
		PirateState.destroyPedestalModel(player, slot)
	end
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "rebirth",
		rebirths = state.rebirths,
		multiplier = PirateState.getRebirthMultiplier(player),
		cash = state.cash,
		slots = state.slots,
		income = PirateState.getIncomePerSecond(player),
	})
end

-- Marks a brainrot as found in the Captain's Log. If it was not already
-- found, adds it to the found set and broadcasts an index message.
function PirateState.markFound(player, defId)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	if state.found[defId] then
		return
	end
	state.found[defId] = true
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "index",
		found = state.found,
		foundCount = PirateState.getFoundCount(player),
	})
end

-- Returns the number of distinct brainrots found in the Captain's Log.
function PirateState.getFoundCount(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(state.found) do
		count = count + 1
	end
	return count
end

-- Returns the player's level for an upgrade key (0 if no state or unset).
function PirateState.getUpgradeLevel(player, key)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return 0
	end
	return state.upgrades[key] or 0
end

-- Sets the player's level for an upgrade key and broadcasts an upgrades
-- message with the whole upgrade table.
function PirateState.setUpgradeLevel(player, key, level)
	local state = players[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.upgrades[key] = level
	PirateState.broadcast(player, {
		type = "upgrades",
		upgrades = state.upgrades,
	})
end

return PirateState

-- RebirthSystem.luau — when a player's lifetime earned reaches
-- REBIRTH_THRESHOLD, the HUD shows a REBIRTH button. Rebirth resets cash
-- and brainrots and grants a permanent +25% money multiplier (stacks up to
-- 5 rebirths) plus a golden aura on the player.

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
local CarryAndPlace = require(script.Parent.CarryAndPlace)

local RebirthSystem = {}

-- Set by init.server.luau: the Remotes folder (ToastMessage, SoundEvent).
RebirthSystem.Remotes = nil

function RebirthSystem.canRebirth(player)
	local state = PlayerState.get(player)
	if not state then
		return false
	end
	return state.lifetimeEarned >= Config.REBIRTH_THRESHOLD and state.rebirths < Config.REBIRTH_MAX
end

function RebirthSystem.doRebirth(player)
	if not RebirthSystem.canRebirth(player) then
		return false
	end
	CarryAndPlace.dropCarried(player)
	CarryAndPlace.clearPlayerPedestals(player)
	local multiplier = PlayerState.applyRebirth(player)

	-- Golden aura: a warm light and sparkles on the character.
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Name = "RebirthAura"
			light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
			light.Brightness = 2
			light.Range = 12
			light.Parent = root
			local sparkles = Instance.new("Sparkles")
			sparkles.Name = "RebirthSparkles"
			sparkles.SparkleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
			sparkles.Parent = root
		end
	end

	if RebirthSystem.Remotes then
		local toastRemote = RebirthSystem.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ToastMessage")
		if toastRemote then
			toastRemote:FireClient(player, "REBIRTH! Penghasilan x" .. string.format("%.2f", multiplier))
		end
		local soundRemote = RebirthSystem.Remotes:FindFirstChild("SoundEvent")
		if soundRemote then
			soundRemote:FireClient(player, "rebirth")
		end
	end
	return true
end

return RebirthSystem
