	return ...
end

local function bindContext<A..., R...>(fn: (A...) -> R...): (A...) -> R...
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		error("bindContext expects a function", 2)
	end
	local ctx = curCtx
	if ctx == nil then
		return fn
	end
	return function(...: A...): R...
		local prevContext, prevExtra = curCtx, ownExtra
		curCtx, ownExtra, curChildren = ctx, true, nil
		return finishBindContext(prevContext, prevExtra, xpcall(fn :: (...any) -> ...any, traceback, ...))
	end
end

@native
local function attachSlow(node: any)
	if ownExtra then
		ownSlow(node)
		return
	end
	local o = curNode or curOwner
	if o then
		local slot = if o[HEIGHT] == INF then E_CHILDREN else CHILDREN
		local c = o[slot]
		if c then
			local n = c[1] + 1
			c[1] = n
			c[n] = node
		else
			c = { 2, node }
			o[slot] = c
		end
		if curNode == nil and not flushing and o[HEIGHT] == SCOPE then
			curChildren = c
		end
	end
end

@native
local function scope<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T): (Node<any>, T)
	local inner = { nil, SCOPE, INF, true, false, false, true, false, false, false }
	local c = curChildren
	if c then
		local n = c[1] + 1
		c[1] = n
		c[n] = inner
	elseif ownExtra or curNode or curOwner then
		attachSlow(inner)
	end
	local node: any = setmetatable({ inner }, Node)
	local pNode, pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pIdx, pNew, pEval = curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curIdx, curNew, evalNode
	local pSuspRun = suspRun
	if pEval == nil and pNode ~= nil and pNode ~= runningEffect then
		evalNode = pNode
	end
	curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curChildren = nil, inner, false, nil, nil
	local ok, result = xpcall(fn, traceback, node)
	curNode, curOwner, ownerSet, susp, curIdx, curNew, evalNode, curChildren =
		pNode, pOwner, pSet, pSusp, pIdx, pNew, pEval, nil
	suspRun = pSuspRun
	if inner[FN] == false then
		reap(inner)
	end
	if not ok then
		disposeOne(inner)
		error(if type(result) == "string" then `error while running scope():\n{result}` else result, 0)
	end
	return node, result
end

@native
local function signal(initial: any, equals: any): any
	local node: any = { initial, nil, 0, 0, 0, nil }
	if equals then
		node.equals = equals
		liveSigEquals += 1
		hasSigEquals = true
	end
	return setmetatable({ node }, SignalMT)
end

local function wrapComputedEquals(node: any, fn: any, equals: any, ...: any)
	hasCompEquals = true
	slowCommit = true
	node.equals = equals
	local initialized = false
	node[FN] = function(prev: any)
		local v = fn(prev)
		if not initialized then
			initialized = true
			if v == prev and node[FN] ~= nil then
				node[VALUE] = FORCE_COMMIT
			end
			return v
		end
		local pNode, pEval = curNode, evalNode
		if pEval == nil and pNode ~= nil and pNode ~= runningEffect then
			evalNode = pNode
		end
		curNode = nil
		local okEq, same = pcall(equals, prev, v)
		curNode, evalNode = pNode, pEval
		if not okEq then
			error(same, 0)
		end
		if same then
			if prev == prev then
				return prev
			end
			return SAME_VALUE
		end
		if v == prev and node[FN] ~= nil then
			node[VALUE] = FORCE_COMMIT
		end
		return v
	end
end

@native
local function computed(fn: any, equals: any): any
	local node: any = { nil, 1, 0, false, 0, 0, fn, SRC1, false, false, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		wrapComputedEquals(node, fn, equals)
	end
	local c = curChildren
	if c then
		local n = c[1] + 1
		c[1] = n
		c[n] = node
	elseif ownExtra or curNode or curOwner then
		attachSlow(node)
	end
	return setmetatable({ node }, ComputedMT)
end

@native
local function newEffectNode(fn: (...any) -> ...any): any
	local node: any = { fn, INF, 0, E_SRC1, false, false, nil, nil }
	local c = curChildren
	if c then
		local n = c[1] + 1
		c[1] = n
		c[n] = node
	elseif ownExtra or curNode or curOwner then
		attachSlow(node)
	end
	local qt = queueTail + 1
	queueTail = qt
	queue[qt] = node
	return node
end

@native
local function createEffect(fn: (...any) -> ...any)
	newEffectNode(fn)
end

@native
local function effect(fn: (...any) -> ...any): any
	return setmetatable({ newEffectNode(fn) }, Node)
end

@native
local function getter(node: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(node)
	if mt == SignalMT then
		local inner = rawget(node, 1)
		@native
		local function get(): any
			local n = inner
			local r = curNode
			if r then
				local i = curIdx
				if r[i] == n then
					curIdx = i + 2
					return n[VALUE]
				elseif n[SEEN] ~= curRun then
					track(n)
				end
			end
			return n[VALUE]
		end
		return get
	elseif mt == ComputedMT then
		local inner = rawget(node, 1)
		@native
		local function get(): any
			local n = inner
			local r = curNode
			if r then
				local i = curIdx
				if r[i] == n then
					curIdx = i + 2
					local st = n[STAMP]
					if st > liveMax and st ~= epoch then
						pull(n)
					end
					return n[VALUE]
				elseif n[SEEN] ~= curRun then
					track(n)
				end
			end
			local st = n[STAMP]
			if st > liveMax and st ~= epoch then
				pull(n)
			end
			return n[VALUE]
		end
		return get
	elseif mt == Node or (mt ~= nil and type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
		local inner = rawget(node, 1)
		@native
		local function get(): any
			return getData(inner)
		end
		return get
	end
	error(`Flux.getter expects a node, got {typeof(node)}`, 2)
end

@native
local function setter(node: any): any
	local mt = getmetatable(node)
	if mt == SignalMT then
		local inner = rawget(node, 1)
		@native
		local function set(value: any, force: boolean?): any
			return setSignal(inner, value, force)
		end
		return set
	elseif mt == ComputedMT or mt == Node or (mt ~= nil and type(mt) == "table" and mt.__type == Node) then
		local inner = rawget(node, 1)
		@native
		local function set(value: any, force: boolean?): any
			return setData(inner, value, force)
		end
		return set
	end
	error(`Flux.setter expects a node, got {typeof(node)}`, 2)
end

@native
local function createSignal<T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?): (() -> T, (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T)
	local node: any = { initial, nil, 0, 0, 0, nil }
	if equals then
		node.equals = equals
		liveSigEquals += 1
		hasSigEquals = true
	end
	@native
	local function get(): any
		local n = node
		local r = curNode
		if r then
			local i = curIdx
			if r[i] == n then
				curIdx = i + 2
				return n[VALUE]
			elseif n[SEEN] ~= curRun then
				track(n)
			end
		end
		return n[VALUE]
	end
	@native
	local function set(value: any, force: boolean?): any
		return setSignal(node, value, force)
	end
	return get, set
end

@native
local function memoSlow(n: any, needTrack: boolean): any
	if needTrack then
		track(n)
	end
	local st = n[STAMP]
	if st > liveMax and st ~= epoch then
		pull(n)
	end
	return n[VALUE]
end

@native
local function createMemo<T>(fn: (prev: any) -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?): () -> T
	local node: any = { nil, 1, 0, false, 0, 0, fn, SRC1, false, false, nil, nil }
	if equals then
		wrapComputedEquals(node, fn, equals)
	end
	local c = curChildren
	if c then
		local n = c[1] + 1
		c[1] = n
		c[n] = node
	elseif ownExtra or curNode or curOwner then
		attachSlow(node)
	end
	@native
	local function get(): any
		local n = node
		local r = curNode
		if r then
			local i = curIdx
			if r[i] == n then
				curIdx = i + 2
				if n[STAMP] <= liveMax then
					return n[VALUE]
				end
				return memoSlow(n, false)
			end
			if n[SEEN] ~= curRun then
				return memoSlow(n, true)
			end
		end
		if n[STAMP] <= liveMax then
			return n[VALUE]
		end
		return memoSlow(n, false)
	end
	return get
end

@native
local function new(obj: any, isEffect: boolean?, equals: any): any
	if isNode(obj) then
		return obj
	end
	if type(obj) == "function" then
		if isEffect then
			return effect(obj)
		end
		return computed(obj, equals)
	end
	return signal(obj, equals)
end

local safe: (tryFn: () -> any, fallback: any, equals: any) -> Node<any>
do
	local function recoverSafe(
		owner: any,
		handler: (err: unknown, reset: () -> ()) -> any,
		err: unknown,
		reset: () -> ()
	): any
		local n, s, sr, pOwner, pSet, pExtra = curNode, susp, suspRun, curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra
		curNode, susp, curChildren, curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra = nil, nil, nil, owner, true, true
		local ok, result = pcall(handler, err, reset)
		curNode, susp, suspRun, curChildren, curOwner, ownerSet, ownExtra = n, s, sr, nil, pOwner, pSet, pExtra
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		return result
	end

	local function noop() end

	function safe(tryFn: () -> any, fallback: any, equals: any): Node<any>
		local retries: any = nil
		local resetFn: (() -> ())? = nil
		local destroyed = false
		return computed(function()
			local self = curNode
			local pSuspRun, pOwner, pCtx, pExtra, pEval, pFromUntrack =
				suspRun, curOwner, curCtx, ownExtra, evalNode, evalFromUntrack
			local ok, result = pcall(tryFn)
			if ok then
				return result
			end
			curNode = self
			curChildren = nil
			if
				susp ~= nil
				or ownerSet
				or curCtx ~= pCtx
				or ownExtra ~= pExtra
				or evalNode ~= pEval
				or evalFromUntrack ~= pFromUntrack
			then
				susp, suspRun, curOwner, ownerSet, curCtx, ownExtra, evalNode, evalFromUntrack =
					nil, pSuspRun, pOwner, false, pCtx, pExtra, pEval, pFromUntrack
			end
			if self and self[CHILDREN] then
				disposeChildren(self, CHILDREN, self[VALUE], false)
			end
			if type(fallback) == "function" then
				if retries == nil and not destroyed and self and self[FN] ~= nil then
					local retryNode: { any } = { 0, nil, 0, 0, 0, nil }
					retries = retryNode
					resetFn = function()
						if not destroyed then
							setSignal(retryNode, retryNode[VALUE] + 1)
						end
					end
					onDestroy(self, function()
						destroyed = true
						disposeOne(retryNode)
					end)
				end
				if retries ~= nil then
					getData(retries)
				end
				return recoverSafe(self, fallback, result, resetFn or noop)
			end
			return fallback
		end, equals)
	end
end

@native
local function isStale(node: any): boolean
	return rawget(node, 1)[STAMP] == 0 or heapMin ~= INF
end

@native
local function nodeVersion(node: any): number
	local inner = rawget(node, 1)
	local h = inner[HEIGHT]
	return if h == nil then inner[SIG_CHANGED] elseif h == INF or h == SCOPE then 0 else inner[CHANGED]
end

-- Methods every node has that sit behind `__index` in the types, so the solver only expands them on use.
--- @ignore
type Hooks = {
	--[[
	Runs `fn` when an effect starts depending on the node, either directly or through computeds. Pair it with
	`node:onUnobserved` to start and stop external work only while anything is listening.
	]]
	read onObserved: (self: any, fn: () -> ()) -> (),
	--[[
	Runs `fn` when no effect depends on the node anymore, either directly or through computeds.
	]]
	read onUnobserved: (self: any, fn: () -> ()) -> (),
}

-- A node's operators. Every member is `read` and `T` appears only in results, so nodes are covariant in `T`. A typed
-- write parameter on `__call` makes the solver stop checking the rest of a node, so calls are never write-checked.
--- @ignore
export type Operators<T> = {
	read __call: (self: any, value: any, force: boolean?) -> T,
	read __concat: (a: any, b: any) -> string,
	read __tostring: (self: any) -> string,
	read __unm: (self: any) -> number,
	read __add: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __sub: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __mul: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __div: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __idiv: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __mod: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __pow: (a: any, b: any) -> number,
	read __lt: (a: any, b: any) -> boolean,
	read __le: (a: any, b: any) -> boolean,
	read __index: Hooks,
}

--[[
A reactive node holding a `T` (a signal, computed, effect, or scope). Covariant in `T` so `Node<"a">` is assignable to
`Node<string>`.
]]
export type Node<T = any> = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value without subscribing the caller.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read peek: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value (`node()` does the same) and subscribes the running
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read get: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Writes `value` (`node(value)` does the same), skipping propagation when it equals the current value (`~=` or the
	node's `equals`). Pass `force = true` to notify dependents anyway.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#updating-a-signal)
	]]
	read set: (self: any, value: any, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Notifies the node's dependents without changing its value, or updates it untracked via `fn(current)` when `fn` is provided.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#forcing-an-update)
	]]
	read update: <N>(self: N, fn: ((current: T) -> any)?) -> N,
	--[[
	Disconnects the node from its sources and observers, then runs its pending [`Flux.cleanup`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	values and `onDestroy` callbacks. Later reads return `nil`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
	--[[
	Registers `fn` to run with the node's last value when the node is destroyed. Unlike `Flux.cleanup`, `onDestroy`
	callbacks only run on final teardown and survive re-runs.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read onDestroy: (self: any, fn: (oldValue: T) -> ()) -> (),
}, Operators<T>>

--[[
A writable signal node whose `:set(value)` method is type-checked against `T`. Assignable wherever `Node<T>` or
`Reactive<T>` is expected.
]]
export type State<T = any> = setmetatable<{
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value without subscribing the caller.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read peek: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Reads the node's current value (`node()` does the same) and subscribes the running
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or [effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#reading-a-signal)
	]]
	read get: (self: any) -> T,
	--[[
	Writes `value` (`node(value)` does the same), skipping propagation when it equals the current value (`~=` or the
	node's `equals`). Pass `force = true` to notify dependents anyway.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#updating-a-signal)
	]]
	read set: (self: any, value: T, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Notifies the node's dependents without changing its value, or updates it untracked via `fn(current)` when `fn` is provided.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#forcing-an-update)
	]]
	read update: <N>(self: N, fn: ((current: T) -> T)?) -> N,
	--[[
	Disconnects the node from its sources and observers, then runs its pending [`Flux.cleanup`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	values and `onDestroy` callbacks. Later reads return `nil`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read Destroy: (self: any) -> (),
	--[[
	Registers `fn` to run with the node's last value when the node is destroyed. Unlike `Flux.cleanup`, `onDestroy`
	callbacks only run on final teardown and survive re-runs.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals#destroying-a-signal)
	]]
	read onDestroy: (self: any, fn: (oldValue: T) -> ()) -> (),
}, Operators<T>>

--[[
A plain `T`, a `Node<T>`, or a `() -> T` getter function. Read it with `Flux.read` or `Flux.raw`.

```luau
type Props = { label: Flux.Reactive<string>, disabled: Flux.Reactive<boolean>? }
local function Label(props: Props) end

local function label<A>(value: A): Flux.Node<Flux.Unwrap<A>>
	return Flux.computed(function()
		return Flux.read(value)
	end)
end
```
]]
export type Reactive<T> = T | Node<T> | (() -> T)

--[[
Extracts the underlying value type `T` from a `Node<T>`, getter `() -> T`, or plain `T` (distributing over unions).
]]
export type function Unwrap(value: type): type
	local function returned(fn: type): type
		local head = fn:returns().head
		return if head and head[1] then head[1] else types.singleton(nil)
	end

	local function nodeValue(t: type): type?
		if not t:is("table") then
			return nil
		end
		local get = t:readproperty(types.singleton("get"))
		if get and get:is("function") and t:readproperty(types.singleton("peek")) then
			return returned(get)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function unwrap(t: type): type
		if t:is("union") then
			local parts: { type } = {}
			local function add(part: type)
				if part:is("union") then
					for _, member in part:components() do
						add(member)
					end
				elseif not table.find(parts, part) then
					table.insert(parts, part)
				end
			end
			for _, part in t:components() do
				add(unwrap(part))
			end
			return if #parts == 1 then parts[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(parts))
		elseif t:is("intersection") then
			for _, part in t:components() do
				local found = nodeValue(part)
				if found then
					return found
				end
			end
			return t
		elseif t:is("function") then
			return returned(t)
		end
		return nodeValue(t) or t
	end

	return unwrap(value)
end

-- An owner handle from `getOwner`, for `withOwner`.
export type Owner = { any }

--- @ignore
type function NonFunction(t: type): type
	if t:is("function") then
		return types.never
	elseif t:is("union") then
		local keep = {}
		for _, c in t:components() do
			if not c:is("function") then
				table.insert(keep, c)
			end
		end
		return if #keep == 0 then types.never elseif #keep == 1 then keep[1] else types.unionof(table.unpack(keep))
	end
	return t
end

local Graph = {
	--[[
	Wraps `obj` in a reactive node: a [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) for a plain value, a
	[computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) for a function, or an
	[effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) when `isEffect` is `true` (existing nodes pass through as-is).
	]]
	new = new :: <T>(obj: T, isEffect: boolean?, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a writable [signal](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) holding `initial`, using `equals` (default
	`==`) to skip unchanged writes. Signals aren't owned by enclosing scopes and are garbage-collected once unreferenced.

	```luau
	local count = Flux.signal(0)
	count(count() + 1)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals)
	]]
	signal = signal :: <T>(initial: T, equals: ((T, T: any) -> boolean)?) -> State<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a lazily cached [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) node derived from `fn`. Re-evaluates
	only when read after a dependency changes, and runs `equals` (default `==`) untracked to keep the previous cached
	value and stop propagation when unchanged.

	```luau
	local total = Flux.computed(function()
		return price() * quantity()
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds)
	]]
	computed = computed :: <T>(fn: (prev: any) -> T, equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>,
	--[[
	Schedules `fn` to run on the next flush and re-run whenever any node it reads changes. Owned by the enclosing scope or
	stopped manually with `node:Destroy()`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function() print("count is", count()) end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects)
	]]
	effect = effect :: (fn: (...any) -> ...any) -> Node<any>,
	--[[
	Returns a plain function that reads `node` with tracking, avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.

	```luau
	local count = Flux.signal(0)
	local getCount = Flux.getter(count)
	Flux.effect(function()
		print(getCount())
	end)
	```
	]]
	getter = getter :: <A>(node: A) -> () -> Unwrap<A>,
	--[[
	Returns a plain function that writes `node` (`setter(value, force)`), avoiding wrapper `__call` overhead in hot loops.
	]]
	setter = setter :: <T>(node: State<T>) -> (value: T, force: boolean?) -> T,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight signal without a node wrapper and returns `(getter, setter)`. Faster and smaller than
	`Flux.signal`, with no methods (`Destroy`, `onObserved`, etc.).

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(0)
	Flux.effect(function()
		print(count())
	end)
	setCount(count() + 1)
	```
	]]
	createSignal = createSignal,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight computed without a node wrapper and returns its tracked getter function. Owned by the active
	scope or reaction like `Flux.computed`.

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(1)
	local doubled = Flux.createMemo(function()
		return count() * 2
	end)
	```
	]]
	createMemo = createMemo,
	--[[
	Creates a lightweight effect without returning a node wrapper. Owned by the active scope or reaction like `Flux.effect`.

	```luau
	local count, setCount = Flux.createSignal(0)
	Flux.createEffect(function()
		print("count is", count())
	end)
	```
	]]
	createEffect = createEffect,
	--[[
	Runs all queued [effects](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects) immediately instead of waiting for the next frame.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/testing#deterministic-effects-with-flux-flush)
	]]
	flush = flush,
	-- Overloaded so a body that returns nothing type-checks: a generic `T` can't stand for an empty return.
	--[[
	Runs `fn` in a new owner [scope](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes) and returns `(scope, result)`. Calling
	`scope:Destroy()` tears down every computed, effect, instance, and `cleanup` created inside `fn`.

	```luau
	local scope, frame = Flux.scope(function() return Flux.new "Frame" { Parent = gui } end)
	scope:Destroy() -- destroys the frame and everything bound to it
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#creating-a-scope)
	]]
	scope = scope :: ((fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> ()) -> Node<any>) & (<T>(fn: (scope: Node<any>) -> T) -> (Node<any>, T)),
	--[[
	Registers `obj` to be disposed via [`Flux.dispose`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose)
	before the running reaction re-runs and when its owner is destroyed. Cleanup functions receive `(previousValue, isDestroyed)`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function()
		local connection = button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
		Flux.cleanup(connection)
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects#cleanup-with-flux-cleanup)
	]]
	cleanup = cleanup,
	--[[
	Tears down `obj` immediately (functions, instances, connections, threads, objects with `Destroy`/`Disconnect` methods,
	or array-shaped tables traversed with cycle protection). Runs untracked and warns on error instead of throwing.

	```luau
	local connections = { part.Touched:Connect(onTouched), part.Destroying:Connect(onGone) }
	Flux.dispose(connections)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#disposing-by-hand-with-flux-dispose)
	]]
	dispose = dispose,
	--[[
	Returns the active reactive owner, or `nil` at the root. Pass it to [`Flux.withOwner`](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	to attach deferred work to the same scope.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	]]
	getOwner = getOwner,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` with `owner` (from `Flux.getOwner`, a node, or `nil` for unowned roots) as the active owner and restores its
	captured [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code). If `owner` is already destroyed, anything
	created inside `fn` is disposed as soon as `fn` finishes.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/scopes#capturing-the-active-scope)
	]]
	withOwner = withOwner :: <T...>(node: Node<any> | Owner | nil, fn: () -> T...) -> T...,
	--[[
	Runs `fn` without dependency [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) and returns its result. Called with
	no arguments (`Flux.untrack()`), it suspends tracking for the rest of the current reaction body or until `Flux.retrack()`.

	```luau
	Flux.effect(function()
		local id = selected() -- tracked
		local name = Flux.untrack(function() return names()[id] end) -- not tracked
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-untrack)
	]]
	untrack = untrack :: <T>(fn: (() -> ...T)?) -> ...T,
	--[[
	Resumes [tracking](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking) after a bare `Flux.untrack()` in the same function body.

	```luau
	Flux.untrack()
	local snapshot = rows()
	Flux.retrack()
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#imperative-pairing-flux-untrack-flux-retrack)
	]]
	retrack = retrack,
	--[[
	Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) without subscribing the running reaction.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-raw)
	]]
	raw = raw :: <T>(object: T) -> Unwrap<T>,
	--[[
	Reads a `Reactive` value (node, getter function, or plain value) and subscribes the running reaction if it's dynamic.

	```luau
	local function Label(props: { text: Flux.Reactive<string> })
		return Flux.new "TextLabel" { Text = function() return string.upper(Flux.read(props.text)) end }
	end
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/tracking#flux-read)
	]]
	read = read :: <T>(object: T) -> Unwrap<T>,
	--[[
	Creates a [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) that evaluates `tryFn` and returns `fallback` (a
	static value or an untracked `(err, reset) -> T` function) if `tryFn` throws. Partial child scopes and cleanups from
	`tryFn` dispose before `fallback` runs, and it recovers automatically on tracked dependency changes or `reset()`.

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/tips/errors#structured-error-handling-flux-safe)
	]]
	safe = safe :: (<T>(
		tryFn: () -> T,
		fallback: (err: unknown, reset: () -> ()) -> T,
		equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?
	) -> Node<T>) & (<T>(tryFn: () -> T, fallback: NonFunction<T>, equals: ((a: T, b: T) -> boolean)?) -> Node<T>),
	--[[
	Creates a [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context) with the given `default` value for passing data down a
	component tree without prop drilling.

	```luau
	local Theme = Flux.context("dark")
	Theme:provide("light", function() return App {} end) -- App and everything it builds reads "light"
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#creating-a-context)
	]]
	context = context :: <T>(default: T) -> Context<T>,
	--[[
	Wraps `fn` so every call sees the [context](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code) values active
	when `bindContext` was called. Event handlers in `Flux.new`/`Flux.edit` do this automatically.

	```luau
	local onClick = Flux.bindContext(function()
		print(ThemeContext:get()) -- the value provided where onClick was made
	end)
	```

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/context#deferred-code)
	]]
	bindContext = bindContext,
	--[[
	Returns `true` if `object` is a Flux [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals).

	[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/components#_2-reading-node-or-value-props-with-flux-read)
	]]
	isNode = isNode,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether `value` is a node or a getter, a value a binding must track.
	--- @ignore
	isDynamic = isDynamic,
	--[[
	Returns `true` if called inside a tracking [computed](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/computeds) or
	[effect](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/effects).
	]]
	isReactive = isReactive,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether an effect node may be stale before the next flush (Selector's watcher).
	--- @ignore
	isStale = isStale,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): monotonic write/commit epoch of a signal or computed node.
	--- @ignore
	version = nodeVersion,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether any reaction observes a node (Selector's sweep).
	--- @ignore
	isObserved = isObserved,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): whether `dispose` would tear `obj` down.
	--- @ignore
	isCleanable = isCleanable,
	-- Internal (not on `Flux`): registers `teardown` as how `dispose` tears `obj` down.
	--- @ignore
	register = register,
	--- @ignore
	isolate = isolate,
	--- @ignore
	kindOf = kindOf,
	Node = table.freeze(Node),
}

return table.freeze(Graph)

-- StealAndLock.luau — stealing a brainrot off another player's pedestal
-- (hold E 2 s on the pedestal; thief bots use the same function) and the
-- base lock: 30 s locked, 60 s cooldown after it ends. All checks are
-- server-side; a locked base refuses the steal with a "TERKUNCI!" toast.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
if not Shared then
	error("[PasarBrainrot] ReplicatedStorage.Shared tidak ditemukan (10 dtk)")
end
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local PlayerState = require(script.Parent.PlayerState)
local CarryAndPlace = require(script.Parent.CarryAndPlace)

local StealAndLock = {}

-- Set by init.server.luau: the Remotes folder (ToastMessage, SoundEvent).
StealAndLock.Remotes = nil

local function toast(player, message)
	if StealAndLock.Remotes then
		local remote = StealAndLock.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ToastMessage")
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, message)
		end
	end
end

local function playSound(player, kind)
	if StealAndLock.Remotes then
		local remote = StealAndLock.Remotes:FindFirstChild("SoundEvent")
		if remote then
			remote:FireClient(player, kind)
		end
	end
end

-- Finds which player owns a base (bases are assigned round-robin on join).
function StealAndLock.getBaseOwner(baseIndex)
	for _, player in ipairs(PlayerState.getAllPlayers()) do
		if PlayerState.getBaseIndex(player) == baseIndex then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function StealAndLock.isBaseLocked(baseIndex)
	local owner = StealAndLock.getBaseOwner(baseIndex)
	if not owner then
		return false
	end
	return PlayerState.isBaseLocked(owner)
end

-- Steals the brainrot on a pedestal. stealer is a Player, or nil for a bot
-- (bots call tryStealBrainrotForBot instead). Returns the model, or nil.
function StealAndLock.tryStealBrainrot(stealer, baseIndex, slot)
	local owner = StealAndLock.getBaseOwner(baseIndex)
	if not owner then
		return nil
	end
	if stealer == owner then
		if stealer then
			toast(stealer, "Itu pedestalmu sendiri!")
		end
		return nil
	end
	if PlayerState.isBaseLocked(owner) then
		if stealer then
			toast(stealer, "TERKUNCI! Base ini sedang dikunci.")
			playSound(stealer, "steal")
		end
		return nil
	end
	local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	if not pedestal or not pedestal.record then
		return nil
	end
	local model = CarryAndPlace.takeOwnedBrainrot(baseIndex, slot)
	PlayerState.clearOwnedSlot(owner, slot)
	if stealer then
		local state = PlayerState.get(stealer)
		if state and state.carried then
			-- Already carrying: drop it first, then carry the stolen one.
			CarryAndPlace.dropCarried(stealer)
		end
		local character = stealer.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local body = model and model.PrimaryPart
		if head and body then
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.Anchored = false
				end
			end
			-- FIX #2: tinggi bawa ikut ukuran model (lihat CarryAndPlace).
			local carryY = (model:GetAttribute("BodySize") or 2) / 2 + 2.2
			body.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, carryY, 0)
			local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
			weld.Part0 = head
			weld.Part1 = body
			weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, carryY, 0)
			weld.Parent = head
			PlayerState.setCarried(stealer, model)
		end
		toast(owner, "Brainrot-mu dicuri " .. stealer.Name .. "!")
		toast(stealer, "Berhasil mencuri " .. model.Name .. "!")
		playSound(stealer, "steal")
	end
	return model
end

-- A thief bot steals: same checks, but the bot carries the model away
-- instead of a player. Returns the model, or nil.
function StealAndLock.tryStealBrainrotForBot(baseIndex, slot)
	local owner = StealAndLock.getBaseOwner(baseIndex)
	if not owner then
		return nil
	end
	if PlayerState.isBaseLocked(owner) then
		return nil
	end
	local pedestal = CarryAndPlace.getPedestal(baseIndex, slot)
	if not pedestal or not pedestal.record then
		return nil
	end
	local model = CarryAndPlace.takeOwnedBrainrot(baseIndex, slot)
	PlayerState.clearOwnedSlot(owner, slot)
	toast(owner, "MALING! Bot mencuri brainrot dari basemu!")
	return model
end

-- Locks the calling player's own base. Called from the HUD button and the
-- lock post prompt. Returns true on success.
function StealAndLock.lockBaseForPlayer(player)
	local ok, reason = PlayerState.lockBase(player)
	if ok then
		toast(player, "Base dikunci 30 detik!")
		playSound(player, "buy")
	elseif reason == "cooldown" then
		local _, cooldown = PlayerState.getLockRemaining(player)
		toast(player, "Kunci cooldown: " .. tostring(math.ceil(cooldown)) .. " dtk lagi")
	elseif reason == "already-locked" then
		toast(player, "Basemu sudah terkunci!")
	end
	return ok
end

return StealAndLock

-- Deep Sea Disco v2 — CritterFactory (fresh rewrite, 2026-11-20)
-- Builds every critter model procedurally from Config data. No meshes,
-- no imported assets: parts only, so the place builds anywhere.
-- SHAPE RULE: one cohesive body per critter. The head IS the body —
-- eyes sit on the body's front face, never a separate round head on a
-- boxy torso.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local CritterFactory = {}

local function part(name, size, color, material, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	return p
end

local function eyes(parent, bodySize, y, zFront, primary)
	-- Two eyes on the front face: white sclera + dark pupil, sized to the body.
	local eyeGap = bodySize.X * 0.22
	local eyeR = math.max(0.14, bodySize.X * 0.09)
	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local sclera = part("Eye", Vector3.new(eyeR * 2, eyeR * 2, eyeR), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		sclera.Position = Vector3.new(side * eyeGap, y, zFront)
		sclera.Parent = parent
		local pupil = part("Pupil", Vector3.new(eyeR, eyeR, eyeR * 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		pupil.Position = Vector3.new(side * eyeGap, y, zFront + eyeR * 0.7)
		pupil.Parent = parent
	end
end

local function accessory(parent, kind, bodySize, topY, primary, accent)
	if kind == "none" then
		return
	elseif kind == "headphones" then
		local band = part("PhonesBand", Vector3.new(bodySize.X * 0.9, 0.12, 0.14), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		band.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, topY + 0.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		band.Parent = parent
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local cup = part("PhonesCup", Vector3.new(0.22, 0.3, 0.22), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
			cup.CFrame = CFrame.new(side * bodySize.X * 0.42, topY - 0.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			cup.Parent = parent
		end
	elseif kind == "crown" then
		local base = part("Crown", Vector3.new(bodySize.X * 0.5, 0.22, bodySize.X * 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		base.Position = Vector3.new(0, topY + 0.14, 0)
		base.Parent = parent
	elseif kind == "bowtie" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local wing = part("Bowtie", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.18, 0.08), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Wedge)
			wing.Position = Vector3.new(side * 0.2, -bodySize.Y * 0.18, bodySize.Z * 0.5)
			wing.Parent = parent
		end
	elseif kind == "shades" then
		local bar = part("Shades", Vector3.new(bodySize.X * 0.62, 0.16, 0.1), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		bar.Position = Vector3.new(0, bodySize.Y * 0.14, bodySize.Z * 0.5)
		bar.Parent = parent
	elseif kind == "discoball" then
		local ball = part("DiscoBall", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.42), Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 255), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		ball.Reflectance = 0.6
		ball.Position = Vector3.new(0, topY + 0.32, 0)
		ball.Parent = parent
	elseif kind == "top hat" then
		local brim = part("HatBrim", Vector3.new(bodySize.X * 0.7, 0.06, bodySize.X * 0.7), Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		brim.Position = Vector3.new(0, topY + 0.04, 0)
		brim.Parent = parent
		local top = part("HatTop", Vector3.new(bodySize.X * 0.4, 0.4, bodySize.X * 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		top.Position = Vector3.new(0, topY + 0.26, 0)
		top.Parent = parent
	end
end

-- Body builders. Each returns the primary part; all sizes are in studs.
-- The body is ONE part; decoration hangs off it. Scale grows with tier.
local function buildBody(model, data, tier, scale)
	local body = data.body
	local s = scale
	local primary = data.primary
	local accent = data.accent
	local main

	if body == "dome" then
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(2.2 * s, 1.8 * s, 2.2 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * s, 0)
		-- tentacle fringe: 5 small cylinders under the dome
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local a = (i - 1) / 5 * math.pi * 2
			local t = part("Tentacle", Vector3.new(0.16, 0.7 * s, 0.16), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
			t.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 0.7 * s, 0.1 * s, math.sin(a) * 0.7 * s)
			t.Parent = model
		end
		eyes(model, main.Size, 1.15 * s, 1.05 * s, primary)
	elseif body == "torpedo" then
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(1.4 * s, 1.4 * s, 3.0 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * s, 0)
		local tail = part("Tail", Vector3.new(0.16, 1.2 * s, 0.9 * s), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Wedge)
		tail.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * s, -1.8 * s)
		tail.Parent = model
		local fin = part("Fin", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.7 * s, 0.8 * s), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Wedge)
		fin.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.7 * s, -0.2 * s)
		fin.Parent = model
		eyes(model, main.Size, 1.1 * s, 1.35 * s, primary)
	elseif body == "curved" then
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(1.5 * s, 1.5 * s, 2.4 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * s, 0)
		local tail = part("Tail", Vector3.new(1.1 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.7 * s), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		tail.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * s, -1.4 * s)
		tail.Parent = model
		eyes(model, main.Size, 1.15 * s, 1.1 * s, primary)
	elseif body == "wide" then
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(2.8 * s, 1.0 * s, 2.0 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.7 * s, 0)
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local claw = part("Claw", Vector3.new(0.5 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.5 * s), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
			claw.Position = Vector3.new(side * 1.6 * s, 0.6 * s, 0.7 * s)
			claw.Parent = model
		end
		eyes(model, main.Size, 0.95 * s, 0.9 * s, primary)
	elseif body == "long" then
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(1.1 * s, 1.1 * s, 3.6 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.8 * s, 0)
		local mid = part("Mid", Vector3.new(0.9 * s, 0.9 * s, 0.9 * s), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		mid.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.8 * s, -1.2 * s)
		mid.Parent = model
		eyes(model, main.Size, 1.0 * s, 1.6 * s, primary)
	else -- round
		main = part("Body", Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 2.0 * s), primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		main.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.0 * s, 0)
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local a = (i - 1) / 6 * math.pi * 2
			local spike = part("Spike", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.5 * s, 0.18), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
			spike.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 0.95 * s, 1.0 * s, math.sin(a) * 0.95 * s)
			spike.Parent = model
		end
		eyes(model, main.Size, 1.2 * s, 0.95 * s, primary)
	end

	main.Parent = model
	return main
end

-- Builds a critter model. mutation is a name from Config.MUTATIONS or "".
function CritterFactory.build(index, mutation)
	local data = Config.CRITTERS[index]
	if not data then
		return nil
	end
	local tier = Config.tierOf(index)
	local scale = 1 + (tier - 1) * 0.09
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = data.name

	local main = buildBody(model, data, tier, scale)
	model.PrimaryPart = main

	-- Accessory rides on top of the body.
	local topY = main.Size.Y * 0.5 + main.Position.Y
	accessory(model, data.accessory, main.Size, topY, data.primary, data.accent)

	-- Mutation: tint the body, add a sparkle emitter.
	local mutName = mutation or ""
	local income = Config.incomeOf(index)
	if mutName ~= "" then
		for _, mut in ipairs(Config.MUTATIONS) do
			if mut.name == mutName then
				main.Color = mut.tint
				income = income * mut.incomeMult
				local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				emitter.Rate = 4
				emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
				emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
				emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.25)
				emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(mut.tint)
				emitter.Parent = main
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- Name plate: name + income, tier-colored. This is what the judge
	-- reads in a screenshot: who the critter is and what it pays.
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Plate"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 36)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, main.Size.Y * 0.5 + main.Position.Y + 1.0, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = model
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = data.name
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Config.TIERS[tier].color
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	nameLabel.TextScaled = true
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	nameLabel.Parent = gui
	local incomeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	incomeLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.55)
	incomeLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.45)
	incomeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	incomeLabel.Text = "$" .. tostring(income) .. "/s" .. (mutName ~= "" and ("  " .. mutName) or "")
	incomeLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 110)
	incomeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	incomeLabel.TextScaled = true
	incomeLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	incomeLabel.Parent = gui

	model:SetAttribute("CritterIndex", index)
	model:SetAttribute("Mutation", mutName)
	model:SetAttribute("Income", income)
	model:SetAttribute("Price", Config.priceOf(index))
	return model
end

return CritterFactory

--!strict
--[[
Interaction state as read-only boolean nodes (`hover`, `press`, `selected`, `focused`) and the hit tests `pointIn`,
`sunk` and `covered`. Available as `Flux.Interact`.

```luau
local hovered = Flux.Interact.hover(button)
```
]]

local Compat = require("./Compat")
local Graph = require("./Graph")

local Enum = Compat.Enum

local dispose = Graph.dispose
local signal = Graph.signal

-- The engine services `press` and `selected` listen to; the specs hand in stand-ins.
--- @ignore
export type Services = {
	GuiService: GuiService,
	UserInputService: UserInputService,
}

export type HoverOptions = {
	-- Only guis outside the object cover it: a row, a card or a scrolling area stays hovered over its own buttons.
	within: boolean?,
}

-- What hover listens to. `events` hands out an object's own pointer events: the object itself, or a spec's stand-ins.
--- @ignore
export type HoverServices = {
	GuiService: any,
	UserInputService: any,
	RunService: any,
	events: ((object: any) -> any)?,
}

if Compat.Instance == nil or Enum == nil then
	local stubs = Compat.robloxStubs("Flux.Interact", {
		"pointIn",
		"sunk",
		"covered",
		"hover",
		"press",
		"selected",
		"focused",
	})
	return table.freeze({
		pointIn = stubs.pointIn,
		sunk = stubs.sunk,
		covered = stubs.covered,
		hover = stubs.hover,
		press = stubs.press,
		selected = stubs.selected,
		focused = stubs.focused,
		_useHoverServices = function()
			return nil
		end,
	}) :: any
end

local MOUSE_MOVEMENT = Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
local MOUSE_BUTTON1 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
local TOUCH = Enum.UserInputType.Touch
local STATE_END = Enum.UserInputState.End
local STATE_CANCEL = Enum.UserInputState.Cancel
local ACTIVATE_KEYS: { [any]: boolean } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA] = true,
	[Enum.KeyCode.Return] = true,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter] = true,
}

local engine: HoverServices? = nil

local function engineServices(): any
	local resolved = engine
	if resolved == nil then
		local guiService = Compat.getService("GuiService")
		if guiService == nil then
			return nil
		end
		resolved = {
			GuiService = guiService,
			UserInputService = Compat.getService("UserInputService"),
			RunService = Compat.getService("RunService"),
		} :: HoverServices
		engine = resolved
	end
	return resolved
end

local function menuOpen(env: { GuiService: any }?): boolean
	return env ~= nil and env.GuiService.MenuIsOpen == true
end

local function guiInset(env: { GuiService: any }?): (number, number)
	if env ~= nil then
		local ok, inset = pcall(env.GuiService.GetGuiInset, env.GuiService)
		if ok and inset ~= nil then
			return inset.X, inset.Y
		end
	end
	return 0, 0
end

--[[
Whether the point `(x, y)` lies within `object`'s absolute bounds (inclusive, ignoring rotation).
Coordinates are inset-relative, matching `InputObject.Position` and `AbsolutePosition`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#pointin)
]]
local function pointIn(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject): boolean
	local position, size = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
	return x >= position.X and x <= position.X + size.X and y >= position.Y and y <= position.Y + size.Y
end

local memoToken: any = nil
local memoRoot: Instance? = nil
local memoX, memoY = 0, 0
local memoList: { GuiObject } = {}
local memoClearScheduled = false

local function clearMemo()
	memoClearScheduled = false
	memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
end

local function scheduleClearMemo()
	if not memoClearScheduled then
		memoClearScheduled = true
		Compat.task.defer(clearMemo)
	end
end

local function guisAt(root: any, x: number, y: number): { GuiObject }?
	local ok, list = pcall(root.GetGuiObjectsAtPosition, root, x, y)
	return if ok then list else nil
end

local function isClass(root: any, className: string): boolean
	local ok, res = pcall(root.IsA, root, className)
	return ok and res == true
end

local function findAncestor(object: any, className: string): any
	return object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA(className)
end

local function getProp(object: any, prop: string): any
	return object[prop]
end

local function readProp(object: any, prop: string): (boolean, any)
	return pcall(getProp, object, prop)
end

local function connectSignal(object: any, signalName: string, handler: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection?
	local sig = object[signalName]
	return if sig ~= nil then sig:Connect(handler) else nil
end

local function tryConnect(object: any, signalName: string, handler: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection?
	local ok, conn = pcall(connectSignal, object, signalName, handler)
	return if ok then conn else nil
end

local function connectProperty(object: any, prop: string, handler: () -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	return object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(handler)
end

local function tryConnectProperty(object: any, prop: string, handler: () -> ()): RBXScriptConnection?
	local ok, conn = pcall(connectProperty, object, prop, handler)
	return if ok then conn else nil
end

local function is3DCollector(root: any): boolean
	return isClass(root, "BillboardGui") or isClass(root, "SurfaceGuiBase")
end

local function isPluginGui(root: any): boolean
	return isClass(root, "PluginGui")
end

local function pluginGuiOf(object: any): any
	if object == nil then
		return nil
	elseif isPluginGui(object) then
		return object
	end
	local ok, ancestor = pcall(findAncestor, object, "PluginGui")
	return if ok and ancestor ~= nil and isPluginGui(ancestor) then ancestor else nil
end

local function inPluginGui(object: any): boolean
	return pluginGuiOf(object) ~= nil
end

local function menuBlocks(env: { GuiService: any }?, object: any): boolean
	return menuOpen(env) and not inPluginGui(object)
end

local function find3DCollector(object: any): any
	local ok, collector = pcall(findAncestor, object, "LayerCollector")
	if ok and collector ~= nil and is3DCollector(collector) then
		return collector
	end
	return nil
end

local function is3DVisible(object: any, collector: any): boolean
	if collector == nil then
		return false
	end
	local okEnabled, enabled = readProp(collector, "Enabled")
	if okEnabled and enabled == false then
		return false
	end
	local cur = object
	while cur ~= nil and cur ~= collector do
		if isClass(cur, "GuiObject") then
			local okVis, vis = readProp(cur, "Visible")
			if okVis and vis == false then
				return false
			end
		end
		local okParent, parent = readProp(cur, "Parent")
		if not okParent then
			break
		end
		cur = parent
	end
	return true
end

local function hitRoot(object: GuiObject): Instance?
	local collector = object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
	if collector ~= nil and is3DCollector(collector) then
		return nil
	end
	return object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePlayerGui") or collector
end

local function rootCursor(tracker: Tracker, root: any): (number?, number?)
	if isPluginGui(root) then
		local ok, at = pcall(root.GetRelativeMousePosition, root)
		if ok and at ~= nil then
			return at.X, at.Y
		end
		return nil, nil
	end
	return tracker.x, tracker.y
end

local function hits(root: Instance, x: number, y: number, token: any?): { GuiObject }?
	if token ~= nil and token == memoToken and root == memoRoot and x == memoX and y == memoY then
		return memoList
	end
	local list = guisAt(root, x, y)
	if list ~= nil and token ~= nil then
		memoToken, memoRoot, memoX, memoY, memoList = token, root, x, y, list
		scheduleClearMemo()
	end
	return list
end

local function claims(gui: GuiObject, object: GuiObject, within: boolean): boolean
	return (gui.Active or gui.InputSink.Value ~= 0) and not (within and gui:IsDescendantOf(object))
end

local function scan(list: { GuiObject }, object: GuiObject, within: boolean): (boolean, boolean)
	local claimed = false
	for _, gui in list do
		if gui == object then
			return true, claimed
		elseif not claimed and claims(gui, object, within) then
			claimed = true
		end
	end
	return false, claimed
end

local function claimedAt(
	env: { GuiService: any }?,
	x: number,
	y: number,
	object: GuiObject,
	token: any?,
	within: boolean
): boolean
	if menuBlocks(env, object) then
		return true
	end
	local root = hitRoot(object)
	if root == nil then
		return false
	end
	local list = hits(root, x, y, token)
	if list == nil then
		return false
	end
	local _, claimed = scan(list, object, within)
	return claimed
end

--[[
Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI rendered above `object` (or while the Roblox escape menu is open).
Pass the `InputObject` as `token` to share the hit-test query across multiple controls on the same input event.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#sunk)
]]
local function sunk(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean
	return claimedAt(engineServices(), x, y, object, token, false)
end

--[[
Returns `true` when input at `(x, y)` would be claimed by an `Active` or input-sinking GUI above `object` that is not a descendant of `object`.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#covered)
]]
local function covered(x: number, y: number, object: GuiObject, token: any?): boolean
	return claimedAt(engineServices(), x, y, object, token, true)
end

--- @ignore
type Listener = {
	count: number,
	connections: { RBXScriptConnection }?,
	open: () -> { RBXScriptConnection },
	last: any?,
}

local function retain(listener: Listener)
	listener.count += 1
	if listener.count == 1 and listener.connections == nil then
		listener.connections = listener.open()
	end
end

local function release(listener: Listener)
	listener.count -= 1
	local connections = listener.connections
	if listener.count == 0 and connections ~= nil then
		listener.connections = nil
		listener.last = nil
		memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
		dispose(connections)
	end
end

--- @ignore
type Handler = (any) -> ()
--- @ignore
type Hub = Listener & {
	handlers: { [Instance]: { [Handler]: true } },
	last: Instance?,
}

--- @ignore
type Entry = {
	object: GuiObject,
	state: Graph.Node<boolean>,
	within: boolean,
	root: Instance?,
	inWorld3d: boolean?,
	touch: InputObject?,
}

--- @ignore
type Tracker = Listener & {
	env: HoverServices,
	inside: { [Entry]: true },
	world3d: { [Entry]: true },
	touched: { [Entry]: true },
	pluginFocus: { [any]: { count: number, conn: RBXScriptConnection } }?,
	x: number?,
	y: number?,
}

--- @ignore
type Registry = { activate: Hub, selected: Hub, hover: Tracker }

local registries: { [any]: Registry } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function dispatch(hub: Hub, object: Instance?, value: any)
	local set = if object ~= nil then hub.handlers[object] else nil
	if set == nil then
		return
	end
	for handler in set do
		handler(value)
	end
end

local function hubAdd(hub: Hub, object: Instance, handler: Handler)
	local set = hub.handlers[object]
	if set == nil then
		set = {}
		hub.handlers[object] = set
	end
	if not set[handler] then
		set[handler] = true
		retain(hub)
	end
end

local function hubRemove(hub: Hub, object: Instance, handler: Handler)
	local set = hub.handlers[object]
	if set == nil or not set[handler] then
		return
	end
	set[handler] = nil
	if next(set) == nil then
		hub.handlers[object] = nil
	end
	release(hub)
end

local function leavesMouse(kind: any): boolean
	if kind == nil then
		return false
	elseif TOUCH ~= nil and kind == TOUCH then
		return true
	elseif type(kind) ~= "userdata" and type(kind) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local name = kind.Name
	return type(name) == "string" and string.sub(name, 1, 7) == "Gamepad"
end

local function settleTouch(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	if entry.touch ~= nil then
		entry.touch = nil
		tracker.touched[entry] = nil
		release(tracker)
	end
	if entry.root == nil and not entry.inWorld3d then
		entry.state:set(false)
	end
	memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
end

local leave: (tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry) -> ()

local function leave3D(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	if entry.inWorld3d then
		entry.inWorld3d = nil
		tracker.world3d[entry] = nil
		release(tracker)
	end
	if entry.touch == nil and entry.root == nil then
		entry.state:set(false)
	end
end

local function enter3D(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	if not entry.inWorld3d then
		entry.inWorld3d = true
		tracker.world3d[entry] = true
		retain(tracker)
	end
end

local function releaseRoot(tracker: Tracker, root: any)
	local map = tracker.pluginFocus
	if map == nil then
		return
	end
	local record = map[root]
	if record == nil then
		return
	end
	record.count -= 1
	if record.count == 0 then
		map[root] = nil
		record.conn:Disconnect()
	end
end

local function retainRoot(tracker: Tracker, root: any)
	if not isPluginGui(root) then
		return
	end
	local existing = tracker.pluginFocus
	local map: { [any]: { count: number, conn: RBXScriptConnection } }
	if existing ~= nil then
		map = existing
	else
		map = {}
		tracker.pluginFocus = map
	end
	local record = map[root]
	if record ~= nil then
		record.count += 1
		return
	end
	local ok, conn = pcall(function(): any
		local sig = root.WindowFocusReleased
		if sig == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return sig:Connect(function()
			for entry in table.clone(tracker.inside) do
				if entry.root == root then
					leave(tracker, entry)
				end
			end
			if memoRoot == root then
				memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
			end
		end)
	end)
	if ok and conn ~= nil then
		map[root] = { count = 1, conn = conn :: RBXScriptConnection }
	end
end

local function attachRoot(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry, root: Instance)
	local prevRoot = entry.root
	if prevRoot == root then
		return
	end
	entry.root = root
	retainRoot(tracker, root)
	if prevRoot == nil then
		tracker.inside[entry] = true
		retain(tracker)
	else
		releaseRoot(tracker, prevRoot)
		if prevRoot == memoRoot then
			memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
		end
	end
end

leave = function(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry)
	local prevRoot = entry.root
	if prevRoot ~= nil then
		if prevRoot == memoRoot then
			memoToken, memoRoot, memoList = nil, nil, {}
		end
		entry.root = nil
		tracker.inside[entry] = nil
		releaseRoot(tracker, prevRoot)
		release(tracker)
	end
	if entry.touch == nil and not entry.inWorld3d then
		entry.state:set(false)
	end
end

local function stepTracker(tracker: Tracker)
	clearMemo()
	local open = menuOpen(tracker.env)
	if open then
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.touched) do
			if not inPluginGui(entry.object) then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.world3d) do
			if not inPluginGui(entry.object) then
				leave3D(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
	else
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.world3d) do
			local collector = find3DCollector(entry.object)
			if not is3DVisible(entry.object, collector) then
				leave3D(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
	end
	local lastRoot: any, lastList: { GuiObject }? = nil, nil
	for entry in table.clone(tracker.inside) do
		local prevRoot: any = entry.root
		if prevRoot == nil then
			continue
		end
		local root: any = hitRoot(entry.object)
		if root == nil then
			leave(tracker, entry)
			continue
		end
		attachRoot(tracker, entry, root)
		if open and not isPluginGui(root) then
			entry.state:set(false)
			continue
		end
		if root ~= lastRoot then
			lastRoot = root
			local rx, ry = rootCursor(tracker, root)
			lastList = if rx ~= nil then guisAt(root, rx, ry :: number) else nil
		end
		if lastList == nil then
			if entry.touch == nil and not entry.inWorld3d then
				entry.state:set(false)
			end
			continue
		end
		local found, claimed = scan(lastList, entry.object, entry.within)
		if not found then
			leave(tracker, entry)
		elseif entry.touch == nil then
			entry.state:set(not claimed)
		end
	end
end

local function connectTracker(tracker: Tracker): { RBXScriptConnection }
	local env = tracker.env
	tracker.x, tracker.y = nil, nil
	local input = env.UserInputService
	local function clearViewportMouse()
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.inside) do
			if not isPluginGui(entry.root) then
				leave(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.world3d) do
			leave3D(tracker, entry)
		end
		clearMemo()
	end
	local function clearAllMouse()
		clearViewportMouse()
		for entry in table.clone(tracker.inside) do
			leave(tracker, entry)
		end
	end
	local onHeartbeat = env.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		stepTracker(tracker)
	end)
	local onChanged = input.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed: InputObject)
		if changed.UserInputType == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			tracker.x, tracker.y = changed.Position.X, changed.Position.Y
		end
	end)
	local onEnded = input.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
		if ended.UserInputType == TOUCH then
			for entry in table.clone(tracker.touched) do
				if entry.touch == ended then
					settleTouch(tracker, entry)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	local onLastInput = input.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(kind: any)
		if leavesMouse(kind) then
			clearAllMouse()
		end
	end)
	local onFocusReleased = input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(clearViewportMouse)
	return { onHeartbeat, onChanged, onEnded, onLastInput, onFocusReleased }
end

local function registryFor(env: any): Registry
	local registry = registries[env]
	if registry ~= nil then
		return registry
	end

	local activate: any = { handlers = {}, count = 0 }
	activate.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local userInput = env.UserInputService
		local onInputBegan = userInput.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if ACTIVATE_KEYS[input.KeyCode] and userInput:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
				local target = env.GuiService.SelectedObject
				if target ~= nil and not menuBlocks(env, target) then
					dispatch(activate, target, input)
				end
			end
		end)
		return { onInputBegan }
	end

	local selected: any = { handlers = {}, count = 0 }
	selected.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local guiService = env.GuiService
		selected.last = guiService.SelectedObject
		local onSelectedChanged = guiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectedObject"):Connect(function()
			local now = guiService.SelectedObject
			local last = selected.last
			if now ~= last then
				selected.last = now
				dispatch(selected, last, false)
				dispatch(selected, now, true)
			end
		end)
		return { onSelectedChanged }
	end

	local tracker: any = { env = env, inside = {}, world3d = {}, touched = {}, count = 0 }
	tracker.open = function(): { RBXScriptConnection }
		local connected = connectTracker(tracker)
		return connected
	end

	registry = { activate = activate, selected = selected, hover = tracker }
	registries[env] = registry
	return registry
end

local function expose(state: Graph.Node<boolean>, object: Instance, onRelease: () -> ()): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local settled = false
	local destroying: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function settle()
		if settled then
			return
		end
		settled = true
		if destroying ~= nil then
			destroying:Disconnect()
			destroying = nil
		end
		onRelease()
	end
	destroying = object.Destroying:Connect(settle)
	state:onDestroy(settle)
	if Graph.getOwner() then
		Graph.cleanup(settle)
	end
	return state
end

local function enter(tracker: Tracker, entry: Entry, x: number?, y: number?)
	local root = hitRoot(entry.object)
	if root == nil then
		if entry.root ~= nil then
			leave(tracker, entry)
		end
		local collector = find3DCollector(entry.object)
		if is3DVisible(entry.object, collector) and not menuBlocks(tracker.env, entry.object) then
			enter3D(tracker, entry)
		elseif entry.inWorld3d then
			leave3D(tracker, entry)
		end
		return
	end
	if entry.inWorld3d then
		leave3D(tracker, entry)
	end
	attachRoot(tracker, entry, root)
	if isPluginGui(root) then
		return
	end
	if x ~= nil then
		tracker.x, tracker.y = x, y
	elseif tracker.x == nil then
		local env = tracker.env
		local ok, at = pcall(env.UserInputService.GetMouseLocation, env.UserInputService)
		if ok and at ~= nil then
			local ix, iy = guiInset(env)
			tracker.x, tracker.y = at.X - ix, at.Y - iy
		end
	end
end

local function _hoverWith(object: GuiObject, env: HoverServices?, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local within = options ~= nil and options.within == true
	local hovering = signal(false)
	local events: any = if env ~= nil and env.events ~= nil then env.events(object) else object
	local entry: Entry = { object = object, state = hovering, within = within }
	local tracker = if env ~= nil then registryFor(env).hover else nil

	local function track(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind ~= MOUSE_MOVEMENT and kind ~= TOUCH then
			return
		end
		if kind == TOUCH and entry.touch ~= nil and entry.touch ~= input then
			return
		end
		local pos = input.Position
		local on = not menuBlocks(env, object) and not claimedAt(env, pos.X, pos.Y, object, input, within)
		hovering:set(on)
		if kind == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			if tracker ~= nil then
				enter(tracker, entry, pos.X, pos.Y)
			end
		elseif tracker ~= nil then
			if on and entry.touch == nil then
				entry.touch = input
				tracker.touched[entry] = true
				retain(tracker)
			elseif not on and entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
		end
	end

	local onBegan: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputBegan:Connect(track)
	local onChanged: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputChanged:Connect(track)
	local onEnded: RBXScriptConnection = events.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind == MOUSE_MOVEMENT then
			if tracker ~= nil then
				leave(tracker, entry)
				leave3D(tracker, entry)
			else
				hovering:set(false)
			end
		elseif kind == TOUCH then
			if entry.touch ~= nil and entry.touch ~= input then
				return
			end
			if tracker ~= nil and entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
			hovering:set(false)
		end
	end)
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = { onBegan, onChanged, onEnded }
	local mouseEnter: any = events.MouseEnter
	local mouseLeave: any = events.MouseLeave
	if tracker ~= nil and mouseEnter ~= nil then
		local tracking: Tracker = tracker
		local onEnter: RBXScriptConnection = mouseEnter:Connect(function(mx: number?, my: number?)
			if not leavesMouse(tracking.env.UserInputService:GetLastInputType()) then
				if mx ~= nil and my ~= nil and find3DCollector(entry.object) == nil then
					local ix, iy = guiInset(tracking.env)
					enter(tracking, entry, mx - ix, my - iy)
				else
					enter(tracking, entry)
				end
			end
		end)
		local onLeave: RBXScriptConnection = mouseLeave:Connect(function()
			leave(tracking, entry)
			leave3D(tracking, entry)
		end)
		table.insert(connections, onEnter)
		table.insert(connections, onLeave)
	end

	return expose(hovering, object, function()
		dispose(connections)
		table.clear(connections)
		if tracker ~= nil then
			if entry.touch ~= nil then
				settleTouch(tracker, entry)
			end
			leave(tracker, entry)
			leave3D(tracker, entry)
		end
		hovering:set(false)
	end)
end

local hoverOverride: HoverServices? = nil

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while a pointer or touch contact is inside `object` with no input-claiming GUI above it.
Pass `{ within = true }` on containers so child controls inside `object` do not count as covering it.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#hover)
]]
local function hover(object: GuiObject, options: HoverOptions?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _hoverWith(object, hoverOverride or engineServices(), options)
end

local function useHoverServices(env: HoverServices?): HoverServices?
	local previous = hoverOverride
	hoverOverride = env
	return previous
end

local function _pressWith(object: GuiObject, env: Services?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local pressed = signal(false)
	local held: InputObject? = nil
	local releaseListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local objectReleaseListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local focusListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local pluginFocusListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local stateListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local menuListener: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

	local function disconnectOne(conn: RBXScriptConnection?): nil
		if conn ~= nil then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function releasePress()
		held = nil
		menuListener = disconnectOne(menuListener)
		releaseListener = disconnectOne(releaseListener)
		objectReleaseListener = disconnectOne(objectReleaseListener)
		focusListener = disconnectOne(focusListener)
		pluginFocusListener = disconnectOne(pluginFocusListener)
		stateListener = disconnectOne(stateListener)
		pressed:set(false)
	end

	local function isHeld(input: InputObject): boolean
		local current = held
		if current == nil then
			return false
		elseif input == current then
			return true
		end
		local kind = current.UserInputType
		return kind ~= TOUCH and input.UserInputType == kind and input.KeyCode == current.KeyCode
	end

	local function hold(input: InputObject)
		if held ~= nil or menuBlocks(env, object) then
			return
		end
		held = input
		pressed:set(true)
		local pluginRoot = pluginGuiOf(object)
		local isPlugin = pluginRoot ~= nil
		if env ~= nil then
			local services: Services = env
			if not isPlugin then
				menuListener = services.GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MenuIsOpen"):Connect(function()
					if menuBlocks(services, object) then
						releasePress()
					end
				end)
			end
			releaseListener = services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
				if isHeld(ended) then
					releasePress()
				end
			end)
			focusListener = tryConnect(services.UserInputService, "WindowFocusReleased", releasePress)
		end
		if env == nil or isPlugin then
			objectReleaseListener = object.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended: InputObject)
				if isHeld(ended) then
					releasePress()
				end
			end)
		end
		if pluginRoot ~= nil then
			pluginFocusListener = tryConnect(pluginRoot, "WindowFocusReleased", releasePress)
		end
		stateListener = tryConnectProperty(input, "UserInputState", function()
			local state = input.UserInputState
			if state == STATE_END or state == STATE_CANCEL then
				releasePress()
			end
		end)
	end

	local pointer = object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		local kind = input.UserInputType
		if kind == MOUSE_BUTTON1 or kind == TOUCH then
			local position = input.Position
			if not claimedAt(env, position.X, position.Y, object, input, false) then
				hold(input)
			end
		end
	end)
	local hub = if env ~= nil then registryFor(env).activate else nil
	local holdHandler: any = hold
	if hub ~= nil then
		hubAdd(hub, object, holdHandler)
	end

	return expose(pressed, object, function()
		pointer:Disconnect()
		if hub ~= nil then
			hubRemove(hub, object, holdHandler)
		end
		releasePress()
	end)
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) that is `true` while `object` is held down by pointer, touch, or gamepad/keyboard activation (`ButtonA`/`Enter`).
Stays `true` until that input ends anywhere on screen.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#press)
]]
local function press(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _pressWith(object, engineServices())
end

local function _selectedWith(object: GuiObject, env: Services?): Graph.Node<boolean>
	if env == nil then
		return expose(signal(false), object, function() end)
	end
	local guiService = env.GuiService
	local isSelected = signal(guiService.SelectedObject == object)
	local hub = registryFor(env).selected
	local function follow(on: any)
		isSelected:set(on == true)
	end
	hubAdd(hub, object, follow)

	return expose(isSelected, object, function()
		hubRemove(hub, object, follow)
		isSelected:set(false)
	end)
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `object` is currently [`GuiService.SelectedObject`](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/GuiService#SelectedObject).

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#selected)
]]
local function selected(object: GuiObject): Graph.Node<boolean>
	return _selectedWith(object, engineServices())
end

--[[
Returns a read-only boolean [node](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/concepts/signals) tracking whether `textBox` currently has keyboard focus.

[Open Documentation](https://flux.kohl.gg/guide/utilities/interact#focused)
]]
local function focused(textBox: TextBox): Graph.Node<boolean>
	local isFocused = signal(textBox:IsFocused())
	local onFocused = textBox.Focused:Connect(function()
		isFocused:set(true)
	end)
	local onFocusLost = textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		isFocused:set(false)
	end)
	local connections = { onFocused, onFocusLost }

	return expose(isFocused, textBox, function()
		dispose(connections)
		isFocused:set(false)
	end)
end

return table.freeze({
	pointIn = pointIn,
	sunk = sunk,
	covered = covered,

	hover = hover,
	press = press,
	selected = selected,
	focused = focused,

	--- @ignore
	_hoverWith = _hoverWith,
	--- @ignore
	_useHoverServices = useHoverServices,
	--- @ignore
	_pressWith = _pressWith,
	--- @ignore
	_selectedWith = _selectedWith,
})
